b: Nono Jesus ure tuie mekido. Jorudure nowu areduji rugadu. Akore are. Amearutorure i rugadu. Dukodire apemegagodumode rugadu. Nono nowu aredu pemegagodure taci je rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tuie mekido. Jorudure nowu areduji rugadu. Akore are. Amearutorure i rugadu. Dukodire apemegagodumode rugadu. Nono nowu aredu pemegagodure taci je rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus aregodure nowu boe eimijera uwai ka. Boe emagare nono tragudu tabo. Edukiorokare. Nou boe ere tuwabo ako rakado jamedu. Jesus jorudure nowu inoduji dukeje makore nowu boe ji. Akore tadawuje awu bai piji. Aredurogu bikare. Unudunure tu je. Mare nowu boe eruduware nowu nogwaredu bire rugadu duji dukodire enogwarigodure Jesus ji.
source: Nono Jesus aregodure nowu boe eimijera uwai ka. Boe emagare nono tragudu tabo. Edukiorokare. Nou boe ere tuwabo ako rakado jamedu. Jesus jorudure nowu inoduji dukeje makore nowu boe ji. Akore tadawuje awu bai piji. Aredurogu bikare. Unudunure tu je. Mare nowu boe eruduware nowu nogwaredu bire rugadu duji dukodire enogwarigodure Jesus ji.

b: Mare nowu boe eimijera ure nowu boe etawuje tuwai piji. Dukejere Jesus ure turemo nowu nogwaredu padure tadawu baito. Dukeje ure tugeragu nowu nogwaredu ieraji. Nono nowu nogwaredu jewodure pugeje rugadu. Ure tumugudo rugadu.
source: Mare nowu boe eimijera ure nowu boe etawuje tuwai piji. Dukejere Jesus ure turemo nowu nogwaredu padure tadawu baito. Dukeje ure tugeragu nowu nogwaredu ieraji. Nono nowu nogwaredu jewodure pugeje rugadu. Ure tumugudo rugadu.

b: Nou boe eruduware nowu inoduji dukodire ereadodure boe eiamedu boe ewiagai awu Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Nou boe eruduware nowu inoduji dukodire ereadodure boe eiamedu boe ewiagai awu Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Jesus Ure Ime Epemegago Jamedu
source: Jesus Ure Ime Epemegago Jamedu

b: Nono Jesus uture pugeje. Mare ia ime joku bokwarewuge ekodure Jesus rekodaji. Ere pobe. Ekudugodure Jesus bagai. egore Mariguduwu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Davi uwobenure aki. Akogudugo cedabo.
source: Nono Jesus uture pugeje. Mare ia ime joku bokwarewuge ekodure Jesus rekodaji. Ere pobe. Ekudugodure Jesus bagai. egore Mariguduwu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Davi uwobenure aki. Akogudugo cedabo.

b: Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ime joku bokwarewuge ere turemo Jesus rekodaji. Etaregodure Jesus ae rugadu. Jesus makore ei. Akore tamearutorure i imode tabemegago duji rugadu kana? egore uu. Cegimijeranure aki.
source: Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ime joku bokwarewuge ere turemo Jesus rekodaji. Etaregodure Jesus ae rugadu. Jesus makore ei. Akore tamearutorure i imode tabemegago duji rugadu kana? egore uu. Cegimijeranure aki.

b: Dukejere Jesus ure tugera bu eku keje. Nono makore ei. Akore tamearutorure jiboe jetuwo pudui tai rugadu.
source: Dukejere Jesus ure tugera bu eku keje. Nono makore ei. Akore tamearutorure jiboe jetuwo pudui tai rugadu.

b: Nono epemegagodure taci je rugadu. Etaiwore pugeje rugadu. Mare Jesus makogodure ei. Akore tareadodukaba boe ewiagai awu irore jiboe ji.
source: Nono epemegagodure taci je rugadu. Etaiwore pugeje rugadu. Mare Jesus makogodure ei. Akore tareadodukaba boe ewiagai awu irore jiboe ji.

b: Mare eture Jesus piji dukeje ereadodure Jesus rore jiboe ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto rugadu boe parugajeje.
source: Mare eture Jesus piji dukeje ereadodure Jesus rore jiboe ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai nowu moto rugadu boe parugajeje.

b: Eture dukeje iage etaregodure ia imedu apo Jesus bagai pugeje. Nou imedu mako bokware. Roiwakare tumagowo. Bope meture tada kodi.
source: Eture dukeje iage etaregodure ia imedu apo Jesus bagai pugeje. Nou imedu mako bokware. Roiwakare tumagowo. Bope meture tada kodi.

b: Mare Jesus ure nowu bope tawuje nowu imedu piji dukeje nowu imedu makore pugeje. Boe emagare nono tuiorudure Jesus roino jitu tabo. Eiamedu boe ebogodure rugadu. egore Marigudu Israel moto kejewu boe erudukare ia awu inodu boe ji jii aino.
source: Mare Jesus ure nowu bope tawuje nowu imedu piji dukeje nowu imedu makore pugeje. Boe emagare nono tuiorudure Jesus roino jitu tabo. Eiamedu boe ebogodure rugadu. egore Marigudu Israel moto kejewu boe erudukare ia awu inodu boe ji jii aino.

b: Mare fariseu doge etaidukare Jesus rore jiboe ji. Emago pegare ji. egore bope doge eimijera kurirewu raka tabore awu Jesus roino tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.
source: Mare fariseu doge etaidukare Jesus rore jiboe ji. Emago pegare ji. egore bope doge eimijera kurirewu raka tabore awu Jesus roino tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji.

b: Maragodure Pao Kurirewu Aiwuge Emagakare
source: Maragodure Pao Kurirewu Aiwuge Emagakare

b: Jesus kodure nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje boe eda jamedu boe ka. Aregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje ure turemo nowu Judeu doge ere bato pui towu baito. Nonore ure eruduwado tuwadaru pemegarewu ji tu tu je. Ure ewie Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijerado pudumi kuri je rugadu. Ure kogodurewuge eiamedu boe epemegago jamedu.
source: Jesus kodure nowu moto jamedu boe parugajeje boe eda jamedu boe ka. Aregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje ure turemo nowu Judeu doge ere bato pui towu baito. Nonore ure eruduwado tuwadaru pemegarewu ji tu tu je. Ure ewie Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijerado pudumi kuri je rugadu. Ure kogodurewuge eiamedu boe epemegago jamedu.

b: Boe emagare Jesus apo tu tu je. Jesus jorudure nowu boe ji dukeje okudugodure ebo rugadu. Akore eie nono ovelha doge emogadure. Jetu pemegare eiwu bokwaie. Boe pegaie ei. Eruduwakaie nuba turomode. Mare ovelha ji karega akoino. Nou boe eroiwakare tuwo tuginorudo. Dujire akoino. Ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jiwu bokware. Dujire akoino.
source: Boe emagare Jesus apo tu tu je. Jesus jorudure nowu boe ji dukeje okudugodure ebo rugadu. Akore eie nono ovelha doge emogadure. Jetu pemegare eiwu bokwaie. Boe pegaie ei. Eruduwakaie nuba turomode. Mare ovelha ji karega akoino. Nou boe eroiwakare tuwo tuginorudo. Dujire akoino. Ure eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jiwu bokware. Dujire akoino.

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boepa kurire rugadu. Nou boepa tadaboe ure turugadu boe ewo kado. Mare umode boepa tadaboe kadowuge emagakare.
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore boepa kurire rugadu. Nou boepa tadaboe ure turugadu boe ewo kado. Mare umode boepa tadaboe kadowuge emagakare.

b: Dukodire tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Boepa jiwu boe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Tamagodo ji maragoduwo boepa jiwuge emagawo etuwo boepato ewo boepa tadaboe kado rugadu. Mare boepa ji karega Jesus akoino. Mearutorumode Pao Kurirewu jiwugeire akoino. Boe emode boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji, Pao Kurirewu umode ekinorudo. Dujire akoino.
source: Dukodire tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Boepa jiwu boe eimijera kurirewunure ema. Tamagodo ji maragoduwo boepa jiwuge emagawo etuwo boepato ewo boepa tadaboe kado rugadu. Mare boepa ji karega Jesus akoino. Mearutorumode Pao Kurirewu jiwugeire akoino. Boe emode boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorumode ji, Pao Kurirewu umode ekinorudo. Dujire akoino.

b: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Enodo Padure Doze
source: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Enodo Padure Doze

b: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai pudae. Ere doze. Nono ure eragado ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Ure eragado ewo boe epemegago ekogodae boe piji.
source: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai pudae. Ere doze. Nono ure eragado ewo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Ure eragado ewo boe epemegago ekogodae boe piji.

b: Ainore nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekiere: Simão. Iere Pedro jamedu. André. Pedro uwienure ema. Tiago. Nou Tiago uo iere Zebedeu. João. Tiago uwienure ema.
source: Ainore nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekiere: Simão. Iere Pedro jamedu. André. Pedro uwienure ema. Tiago. Nou Tiago uo iere Zebedeu. João. Tiago uwienure ema.

b: Filipe, Bartolomeu, Tomé, Mateus. Boe ere to diero maku nowu Mateus ai uwo maku boe eimijerage etai. Tiago. Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Tadeu.
source: Filipe, Bartolomeu, Tomé, Mateus. Boe ere to diero maku nowu Mateus ai uwo maku boe eimijerage etai. Tiago. Alfeu onaregedunure ema. Tadeu.

b: Simão. Emare makore tumedagei marigudu emearutorukawo Roma kejewu boe eimijeragei pugeje. Judas Iscariotes. Emare umode Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Nou ime eture Jesus bataru tabowuge umode emage rugadu.
source: Simão. Emare makore tumedagei marigudu emearutorukawo Roma kejewu boe eimijeragei pugeje. Judas Iscariotes. Emare umode Jesus maku boe eimijera pegarewuge etai. Nou ime eture Jesus bataru tabowuge umode emage rugadu.

b: Awu doze ime dogere Jesus ure etudo tuwadaru tabo. Makore ei. Akore tadukaba boe tuginaiwuge etae. Tadukaba ia Samaritano doge eda ka.
source: Awu doze ime dogere Jesus ure etudo tuwadaru tabo. Makore ei. Akore tadukaba boe tuginaiwuge etae. Tadukaba ia Samaritano doge eda ka.

b: Tadudo tu Judeu doge etae. Ere nono okware boetowuge ovelha doge emogadure. Mare ovelha ji karega inagoino. Nou Judeu doge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino.
source: Tadudo tu Judeu doge etae. Ere nono okware boetowuge ovelha doge emogadure. Mare ovelha ji karega inagoino. Nou Judeu doge emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ji pugeje. Dujire inagoino.

b: Tadumode dukeje tamagomode tarudure jiwuge ewiagai awu iwadaru ji. Tamagodo: “Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri je.” Ainore tagagomode boe ji.
source: Tadumode dukeje tamagomode tarudure jiwuge ewiagai awu iwadaru ji. Tamagodo: “Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri je.” Ainore tagagomode boe ji.

b: Tadumode dukeje tamode kogodurewuge epemegago. Tamode birewuge eewodudo pugeje. Tamode kogodurewuge biri pegarewuge epemegago. Tamode bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Ire taragado tarowo awu inagoino jiwu taroji mare ikare nowu ire maku tagaiboe morido. Dukodire tamodukare boe edo iaboe maku tagai tarore jiboe morice jamedu.
source: Tadumode dukeje tamode kogodurewuge epemegago. Tamode birewuge eewodudo pugeje. Tamode kogodurewuge biri pegarewuge epemegago. Tamode bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Ire taragado tarowo awu inagoino jiwu taroji mare ikare nowu ire maku tagaiboe morido. Dukodire tamodukare boe edo iaboe maku tagai tarore jiboe morice jamedu.

b: Tadukaba tori kuieje tabo. Tadukaba prata tabo. Tadukaba ia diero tabo rugadu.
source: Tadukaba tori kuieje tabo. Tadukaba prata tabo. Tadukaba ia diero tabo rugadu.

b: Tadukaba ia tagudau areia meture tadawu kadarabo tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau areia tabo. Tadukaba ia tawure okeakejewu tabo. Tadukaba ia tagedu jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadumode tawo boe ewie iwadaru ji. Dukodire boe etu pemegamode tai.
source: Tadukaba ia tagudau areia meture tadawu kadarabo tabo. Tadukaba ia tagudau areia tabo. Tadukaba ia tawure okeakejewu tabo. Tadukaba ia tagedu jiwu tagaibo tabo. Tadudo tu meture taiwu tagudau areia tabo. Tadumode tawo boe ewie iwadaru ji. Dukodire boe etu pemegamode tai.

b: Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tagaiwodo ia ro pemegarewu bagai tamuguwo nono uwai keje jii tadure kejewu meri ka.
source: Tagaregodumode ia boe eda ka dukeje tagaiwodo ia ro pemegarewu bagai tamuguwo nono uwai keje jii tadure kejewu meri ka.

b: Tamode taremo nowu baito dukeje tagimadudo nowu boebo.
source: Tamode taremo nowu baito dukeje tagimadudo nowu boebo.

b: Nou bai tadawuge ero pemegamode tai, etaidumode tai tietu pemegawo tai dukeje tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ei. Mare ero pemegamodukare tai dukeje tagaba tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai.
source: Nou bai tadawuge ero pemegamode tai, etaidumode tai tietu pemegawo tai dukeje tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ei. Mare ero pemegamodukare tai dukeje tagaba tawadaru pemegarewu maku etai.

b: Ia boe eda kejewuge etaidumodukare tamagore jiboe ji. Ekimadumodukare tagabo dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode nowu boe eda piji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu tawuje nowu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe jituji kodire umode tugera ra epiji.
source: Ia boe eda kejewuge etaidumodukare tamagore jiboe ji. Ekimadumodukare tagabo dukeje tadudo epiji. Tadumode nowu boe eda piji dukeje tawure okeakejewu to pui egai tawo moto urugudu tawuje nowu tawure okeakejewu piji nowu boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu erore jiboe jituji kodire umode tugera ra epiji.

b: Inure tawie. Boe pegamode nowu aidukare taiwugei rugadu. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji. Mariguduwuge Sodoma kejewuge ero pegare. Gomorra kejewuge ero pegare jamedu. Dukodire nowu meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado nowu Sodoma kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Umode boe pegado nowu Gomorra kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Mare nowu aidukare taiwuge boe eire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode nowu Sodoma kejewuge ekori, nowu Gomorra kejewuge ekori jamedu.
source: Inure tawie. Boe pegamode nowu aidukare taiwugei rugadu. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe eiamedu boe erore jiboe ji. Mariguduwuge Sodoma kejewuge ero pegare. Gomorra kejewuge ero pegare jamedu. Dukodire nowu meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado nowu Sodoma kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Umode boe pegado nowu Gomorra kejewugei ero pegarewu morice. Mare nowu aidukare taiwuge boe eire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode nowu Sodoma kejewuge ekori, nowu Gomorra kejewuge ekori jamedu.

b: Boe Pegamode Mearutorure Jesus Jiwugei
source: Boe Pegamode Mearutorure Jesus Jiwugei

b: – Nou ire tadudo etaewuge ere nono rie doge emogadure. Tare nono ovelha doge emogadure. Mare barogo ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu bokware. Dujire inagoino. Mare tadumode ewagaiwuge emearudae pegamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire inure tawie. Taeku jado nono awagu ro mogadure. Mare awagu ji karega inagoino. Taruduwado boe emearudae jamedu boe ji. Dujire inagoino. Mare tamearudae pegarewu bokwado nono metugo mogadure. Mare metugo ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegakaba boe ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: – Nou ire tadudo etaewuge ere nono rie doge emogadure. Tare nono ovelha doge emogadure. Mare barogo ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu bokware. Dujire inagoino. Mare tadumode ewagaiwuge emearudae pegamode rugadu. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire inure tawie. Taeku jado nono awagu ro mogadure. Mare awagu ji karega inagoino. Taruduwado boe emearudae jamedu boe ji. Dujire inagoino. Mare tamearudae pegarewu bokwado nono metugo mogadure. Mare metugo ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegakaba boe ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Taeku jado ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewu bagai. Mare ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu tai rugadu. Emode tamagu Judeu doge eimijerage etai. Emode tarego Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore emode boeto tai tapira biri iku tabo.
source: Taeku jado ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewu bagai. Mare ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu tai rugadu. Emode tamagu Judeu doge eimijerage etai. Emode tarego Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Nonore emode boeto tai tapira biri iku tabo.

b: Tamearutorumode i dukodire ro pegarewuge emode tamagu boe ekimijera governador doge etai. Emode tamagu boe ekimijerage kurirewuge etai rugadu. Nono tamode nowu boe ekimijerage ewie iwadaru ji jamedu. Tamode boe tuginaiwuge ewie iwadaru ji jamedu.
source: Tamearutorumode i dukodire ro pegarewuge emode tamagu boe ekimijera governador doge etai. Emode tamagu boe ekimijerage kurirewuge etai rugadu. Nono tamode nowu boe ekimijerage ewie iwadaru ji jamedu. Tamode boe tuginaiwuge ewie iwadaru ji jamedu.

b: Mare nowu boe ekimijerage emode tadugu baicorewuto dukeje tamororamagadukaba ia tamagomode jiboe bagai. Tamororamagadukaba tamode ewie jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega. Pao Kurirewu Uwari makomode tai tuwo tamagore jiboe maku tagai Taonure ema kodi. Emare umode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu makomode jiboe ji tamagowo nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe ekimijerage ewiagai.
source: Mare nowu boe ekimijerage emode tadugu baicorewuto dukeje tamororamagadukaba ia tamagomode jiboe bagai. Tamororamagadukaba tamode ewie jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega. Pao Kurirewu Uwari makomode tai tuwo tamagore jiboe maku tagai Taonure ema kodi. Emare umode taruduwado Pao Kurirewu makomode jiboe ji tamagowo nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe ekimijerage ewiagai.

b: – Imode tawie iaboe ji pugeje. Tamearutorure i dukodire boe erudu pegamode tai, ero pegamode tai. Mare tamodukare tagera ra ipiji dukeje imode taginorudo rugadu. Ia boe emearutorumode i dukodire etumana mage emode nowu tuwiemage mearutorure iwuge emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Ia boe emearutorumode i dukodire etuo jorudu pegamode ei. Dukodire nowu etuo umode tore mearutorure iwuge emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Ia boe etore etuje mearutorumode i dukodire boe etore etaidumodukare nowu tujeji pugeje. Ia boe etore etuo mearutorumode i dukodire nowu boe etore etaidumodukare nowu tuoji pugeje. Dukodire nowu boe etore emode tujemage tuomage mearutorure iwuge emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo jamedu.

Ia boe emearutorumode i dukodire etumana mage emode nowu tuwiemage mearutorure iwuge emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Ia boe emearutorumode i dukodire etuo jorudu pegamode ei. b: Mare ia boe ero pegamode tai dukeje tarego nowu boe epiji tamuguwo ia boe eda keje pugeje. Iwo tawie. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Tadumode Judeu doge eno moto kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka jii toro imode ikirimi kejewu meri ka. Mare tagaregodumodukare nowu Judeu doge emugure kejewu eda jamedu boe ka jii itaregodumode du ka.
source: Mare ia boe ero pegamode tai dukeje tarego nowu boe epiji tamuguwo ia boe eda keje pugeje. Iwo tawie. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Tadumode Judeu doge eno moto kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka jii toro imode ikirimi kejewu meri ka. Mare tagaregodumodukare nowu Judeu doge emugure kejewu eda jamedu boe ka jii itaregodumode du ka.

b: Boe emearutorumodukare ia mugure bapera kejewuji joruduwamodukare nono tugimijera mogadure. Boe emearutorumode tu nowu mugure bapera kejewu ukimijeraji. Boe emearutorumodukare ia boe eimijera utugareji. Boe emearutorumode tu nowu boe eimijeraji.
source: Boe emearutorumodukare ia mugure bapera kejewuji joruduwamodukare nono tugimijera mogadure. Boe emearutorumode tu nowu mugure bapera kejewu ukimijeraji. Boe emearutorumodukare ia boe eimijera utugareji. Boe emearutorumode tu nowu boe eimijeraji.

b: Mare nowu mugure bapera kejewu joruduware jiboe umode nono nowu ukimijera joruduware jiboe mogadure. Du ure turugadu. Nou boe eimijera utugare romode nono tugimijera ro mogadure. Du ure turugadu. Boe emode ia boe etuo iedo “Mareboe” aino dukeje emode nowu imedu uwobe ekiedo aino jamedu. Mare ire inagoino. Taire inagoino jamedu. Boe etokire i nowu bope ie tabo. Etokimode tai jamedu. Dujire inagoino. Etoki kuricigomode tai rugadu tokire i dupiji rugadu.
source: Mare nowu mugure bapera kejewu joruduware jiboe umode nono nowu ukimijera joruduware jiboe mogadure. Du ure turugadu. Nou boe eimijera utugare romode nono tugimijera ro mogadure. Du ure turugadu. Boe emode ia boe etuo iedo “Mareboe” aino dukeje emode nowu imedu uwobe ekiedo aino jamedu. Mare ire inagoino. Taire inagoino jamedu. Boe etokire i nowu bope ie tabo. Etokimode tai jamedu. Dujire inagoino. Etoki kuricigomode tai rugadu tokire i dupiji rugadu.

b: Mare tabagudukaba ece. Boe ero pegamode dukeje etaidumode tuwo nowu turo pegarewu biado boe epiji tumagowo ro pemegarewuge nuie pudumi. Mare Pao Kurirewu joruduware marigudu ero pegarewu ji dukodire boe eruduwamode nowu ero pegarewu ji jamedu.
source: Mare tabagudukaba ece. Boe ero pegamode dukeje etaidumode tuwo nowu turo pegarewu biado boe epiji tumagowo ro pemegarewuge nuie pudumi. Mare Pao Kurirewu joruduware marigudu ero pegarewu ji dukodire boe eruduwamode nowu ero pegarewu ji jamedu.

b: Tu tagi taruduware ia ire taruduwado jiboe ji mare tamagodo nowu ire taruduwado jiboe ji boe ewiagai rugadu. Tamago pemegado ji boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo tamagore jiboe ji.
source: Tu tagi taruduware ia ire taruduwado jiboe ji mare tamagodo nowu ire taruduwado jiboe ji boe ewiagai rugadu. Tamago pemegado ji boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo tamagore jiboe ji.

b: Boe Epagudukawo Ceboe Reo
source: Boe Epagudukawo Ceboe Reo

b: – Tabagudukaba boece. Boe emode tawido mare eragakare tuwo tawarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tabagudukaba ece. Tu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koiare umode boe ewarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto boe ewi keje. Tabagududo tu Pao Kurirewuce. Mare tabagudu remawu ji karega inagoino. Taragado tai rugadu tamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.
source: – Tabagudukaba boece. Boe emode tawido mare eragakare tuwo tawarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tabagudukaba ece. Tu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koiare umode boe ewarigu bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto boe ewi keje. Tabagududo tu Pao Kurirewuce. Mare tabagudu remawu ji karega inagoino. Taragado tai rugadu tamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dujire inagoino.

b: Ca kiebarege kugure emode pobe dukeje boe emode to diero torirogu udo mitotu je tuwo akirodo nowu kiebarege kugurei tugece tuwo kowuje. Nou kiebarege emori bokware mare du inodu tabo Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare epiji rugadu. Ewudumodukare moto ka Pao Kurirewu mearudae piji.
source: Ca kiebarege kugure emode pobe dukeje boe emode to diero torirogu udo mitotu je tuwo akirodo nowu kiebarege kugurei tugece tuwo kowuje. Nou kiebarege emori bokware mare du inodu tabo Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare epiji rugadu. Ewudumodukare moto ka Pao Kurirewu mearudae piji.

b: Mare Pao Kurirewu aidure tai du kodure nowu kiebarege kugure eiamedu boe ekori. Dukodire jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Joruduware tai rugadu. Joruduware tagao iku jamedu boe ji. Joruduware nowu inodurogu boe ji kodire joruduware nuba boe mode tai duji rugadu. Jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tabagudukawo boece rugadu.
source: Mare Pao Kurirewu aidure tai du kodure nowu kiebarege kugure eiamedu boe ekori. Dukodire jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Joruduware tai rugadu. Joruduware tagao iku jamedu boe ji. Joruduware nowu inodurogu boe ji kodire joruduware nuba boe mode tai duji rugadu. Jetu pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai tabagudukawo boece rugadu.

b: Boe Ewo Boe Ewie Tumearutoruie Jesus ji
source: Boe Ewo Boe Ewie Tumearutoruie Jesus ji

b: – Iwo tawie iaboe ji pugeje. Ia boe emagomode boe eiamedu boe ewiagai tuie tumagu inai tumearutoruwo tu i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu biagai baru tada nowu mearutorure iwu nuie ema rugadu. Toro nowu Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe ero pegarewu bagaiwu meri kejere imagomode aino ji.
source: – Iwo tawie iaboe ji pugeje. Ia boe emagomode boe eiamedu boe ewiagai tuie tumagu inai tumearutoruwo tu i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu biagai baru tada nowu mearutorure iwu nuie ema rugadu. Toro nowu Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe ero pegarewu bagaiwu meri kejere imagomode aino ji.

b: Mare ia boe makomode boe ewiagai tugaie tumagu inai, tumearutorukaie i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu biagai baru tada nowu mearutorukare iwu nuie ema rugadu.
source: Mare ia boe makomode boe ewiagai tugaie tumagu inai, tumearutorukaie i dukeje imagomode Pao Kurirewu biagai baru tada nowu mearutorukare iwu nuie ema rugadu.

b: Tamearudaere itaregodure iwo boe epemegado pui. Ca itaregodure iwo boe pemegado boe ji rugadu. Mare ia boe emearutorumodukare i. Dukodire emearudaemodukare nono pumearudae mogadure imagore jiboe ji. Dukodire boe epemegamodukare pui.
source: Tamearudaere itaregodure iwo boe epemegado pui. Ca itaregodure iwo boe pemegado boe ji rugadu. Mare ia boe emearutorumodukare i. Dukodire emearudaemodukare nono pumearudae mogadure imagore jiboe ji. Dukodire boe epemegamodukare pui.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie nuba boemode mearutorure iwuge ji. Aino nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Akore ime emearudaemodukare nono tuo mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuo mearudae pegamode nowu tore imei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono tuje mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuje mearudae pegamode nowu tore aremei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono turagomage emearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu eturago mage emearudae pegamode nowu tujarugo magei. Nou imedu uwobe erudu pegamode ji. Jorudu pegare jiwuge emode emage. – Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie nuba boemode mearutorure iwuge ji. Aino nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Akore ime emearudaemodukare nono tuo mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuo mearudae pegamode nowu tore imei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono tuje mearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu etuje mearudae pegamode nowu tore aremei. Areme emearudaemodukare nono turagomage emearudae mogadure. Dukodire nowu eturago mage emearudae pegamode nowu tujarugo magei. Nou imedu uwobe erudu pegamode ji. Jorudu pegare jiwuge emode emage. – Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu.

b: Iwo tawie pugeje. Boe emearudu kurimodukare i tuje kori, tuo kori, tore ime ekori, tore areme ekori, dukeje ukare turugadu iwo eruduwado imearudae ji.
source: Iwo tawie pugeje. Boe emearudu kurimodukare i tuje kori, tuo kori, tore ime ekori, tore areme ekori, dukeje ukare turugadu iwo eruduwado imearudae ji.

b: Imearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu ji dukodire boe erudu pegare i, emode iwido. Boe etaidumode tuwo tumearutorudo imearudae ji dukeje ewo tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure. Emodukare tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure dukeje imodukare eruduwado imearudae ji.
source: Imearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu ji dukodire boe erudu pegare i, emode iwido. Boe etaidumode tuwo tumearutorudo imearudae ji dukeje ewo tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure. Emodukare tudo turugadu tuwiwo nono iwimode dumogadure dukeje imodukare eruduwado imearudae ji.

b: Boe emearudae pemegare tuwo tuginorudo mare emearudaere tu pudui. Mare nowu eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare tuginorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare ia boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra tumearudae piji, taidure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo i rugadu. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto.
source: Boe emearudae pemegare tuwo tuginorudo mare emearudaere tu pudui. Mare nowu eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare tuginorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare ia boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra tumearudae piji, taidure jiboe piji tumearutoruwo i rugadu. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto.

b: Inure tawie. Ia boe eruduware tamearutorure i duji. Nono ekimadumode tagabo ekimadunure itabo jamedu. Ire eroino jamedu. Boe ekimadumode itabo ekimadunure ure itarego matowu Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Ire eroino Pao Kurirewu jire eroino jamedu.
source: Inure tawie. Ia boe eruduware tamearutorure i duji. Nono ekimadumode tagabo ekimadunure itabo jamedu. Ire eroino jamedu. Boe ekimadumode itabo ekimadunure ure itarego matowu Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Ire eroino Pao Kurirewu jire eroino jamedu.

b: Boe eruduware ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei dukodire ekimadumode ebo dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei nono turo moga makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei dumogadure. Boe eruduware ia ro pemegarewugei dukodire ekimadumode ebo dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei nono turo moga ro pemegarewugei dumogadure.
source: Boe eruduware ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei dukodire ekimadumode ebo dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei nono turo moga makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei dumogadure. Boe eruduware ia ro pemegarewugei dukodire ekimadumode ebo dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei nono turo moga ro pemegarewugei dumogadure.

b: Iwo tawie rugadu. Boe eruduware mearutorure iwugei dukodire emode pobo maku etai ekuduwo ce. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei eroino du morice.
source: Iwo tawie rugadu. Boe eruduware mearutorure iwugei dukodire emode pobo maku etai ekuduwo ce. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei eroino du morice.

b: João Batista Ure Joruduwadowuge Ero Reo
source: João Batista Ure Joruduwadowuge Ero Reo

b: Jesus ure tumago akedudo nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje uture pugeje. Nou ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze. Ca uture Galiléia moto kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka tuwo boe eruduwado. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai tu tu je.
source: Jesus ure tumago akedudo nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje uture pugeje. Nou ure joruduwadowuge enodo padure doze. Ca uture Galiléia moto kejewu boe eda jamedu boe ka tuwo boe eruduwado. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai tu tu je.

b: João Batista rakojere baicorewu tada. Boe ere João Batista bie nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji. Dukodire João Batista ure ia ture joruduwadowuge etudo toro Jesus bagai.
source: João Batista rakojere baicorewu tada. Boe ere João Batista bie nowu Jesus rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji. Dukodire João Batista ure ia ture joruduwadowuge etudo toro Jesus bagai.

b: Makore ei enarawo Jesus ji Pao Kurirewu umoduie maku boe etaiwu boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu kana? Enarawo Jesus ji boe epagaiago ia bagai kimo kana? Dukodire eture Jesus ae rugadu. Enarare Jesus ji nono tugimijera makore pudui dumogadure rugadu.
source: Makore ei enarawo Jesus ji Pao Kurirewu umoduie maku boe etaiwu boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu kana? Enarawo Jesus ji boe epagaiago ia bagai kimo kana? Dukodire eture Jesus ae rugadu. Enarare Jesus ji nono tugimijera makore pudui dumogadure rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore tagirimi tawo João biedu pemegado rugadu tarudure jiwu irore jiboe ji tamearudure jiwu imagore jiboe ji.
source: Nono Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore tagirimi tawo João biedu pemegado rugadu tarudure jiwu irore jiboe ji tamearudure jiwu imagore jiboe ji.

b: Ire joku bokwarewuge epemegago etaiwowo pugeje. Ire pogora pegarewuge epemegago emeruwo pugeje. Ire kogodurewuge ewiri pegarewuge epemegago ewiri pemegawo pugeje. Ire bija bokwarewuge epemegago emearuduwo pugeje. Ire birewuge eewodudo pugeje. Ire marenarue doge ewie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu aregoduie rugadu.
source: Ire joku bokwarewuge epemegago etaiwowo pugeje. Ire pogora pegarewuge epemegago emeruwo pugeje. Ire kogodurewuge ewiri pegarewuge epemegago ewiri pemegawo pugeje. Ire bija bokwarewuge epemegago emearuduwo pugeje. Ire birewuge eewodudo pugeje. Ire marenarue doge ewie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu aregoduie rugadu.

b: Boe pemegamode nowu mearutorure iwu boe ji. Emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji nono egaremode pudui rugadu.
source: Boe pemegamode nowu mearutorure iwu boe ji. Emodukare tugera ra tumearutorure i dupiji nono egaremode pudui rugadu.

b: Nou João Batista ure joruduwadowuge eture pugeje Jesus piji. Dukeje Jesus makore João Batista rore jiboe ji nowu rakojere pudabowuge boe ewiagai. Akore marigudu tadure jice boe akurugudu maerewu ka mare taruduwo bakuru jeture boebutu jitu bagai karega. Taruduwo ukudau areia moturewu jiwu boe ewagai karega. Taruduwo oe kurirewuge ewagai karega. Nou ukudau areia moturewu jiwu boe emugure bai kurirewu tada. Oe kurirewuge emugure bai kurirewu tada. Tadumode bai kurirewu ka nouge ewagai. Mare tadure boe maerewu ka. Tadure toro taruduwo João Batistaji. Taruduware João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jituji. Dukodire tadure toro boe maerewu ka João Batista bagai. Aino ca imode tawie. João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Mare imode tawie iaboe ji pugeje. João Batista rore nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure rugadu.
source: Nou João Batista ure joruduwadowuge eture pugeje Jesus piji. Dukeje Jesus makore João Batista rore jiboe ji nowu rakojere pudabowuge boe ewiagai. Akore marigudu tadure jice boe akurugudu maerewu ka mare taruduwo bakuru jeture boebutu jitu bagai karega. Taruduwo ukudau areia moturewu jiwu boe ewagai karega. Taruduwo oe kurirewuge ewagai karega. Nou ukudau areia moturewu jiwu boe emugure bai kurirewu tada. Oe kurirewuge emugure bai kurirewu tada. Tadumode bai kurirewu ka nouge ewagai. Mare tadure boe maerewu ka. Tadure toro taruduwo João Batistaji. Taruduware João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jituji. Dukodire tadure toro boe maerewu ka João Batista bagai. Aino ca imode tawie. João Batista makore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Mare imode tawie iaboe ji pugeje. João Batista rore nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure rugadu.

b: Dujire Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu. Nou bataru padure bapera keje. Akore Imode itugare arego uwo boe pemegado nowu umode boe ekinorudowu togi.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. João Batista jire akoino. Dukodire care awu bataru jeture pudui rugadu.
source: Dujire Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu. Nou bataru padure bapera keje. Akore Imode itugare arego uwo boe pemegado nowu umode boe ekinorudowu togi.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore marigudu. João Batista jire akoino. Dukodire care awu bataru jeture pudui rugadu.

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji rugadu. João Batista kurire boe eiamedu boe ekori. Mare aino ia boe etugare umode tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukeje kurimode João Batista kori Pao Kurirewu jakai.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji rugadu. João Batista kurire boe eiamedu boe ekori. Mare aino ia boe etugare umode tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukeje kurimode João Batista kori Pao Kurirewu jakai.

b: João Batista aregodure dukeje ure boe ewie Pao Kurirewu ure maku aiwu tuwadaru pemegarewuji. Ainore rore jii aino. Akore Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri aino. Dukodire nowu aidukare nowu bataru pemegarewu jiwuge ere turokogado nowu ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewugei emearutorukawo ji pugeje.
source: João Batista aregodure dukeje ure boe ewie Pao Kurirewu ure maku aiwu tuwadaru pemegarewuji. Ainore rore jii aino. Akore Pao Kurirewu umoduie boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi kuri aino. Dukodire nowu aidukare nowu bataru pemegarewu jiwuge ere turokogado nowu ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewugei emearutorukawo ji pugeje.

b: Moisés ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru ure boe ewie nuba Pao Kurirewu romode. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje jamedu boe eruduwawo Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Ainore Pao Kurirewu rore tuwo boe ewie tumearudaere jiboe ji jii toro João Batista aregodure du ka.
source: Moisés ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaru ure boe ewie nuba Pao Kurirewu romode. Makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje jamedu boe eruduwawo Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Ainore Pao Kurirewu rore tuwo boe ewie tumearudaere jiboe ji jii toro João Batista aregodure du ka.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie tumoduie Elias arego mato boe etae. Mare Elias ji karega akoino. Nou aregodumodewu romode nono Elias ro mogadure. Dujire akoino. Aino ca imode tawie. Awu João Batistanure ema rugadu. João Batista jire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Rore nono Elias ro mogadure. Tamearutorumode nowu inoduji dukeje tamearutorumode iwadaru ji jamedu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie tumoduie Elias arego mato boe etae. Mare Elias ji karega akoino. Nou aregodumodewu romode nono Elias ro mogadure. Dujire akoino. Aino ca imode tawie. Awu João Batistanure ema rugadu. João Batista jire Pao Kurirewu akoino. Rore nono Elias ro mogadure. Tamearutorumode nowu inoduji dukeje tamearutorumode iwadaru ji jamedu.

b: Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji.
source: Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji.

b: Imode taruduwado nuba mearutorukare João Batista jiwuge emearudaere. Ere nono boe etore ewadure puapo nono bawadu keje dumogadure. Ewadure puapo mare etokire pui.
source: Imode taruduwado nuba mearutorukare João Batista jiwuge emearudaere. Ere nono boe etore ewadure puapo nono bawadu keje dumogadure. Ewadure puapo mare etokire pui.

b: Egore: “Cere bapo akodo. Nono cemagore tai tareruwo mare tarerukare. Nono cemagore tai tagraguduwo cedabo mare tagragudukare.” – Ainore boe etore egore pui. Epemegakare pui rugadu. Ca nowu mearutorukare João Batista jiwuge ere nono nowu boe etore emogadure. Mare boe etore ei karega inagoino. João Batista makore boe ewiagai ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce mare erokare aino. Dujire inagoino.
source: Egore: “Cere bapo akodo. Nono cemagore tai tareruwo mare tarerukare. Nono cemagore tai tagraguduwo cedabo mare tagragudukare.” – Ainore boe etore egore pui. Epemegakare pui rugadu. Ca nowu mearutorukare João Batista jiwuge ere nono nowu boe etore emogadure. Mare boe etore ei karega inagoino. João Batista makore boe ewiagai ewo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce mare erokare aino. Dujire inagoino.

b: João Batista ure tugera ra tuge piji jao tumagowo baru to nono boe ero mogadure. João Batista kudukare vinho kuruce nono ro pemegarewu ro mogadure. Mare boe emago pegare ji. Egore bope uwari metuie tada.
source: João Batista ure tugera ra tuge piji jao tumagowo baru to nono boe ero mogadure. João Batista kudukare vinho kuruce nono ro pemegarewu ro mogadure. Mare boe emago pegare ji. Egore bope uwari metuie tada.

b: Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Pao Kurirewu ure itarego mato boe etae. Inogwagere boebo. Ikudure boebo. Mare du inodu tabo boe emago pegare i jamedu. Egore inogwage ierikaie. Mare pagare egoino. Egore ikudu kigoduie vinho kuruce. Mare pagare egoino. Egore itaiduie ro pegarewugei, nowu ure tugeragu boe enoe mori jiwugei, marenarue dogei jamedu. Ainore egore. Mare tumago pegawo i dubagaire egoino. Mare ia boe emearutorumode i. Dukodire boe eruduwagodumode Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire João Batista akoino duji. Boe eruduwagodumode Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire inagoino duji jamedu.

b: Umodukare boe pegado rakakarewuge ji. Umodukare boe pegado marenarue dogei. Ainore itugare romode jii boe emearutorure jitu ka uwo boe ekinorudo turo pegarewu mori piji.
source: Umodukare boe pegado rakakarewuge ji. Umodukare boe pegado marenarue dogei. Ainore itugare romode jii boe emearutorure jitu ka uwo boe ekinorudo turo pegarewu mori piji.

b: Nou itugare ie jire boe eiamedu boe emearutorumode. Epagamode uwo mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo du bagai rugadu. Aino care awu Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu.
source: Nou itugare ie jire boe eiamedu boe emearutorumode. Epagamode uwo mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo du bagai rugadu. Aino care awu Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu.

b: Boe Egore Bope Eimijera Kurirewu Belzebu Metuie Jesus Tada
source: Boe Egore Bope Eimijera Kurirewu Belzebu Metuie Jesus Tada

b: Ia meri keje boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia joku bokwarewu imedu apo. Nou imedu mako bokware jamedu. Mare bope uwari meture tada dukodire nowu bope uwari koiare ure nowu imedu joku bokwado ure mako bokwado. Nono Jesus ure nowu imedu pemegago rugadu dukodire nowu imedu makore pugeje, aiwore pugeje.
source: Ia meri keje boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia joku bokwarewu imedu apo. Nou imedu mako bokware jamedu. Mare bope uwari meture tada dukodire nowu bope uwari koiare ure nowu imedu joku bokwado ure mako bokwado. Nono Jesus ure nowu imedu pemegago rugadu dukodire nowu imedu makore pugeje, aiwore pugeje.

b: Nou boe eiamedu boe erore ta je. Enarare pui. egore nou Pao Kurirewu umoduie maku pagaiwu Davi Onaregedu kana?
source: Nou boe eiamedu boe erore ta je. Enarare pui. egore nou Pao Kurirewu umoduie maku pagaiwu Davi Onaregedu kana?

b: Fariseu doge emearudure egoino duji dukeje emago pegare Jesus ji pu biagai. egore bope doge eimijera Belzebu meture Jesus tada dukodire ure turaga maku Jesus ai Jesus uwo bope uwari tawuje boe epiji.
source: Fariseu doge emearudure egoino duji dukeje emago pegare Jesus ji pu biagai. egore bope doge eimijera Belzebu meture Jesus tada dukodire ure turaga maku Jesus ai Jesus uwo bope uwari tawuje boe epiji.

b: Mare Jesus joruduware emearudae pegarewuji. Dukodire makore nowu fariseu dogei. Akore nou epokare puapowu boe erugodumode pui rugadu. Dukeje eraga akedumode epiji kuri je. Boe erugodumode tuwobei dukeje emode tugera ra pubiji rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus joruduware emearudae pegarewuji. Dukodire makore nowu fariseu dogei. Akore nou epokare puapowu boe erugodumode pui rugadu. Dukeje eraga akedumode epiji kuri je. Boe erugodumode tuwobei dukeje emode tugera ra pubiji rugadu.

b: Ca mearutorure Satanás jiwuge emode Satanás utugarege bope doge etawuje ia boe epiji dukeje ere nono epokare puapowuge emogadure. Erugodumode pui rugadu. Dukodire nowu mearutorure Satanás jiwuge eragamodukare rugadu etagedumode rugadu.
source: Ca mearutorure Satanás jiwuge emode Satanás utugarege bope doge etawuje ia boe epiji dukeje ere nono epokare puapowuge emogadure. Erugodumode pui rugadu. Dukodire nowu mearutorure Satanás jiwuge eragamodukare rugadu etagedumode rugadu.

b: Kocare tagagore nowu Belzebu raka taboie ire bope uwari pegarewu tawuje boe epiji. Mare nowu tare joruduwadowuge nuba erore tuwo bope uwari tawuje boe epiji? Pao Kurirewu raka tabore eroino na? Tu Pao Kurirewu rakare tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji tu rugadu. Dukodire nowu tare joruduwadowuge egomode pagaie tagagoino Belzebu raka taboie ire bope uwari tawuje boe epiji.
source: Kocare tagagore nowu Belzebu raka taboie ire bope uwari pegarewu tawuje boe epiji. Mare nowu tare joruduwadowuge nuba erore tuwo bope uwari tawuje boe epiji? Pao Kurirewu raka tabore eroino na? Tu Pao Kurirewu rakare tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji tu rugadu. Dukodire nowu tare joruduwadowuge egomode pagaie tagagoino Belzebu raka taboie ire bope uwari tawuje boe epiji.

b: Pao Kurirewu koiare ure turaga maku inai iwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji rugadu. Dukodire boe erudure Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewu ji rugadu. Turore aino dutabo Pao Kurirewu makonure boe ewagai ewo tugimijera kurirewudo tu pudumi rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu koiare ure turaga maku inai iwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji rugadu. Dukodire boe erudure Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewu ji rugadu. Turore aino dutabo Pao Kurirewu makonure boe ewagai ewo tugimijera kurirewudo tu pudumi rugadu.

b: Ca iwogurewu aidure tuwo turemo ia tugobaigare uwaito tuwo tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji. Mare umode nowu tugobaigare kogudo bukigu tabo boeto ji. Nono umode tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji rugadu tuduwo tabo rugadu.
source: Ca iwogurewu aidure tuwo turemo ia tugobaigare uwaito tuwo tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji. Mare umode nowu tugobaigare kogudo bukigu tabo boeto ji. Nono umode tugeragu nowu tugobaigare oeji rugadu tuduwo tabo rugadu.

b: Aidukare iwu aidumode tuwo imearudae pegado tuwo iro bokwado. Ukare tugera maku inaiwu umodukare boe etarego itae. Umode boe edo taodo ipiji.
source: Aidukare iwu aidumode tuwo imearudae pegado tuwo iro bokwado. Ukare tugera maku inaiwu umodukare boe etarego itae. Umode boe edo taodo ipiji.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe etaidukare turo pegarewu ji pugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu piji. Boe emago pegamode Imedu Onaregeduji mare toro ia meri keje ekiarigodumode nowu tuwadaru pegarewuji. Emagomode Pao Kurirewu ji biagoduwo nowu tuwadaru pegarewu piji. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode ewadaru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare ia boe emago pegamode Pao Kurirewu Uwariji dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu ewadaru pegarewu piji. Nou bataru metumode nowu boebo jii rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu inodu piji rugadu.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagoino. Boe etaidukare turo pegarewu ji pugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu biagodumode nowu ero pegarewu piji. Boe emago pegamode Imedu Onaregeduji mare toro ia meri keje ekiarigodumode nowu tuwadaru pegarewuji. Emagomode Pao Kurirewu ji biagoduwo nowu tuwadaru pegarewu piji. Nou bataru metumode nowu boebo jii rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare nowu inodu piji rugadu.

b: – Iwo tawie. Iguru pegarewu tudu pemegamodukare. Iguru pemegarewu tudu pemegamode rugadu. Boe eruduwamode tuduji dukeje eruduwamode nowu tudu iji jamedu. Mare iguru ji karega inagoino. Ire inagoino. Ca tamearudae tawuje nuba ire taegai.
source: – Iwo tawie. Iguru pegarewu tudu pemegamodukare. Iguru pemegarewu tudu pemegamode rugadu. Boe eruduwamode tuduji dukeje eruduwamode nowu tudu iji jamedu. Mare iguru ji karega inagoino. Ire inagoino. Ca tamearudae tawuje nuba ire taegai.

b: Mare tare nono awage pegarewuge emogadure. Mare awagu ji karega inagoino. Ro pegarewugenure tagi marigudu. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire tamearudae pemegamodukare i rugadu. Dukodire tamago pemegamodukare i jamedu. Boe ewiagoromode tumearudae pegarewu tabo dukeje emago pegamode nono nowu tumearudae mogadure.
source: Mare tare nono awage pegarewuge emogadure. Mare awagu ji karega inagoino. Ro pegarewugenure tagi marigudu. Dujire inagoino. Dukodire tamearudae pemegamodukare i rugadu. Dukodire tamago pemegamodukare i jamedu. Boe ewiagoromode tumearudae pegarewu tabo dukeje emago pegamode nono nowu tumearudae mogadure.

b: Boe ewiagoromode tumearudae pegarewu tabo dukeje ero pegamode emago pegamode nono nowu tumearudae mogadure. Mare boe ewiagoromode tumearudae pemegarewu tabo dukeje ero pemegamode emago pemegamode nono nowu tumearudae mogadure jamedu.
source: Boe ewiagoromode tumearudae pegarewu tabo dukeje ero pegamode emago pegamode nono nowu tumearudae mogadure. Mare boe ewiagoromode tumearudae pemegarewu tabo dukeje ero pemegamode emago pemegamode nono nowu tumearudae mogadure jamedu.

b: Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe eiamedu boe ji ero pegarewu bagai. Dukeje boe eiamedu boe emagomode turore jiboe ji tumagore jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu biagai rugadu. Boe etaidumode tuwo ia tuwadaru biado mare pagatu je. Pao Kurirewu joruduware marigudu emearudae ji.
source: Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu aiwomode boe eiamedu boe ji ero pegarewu bagai. Dukeje boe eiamedu boe emagomode turore jiboe ji tumagore jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu biagai rugadu. Boe etaidumode tuwo ia tuwadaru biado mare pagatu je. Pao Kurirewu joruduware marigudu emearudae ji.

b: Dukodire imode tawie. Tamagore jiboe pemegamode dukeje Pao Kurirewu mako pegamodukare tai. Mare tamagore jiboe pegare dukeje Pao Kurirewu makomode tai tumoduie boe pegado tai tawadaru pegarewu morice.
source: Dukodire imode tawie. Tamagore jiboe pemegamode dukeje Pao Kurirewu mako pegamodukare tai. Mare tamagore jiboe pegare dukeje Pao Kurirewu makomode tai tumoduie boe pegado tai tawadaru pegarewu morice.

b: Boe Emagore Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewu Bagai Pugeje
source: Boe Emagore Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewu Bagai Pugeje

b: Nono ia fariseu doge emagore Jesus ji. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emagore Jesus ji jamedu. egore cegimijera. Cerududo ia aro rakarewu ji cemearutoruwo ai. Mare pagatu jere egoino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo Jesus bataru ji.
source: Nono ia fariseu doge emagore Jesus ji. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emagore Jesus ji jamedu. egore cegimijera. Cerududo ia aro rakarewu ji cemearutoruwo ai. Mare pagatu jere egoino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo Jesus bataru ji.

b: Nono Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore aino care boe emearudae pegare rugadu, ero pegare rugadu. Ainore tamearudaere jamedu. Tamagore i iwo ia iro rakarewu tawuje taegai taruduwo iro rakarewu ji taruduwawo kaboba ure imi duji. Mare pagatu jere tagagoino. Dukodire iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji taegai pugeje. Mare boemode i nono boe moga Jonas jitu mogadure. Dukejere boe eruduwamode i rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore aino care boe emearudae pegare rugadu, ero pegare rugadu. Ainore tamearudaere jamedu. Tamagore i iwo ia iro rakarewu tawuje taegai taruduwo iro rakarewu ji taruduwawo kaboba ure imi duji. Mare pagatu jere tagagoino. Dukodire iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji taegai pugeje. Mare boemode i nono boe moga Jonas jitu mogadure. Dukejere boe eruduwamode i rugadu.

b: Marigudu Jonas meture karo kurirewu kuri tada. Merire pobe metia bokware ji nono nowu karo kuri tada. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu ure Jonas tawuje nowu karo kurirewu kuri piji rugadu. Aino Imedu Onaregedu rakojemode moto tada jamedu. Merimode pobe metia bokware ji nono jamedu.
source: Marigudu Jonas meture karo kurirewu kuri tada. Merire pobe metia bokware ji nono nowu karo kuri tada. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu ure Jonas tawuje nowu karo kurirewu kuri piji rugadu. Aino Imedu Onaregedu rakojemode moto tada jamedu. Merimode pobe metia bokware ji nono jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure Jonas tawuje karo kurirewu kuri piji dukeje uture Nínive ba kurirewu ka Pao Kurirewu bataru tabo. Dukodire nowu Nínive kejewuge eruduware boe jokodu jire Jonas akoino pudui duji. Ekiarigodure turo pegarewuji. Ere tugera ra turo pegarewu piji rugadu tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare boe eimijera kurirewunure imi. Ikodure Jonas kori. Ioruduware jiboe kodure Jonas joruduware jiboe kori. Mare du inodu tabo tagaidukare taruduwawo i. Tagaidukare tawo tagera ra taro pegarewu piji. Toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe eewodudo pugeje taiwowo boe ero pegarewu bagai tuwo boe pegado ei ero pegarewu morice. Nou meri keje nowu Nínive ba kurirewu kejewuge emago pegamode tai tawiapagakare iwadaru ji dukodi.

Nou meri keje nowu Nínive ba kurirewu kejewuge emago pegamode tai tawiapagakare iwadaru ji dukodi.

Dukodire ure tudawuje to moto piji tuduwo toro Salomão uwai ka tumearuduwo Salomão makore jiboe ji. Mare boe eimijera kurirewunure imi. Ikodure Salomão kori. b: Bope Uwari Umode Tugirimi
source: Bope Uwari Umode Tugirimi

b: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore bope uwari pegarewu umode tudawuje ia imedu piji dukeje utumode toro boe maerewu ka taiwo tabo tumode tamudo kejewu bagai. Jorudumodukare taidure jiboe ji dukeje mearudaemode tuwo tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu ae pugeje tuwo turemo to pugeje. Dukodire nowu bope uwari pegarewu umode tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu ae rugadu. Aregodumode dukeje jorudumode ji pemegare duji. Jorudumode ji ure nono tuwai moturewu umogadure.
source: Jesus mako kimore boe ji. Akore bope uwari pegarewu umode tudawuje ia imedu piji dukeje utumode toro boe maerewu ka taiwo tabo tumode tamudo kejewu bagai. Jorudumodukare taidure jiboe ji dukeje mearudaemode tuwo tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu ae pugeje tuwo turemo to pugeje. Dukodire nowu bope uwari pegarewu umode tugirimi nowu tumedure tadawu imedu ae rugadu. Aregodumode dukeje jorudumode ji pemegare duji. Jorudumode ji ure nono tuwai moturewu umogadure.

b: Dukejere utumode toro tumedage bope doge ewagai. Enodo padure sete. Epegare nowu bope uwari boeto jiwu kori. Bope uwari boeto jiwu makomode ei etuwo pudabo toro nowu imedu ae. Nono emode turemo nowu imeduto pugeje. Dukodire boe pegamode nowu imeduji rugadu. Boetojiwu meture tadawu bope uwari ure mitotu je. Aino care bope doge enodo padu kejeboere oito nowu imedu tada. Dukodire boe pegamode nowu imeduji rugadu. Ca iwo tawie. Mearutoru bokware iwugeire boe pegamode rugadu nono boe pegare nowu imedu jitu mogadure.

b: Jesus Uce Uwiemage Etaregodure
source: Jesus Uce Uwiemage Etaregodure

b: Jesus mako kimore boe ji dukeje uce uwiemage etaregodure bagai. Etaidure tumagowo ji. Mare ekare turemo baito. Epagare bagai toro bawadu keje.
source: Jesus mako kimore boe ji dukeje uce uwiemage etaregodure bagai. Etaidure tumagowo ji. Mare ekare turemo baito. Epagare bagai toro bawadu keje.

b: Ia imedu ure Jesus bie. Akore ace, awiemage etaregodure. Eragojere toro bawadu keje. Etaidure tumagowo ai.
source: Ia imedu ure Jesus bie. Akore ace, awiemage etaregodure. Eragojere toro bawadu keje. Etaidure tumagowo ai.

b: Jesus akore Imode tawie iogudubanure mugace, iogudubanure iwobece.
source: Jesus akore Imode tawie iogudubanure mugace, iogudubanure iwobece.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugera raido nowu ture joruduwadowuge eiagwai. Akore awu ire joruduwadowuge ere nono iwobe emogadure.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugera raido nowu ture joruduwadowuge eiagwai. Akore awu ire joruduwadowuge ere nono iwobe emogadure.

b: Mearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu mearudae jamedu boe jiwuge ere nono iwobe emogadure rugadu. Ere nono iwie mage emogadure rugadu. Ere nono muga mage emogadure rugadu.
source: Mearutorure Iogwa Kurirewu mearudae jamedu boe jiwuge ere nono iwobe emogadure rugadu. Ere nono iwie mage emogadure rugadu. Ere nono muga mage emogadure rugadu.

b: Boepa Tadaboe Jiwu Bakaru Reo
source: Boepa Tadaboe Jiwu Bakaru Reo

b: Nou meri ji rugadu Jesus uture nowu bai piji pobo maerewu okwa ka pugeje. Boe ere bato pui nono tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji pugeje. Emagare rugadu. Dukodire Jesus ure taredo ia ika kurirewuto. Nou ika kurirewu padure nono pobo tada. Nou boe edure pobo okwai tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji. Jesus ure tumugudo nowu ika kurirewu ja tada.
source: Nou meri ji rugadu Jesus uture nowu bai piji pobo maerewu okwa ka pugeje. Boe ere bato pui nono tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji pugeje. Emagare rugadu. Dukodire Jesus ure taredo ia ika kurirewuto. Nou ika kurirewu padure nono pobo tada. Nou boe edure pobo okwai tumearuduwo Jesus bataru ji. Jesus ure tumugudo nowu ika kurirewu ja tada.

b: Dukejere Jesus readodure ewiagai ia bakaruji tuwo eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Akore ia imedu ure tudawuje tuwo boe a roto ja ja moto joki to boepa tada.
source: Dukejere Jesus readodure ewiagai ia bakaruji tuwo eruduwado toro nouia Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Akore ia imedu ure tudawuje tuwo boe a roto ja ja moto joki to boepa tada.

b: Ia a buture awara okwaji. Dukodire kiebarege ere nowu buture awara okwa jiwu boe a rugadu kowuje.
source: Ia a buture awara okwaji. Dukodire kiebarege ere nowu buture awara okwa jiwu boe a rugadu kowuje.

b: Ia a buture toriguru tada. Boture kuri je mare moto pegare ji.
source: Ia a buture toriguru tada. Boture kuri je mare moto pegare ji.

b: Dukodire boeru jeture ji dukejere nowu boeru ure nowu botureboe bito kuri je rugadu. Ukwa bokware kodi. Moto pegare kodi.
source: Dukodire boeru jeture ji dukejere nowu boeru ure nowu botureboe bito kuri je rugadu. Ukwa bokware kodi. Moto pegare kodi.

b: Ia a buture botoguru tada. Botoguru boture tabo mare botoguru ure bito.
source: Ia a buture botoguru tada. Botoguru boture tabo mare botoguru ure bito.

Imedu Onaregedu umode tugirimi pugeje dukeje umode tudugarege baru tadawuge etudo tododai nowu mearutorure bope doge eimijera jiwuge ro pegarewuge ewagai. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emode tugeragu nowu mearutorure bope doge eimijera jiwuge eiamedu boe ji nowu ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewuge epiji. Emodukare tugeragu nowu ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewuge ji. Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge emode nowu mearutorure bope doge eimijera jiwuge ewarigu toro bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto. Nonore etragudu rakamode rugadu joru kori koia. Emode to reko pui tuwiri boe kori koia.

b: Mare nowu ure tugimijerado Pao Kurirewu cewuge ro pemegarewuge emugumode nowu Pao Kurirewu apo. Ekimijera mode ema rugadu. Pao Kurirewu umode emugu pemegado nono rugadu. Umode egaredo pudui rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe erudumode ei egarere pudui duji boe pemegare ei duji. Mearudure awu inagoino jiwuge ewiapaga pemegawo awu iwadaru ji rugadu tumearutoruwo ji rugadu.

Toro ia meri keje imedu jorudure nowu biadodurewu tori kuiejeji nowu moto keje. Jakarere pudui rugadu. Mare utukare tabo raga. Ure tugu mototo pugeje jii tumode akirodo nowu moto jitu ka. b: Nono Herodes makore nowu nogwareduji. Akore amearutorudo i. Imode akogwamagudure bagaiboe jamedu boe maku akai rugadu.

b: Ca Jesus ure tudawuje ika kurirewu piji. Aiwore, jorudure boe emagare duji. Okudugodure ebo rugadu. Nono ca iogore nowu kogodurewugei, nowu mugure nonowugei jamedu.

b: Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etaregodure Jesus ae merirekodutabo. Ca egore Merirekodu. Awu boe etudo awu boe maerewu piji. Emearudaere tuwo nowu boe etudo ia boe etae ewo tugeragu ia tuge roguji.

b: Ca egore cege amirewure ikera aboudure tu je. Cege karorogu ere pobetu je jamedu.

b: Jesus akore arego mato itae.

b: Nono ca eiamedu boe enogwagere. Nono ca ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu. Ca nowu utugarege ere nowu kadarabo doge korau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo dogere enodo padu kejeboere doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.
source: Nono ca eiamedu boe enogwagere. Nono ca ekuredure egarere pudui rugadu. Ca nowu utugarege ere nowu kadarabo doge korau nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nou kadarabo dogere enodo padu kejeboere doze nowu boe eke kobo tabo rugadu.

b: Jesus Merure Pobo Aoji
