Pao Kurirewu maragodae reno pugeje.

b: Jesus Iogore Boei Genesaré Ba Kurirewu Keje
source: Jesus Iogore Boei Genesaré Ba Kurirewu Keje

b: Ekurugodure nowu pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje etaregodure Genesaré moto ka. Nonore ere to ika kurirewu bu. Ere kogudo.
source: Ekurugodure nowu pobo maerewu kajeje dukeje etaregodure Genesaré moto ka. Nonore ere to ika kurirewu bu. Ere kogudo.

b: Ere tudawuje to ika kurirewu piji dukeje boe erudure Jesus ji. Eruduware Jesus ure ema duji.
source: Ere tudawuje to ika kurirewu piji dukeje boe erudure Jesus ji. Eruduware Jesus ure ema duji.

b: Dukodire nowu boe eregodure nowu boe eda jamedu boe ji tuwo nowu boe ewie Jesus aregodure duji. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe etaregodure tuwobe kogodurewugebo Jesus ae. Nou kogodurewuge epadure tugudau kodo keje.
source: Dukodire nowu boe eregodure nowu boe eda jamedu boe ji tuwo nowu boe ewie Jesus aregodure duji. Dukodire boe eiamedu boe etaregodure tuwobe kogodurewugebo Jesus ae. Nou kogodurewuge epadure tugudau kodo keje.

b: Jesus uture nowu boe eiamedu boe eda ka. Uture boe eda ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje. Uture ba kurirewu ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo nono jamedu. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje jamedu. Nono nowu ure tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa kejewuge eiamedu boe epemegagodure rugadu.
source: Jesus uture nowu boe eiamedu boe eda ka. Uture boe eda ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje. Uture ba kurirewu ka dukeje boe etaregodure ae kogodurewugebo nono jamedu. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji kogodurewuge ewo tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa keje jamedu. Nono nowu ure tugera bu Jesus ukudau areia okwa kejewuge eiamedu boe epemegagodure rugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Nou Judeu Doge Eroiaji
source: Jesus Makore Nou Judeu Doge Eroiaji

b: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae jamedu. Ere bato pui Jesus ae.
source: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaregodure Jerusalém piji Jesus ae jamedu. Ere bato pui Jesus ae.

b: Eruduware Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enogwagere tugera tabo duji. Nou fariseu doge etaidure boe ewo tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge tuwobe ero mogadure. Judeu doge erore tu tu aino togwagewo. Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erokare nono ero mogadure.
source: Eruduware Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enogwagere tugera tabo duji. Nou fariseu doge etaidure boe ewo tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge tuwobe ero mogadure. Judeu doge erore tu tu aino togwagewo. Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erokare nono ero mogadure.

b: Marigudu fariseu doge, Judeu doge eiamedu boe erore nowu mariguduwuge tugimijerage ere maku pudaiwu bakaru tadawu ero boe ji tu tu je. Dukodire marigudu ere tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure togwagewo tu tu je. Ainore erore jii aino.
source: Marigudu fariseu doge, Judeu doge eiamedu boe erore nowu mariguduwuge tugimijerage ere maku pudaiwu bakaru tadawu ero boe ji tu tu je. Dukodire marigudu ere tugera kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure togwagewo tu tu je. Ainore erore jii aino.

b: Emode akirodo tugeji nowu boe jeto tadawu bai piji dukeje emode kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure jamedu tu tu je. Mariguduwuge Judeu doge eno bakaru kurire dukodire erore jiboe makare rugadu. Kodire ere turuwobo kabi tu tu je. Ere tudaria kabi tu tu je. Ere tubagaga kabi tu tu je. Ere tubadure kejewu kamorewu kabi tu tu je jamedu. Emodukare tugera ra turore aino dupiji rugadu. Turoia jire eroino tu tu je tuwo nowu jamedu boe pemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu turo boe ji tu tu je.
source: Emode akirodo tugeji nowu boe jeto tadawu bai piji dukeje emode kabi nono mariguduwuge Judeu doge ero mogadure jamedu tu tu je. Mariguduwuge Judeu doge eno bakaru kurire dukodire erore jiboe makare rugadu. Kodire ere turuwobo kabi tu tu je. Ere tudaria kabi tu tu je. Ere tubagaga kabi tu tu je. Ere tubadure kejewu kamorewu kabi tu tu je jamedu. Emodukare tugera ra turore aino dupiji rugadu. Turoia jire eroino tu tu je tuwo nowu jamedu boe pemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu turo boe ji tu tu je.

b: Dukodire nowu fariseu doge, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidukare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekare tugera kabi duji. Enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba nowu are joruduwadowuge emearutorukare mariguduwuge pawobe emagore jiboe ji? Erokare nono nowu mariguduwuge pawobe ero mogadure. Enogwagere mare ekare tugera kabi nono nowu mariguduwu paro mogadure. Ukare turugadu.
source: Dukodire nowu fariseu doge, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidukare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ekare tugera kabi duji. Enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba nowu are joruduwadowuge emearutorukare mariguduwuge pawobe emagore jiboe ji? Erokare nono nowu mariguduwuge pawobe ero mogadure. Enogwagere mare ekare tugera kabi nono nowu mariguduwu paro mogadure. Ukare turugadu.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore tare boe eruduwado mare tamearutorukare tawadaru ji. Boe jokodu jire Isaías akoino marigudu. Marigudu rugadu ure pawobe ewie taromode tamearudaemode jiboe ji. Marigudu Isaías akore Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie rugadu. Akore Awu boe emagore togwa tabo tumearutoruie i mare emearudae remawu ure tuginai rugadu toro imearudae piji rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore tare boe eruduwado mare tamearutorukare tawadaru ji. Boe jokodu jire Isaías akoino marigudu. Marigudu rugadu ure pawobe ewie taromode tamearudaemode jiboe ji. Marigudu Isaías akore Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie rugadu. Akore Awu boe emagore togwa tabo tumearutoruie i mare emearudae remawu ure tuginai rugadu toro imearudae piji rugadu.

b: – “Awu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i mare pagare egoino. Ere boe eruduwado bakaruji. Egore iwadaruie. Mare pagare egoino. Ia tumagore jiwu bakaru jire nowu boe egoino.”
source: – “Awu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo i mare pagare egoino. Ere boe eruduwado bakaruji. Egore iwadaruie. Mare pagare egoino. Ia tumagore jiwu bakaru jire nowu boe egoino.”

b: Jesus makore nowu fariseu dogei pugeje. Akore taro kodure nowu imedu Isaías ure boe ewie jiboe ji rugadu. Tare tagera ra Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji tamearutoruwo tu tamearudae ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru ji karega tagagoino.
source: Jesus makore nowu fariseu dogei pugeje. Akore taro kodure nowu imedu Isaías ure boe ewie jiboe ji rugadu. Tare tagera ra Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji tamearutoruwo tu tamearudae ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru ji karega tagagoino.

b: – Jerorewugenure tagi. Tamago moture tawo boe emearutorudo tawadaru ji ekoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji emearutorukawo Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji.
source: – Jerorewugenure tagi. Tamago moture tawo boe emearutorudo tawadaru ji ekoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji emearutorukawo Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji.

b: Marigudu Moisés ure pawobe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji. Akore Tamearutorudo taoji tajeji. Ca nowu boe mako pegamode tuoji tujeji tuwo epogurudo dukeje bitoduiago.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore jawu tawobei.
source: Marigudu Moisés ure pawobe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu ji. Akore Tamearutorudo taoji tajeji. Ca nowu boe mako pegamode tuoji tujeji tuwo epogurudo dukeje bitoduiago.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu akore jawu tawobei.

b: Mare tagi tare boe eruduwado ia bataru tuginaiwuji boe ekawo tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Tagagore imedu makomoduie tujeji tuoji tumodukaie tugera maku etai tumoduie toe maku Pao Kurirewu ai kodi. Dukodire tumodukaie tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Ainore boe eromoduie.
source: Mare tagi tare boe eruduwado ia bataru tuginaiwuji boe ekawo tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Tagagore imedu makomoduie tujeji tuoji tumodukaie tugera maku etai tumoduie toe maku Pao Kurirewu ai kodi. Dukodire tumodukaie tugera maku tuo ai tuje ai. Ainore boe eromoduie.

b: Mare pagare egoino. Etaidukare tuwo tugera maku tuje ai tuo ai dukodire egoino.
source: Mare pagare egoino. Etaidukare tuwo tugera maku tuje ai tuo ai dukodire egoino.

b: Taigoiare tare boe egodo aino. Dukodire care tagaidukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Tamearutorukare ji. Tagaidure tagoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji. Ainore tarore ia taroji jamedu. Tare taro udo tuginai Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu piji rugadu.
source: Taigoiare tare boe egodo aino. Dukodire care tagaidukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Tamearutorukare ji. Tagaidure tagoduwo nowu tamearudae rekodaji. Ainore tarore ia taroji jamedu. Tare taro udo tuginai Pao Kurirewu mearudae remawu piji rugadu.

b: Ainore Boe Emode Tubegado
source: Ainore Boe Emode Tubegado

b: Nono Jesus makore boe makarewuge etae ewo bato pui pudae. Makore nowu boe ji. Akore taiamedu boe tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Iwo taruduwa kuricigodo iwadaru ji.
source: Nono Jesus makore boe makarewuge etae ewo bato pui pudae. Makore nowu boe ji. Akore taiamedu boe tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Iwo taruduwa kuricigodo iwadaru ji.

b: Nou tagwagemode jiboe umodukare tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumodukare tago bakaru tadawu taro piji. Mare nowu taiabijiwu tawadaru pegarewu umode tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumode tago bakaru tadawu taro piji jii je.
source: Nou tagwagemode jiboe umodukare tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumodukare tago bakaru tadawu taro piji. Mare nowu taiabijiwu tawadaru pegarewu umode tabegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire tawujedumode tago bakaru tadawu taro piji jii je.

b: Dukeje Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji uwo tuioruduwado kaba jiba akoino nowu boe ji.
source: Dukeje Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji uwo tuioruduwado kaba jiba akoino nowu boe ji.

b: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taruduwa bokware nono nowu boe emogadure. Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Tamodukare tabegado tage tabo rugadu.
source: Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taruduwa bokware nono nowu boe emogadure. Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Tamodukare tabegado tage tabo rugadu.

b: Tamode tage ko dukeje taguredumode. Nono umode tudawuje tabiji. Mare tabemega kimomode tarowo boe eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Tage umodukare tamearudae pegado boe ji. Tagoino dutabo Jesus ure nowu Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu ia ero akedudo. Nou bakaru akore ekaiago ia tuge kowuje tuwo tubemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Aino care Jesus ure nowu bakaru akedudo. Boe eke jamedu boe uie turugadu.
source: Tamode tage ko dukeje taguredumode. Nono umode tudawuje tabiji. Mare tabemega kimomode tarowo boe eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Tage umodukare tamearudae pegado boe ji. Tagoino dutabo Jesus ure nowu Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu ia ero akedudo. Nou bakaru akore ekaiago ia tuge kowuje tuwo tubemegado turowo nowu to bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji. Aino care Jesus ure nowu bakaru akedudo. Boe eke jamedu boe uie turugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore boe ero pegarewu umode tudawuje boe emearudae piji. Nou inodu koiare umode boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore boe ero pegarewu umode tudawuje boe emearudae piji. Nou inodu koiare umode boe epegado Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.

b: Du nowu boe emearudae pegarewu aregodumode epiji rugadu. Emode nowu tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo rugadu. Ero pegamode tieribari tabo. Ekiwogumode. Emode boe ewido.
source: Du nowu boe emearudae pegarewu aregodumode epiji rugadu. Emode nowu tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo rugadu. Ero pegamode tieribari tabo. Ekiwogumode. Emode boe ewido.

b: Eribarimode toreduje piji toredu piji. Enogwa kidumode tu pudai tuwo toe kurido tumedage epiji. Emode turo pegarewu kurido rugadu. Boe emode boe ekiripagado. Boe etaora bai baimode tuge kurure pudui dutabo. Boe ekorigodumode boe enoe keje. Boe emago pegamode tumedage eroji. Boe enojaromode tuwadaru ji. Boe eruduwa bokwamode turore jiboe ji.
source: Eribarimode toreduje piji toredu piji. Enogwa kidumode tu pudai tuwo toe kurido tumedage epiji. Emode turo pegarewu kurido rugadu. Boe emode boe ekiripagado. Boe etaora bai baimode tuge kurure pudui dutabo. Boe ekorigodumode boe enoe keje. Boe emago pegamode tumedage eroji. Boe enojaromode tuwadaru ji. Boe eruduwa bokwamode turore jiboe ji.

b: Boe emode tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turowo awu boe ero pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Awu boe ero pegarewu koiare umode boe epegado rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.
source: Boe emode tumearudae pegarewu tawuje turowo awu boe ero pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Awu boe ero pegarewu koiare umode boe epegado rugadu Pao Kurirewu jakai dukodire etawujedumode to bakaru tadawu turo piji jii je.

b: Aredu Tuginaiwudo
source: Aredu Tuginaiwudo

b: Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Uture toro ia moto ka. Puredure Tiro ba kurirewuji. Nono ure turemo ia boe ewaito. Aidure tuwo tamudo. Aidukare boe eruduwawo turagojere nono duji mare boe erudure ure turemo nowu bai toduji.
source: Nono Jesus uture nowu boe epiji. Uture toro ia moto ka. Puredure Tiro ba kurirewuji. Nono ure turemo ia boe ewaito. Aidure tuwo tamudo. Aidukare boe eruduwawo turagojere nono duji mare boe erudure ure turemo nowu bai toduji.

b: Ia aredu joruduware Jesus rakojere nono duji. Bope uwari meture nowu aredu onaregedu tada. Dukodire uce aregodure Jesus ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.
source: Ia aredu joruduware Jesus rakojere nono duji. Bope uwari meture nowu aredu onaregedu tada. Dukodire uce aregodure Jesus ae. Ure tubu jodo moto keje Jesus jokorai.

b: Nou aredu Judeu kejewu aredu karegure ema. Boture Fenícia moto keje puredure Síria moto ji. Okwamagudure Jesus ji uwo nowu bope uwari tawuje tonaregedu aredu piji.
source: Nou aredu Judeu kejewu aredu karegure ema. Boture Fenícia moto keje puredure Síria moto ji. Okwamagudure Jesus ji uwo nowu bope uwari tawuje tonaregedu aredu piji.

b: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore boe etore enogwagewo jii tuguredu ka. Ukare turugadu boe ewo tore ekerogu tawuje epiji tuwo maku tagu ariga doge etai.
source: Mare Jesus makore ji. Akore boe etore enogwagewo jii tuguredu ka. Ukare turugadu boe ewo tore ekerogu tawuje epiji tuwo maku tagu ariga doge etai.

b: Nou aredu joruduware boe etore ji karega Jesus akoino duji. Joruduware Judeu dogeire Jesus akoino duji. Jesus aregodure moto ka tumagowo Judeu dogei rugadu. Nono nowu aredu makore Jesus bataru jipagi. Akore boe rugadu. Mare ariga doge epuredumode boe etorei tuwo nowu buture ira kudawu boe etore eke gigudu rugadu boe kowuje.
source: Nou aredu joruduware boe etore ji karega Jesus akoino duji. Joruduware Judeu dogeire Jesus akoino duji. Jesus aregodure moto ka tumagowo Judeu dogei rugadu. Nono nowu aredu makore Jesus bataru jipagi. Akore boe rugadu. Mare ariga doge epuredumode boe etorei tuwo nowu buture ira kudawu boe etore eke gigudu rugadu boe kowuje.

b: Jesus akore Boe jokodu. Atudo aibagi awai ka akanaregedu aredu bagai. Ire nowu bope uwari tawuje piji dukodire akanaregedu pemegagodure rugadu. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji.
source: Jesus akore Boe jokodu. Atudo aibagi awai ka akanaregedu aredu bagai. Ire nowu bope uwari tawuje piji dukodire akanaregedu pemegagodure rugadu. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji.

b: Dukodire nowu aredu ure tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka tuioruduwo tonaregeduji. Aregodure tuwai ka dukeje jorudure tonaregedu padure kamorewu keje duji. Pemegagodure. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji rugadu.
source: Dukodire nowu aredu ure tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka tuioruduwo tonaregeduji. Aregodure tuwai ka dukeje jorudure tonaregedu padure kamorewu keje duji. Pemegagodure. Nou bope uwari ure tudawuje piji rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Bija Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago
source: Jesus Ure Bija Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago

b: Nono Jesus uture nowu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge epiji. Uture Sidom ba kurirewu ka. Dukeje merure boe eda kejewu moto ji. Boe eda enodo padure dez nono nowu moto keje. Nono aregodure nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka.
source: Nono Jesus uture nowu Tiro ba kurirewu kejewuge epiji. Uture Sidom ba kurirewu ka. Dukeje merure boe eda kejewu moto ji. Boe eda enodo padure dez nono nowu moto keje. Nono aregodure nowu Galiléia pobo maerewu okwa ka.

b: Nonore ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia bija bokwarewu imedu apo. Roiwakare tumagowo jamedu. Nono nowu boe enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera bu nowu imedu keje pemegagoduwo.
source: Nonore ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia bija bokwarewu imedu apo. Roiwakare tumagowo jamedu. Nono nowu boe enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera bu nowu imedu keje pemegagoduwo.

b: Dukodire Jesus ure taradaino boe epiji nowu imedu apo. Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje pudogi. Dukejere ure todoguru bu tugerako keje. Nono ure raido nowu imedu eru ka.
source: Dukodire Jesus ure taradaino boe epiji nowu imedu apo. Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje pudogi. Dukejere ure todoguru bu tugerako keje. Nono ure raido nowu imedu eru ka.

b: Nono Jesus aiwore baru to. Ure ake tawuje tubiji. Dukejere makore Judeu doge ewadaru tabo. Akore efatá. (Boe ewadaru tabore boe egore: “Uwo tuiado” aino.)
source: Nono Jesus aiwore baru to. Ure ake tawuje tubiji. Dukejere makore Judeu doge ewadaru tabo. Akore efatá. (Boe ewadaru tabore boe egore: “Uwo tuiado” aino.)

b: Ca nowu imedu bija pemegagodure pugeje taci je. Mearudure boe emagoji rugadu. Makore jamedu. Mako pemegare.
source: Ca nowu imedu bija pemegagodure pugeje taci je. Mearudure boe emagoji rugadu. Makore jamedu. Mako pemegare.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ekawo boe ewie nowu turore jiboe ji. Makore ei mare emearutorukare. Ere boe ewie rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ekawo boe ewie nowu turore jiboe ji. Makore ei mare emearutorukare. Ere boe ewie rugadu.

b: Biapagare nowu Jesus ro jiwuge eiamedu boe erore ta je. egore awu Jesus ro pemegare rugadu! Rakare rugadu kodire umode bija bokwarewuge ewija epemegago emearuduwo boe ji eruduwawo boe emagore pudui duji. Rakare tuwo mako bokwarewuge emagodo pugeje.
source: Biapagare nowu Jesus ro jiwuge eiamedu boe erore ta je. egore awu Jesus ro pemegare rugadu! Rakare rugadu kodire umode bija bokwarewuge ewija epemegago emearuduwo boe ji eruduwawo boe emagore pudui duji. Rakare tuwo mako bokwarewuge emagodo pugeje.

b: Jesus Ure Ia Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo Jamedu
source: Jesus Ure Ia Boe Makarewuge Enogwagedo Jamedu

b: Ia meri keje boe ere bato pui pugeje tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji. Emagare rugadu. Enodo padure quatro mil. Care eke akedure dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Nono ca makore ei.
source: Ia meri keje boe ere bato pui pugeje tuwiapagawo Jesus bataru ji. Emagare rugadu. Enodo padure quatro mil. Care eke akedure dukeje Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae. Nono ca makore ei.

b: Akore inogudugodure awu boebo. Merire pobe metia bokware ei woe itabo. Woe boe eke bokware rugadu ewo ko.
source: Akore inogudugodure awu boebo. Merire pobe metia bokware ei woe itabo. Woe boe eke bokware rugadu ewo ko.

b: Itaidukare iwo etudo tuguri bioro tabo mare eragamodukare tumeruwo awara ji pugeje. Iage etaregodu jaere woe itae.
source: Itaidukare iwo etudo tuguri bioro tabo mare eragamodukare tumeruwo awara ji pugeje. Iage etaregodu jaere woe itae.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nou boe emagare rugadu woe pagabo. Nuba ceromode woe boe maerewuto boe eke bagai nowu boe ekeje?
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nou boe emagare rugadu woe pagabo. Nuba ceromode woe boe maerewuto boe eke bagai nowu boe ekeje?

b: Jesus akore Nuba tage amirewu rogure tu je? egore amirewu oto padure sete.
source: Jesus akore Nuba tage amirewu rogure tu je? egore amirewu oto padure sete.

b: Nono Jesus makore boe eiamedu boe ji ewo tumugudo moto keje. Dukejere ure tugeragu nowu amirewuji. Nono imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Dukejere ure nowu amirewu kado. Ure maku ture joruduwadowuge etai ewo reko boe etae. Dukodire ere pedo boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore boe eiamedu boe ji ewo tumugudo moto keje. Dukejere ure tugeragu nowu amirewuji. Nono imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Dukejere ure nowu amirewu kado. Ure maku ture joruduwadowuge etai ewo reko boe etae. Dukodire ere pedo boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu.

b: Ia kare kugurere nono jamedu. Jesus imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo. Dukejere makore ture joruduwadowugei ewo nowu kare kugure pedo boe eiamedu boe ji jamedu.
source: Ia kare kugurere nono jamedu. Jesus imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu kare kugure eparu tabo. Dukejere makore ture joruduwadowugei ewo nowu kare kugure pedo boe eiamedu boe ji jamedu.

b: Nono ca nowu boe eiamedu boe enogwagere. Egarere pudui rugadu tuguredure duji. Emagare. Enodo padure quatro mil. Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere kadarabo korobadurewugedo sete nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ewo tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje.
source: Nono ca nowu boe eiamedu boe enogwagere. Egarere pudui rugadu tuguredure duji. Emagare. Enodo padure quatro mil. Nono ca nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ere kadarabo korobadurewugedo sete nowu boe eke kobo tabo. Nono Jesus makore nowu boe ji ewo tugirimi tuibagi tuwai ka pugeje.

b: Dukejere Jesus ure taredo ika kurirewuto ture joruduwadowugebo. Eture toro Dalmanuta moto ka.
source: Dukejere Jesus ure taredo ika kurirewuto ture joruduwadowugebo. Eture toro Dalmanuta moto ka.

b: Fariseu Doge Etaidure Tuioruduwo Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewuji
source: Fariseu Doge Etaidure Tuioruduwo Ia Jesus Ro Rakarewuji

b: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jesus ae. Ere tunarado ji tumago rakarewu tabo tuioruduwo joruduwamode rugadu dubagai. Dukodire enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo ro rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.
source: Ia fariseu doge etaregodure Jesus ae. Ere tunarado ji tumago rakarewu tabo tuioruduwo joruduwamode rugadu dubagai. Dukodire enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo ia turo ro rakarewu to tiagai tuioruduwo nouia ro rakarewu aregodure rugadu Pao Kurirewu piji du bagai.

b: Mare Jesus joruduware nowu boe emearutorukare pudui duji dukodire ure ake ta tubiji tugiarigodure dukodi. Nono akore Kocare awu boe etaidure tu iro rakawo tuioruduwawo i rugadu. Boro! Iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji rugadu! Pagare egoino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo i rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus joruduware nowu boe emearutorukare pudui duji dukodire ure ake ta tubiji tugiarigodure dukodi. Nono akore Kocare awu boe etaidure tu iro rakawo tuioruduwawo i rugadu. Boro! Iromodukare ia iro rakarewu ji rugadu! Pagare egoino. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo i rugadu.

b: Dukodire uture epiji. Ure taredo ika kurirewuto pugeje tugurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka.
source: Dukodire uture epiji. Ure taredo ika kurirewuto pugeje tugurugoduwo nowu pobo maerewu okwa ka.

b: Fariseu Doge Ero Pegarewu Reo
source: Fariseu Doge Ero Pegarewu Reo

b: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewiagodure tuwo tugeragu ia tuge amirewu ji pugeje. Dukodire eke akedugodure. Eke amirewure mitotu je nowu ika kurirewu tada.
source: Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewiagodure tuwo tugeragu ia tuge amirewu ji pugeje. Dukodire eke akedugodure. Eke amirewure mitotu je nowu ika kurirewu tada.

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore tawiapagado tawo tado tarugadu. Fariseu doge emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Herodes mearudae ure nono fermento mogadure jamedu. Tamearudaekaba nono nowu emearudae mogadure.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore tawiapagado tawo tado tarugadu. Fariseu doge emearudae ure nono fermento mogadure. Herodes mearudae ure nono fermento mogadure jamedu. Tamearudaekaba nono nowu emearudae mogadure.

b: Dukodire nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui kaba jiba akoino nowu fermento jiboe ji. Egore pui: – Pawiagodure page amirewu piji dukodire Pagimijera akoino pai.
source: Dukodire nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui kaba jiba akoino nowu fermento jiboe ji. Egore pui: – Pawiagodure page amirewu piji dukodire Pagimijera akoino pai.

b: Jesus joruduware egoino pui duji. Nono unaragodure ei. Akore kodiba tamagore pui nowu tage amirewu bokwaie duji? Kocare taruduwa bokware kimo? Tagaora rakare taruduwawo iwadaru ji.
source: Jesus joruduware egoino pui duji. Nono unaragodure ei. Akore kodiba tamagore pui nowu tage amirewu bokwaie duji? Kocare taruduwa bokware kimo? Tagaora rakare taruduwawo iwadaru ji.

b: Taekure taruduwo irore jiboe ji. Tawijare tamearuduwo imagore jiboe ji. Mare tawiagodure irore jiboe piji, imagore jiboe piji marigudu.
source: Taekure taruduwo irore jiboe ji. Tawijare tamearuduwo imagore jiboe ji. Mare tawiagodure irore jiboe piji, imagore jiboe piji marigudu.

b: Ire boe ekerogu kado dukeje nowu boe eke kodure kuri boe ekori. Ire boe enogwagedo nowu boe eke roguji. Nou boe enodo padure cinco mil. Enogwagere dukeje tare boe eke kobo tugu kadaraboto boe etuwo tabo. Nuba tare korau kadarabo ure nowu boe eke kobo tabo? egore oto padure doze.
source: Ire boe ekerogu kado dukeje nowu boe eke kodure kuri boe ekori. Ire boe enogwagedo nowu boe eke roguji. Nou boe enodo padure cinco mil. Enogwagere dukeje tare boe eke kobo tugu kadaraboto boe etuwo tabo. Nuba tare korau kadarabo ure nowu boe eke kobo tabo? egore oto padure doze.

b: Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore ca ia meri keje ire boe enogwagedo pugeje. Nou amirewu ure sete. Ire kado boe etai pugeje du nowu ime enodo padure quatro mil. Ca nuba tare korau kadarabo dogere nowu boe eke kobo tabo? egore oto padure sete.
source: Jesus makore ei pugeje. Akore ca ia meri keje ire boe enogwagedo pugeje. Nou amirewu ure sete. Ire kado boe etai pugeje du nowu ime enodo padure quatro mil. Ca nuba tare korau kadarabo dogere nowu boe eke kobo tabo? egore oto padure sete.

b: Jesus akore Kocare taruduwa bokware imearudae remawu ji kana?
source: Jesus akore Kocare taruduwa bokware imearudae remawu ji kana?

b: Jesus Ure Joku Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago
source: Jesus Ure Joku Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago

b: Jesus a regodure ture joruduwadowugebo Betsaida ba kurirewu ka. Nono ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia joku bokwarewu imedu apo. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera bu keje.
source: Jesus a regodure ture joruduwadowugebo Betsaida ba kurirewu ka. Nono ia boe etaregodure Jesus ae ia joku bokwarewu imedu apo. Enogwamagudure Jesus ji uwo tugera bu keje.

b: Jesus ure tugeragu nowu joku bokwarewu imedu ieraji. Uture apo toro nowu ba kurirewu piji tugiogowo nowu imeduji. Nono Jesus ure todoguru bu nowu imedu joku keje. Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu keje jamedu. Dukejere unarare ji. Akore arudure iaboe ji?
source: Jesus ure tugeragu nowu joku bokwarewu imedu ieraji. Uture apo toro nowu ba kurirewu piji tugiogowo nowu imeduji. Nono Jesus ure todoguru bu nowu imedu joku keje. Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu keje jamedu. Dukejere unarare ji. Akore arudure iaboe ji?

b: Nou imedu aiwore. Dukeje akore Uu. Iorudure ia boe ji. Mare ioruduwakare ei. Ere nono igurure tumeru tabo mato, toro, mato, toro, mato.
source: Nou imedu aiwore. Dukeje akore Uu. Iorudure ia boe ji. Mare ioruduwakare ei. Ere nono igurure tumeru tabo mato, toro, mato, toro, mato.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu joku keje. Dukejere nowu imedu aiwore pugeje. Care joku pemegagodure. Jorudure boe ji rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu joku keje. Dukejere nowu imedu aiwore pugeje. Care joku pemegagodure. Jorudure boe ji rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ji utuwo tuibagi tuwai ka. Akore akaba akirimi ba kurirewu ka. Atudo jii toro awai ka.
source: Nono Jesus makore ji utuwo tuibagi tuwai ka. Akore akaba akirimi ba kurirewu ka. Atudo jii toro awai ka.

b: Pedro Akore umode Boe Ekinorudowu Nuie Jesusce Rugadu
source: Pedro Akore umode Boe Ekinorudowu Nuie Jesusce Rugadu

b: Dukejere Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo nowu ba kurirewu piji toro ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda puredure Cesaréia Filipe ba kurirewuji. Nou awara ji Jesus unarare nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore nuba boe emearudaere i?
source: Dukejere Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo nowu ba kurirewu piji toro ia boe eda ka. Nou boe eda puredure Cesaréia Filipe ba kurirewuji. Nou awara ji Jesus unarare nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore nuba boe emearudaere i?

b: egore boe egore João Batista nuie aki. Nouiage egore elias nuie aki. Nouiage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu nuie aki.
source: egore boe egore João Batista nuie aki. Nouiage egore elias nuie aki. Nouiage egore ia mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu nuie aki.

b: Nono Jesus unarare ei pugeje. Akore tagi. Nuba tamearudaere i? Pedro akore Umode boe ekinorudowunure aki rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus unarare ei pugeje. Akore tagi. Nuba tamearudaere i? Pedro akore Umode boe ekinorudowunure aki rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus akore Tamagokaba awu tamearudaere idu jiboe ji boe ewiagai.
source: Nono Jesus akore Tamagokaba awu tamearudaere idu jiboe ji boe ewiagai.

b: Jesus Ure Ewie Tuwimode Duji
source: Jesus Ure Ewie Tuwimode Duji

b: Nono Jesus ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado pugeje. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Judeu doge eimijerage erudu pegamode i. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage erudu pegamode i. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge erudu pegamode i. Emode boe pegado i rugadu. Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje.
source: Nono Jesus ure nowu ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado pugeje. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Judeu doge eimijerage erudu pegamode i. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage erudu pegamode i. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge erudu pegamode i. Emode boe pegado i rugadu. Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumode pugeje.

b: Jesus mako pemegare nowu tuwadaru ji nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewiagai eruduwawo boe mode pudui duji. Mare Pedro aidukare nowu Jesus bataru ji. Ure tumegido Jesus apo kuri nono tumagowo ji. Akore boe modukare aino ai.
source: Jesus mako pemegare nowu tuwadaru ji nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewiagai eruduwawo boe mode pudui duji. Mare Pedro aidukare nowu Jesus bataru ji. Ure tumegido Jesus apo kuri nono tumagowo ji. Akore boe modukare aino ai.

b: Mare Jesus ure tumegido. Nono aiwore nowu ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ji. Dukejere mako rakare Pedro ji. Akore akaradai ikoda piji Satanás. Amearudae jire inagoino. Amearudaere nono boe emearudae mogadure. Boe emearudaekare nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure.
source: Mare Jesus ure tumegido. Nono aiwore nowu ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ji. Dukejere mako rakare Pedro ji. Akore akaradai ikoda piji Satanás. Amearudae jire inagoino. Amearudaere nono boe emearudae mogadure. Boe emearudaekare nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure.

b: Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai ewo tuburedo pudui. Makore ia boe ewagai jamedu. Dukejere makore ei. Akore ia tagi tagaidumode tamearutoruwo i dukeje tagera ra taro pegarewu piji, tawia ra tamearudae pegarewu piji, tagaidure jiboe piji. Tado tarugadu boe pegawo tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Iwimode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dukodire inagoino tai tawo tado tarugadu tagoduwo itabo.
source: Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai ewo tuburedo pudui. Makore ia boe ewagai jamedu. Dukejere makore ei. Akore ia tagi tagaidumode tamearutoruwo i dukeje tagera ra taro pegarewu piji, tawia ra tamearudae pegarewu piji, tagaidure jiboe piji. Tado tarugadu boe pegawo tai nono boe pegamode i dumogadure. Iwimode ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Dukodire inagoino tai tawo tado tarugadu tagoduwo itabo.

b: Boe ewiapagamode tuwo boe pemegado tu pudui turaga tabo dukeje nowu boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare tuginorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji tumearudae pegarewu piji tuwo tumagu inai tuwo boe eruduwado iwu bakaru pemegarewu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu.
source: Boe ewiapagamode tuwo boe pemegado tu pudui turaga tabo dukeje nowu boe eraga akedumode epiji rugadu. Egare remawu modukare. Emodukare tuginorudo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu piji rugadu. Mare boe ewiapagamodukare tumearudae ji pugeje tuwo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji tumearudae pegarewu piji tuwo tumagu inai tuwo boe eruduwado iwu bakaru pemegarewu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode egare remawudo rugadu. Nono ewarigudumodukare bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewuto jamedu.

b: Imedu umode toedo boe jamedu boece. Mare nowu oe umodukare imedu rutudo baru to. Ca nowu imedu biagorokare tuwo tumearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Biagorore tu tuwo toe kurido pagatu je. Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe emodukare turudu morido toe tabo.
source: Imedu umode toedo boe jamedu boece. Mare nowu oe umodukare imedu rutudo baru to. Ca nowu imedu biagorokare tuwo tumearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji. Biagorore tu tuwo toe kurido pagatu je. Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe emodukare turudu morido toe tabo.

b: Ro pegarewuge emagare rugadu. Ro pegarewuge tieribari tabowuge emagare rugadu. Mare ia boe epogurure tumagowo iwu bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai dukeje imodukare ikeragu ei itae. Itaregodumode Pao Kurirewu o jorugu pemegarewu tabo Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawugebo dukeje imodukare ikeragu ei. Nou Pao Kurirewu o jorugu pemegarewu urugure Pao Kurirewu kujegajeje. Imode ikirimi mato dukeje urugumode nowu aregodumode itabowu Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ekujegajeje jamedu.
source: Ro pegarewuge emagare rugadu. Ro pegarewuge tieribari tabowuge emagare rugadu. Mare ia boe epogurure tumagowo iwu bakaruji nowu boe ewiagai dukeje imodukare ikeragu ei itae. Itaregodumode Pao Kurirewu o jorugu pemegarewu tabo Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawugebo dukeje imodukare ikeragu ei. Nou Pao Kurirewu o jorugu pemegarewu urugure Pao Kurirewu kujegajeje. Imode ikirimi mato dukeje urugumode nowu aregodumode itabowu Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge ekujegajeje jamedu.

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje. Akore iwo tawie. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje aregodumode turaga tabo rugadu. Ia tagi tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe ji. Tawimodukare jii toro tarudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu roino jitu ka.
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowugei pugeje. Akore iwo tawie. Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi dukeje aregodumode turaga tabo rugadu. Ia tagi tarudumode awu inagoino jiboe ji. Tawimodukare jii toro tarudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu roino jitu ka.

b: Jesus Ure Tiedo Tuginai
source: Jesus Ure Tiedo Tuginai

b: Meri oto padure seis Jesus ji pugeje. Nono ca uture Pedro apo, Tiago apo, João apo toro ia tori ricorewu ao ka. Tu emagere edure nono nowu tori aogeje. Nono nowu Jesus je ure tudo tuginai. Nou ure joruduwadowuge erudure ji rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu koiare ure Jesus je udo tuginai.
source: Meri oto padure seis Jesus ji pugeje. Nono ca uture Pedro apo, Tiago apo, João apo toro ia tori ricorewu ao ka. Tu emagere edure nono nowu tori aogeje. Nono nowu Jesus je ure tudo tuginai. Nou ure joruduwadowuge erudure ji rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu koiare ure Jesus je udo tuginai.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus ukudau areia kigadu maerewudo ji. Kigadure rugadu kigadureboe jamedu boe kori.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure Jesus ukudau areia kigadu maerewudo ji. Kigadure rugadu kigadureboe jamedu boe kori.

b: Nono ca rore puku ei ime edure nono ebo. Eliare Moisere edu nono tumago tabo Jesus ji.
source: Nono ca rore puku ei ime edure nono ebo. Eliare Moisere edu nono tumago tabo Jesus ji.

b: Nono Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Ure turugadu paeduwo woe. Cemode ia macebradudo pobe metia bokware. Iamode akai. Iamode Moisés ai. Iamode Elias ai jamedu.
source: Nono Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Ure turugadu paeduwo woe. Cemode ia macebradudo pobe metia bokware. Iamode akai. Iamode Moisés ai. Iamode Elias ai jamedu.

b: Pedro, Tiago, João epagudugodure dukodire Pedro makore aino. Dukodire eruduwakare tumagomode jiboe ji.
source: Pedro, Tiago, João epagudugodure dukodire Pedro makore aino. Dukodire eruduwakare tumagomode jiboe ji.

b: Nono ia boetugu ure turawuje etae. Nou boetugu ure taiado ebo. Nono emearudure ia boe emagoji nowu boetugu piji. Akore imearudu kurire jiwu itonaregedu reo. Tawiapaga pemegado awu itonaregedu bataru ji.
source: Nono ia boetugu ure turawuje etae. Nou boetugu ure taiado ebo. Nono emearudure ia boe emagoji nowu boetugu piji. Akore imearudu kurire jiwu itonaregedu reo. Tawiapaga pemegado awu itonaregedu bataru ji.

b: Nono ere tie maedo mare erudukare ia boe ji pugeje. Tu emagere eragojere nono Jesus apo.
source: Nono ere tie maedo mare erudukare ia boe ji pugeje. Tu emagere eragojere nono Jesus apo.

b: Nono ere turawuje nowu tori ao piji. Dukejere Jesus makore ei. Akore tareadodukaba tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Iewodumode pugeje dukeje tareadodumode awu tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai.
source: Nono ere turawuje nowu tori ao piji. Dukejere Jesus makore ei. Akore tareadodukaba tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai. Imedu Onaregedunure imi. Iewodumode pugeje dukeje tareadodumode awu tarudure jiboe ji boe ewiagai.

b: Emearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji. Mare puire enarare. egore nuburedu jiba akoino pai tuiewodumoduie pugeje?
source: Emearutorure awu Jesus bataru ji. Mare puire enarare. egore nuburedu jiba akoino pai tuiewodumoduie pugeje?

b: Dukodire enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba pawobe eruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge egore elias aregodumoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu otodai?
source: Dukodire enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba pawobe eruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge egore elias aregodumoduie nowu umode boe ekinorudowu otodai?

b: Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu makore boe ji marigudu Elias aregodumoduie boeto ji rugadu. Umoduie boe ewie ewo tudo turugadu nowu umode boe ekinorudowu aregoduwo etae rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu bataru makore boe ji marigudu boe pegamoduie nowu Imedu Onaregeduji. Boe etaidumodukaie nowu Imedu Onaregeduji.
source: Jesus akore Pao Kurirewu makore boe ji marigudu Elias aregodumoduie boeto ji rugadu. Umoduie boe ewie ewo tudo turugadu nowu umode boe ekinorudowu aregoduwo etae rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu bataru makore boe ji marigudu boe pegamoduie nowu Imedu Onaregeduji. Boe etaidumodukaie nowu Imedu Onaregeduji.

b: Mare inure tawie. Nou Pao Kurirewu makore jiwu imedu Elias aregodure marigudu. João Batistare ema. Rore nono Elias ro mogadure. Mare boe etaidukare ji. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu ainoie boemoduie nowu Eliaji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu João Batistaji.
source: Mare inure tawie. Nou Pao Kurirewu makore jiwu imedu Elias aregodure marigudu. João Batistare ema. Rore nono Elias ro mogadure. Mare boe etaidukare ji. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu ainoie boemoduie nowu Eliaji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu João Batistaji.

b: Jesus Ure Mareboe Meture Tadawu Iparedu Pemegago
source: Jesus Ure Mareboe Meture Tadawu Iparedu Pemegago

b: Nono Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowuge etae Pedro apo, João apo, Tiago apo. Boe emagare nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowugebo. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge edure nono ebo jamedu. Etokire pui.
source: Nono Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowuge etae Pedro apo, João apo, Tiago apo. Boe emagare nono nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowugebo. Ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge edure nono ebo jamedu. Etokire pui.

b: Boe erudure Jesus ji dukeje egarere pudui. Nono eregodure togi. Ekimadure Jesus apo.
source: Boe erudure Jesus ji dukeje egarere pudui. Nono eregodure togi. Ekimadure Jesus apo.

b: Mare Jesus unarare ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore kaba tawadaru jiba tagagoino nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugei?
source: Mare Jesus unarare ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore kaba tawadaru jiba tagagoino nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugei?

b: Nono ia imedu rakojere boe etoiadada. Makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Itaregodure itonaregedu apo woe are joruduwadowuge etae. Bope uwari meture awu itonaregedu tada. Dukodire itonaregedu roiwakare tumagowo.
source: Nono ia imedu rakojere boe etoiadada. Makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Itaregodure itonaregedu apo woe are joruduwadowuge etae. Bope uwari meture awu itonaregedu tada. Dukodire itonaregedu roiwakare tumagowo.

b: Nou bope uwari ro pegare itonaregeduji. Ure butudo moto ka. Nou itonaregedu jataro aregodure jabiji. Ure tora reko pui. Nono rakagodure. Inogwamagudure are joruduwadowugei ewo nowu bope uwari pegarewu barigu piji mare ero cekare ji.
source: Nou bope uwari ro pegare itonaregeduji. Ure butudo moto ka. Nou itonaregedu jataro aregodure jabiji. Ure tora reko pui. Nono rakagodure. Inogwamagudure are joruduwadowugei ewo nowu bope uwari pegarewu barigu piji mare ero cekare ji.

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore tare ikiarigo. Tamearutorukare rugadu. Iragoje raimodukare tagabo. Nuba tagaidure irowo tamearutoruwo i? Nono Jesus makore iagei. Akore mato nowu iparedu apo itae!
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore tare ikiarigo. Tamearutorukare rugadu. Iragoje raimodukare tagabo. Nuba tagaidure irowo tamearutoruwo i? Nono Jesus makore iagei. Akore mato nowu iparedu apo itae!

b: Dukodire boe ere nowu iparedu reko Jesus ae. Nou meture nowu iparedu tadawu bope uwari jorudure Jesus ji dukeje ure nowu iparedu butudo moto ka pugeje. Magadugodure moto keje. Nou iparedu jataro aregodure ja piji. Dukodire Jesus makore nowu iparedu uoji jamedu.
source: Dukodire boe ere nowu iparedu reko Jesus ae. Nou meture nowu iparedu tadawu bope uwari jorudure Jesus ji dukeje ure nowu iparedu butudo moto ka pugeje. Magadugodure moto keje. Nou iparedu jataro aregodure ja piji. Dukodire Jesus makore nowu iparedu uoji jamedu.

b: Akore marigudu na nowu bope roino akanaregeduji? Nou iparedu uo akore Marigudu rugadu. Imedurogu biagare tu je dutabore nowu bope uwari roino ji jii aino.
source: Akore marigudu na nowu bope roino akanaregeduji? Nou iparedu uo akore Marigudu rugadu. Imedurogu biagare tu je dutabore nowu bope uwari roino ji jii aino.

b: Mai karega roino ji. Ure barigu joru to biwo joru tada. Dukeje ure barigu poboto biwo pobo tada. Inogwamagudunure ai. Akogududo cedabo. Aroiware dukeje awu itonaregedu pemegago.
source: Mai karega roino ji. Ure barigu joru to biwo joru tada. Dukeje ure barigu poboto biwo pobo tada. Inogwamagudunure ai. Akogududo cedabo. Aroiware dukeje awu itonaregedu pemegago.

b: Jesus akore Uu. Mare amearutorumode rugadu dukeje aroiwamode boe jamedu boe ji.
source: Jesus akore Uu. Mare amearutorumode rugadu dukeje aroiwamode boe jamedu boe ji.

b: Nou imedu aidure rugadu. Akore imearutorure ai. Imearudae pegarewu tawuje ipiji imearutoru raiwo ai rugadu.
source: Nou imedu aidure rugadu. Akore imearutorure ai. Imearudae pegarewu tawuje ipiji imearutoru raiwo ai rugadu.

b: Jesus jorudure nowu boe emagare turegodu tabo mato pudae duji. Nono mako pegare nowu meture nowu iparedu tadawu bope uwariji. Akore bope uwarinure aki. Mako bokwarewunure aki. Bija bokwarewunure aki. Atudo awu iparedu piji. Amodukare aremo to pugeje!
source: Jesus jorudure nowu boe emagare turegodu tabo mato pudae duji. Nono mako pegare nowu meture nowu iparedu tadawu bope uwariji. Akore bope uwarinure aki. Mako bokwarewunure aki. Bija bokwarewunure aki. Atudo awu iparedu piji. Amodukare aremo to pugeje!

b: Nou bope uwari kudugodure. Nono ure nowu iparedu butudo moto ka pugeje. Mare ure tudawuje nowu iparedu piji rugadu. Nono nowu iparedu ure nono birewuboe mogadure. Nou boe egore bire rugadu!
source: Nou bope uwari kudugodure. Nono ure nowu iparedu butudo moto ka pugeje. Mare ure tudawuje nowu iparedu piji rugadu. Nono nowu iparedu ure nono birewuboe mogadure. Nou boe egore bire rugadu!

b: Mare Jesus ure tugeragu nowu iparedu ieraji. Dukejere ure udo turagojedo pugeje.
source: Mare Jesus ure tugeragu nowu iparedu ieraji. Dukejere ure udo turagojedo pugeje.

b: Nono Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba ceroiwakare cewo nowu bope uwari tawuje nowu iparedu piji?
source: Nono Jesus ure turemo ia baito. Nono nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kodiba ceroiwakare cewo nowu bope uwari tawuje nowu iparedu piji?

b: Jesus akore Boe emagomodukare baru to dukeje eroiwamodukare tuwo awu bope uwari tawuje boe epiji. Boe enogwamaguduwo baru to nono boe eroiwamode tuwo bope uwari tawuje piji. Ia boe eroiwamodukare tuwo tawuje rugadu.
source: Jesus akore Boe emagomodukare baru to dukeje eroiwamodukare tuwo awu bope uwari tawuje boe epiji. Boe enogwamaguduwo baru to nono boe eroiwamode tuwo bope uwari tawuje piji. Ia boe eroiwamodukare tuwo tawuje rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Tuwimoduie Tuiewodumoduie Pugeje Jamedu
source: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Tuwimoduie Tuiewodumoduie Pugeje Jamedu

b: Jesus uture nowu moto piji ture joruduwadowugebo jii toro nowu Galiléia moto ka.
source: Jesus uture nowu moto piji ture joruduwadowugebo jii toro nowu Galiléia moto ka.

b: Jesus mearudaere tuwo tudaru kuri boe poru ka jao ture joruduwadowugebo tuwo eruduwado nuba boemode pudui duji. Makore ei. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai. Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware i dukejere iewodumode pugeje.
source: Jesus mearudaere tuwo tudaru kuri boe poru ka jao ture joruduwadowugebo tuwo eruduwado nuba boemode pudui duji. Makore ei. Akore imedu Onaregedunure imi. Imagudumode ro pegarewuge etai. Emode iwido. Mare merimode pobe metia bokware i dukejere iewodumode pugeje.

b: Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Mare epagudure tunarawo Jesus ji kaba jiba Jesus akoino pudui.
source: Mare nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare nowu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Mare epagudure tunarawo Jesus ji kaba jiba Jesus akoino pudui.

b: Duboba Boe Eimijerage Mode Emage
source: Duboba Boe Eimijerage Mode Emage

b: Jesus aregodure Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Ere turemo ia baito dukeje Jesus unarare ei. Akore tagokire pui awara ji. Kaboba bagaiba tagagoino pui?
source: Jesus aregodure Cafarnaum ba kurirewu ka ture joruduwadowugebo. Ere turemo ia baito dukeje Jesus unarare ei. Akore tagokire pui awara ji. Kaboba bagaiba tagagoino pui?

b: Mare emagokare Jesus bataru jipagi. Eiamedu boe etaidure tuwo boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi tumedage epiji. Dukodire etokire pui awara ji. Nono epogurure tumagowo tumearudae boe ji Jesus biagai. Dukodire emagokare Jesus bataru jipagi.
source: Mare emagokare Jesus bataru jipagi. Eiamedu boe etaidure tuwo boe eimijera kurirewudo pudumi tumedage epiji. Dukodire etokire pui awara ji. Nono epogurure tumagowo tumearudae boe ji Jesus biagai. Dukodire emagokare Jesus bataru jipagi.

b: Nono Jesus ure tumugudo nowu bai tada tumagowo nowu ture joruduwadowugei mare joruduware emearudae boe ji rugadu. Makore ei. Akore boe eimijera mearudaemode nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera ro pemegarewudo pudumi.
source: Nono Jesus ure tumugudo nowu bai tada tumagowo nowu ture joruduwadowugei mare joruduware emearudae boe ji rugadu. Makore ei. Akore boe eimijera mearudaemode nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera ro pemegarewudo pudumi.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu ia boe etonaregedu roguji. Makore ji rakojewo nono boe etoiadada. Nono ukimadure apo dukeje makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei pugeje.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu ia boe etonaregedu roguji. Makore ji rakojewo nono boe etoiadada. Nono ukimadure apo dukeje makore nowu ture joruduwadowugei pugeje.

b: Akore boe emode tugera podo boe etonaregedu apo inai itabore ere tugera podo. Boe emode tugera podo itabo ure itarego matowu apore ure tugera podo jamedu.
source: Akore boe emode tugera podo boe etonaregedu apo inai itabore ere tugera podo. Boe emode tugera podo itabo ure itarego matowu apore ure tugera podo jamedu.

b: Ro Pegakare Ceiwuge Etaidure Cei
source: Ro Pegakare Ceiwuge Etaidure Cei

b: João makore Jesus ji. Akore cerudure ia imeduji. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji akie tabo. Cemagore ji uwo tugera ra nowu turo piji. Ia are joruduwadowu karegure ema.
source: João makore Jesus ji. Akore cerudure ia imeduji. Ure bope doge etawuje boe epiji akie tabo. Cemagore ji uwo tugera ra nowu turo piji. Ia are joruduwadowu karegure ema.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore Piji. Umode bope tawuje boe epiji ikie tabo dukeje mako pegamodukare i.
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore Piji. Umode bope tawuje boe epiji ikie tabo dukeje mako pegamodukare i.

b: Ro pegakare paiwuge emearudu kurinure pai.
source: Ro pegakare paiwuge emearudu kurinure pai.

b: Inure tawie. Ia boe eruduware tamearutorure i duji. Nono emode pobo maku tagai taguduwo ce dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei rugadu eroino du morice.
source: Inure tawie. Ia boe eruduware tamearutorure i duji. Nono emode pobo maku tagai taguduwo ce dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei rugadu eroino du morice.

b: Boe Etaidure Tuwo Boe Ekiripagado Ero Pegawo
source: Boe Etaidure Tuwo Boe Ekiripagado Ero Pegawo

b: Jesus akore Boe emode tori kurirewu kogudo ia boe ekidoru kajeje tuwo ewarigu poboto dukodire nowu ewarigudure pobo towuge ewimode. Mare ia boe umode nowu itore mearutorure maibari iwuge edo tugera ra ipiji ero pegawo pugeje dukeje boe pegamode nowu ure nowu boe etore etaora pegadowuji rugadu. Jire boe pegarewu kodumode nowu barigudure pobo towuge ekori.
source: Jesus akore Boe emode tori kurirewu kogudo ia boe ekidoru kajeje tuwo ewarigu poboto dukodire nowu ewarigudure pobo towuge ewimode. Mare ia boe umode nowu itore mearutorure maibari iwuge edo tugera ra ipiji ero pegawo pugeje dukeje boe pegamode nowu ure nowu boe etore etaora pegadowuji rugadu. Jire boe pegarewu kodumode nowu barigudure pobo towuge ekori.

b: Boe etaidukare tugera kadoduwo tugana piji. Mare tagera umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tagera kado tabiji. Mare tagera remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamearutorumodukare i dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Nou joru akedumodukare rugadu. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu jii toro rugadu. Mare tamearutorumode i dukeje imode tarududo baru to. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pemegamode tai nono jii toro rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tagera umode mitotu je mare du inodu tabo tamearutorure i dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.
source: Boe etaidukare tugera kadoduwo tugana piji. Mare tagera umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tagera kado tabiji. Mare tagera remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamearutorumodukare i dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Nou joru akedumodukare rugadu. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu jii toro rugadu. Mare tamearutorumode i dukeje imode tarududo baru to. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pemegamode tai nono jii toro rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tagera umode mitotu je mare du inodu tabo tamearutorure i dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.

b: Boe etaidukare tuwure kadoduwo tubogora piji. Mare tawure umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tawure kado tabogora piji. Mare tawure remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamearutorumodukare i dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu jii toro rugadu. Mare tamearutorumode i dukeje imode tarududo baru to. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pemegamode tai nono jii toro rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tawure umode mitotu je mare du inodu tabo tamearutorure i dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.
source: Boe etaidukare tuwure kadoduwo tubogora piji. Mare tawure umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje tawure kado tabogora piji. Mare tawure remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamearutorumodukare i dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu jii toro rugadu. Mare tamearutorumode i dukeje imode tarududo baru to. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pemegamode tai nono jii toro rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tawure umode mitotu je mare du inodu tabo tamearutorure i dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.

b: Boe etaidukare tuioku bokwawo. Mare taeku umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje taeku tawuje tabiji. Mare taeku remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamodukare tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu. Toro ate doge enogwagemode boe ji jii toro. Etagedumodukare. Toro joru umode boe ekowu jii toro. Nou joru akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Mare tamode tamearudae pegarewu barigu tagaora piji tawo tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukeje boe pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Taeku umode mitotu je mare tamearutorure i rugadu dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.
source: Boe etaidukare tuioku bokwawo. Mare taeku umode taro pegado tamearutorukawo i dukeje taeku tawuje tabiji. Mare taeku remawu ji karega inagoino. Tamearudae pegarewu jire inagoino tawo barigu tabiji. Mare paga karega. Tamodukare tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukeje tawarigudumode bope doge eda kejewu joru maerewuto. Tadumode toro dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu. Toro ate doge enogwagemode boe ji jii toro. Etagedumodukare. Toro joru umode boe ekowu jii toro. Nou joru akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Mare tamode tamearudae pegarewu barigu tagaora piji tawo tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce dukeje boe pemegamode tai rugadu. Dukodire inagoino tai. Taeku umode mitotu je mare tamearutorure i rugadu dukeje tarudumode baru to rugadu tawikawo pugeje.

b: – Joru butumode boe eiamedu boe ewugeje. Nou joru umode boe pegarewu kowu. Nou boe pemegarewu jetumode.
source: – Joru butumode boe eiamedu boe ewugeje. Nou joru umode boe pegarewu kowu. Nou boe pemegarewu jetumode.

b: – Sal pemegare. Mare sal pegomode dukeje nowu sal akedumode. Nono umodukare nono sal mogadure pugeje. Sal umode boe eke pemegado. Tarodo pui nono sal mogadure. Mare sal ji karega inagoino. Tagogududo tagabo. Taro pemegado pui tabemegawo pui rugadu.
source: – Sal pemegare. Mare sal pegomode dukeje nowu sal akedumode. Nono umodukare nono sal mogadure pugeje. Sal umode boe eke pemegado. Tarodo pui nono sal mogadure. Mare sal ji karega inagoino. Tagogududo tagabo. Taro pemegado pui tabemegawo pui rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Ekawo Tugera Ra Toreduje Epiji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Ekawo Tugera Ra Toreduje Epiji

b: Nono Jesus uture nowu moto piji toro Judéia moto ka. Kurugodure Jordão po kajeje. Boe emagare taregodutabo Jesus ae pugeje. Dukodire Jesus ure eruduwado nono turo mogadure.

b: – Mare nowu jeture boepa jiwuge emagore pui. Egore: “Awu ore boepa cewu onaregedu reo. Emare omode tuo oe jamedu boece. Pawo bito pagowo awu uo o motoce.”

b: – Dukodire nowu jeture boepa jiwuge ere tugeragu nowu ore boepa cewu onaregeduji. Ere bito. Ere barigu toro nowu boepa piji.

b: Jesus mako kimore nowu boe ji. Akore ainore erore rugadu. Ca. Nuba nowu ore boepa cewu romode nowu jeture boepa jiwugei? Aregodumode etae. Umode ewido. Nono umode to boepa maku iage etai etuwo ji pugeje.

b: Mare tagaiwokare rugadu ia padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji kana? Ainore awu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Boe emearudae pegare ia toriji. Egore pegaie tuwo tuwaido ema. Mare nowu tori pemegarewunure ema rugadu boe ewo tuwaido ema rugadu.

b: – Pao Kurirewu koiare ure nowu tori pemegado aino. Ure pemegado nouia tori jamedu boe ekori. Boe eiamedu boe ebogodure nowu Pao Kurirewu roino duji.

b: Judeu doge eimijerage emearudure Jesus akoino jiboe ji dukeje eruduware puduire Jesus akoino duji. Dukodire etaidure tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo tugu baicorewuto kuri je rugadu. Mare boe etaidure Jesus ji. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage epagudure, eroiwakare tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji. Dukodire eture piji.

b: Boe Ewo To Imposto Mori Maku Roma Kejewu Boe Eimijera Kurirewu César Ai
source: Boe Ewo To Imposto Mori Maku Roma Kejewu Boe Eimijera Kurirewu César Ai

b: Judeu doge eimijerage ere fariseu doge etudo Jesus ae. Ere ia aidure Herodes jiwuge etudo Jesus ae jamedu. Judeu doge eimijerage emagore nowu boe ji etuwo Jesus ae tunarawo ji tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji.

b: Dukodire etaregodure Jesus ae. Emagore Jesus ji. egore boe eimijeranure aki rugadu. Akare awadaru udo paga boe ji. Amearudaere boe ji boe remawu tabo. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Awiapagakare boe ewadaru pegarewuji. Amearudaere Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji. Are boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji tu tu je. Awiapagakare ia boe emearudae pegarewu ji rugadu. Ca. b: Ere ia diero tori maku Jesus ai. Nono Jesus akore Ioguduba je ba padure awu diero tori keje? Ioguduba ie ba padure awu diero tori keje? egore Roma kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu César ie padure keje.

b: Nono Jesus akore Boe rugadu. Care César oeboe maku César ai. Mare Pao Kurirewu oeboe maku Pao Kurirewu ai jamedu. Nou boe emearudure Jesus akoino duji dukodire erore ta je akoino pudui duji.

b: Ia Boe Eimijerage Enarare Jesus ji Pugeje
source: Ia Boe Eimijerage Enarare Jesus ji Pugeje

b: Nono ia saduceu doge etaregodure Jesus ae tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji jamedu. Nou saduceu doge emearudaere boe eewodumodukaie pugeje. Nono emagore Jesus ji.
source: Nono ia saduceu doge etaregodure Jesus ae tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji jamedu. Nou saduceu doge emearudaere boe eewodumodukaie pugeje. Nono emagore Jesus ji.

b: egore Joruduwarewu imedunure aki. Ca mariguduwu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Moisés ure jaoboe ero maku etai pamearutoruwo ji jii aino rugadu. Akore imedu bimoduie mare ore bokwaie dukeje nowu imedu uwie muguwo nowu tumana birewu oreduje apo torewo nowu birewu tumana ai.

b: Ca ia meri keje ime enodo padure sete. Etumana etuwie magenure pugi. Etumana mugure ia aredu apo. Mare care bire. Mare ore bokware.

source: Dukodire nowu uwie imedu mugure nowu aredu apo. Mare nowu imedu bire jamedu. Etore bokware. Nono uwie imedu mugure nowu aredu apo jamedu. Mare bire jamedu.

b: Dukodire nowu uwie ime eiamedu boe emugure nowu aredu apo rugadu. Mare eiamedu boe ewire. Etore bokware. Dukeje care nowu aredu bire jamedu.
source: Dukodire nowu uwie ime eiamedu boe emugure nowu aredu apo rugadu. Mare eiamedu boe ewire. Etore bokware. Dukeje care nowu aredu bire jamedu.

b: Dukodire cedaidure cenarawo ai. Pao Kurirewu umode eewodudo pugeje dukeje duboba mugumode nowu aredu apo? Eiamedu boe emugure apo moto keje mare duboba mugumode nowu aredu apo baru tada?

b: Jesus makore nowu boe ewadaru jipagi. Akore taruduwa bokware. Taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu bataru padure kejewu baperaji. Taruduwakare Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewuji.

Joru cere nowu enado ito mare nowu joru ukare nowu enado i kowu. Nou enado i pijire Pao Kurirewu makore Moisesji. Akore Abraão mearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewunure imi. b: Pao Kurirewu Bataru Kurirewu Reo
source: Pao Kurirewu Bataru Kurirewu Reo

b: Ia joruduware Pao Kurirewu ure maku etaiwu bakaru jiwu mearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji. Joruduware Jesus mako pemegare nowu saduceu doge ewadaru jipagi duji. Mare mearudaere tunarawo Jesus ji jamedu. Akore kakojiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu remawu jiba pamode pageragu?
source: Ia joruduware Pao Kurirewu ure maku etaiwu bakaru jiwu mearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji. Joruduware Jesus mako pemegare nowu saduceu doge ewadaru jipagi duji. Mare mearudaere tunarawo Jesus ji jamedu. Akore kakojiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru pemegarewu remawu jiba pamode pageragu?

b: Jesus akore Ere pobe. Boetojiwu bataru kurirewu ure aino: “Pao Kurirewu ure mitotu je. Tamearudu kurido Pao Kurirewu ji taraga tabo, tamearudae pemegarewu tabo, tarore jiboe jamedu boe tabo. Judeu doge eiamedu boe eruduwawo awu bataru ji rugadu.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu bataru kurirewu boeto jiwu ure.

Judeu doge eiamedu boe eruduwawo awu bataru ji rugadu.” Ainore Pao Kurirewu bataru kurirewu boeto jiwu ure.

b: Pao Kurirewu bataru boigoduwu ure aino: “Tamearudu kurido tamedagei nono tamearudu kuri moga tai dumogadure.” Ia bataru kurirewu bokware nono awu bataru pobedu doge emogadure.

b: Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu imedu makore Jesus ji pugeje. Akore awadaru ure turugadu. Joruduwarewunure aki. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Pao Kurirewu ure mitotu je. Ia boe umodukare nono umogadure.
source: Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwu imedu makore Jesus ji pugeje. Akore awadaru ure turugadu. Joruduwarewunure aki. Boe jokodu jire akagoino. Pao Kurirewu ure mitotu je. Ia boe umodukare nono umogadure.

b: Boe emearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji turaga tabo, tumearudae pemegarewu jamedu boe tabo. Boe emearudu kuriwo tumedagei nono tumearudu kuri moga pudui dumogadure. Boe emearutorumode awu Pao Kurirewu bataru kurirewu boeto jiwuji dukeje emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu bataru jamedu boe ji. Boe emode boe egu barogorogu bito tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai turo pegarewu boe morice. Emode boe egu barogorogu kodu kowu tuwo tomeado ce Pao Kurirewu ai. Mare emearudu kurimode Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu emearudu kurimode tumedagei rugadu. Dure pemegare nowu turo boe egu barogorogu jitu kori rugadu.

b: Jesus mearudure nowu imedu bataru ji. Jorudure ji joruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwunure ema duji. Dukodire Jesus makore ji pugeje. Akore aruduware awo akimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Ca. Amearutorudo ji rugadu. Nono boe eraga bokware tunarawo Jesus ji pugeje. Eraga bokware tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe ji rugadu.

source: Jesus ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Nono unarare boe ji. Akore joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ere boe eruduwado nowu umode boe ekinorudowuji. Egore Davi onaregedu moduie ema. Mare eruduwa pemegakare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Boe Ekimijerage Ero Pegare Jiboe ji

b: Nono Jesus ure eruduwado rugadu. Akore tagaiwo pemegado joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo pudui. Ere boe etaiwodo tugudau areia moturewu meture pudui duji. Etaidure tuwo boe epogurudo. Etumode ba kurirewu ka dukeje etaidure boe emago pemegawo pudui etaidure boe ekimijeragewo pudumi kodi. Dukodire erore aino.

b: Eragojemode boebo dukeje emago raimode baru to boe emearuduwo tagoi tuwadaru moturewu jituji. Mare pagatu je. Ekiwogure okoge bokwarewuge aremei. Ere nowu areme okoge bokwarewuge ewai aru epiji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pegamode ei rugadu nowu ero pegarewu boe morice.

b: Okoge Bokwarewu Aredu Ure To Diero Rogu Maku Pao Kurirewu Ai
source: Okoge Bokwarewu Aredu Ure To Diero Rogu Maku Pao Kurirewu Ai

b: Jesus ure tumugudo nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada taiwo tabo boe ji. Ere ia to diero tugu ira jagi tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai. Oe kurirewuge ere ture tuguboe kurido rugadu.
source: Jesus ure tumugudo nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada taiwo tabo boe ji. Ere ia to diero tugu ira jagi tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai. Oe kurirewuge ere ture tuguboe kurido rugadu.

b: Nono ia okoge bokwarewudo aredu marenaru aregodure. Nou okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero torirogu pobedu tugu nowu ira jagi. Ure nono um centavo mogadure.

b: Mare diero kurirewu ji karega inagoino. Nou oe kurirewuge ere to diero kurido Pao Kurirewu ai mare etaidukare jiwu kobo rogure ere maku. Eno diero kurire ebo kimo. Mare awu aredu ure to diero rugadu maku. Dujire inagoino.

b: Jesus Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwai Akedumoduie
source: Jesus Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwai Akedumoduie

b: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje Pao Kurirewu uwai piji ture joruduwadowugebo. Ia akore Ikimijera. Akaiwodo. Awu Pao Kurirewu uwai moture rugadu, rakare jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje Pao Kurirewu uwai piji ture joruduwadowugebo. Ia akore Ikimijera. Akaiwodo. Awu Pao Kurirewu uwai moture rugadu, rakare jamedu.

b: Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore awu tarudure jiwu bai rakare, moture. Mare ro pegarewuge emode nowu tarudure jiwu bai kurirewu butudo rugadu. Tori tabore pawobe ere towuje marigudu. Mare ia meri keje nowu tori jamedu boe epadumodukare puaoji pugeje.
source: Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore awu tarudure jiwu bai rakare, moture. Mare ro pegarewuge emode nowu tarudure jiwu bai kurirewu butudo rugadu. Tori tabore pawobe ere towuje marigudu. Mare ia meri keje nowu tori jamedu boe epadumodukare puaoji pugeje.

b: Jesus Ure Ewie Nuba Boe Mode Boei
source: Jesus Ure Ewie Nuba Boe Mode Boei

b: Jesus uture Oliveira Ri ao ka. Mugu jaekare Pao Kurirewu uwai piji. Jesus ure tumugudo nono. Pedro, Tiago, João, André eiamedu boe etaregodure Jesus ae. Ia boe edukare nono ebo. Nono enarare Jesus ji.
source: Jesus uture Oliveira Ri ao ka. Mugu jaekare Pao Kurirewu uwai piji. Jesus ure tumugudo nono. Pedro, Tiago, João, André eiamedu boe etaregodure Jesus ae. Ia boe edukare nono ebo. Nono enarare Jesus ji.

b: egore kaba meri kejeba Pao Kurirewu uwai butumode, nowu akagoino jiboe jetumode pudui kuri aino na? Kaba jiba cerudumode ceruduwawo nowu akagoino jiboe jetumode pudui kuri aino duji?
