b: Jesus makore ei. Akore taeku jado boe ekawo taekiripagado.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore taeku jado boe ekawo taekiripagado.

b: Boe emagamode tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare egoino. Mare du inodu tabo emode boe ekiripagado rugadu.
source: Boe emagamode tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare egoino. Mare du inodu tabo emode boe ekiripagado rugadu.

b: Tamearudumode bakaru pegarewuji. Boe emode tawie boe erugoduie pui tuwaiga tabo. Boe erugodu akedukaie. Boe egomode nowu torowu boe ekorigoduie dukodie erugodu kurie pui rugadu. Mare taragado tai tamororamagadukawo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ro pegarewuge erugoduji marigudu. Umodukare nowu erugodu tawuje epiji. Erugodumode pui tuwaiga tabo rugadu mare moto akedumodukare raga.
source: Tamearudumode bakaru pegarewuji. Boe emode tawie boe erugoduie pui tuwaiga tabo. Boe erugodu akedukaie. Boe egomode nowu torowu boe ekorigoduie dukodie erugodu kurie pui rugadu. Mare taragado tai tamororamagadukawo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ro pegarewuge erugoduji marigudu. Umodukare nowu erugodu tawuje epiji. Erugodumode pui tuwaiga tabo rugadu mare moto akedumodukare raga.

b: Boe eimijera kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje jamedu. Awu inagoino jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji nono aredu kurijirigodu mogadure. Aredu kurijirigodure dukeje boe eruduware kuri butumode kuri aino duji. Mare aredu kurijirigodu ji karega inagoino. Boe pegamode moto ji nono iwadaru mogadure dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji. Dujire inagoino.
source: Boe eimijera kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje jamedu. Awu inagoino jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji nono aredu kurijirigodu mogadure. Aredu kurijirigodure dukeje boe eruduware kuri butumode kuri aino duji. Mare aredu kurijirigodu ji karega inagoino. Boe pegamode moto ji nono iwadaru mogadure dukeje taruduwamode moto akedumode kuri aino duji. Dujire inagoino.

b: Taeku jado. Boe emode tugeragu tai. Emode tadugu baicorewuto. Etaiwomode ia taro pegare jiboe bagai. Emode boeto tai Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tada. Tamearutorure i kodire boe eimijera kurirewuge emagomode tawagai. Dukejere tamagodo iwadaru pemegarewu ji ewadaru jipagi.
source: Taeku jado. Boe emode tugeragu tai. Emode tadugu baicorewuto. Etaiwomode ia taro pegare jiboe bagai. Emode boeto tai Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tada. Tamearutorure i kodire boe eimijera kurirewuge emagomode tawagai. Dukejere tamagodo iwadaru pemegarewu ji ewadaru jipagi.

b: Boe eiamedu boe emearudumode iwu bakaru pemegarewu ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje dukeje moto akedumode.
source: Boe eiamedu boe emearudumode iwu bakaru pemegarewu ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje dukeje moto akedumode.

b: Boe emode tadugu baicorewuto. Emagomode tai ia taro pegarewu bagai. Mare tamororamagadukaba tamagore jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode tuwadaru maku tagai tamagowo ewadaru jipagi.
source: Boe emode tadugu baicorewuto. Emagomode tai ia taro pegarewu bagai. Mare tamororamagadukaba tamagore jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode tuwadaru maku tagai tamagowo ewadaru jipagi.

b: Boe emode tuwiemage emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Boe emode tore emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Boe etore emode tuo tuje emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo.
source: Boe emode tuwiemage emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Boe emode tore emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo. Boe etore emode tuo tuje emagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai ewidoduwo.

b: Tamearutorumode i kodire boe eiamedu boe erudu pegamode tai. Mare tamodukare tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji kodire imode taginorudo rugadu.
source: Tamearutorumode i kodire boe eiamedu boe erudu pegamode tai. Mare tamodukare tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji kodire imode taginorudo rugadu.

b: Judeu Doge Erudu Pegamode Jiboe Reo
source: Judeu Doge Erudu Pegamode Jiboe Reo

b: Jesus makore kimo. Akore tarudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje taruduwamode boe pegamode kuri aino duji. Tarudumode nowu inoduji kodire inagoino tai. Boe erudumode awu bataru padure kejewu baperaji rugadu. Mare boe erudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakamode toro tori ao ka tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.
source: Jesus makore kimo. Akore tarudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje taruduwamode boe pegamode kuri aino duji. Tarudumode nowu inoduji kodire inagoino tai. Boe erudumode awu bataru padure kejewu baperaji rugadu. Mare boe erudumode nowu Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakamode toro tori ao ka tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.

b: Nou rakojere tuwai aogejewuge eregoduwo tuwai piji toro tori ao ka. Ekawo turemo tuwaito iaboe bagai. Etuwo tugera kedo tabo.
source: Nou rakojere tuwai aogejewuge eregoduwo tuwai piji toro tori ao ka. Ekawo turemo tuwaito iaboe bagai. Etuwo tugera kedo tabo.

b: Nou maragodure to boepa jiwuge eregoduwo nowu to boepa piji toro nowu tori ao ka jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka ia tugudau areia bagai.
source: Nou maragodure to boepa jiwuge eregoduwo nowu to boepa piji toro nowu tori ao ka jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka ia tugudau areia bagai.

b: Nou Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe rakojemode Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje boe pegamode boe ji rugadu. Dukodire inagoino boe ji eregoduwo rugadu toro tori ao ka. Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwakare turegodu rakawo dukodi. Boe pegamode etore kugure etuje magei jamedu eroiwakare ture rakawo dukodi.
source: Nou Pao Kurirewu jorudu pegare jiboe rakojemode Pao Kurirewu uwai tada dukeje boe pegamode boe ji rugadu. Dukodire inagoino boe ji eregoduwo rugadu toro tori ao ka. Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwakare turegodu rakawo dukodi. Boe pegamode etore kugure etuje magei jamedu eroiwakare ture rakawo dukodi.

b: Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai biaku butukawo boe ji nowu eregodure jiwu meri keje.
source: Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai biaku butukawo boe ji nowu eregodure jiwu meri keje.

b: Boe pegamode boe ji rugadu boe pega jamedu boe kori. Pao Kurirewu ure moto to dupiji boe erudukare awu boe pegarewu boe ji jii aino. Mare boe pegamode moto ji rugadu.
source: Boe pegamode boe ji rugadu boe pega jamedu boe kori. Pao Kurirewu ure moto to dupiji boe erudukare awu boe pegarewu boe ji jii aino. Mare boe pegamode moto ji rugadu.

b: Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu merido biagatu je pugeje. Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode rugadu dukeje boe eiamedu boe ewimode rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu boe pegamode kejewu merido biagatu je tuwo mearutorure puduiwuge edo cinorudo.
source: Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu merido biagatu je pugeje. Nou boe pegamode kejewu meri makamode rugadu dukeje boe eiamedu boe ewimode rugadu. Mare Pao Kurirewu umode nowu boe pegamode kejewu merido biagatu je tuwo mearutorure puduiwuge edo cinorudo.

b: Mare boe pegamode kejewu meri aregodumode dukeje boe egomode: “Umode boe ekinorudowu aregodu. Ema reo!” Ainore boe egomode. Mare tawiapagakaba ewadaru ji. Pagare egoino.
source: Mare boe pegamode kejewu meri aregodumode dukeje boe egomode: “Umode boe ekinorudowu aregodu. Ema reo!” Ainore boe egomode. Mare tawiapagakaba ewadaru ji. Pagare egoino.

b: Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe etaregodumode rugadu nowu tuwadaru tabo rugadu. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare egoino. Egomode tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare pagare egoino. Ero rakamode boe emearutoruwo pudui Pao Kurirewu piji pagatu je. Emodukare mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge remawuge ekiripagado. Mare etaidumode tuwo mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ekiripagado nowu turo rakarewu tabo rugadu.
source: Mare paga karega inagoino. Boe etaregodumode rugadu nowu tuwadaru tabo rugadu. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Mare pagare egoino. Egomode tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare pagare egoino. Ero rakamode boe emearutoruwo pudui Pao Kurirewu piji pagatu je. Emodukare mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge remawuge ekiripagado. Mare etaidumode tuwo mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ekiripagado nowu turo rakarewu tabo rugadu.

b: Dukodi care taeku jado. Pagare eroino tai. Tamearutorukaba ei. Ire tawie boe jamedu boe ji marigudu.
source: Dukodi care taeku jado. Pagare eroino tai. Tamearutorukaba ei. Ire tawie boe jamedu boe ji marigudu.

b: Imedu Onaregedu Aregodumode Pugeje
source: Imedu Onaregedu Aregodumode Pugeje

b: – Boe pegare moto jiboe akedumode dukeje meri joku akedumode jamedu. Ari joku akedumode jamedu.
source: – Boe pegare moto jiboe akedumode dukeje meri joku akedumode jamedu. Ari joku akedumode jamedu.

b: Kuieje doge ewudumode baru piji jamedu. Baru magadugodumode rugadu.
source: Kuieje doge ewudumode baru piji jamedu. Baru magadugodumode rugadu.

b: Dukejere care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode tugodu tabo boetugu aojitu duji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Dukejere care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode tugodu tabo boetugu aojitu duji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Umode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge etudo tododai Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwuge ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emode edo tudo pui.
source: Umode Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge etudo tododai Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu jiwuge ewagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emode edo tudo pui.

b: Figo I Umode Boe Eruduwado
source: Figo I Umode Boe Eruduwado

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je. Figo i okurogu boture dukeje taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je. Figo i okurogu boture dukeje taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.

b: Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode boe puredugodure itaregoduwo iwo boe jamedu boe akedudo. Mare bubutu ji karega inagoino. Nou itaregodumode jiwu meri jire inagoino.
source: Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode boe puredugodure itaregoduwo iwo boe jamedu boe akedudo. Mare bubutu ji karega inagoino. Nou itaregodumode jiwu meri jire inagoino.

b: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.
source: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.

b: Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode jamedu. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode jamedu. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Boe Eruduwakare Jesus Aregodumode Kejewu Meriji
source: Boe Eruduwakare Jesus Aregodumode Kejewu Meriji

b: Nono Jesus mako kimore. Akore boe eruduwakare nowu meri ji rugadu. Boe eruduwakare kaiba meri jetumode awu iwadaru jetuwo pudui. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge eruduwakare. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu joruduwakare. Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduware tu rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus mako kimore. Akore boe eruduwakare nowu meri ji rugadu. Boe eruduwakare kaiba meri jetumode awu iwadaru jetuwo pudui. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge eruduwakare. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu joruduwakare. Tu Pao Kurirewu joruduware tu rugadu.

b: Taruduwakare itaregodumode kejewu meri ji. Dukodire tado tarugadu. Tagaiwodo itaregodumode dubagai.
source: Taruduwakare itaregodumode kejewu meri ji. Dukodire tado tarugadu. Tagaiwodo itaregodumode dubagai.

b: Iromode nono ia imedu ro mogadure. Utu jaere tugiriaduwo. Ure tudugarege etu pemegado tuwaiji. Ure emaragodae maku etai. Ure ia tudugare rakojedo bai poro keje. Makore nowu tudugare ji jetu pemegawo nowu bai poroji tubaga tabo tuwagai.
source: Iromode nono ia imedu ro mogadure. Utu jaere tugiriaduwo. Ure tudugarege etu pemegado tuwaiji. Ure emaragodae maku etai. Ure ia tudugare rakojedo bai poro keje. Makore nowu tudugare ji jetu pemegawo nowu bai poroji tubaga tabo tuwagai.

b: Iromode nono nowu imedu ro mogadure. Dukodire inagoino tai taeku jaewo. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba itaregodumode. Itaregodumode boeco ji rakudu, meri ji rakudu, baburedugodutabo rakudu, caboecoto rakudu, merirekodutabo rakudu. Taruduwakare.
source: Iromode nono nowu imedu ro mogadure. Dukodire inagoino tai taeku jaewo. Taruduwakare kaba meri kejeba itaregodumode. Itaregodumode boeco ji rakudu, meri ji rakudu, baburedugodutabo rakudu, caboecoto rakudu, merirekodutabo rakudu. Taruduwakare.

b: Dukodire tado tarugadu tabaga tabo iwagai. Itaregodumode taci je. Itaidukare ioruduwo tai tamearutorukare i dutabo.
source: Dukodire tado tarugadu tabaga tabo iwagai. Itaregodumode taci je. Itaidukare ioruduwo tai tamearutorukare i dutabo.

b: Dukodi inagoino tai. Inagoino boe eiamedu boe ji. Tado tarugadu tabaga tabo iwagai.
source: Dukodi inagoino tai. Inagoino boe eiamedu boe ji. Tado tarugadu tabaga tabo iwagai.

b: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Tawuje Tuwo Jesus Bito
source: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Tawuje Tuwo Jesus Bito

b: Merimode pobe dukeje Judeu doge emode tuwadae Páscoa towuje. Nou ewadae kejere emode ia tuge amirewu tuginaiwu kowuje. Fermento metukare nowu amirewu tada. Care nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etaidure tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidure tuwo Jesus bito jamedu. Mare etaidukare boe eruduwawo nowu tumearudae pegarewuji.
source: Merimode pobe dukeje Judeu doge emode tuwadae Páscoa towuje. Nou ewadae kejere emode ia tuge amirewu tuginaiwu kowuje. Fermento metukare nowu amirewu tada. Care nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etaidure tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etaidure tuwo Jesus bito jamedu. Mare etaidukare boe eruduwawo nowu tumearudae pegarewuji.

b: Emagore pui. egore Pamode pageragu Jesus ji nowu Judeu doge ewadae keje dukeje boe ekorigodumode pai rugadu. Emode bato pui turo pegawo pai. Dukodire paromodukare aino ewadae keje.
source: Emagore pui. egore Pamode pageragu Jesus ji nowu Judeu doge ewadae keje dukeje boe ekorigodumode pai rugadu. Emode bato pui turo pegawo pai. Dukodire paromodukare aino ewadae keje.

b: Jesus Uture Boe Eda Betânia Ka
source: Jesus Uture Boe Eda Betânia Ka

b: Jesus rakojere boe eda Betânia keje Simão uwai tada. Nou Simão iere Biri Pegarewu jamedu. Jesus mugure nono nowu bai tada ira keje togwage tabo. Nono ia aredu aregodure Jesus ae poarirogu tabo. Boe ere nowu poari towuje tori tabo. Nou tori iere alabastro. Roreboe mori kurirewu meture nowu poarirogu tada. Boe ere nowu roreboe towuje nardo tabo. Nono ca nowu aredu ure nowu poarirogu jado. Ure nowu roreboe redo Jesus aora joki.
source: Jesus rakojere boe eda Betânia keje Simão uwai tada. Nou Simão iere Biri Pegarewu jamedu. Jesus mugure nono nowu bai tada ira keje togwage tabo. Nono ia aredu aregodure Jesus ae poarirogu tabo. Boe ere nowu poari towuje tori tabo. Nou tori iere alabastro. Roreboe mori kurirewu meture nowu poarirogu tada. Boe ere nowu roreboe towuje nardo tabo. Nono ca nowu aredu ure nowu poarirogu jado. Ure nowu roreboe redo Jesus aora joki.

b: Boe erudure nowu aredu roino duji dukeje iage emago pegare nowu aredu roino Jesus jituji. egore awu aredu ro pegare. Ure nowu roreboe barigu. Nou roreboe mori kurire rugadu. Boe emaragodumode jii joru akedu ka tuwo tugeragu nowu diero kurirewu ji tuwo akirodo nowu roreboe ji. Kocare ukare nowu roreboe maku diero bagai tuwo diero kurido tuwo maku marenarue doge etai? Nono emago pegare nowu areduji.
source: Boe erudure nowu aredu roino duji dukeje iage emago pegare nowu aredu roino Jesus jituji. egore awu aredu ro pegare. Ure nowu roreboe barigu. Nou roreboe mori kurire rugadu. Boe emaragodumode jii joru akedu ka tuwo tugeragu nowu diero kurirewu ji tuwo akirodo nowu roreboe ji. Kocare ukare nowu roreboe maku diero bagai tuwo diero kurido tuwo maku marenarue doge etai? Nono emago pegare nowu areduji.

b: Mare Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore tagaba awu aredu pogurudo rore iduji. Rore i du moture Pao Kurirewu jakai. Mare paga karega.
source: Mare Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore tagaba awu aredu pogurudo rore iduji. Rore i du moture Pao Kurirewu jakai. Mare paga karega.

b: Marenarue doge edumode tagabo jii toro rugadu. Tagaidumode taro pemegawo ei dukeje taro pemegado ei tagaidure jiwu meri keje. Mare imire itumode tabiji rugadu.
source: Marenarue doge edumode tagabo jii toro rugadu. Tagaidumode taro pemegawo ei dukeje taro pemegado ei tagaidure jiwu meri keje. Mare imire itumode tabiji rugadu.

b: Awu aredu joruduware nowu inoduji dukodire ure nowu roreboe redo iogi tuwo iwiri udo turugadu ituguduwo mototo iwi keje.
source: Awu aredu joruduware nowu inoduji dukodire ure nowu roreboe redo iogi tuwo iwiri udo turugadu ituguduwo mototo iwi keje.

b: Ca iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Awu aredu rore iboe akedumodukare boe etaora piji jii toro rugadu. Boe etumode moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe eruduwado emearutoruwo i iwo ekinorudo dukeje ereadodumode awu aredu rore iduji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Dukodire boe ewiagodumodukare awu aredu piji rugadu jii toro rugadu.
source: Ca iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Awu aredu rore iboe akedumodukare boe etaora piji jii toro rugadu. Boe etumode moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe eruduwado emearutoruwo i iwo ekinorudo dukeje ereadodumode awu aredu rore iduji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Dukodire boe ewiagodumodukare awu aredu piji rugadu jii toro rugadu.

b: Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai
source: Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotes uture toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae. Judas Iscariotes makore ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotes uture toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae. Judas Iscariotes makore ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai.

b: Egarere nowu Judas Iscariotes makore pudui boe ji rugadu. Dukodire egore tumoduie diero maku ai. Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo tumode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu meri bagai.
source: Egarere nowu Judas Iscariotes makore pudui boe ji rugadu. Dukodire egore tumoduie diero maku ai. Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo tumode Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu meri bagai.

b: Jesus Okwagemode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Ekeji Ture Joruduwadowugebo
source: Jesus Okwagemode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Ekeji Ture Joruduwadowugebo

b: Páscoa meri boeto jiwu aregodure dukeje Judeu doge ere tagu carneiro doge kugure ewido tuwo tuge pemegado nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji. Nou meri ji nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaiba cemode page pemegado pawo kowuje, pawaduwo Páscoaji?
source: Páscoa meri boeto jiwu aregodure dukeje Judeu doge ere tagu carneiro doge kugure ewido tuwo tuge pemegado nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji. Nou meri ji nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaiba cemode page pemegado pawo kowuje, pawaduwo Páscoaji?

b: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu imei. Ere pobe. Ure joruduwadowugenure emage. Makore ei. Akore tadudo toro ba kurirewu ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje ia imedu aregodumode tadogi ia pori po tabo. Tadudo nowu imedu rekodaji.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu imei. Ere pobe. Ure joruduwadowugenure emage. Makore ei. Akore tadudo toro ba kurirewu ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje ia imedu aregodumode tadogi ia pori po tabo. Tadudo nowu imedu rekodaji.

b: Umode turemo ia baito dukeje tanarado nowu uwaire bai cewuji ia paedumodewu bagai. Tagagodo aino: “Pagimijera aidure ia tumugumodewu bagai togwagewo Páscoa kejewu boe ekeji ture joruduwadowugebo nowu boe edurewu tada.”
source: Umode turemo ia baito dukeje tanarado nowu uwaire bai cewuji ia paedumodewu bagai. Tagagodo aino: “Pagimijera aidure ia tumugumodewu bagai togwagewo Páscoa kejewu boe ekeji ture joruduwadowugebo nowu boe edurewu tada.”

b: Tamagomode aino dukeje nowu uwaire bai cewu umode tarududo ia boe edu tadawu bai pemegarewuji. Nou bai pemegamode rugadu pagwagewo Páscoa kejewu pageji. Nonore tamode page pemegado.
source: Tamagomode aino dukeje nowu uwaire bai cewu umode tarududo ia boe edu tadawu bai pemegarewuji. Nou bai pemegamode rugadu pagwagewo Páscoa kejewu pageji. Nonore tamode page pemegado.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge pobedu doge eture nowu ba kurirewu ka. Erudure nowu boe ji nono Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Páscoaji nowu bai tada rugadu.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge pobedu doge eture nowu ba kurirewu ka. Erudure nowu boe ji nono Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Páscoaji nowu bai tada rugadu.

b: Nou boeco ji Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowugebo nowu bai ka nowu ime pobedu doge etae. Dukodire enodo padure doze nono Jesus apo.
source: Nou boeco ji Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowugebo nowu bai ka nowu ime pobedu doge etae. Dukodire enodo padure doze nono Jesus apo.

b: Emugure nono ira keje togwage tabo rugadu. Dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Tagwagere itabo woe mare ia tagi tamode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.
source: Emugure nono ira keje togwage tabo rugadu. Dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Tagwagere itabo woe mare ia tagi tamode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ekiarigodure. Dukodire enarare Jesus ji tu tu puregodaji. egore i na akagoino? Imi na?
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ekiarigodure. Dukodire enarare Jesus ji tu tu puregodaji. egore i na akagoino? Imi na?

b: Jesus akore Tare doze. Mare umode tuge amirewu pegodo nowu carneiro kaguru tabowu emare umode imagu boe ekimijerage pegarewuge etai.
source: Jesus akore Tare doze. Mare umode tuge amirewu pegodo nowu carneiro kaguru tabowu emare umode imagu boe ekimijerage pegarewuge etai.

b: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie iwimoduie duji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje. Aino care iwimode nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koia. Mare boe pegamode rugadu nowu ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji. Botumodukare dukeje boe pegamodukare ji. Mare boture. Aino care umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai dukodire boe pegamode ji rugadu.
source: Marigudu Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie iwimoduie duji. Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje. Aino care iwimode nowu Pao Kurirewu mearudae koia. Mare boe pegamode rugadu nowu ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji. Botumodukare dukeje boe pegamodukare ji. Mare boture. Aino care umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai dukodire boe pegamode ji rugadu.

b: Jesus Okwagere Ture Joruduwadowugebo
source: Jesus Okwagere Ture Joruduwadowugebo

b: Ca enogwage kimore. Jesus ure tugeragu tuge amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tagwagedo awuji. Ikodu reo tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.
source: Ca enogwage kimore. Jesus ure tugeragu tuge amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tagwagedo awuji. Ikodu reo tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu. Nono imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu uva kuru paru tabo. Dukejere ure pedo ei jamedu ekuduwo ce.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu. Nono imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu uva kuru paru tabo. Dukejere ure pedo ei jamedu ekuduwo ce.

b: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Iku redodumode boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu tumoduie turo maiwu maku boe etai tuwo boe ekinorudo. Aino care iku umode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu. Nou iku koiare umode mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge etawuje tuwobece tuwo ekinorudo rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ei. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Iku redodumode boe eiamedu boe ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu tumoduie turo maiwu maku boe etai tuwo boe ekinorudo. Aino care iku umode nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru jetudo pudui rugadu. Nou iku koiare umode mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge etawuje tuwobece tuwo ekinorudo rugadu.

b: Mare iwo tawie. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode mato ibagi pugeje du ka. Itaregodumode pugeje dukeje boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi. Nono ikudumode vinho kuru maiwuce tagabo.
source: Mare iwo tawie. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode mato ibagi pugeje du ka. Itaregodumode pugeje dukeje boe eiamedu boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi. Nono ikudumode vinho kuru maiwuce tagabo.

b: Jesus akoino dukeje urare Pao Kurirewu bataru tabo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Nono ere tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri ao ka.
source: Jesus akoino dukeje urare Pao Kurirewu bataru tabo nowu ture joruduwadowugebo. Nono ere tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri ao ka.

b: Jesus Joruduware Nuba Pedro Akomode
source: Jesus Joruduware Nuba Pedro Akomode

b: Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taiamedu boe tamode tagera ra ipiji. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu. Nou bataru padure bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu umode nowu jeture boeiwu bito. Nono nowu boe eiamedu boe emode taodo nowu tugimijera piji nono ovelha doge ero mogadure.”
source: Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore taiamedu boe tamode tagera ra ipiji. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu. Nou bataru padure bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu umode nowu jeture boeiwu bito. Nono nowu boe eiamedu boe emode taodo nowu tugimijera piji nono ovelha doge ero mogadure.”

b: Mare iewodumode pugeje dukeje itumode tagododai toro Galiléia moto ka.
source: Mare iewodumode pugeje dukeje itumode tagododai toro Galiléia moto ka.

b: Pedro akore Nou iage emode tugera ra apiji mare imire iromodukare aino. Imodukare ikera ra apiji rugadu.
source: Pedro akore Nou iage emode tugera ra apiji mare imire iromodukare aino. Imodukare ikera ra apiji rugadu.

b: Jesus makore Pedro ji. Akore imode awie boe remawu ji. Awu boeco ji rugadu akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.
source: Jesus makore Pedro ji. Akore imode awie boe remawu ji. Awu boeco ji rugadu akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.

b: Mare Pedro aidukare awu Jesus akoino pudui duji. Akore boro. Iwimode akabo mare imodukare iwadaru udo nono akago mogadure. Imodukare ikera ra apiji rugadu. Ainore Pedro akore. Nono nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nono Pedro ako mogadure jamedu.
source: Mare Pedro aidukare awu Jesus akoino pudui duji. Akore boro. Iwimode akabo mare imodukare iwadaru udo nono akago mogadure. Imodukare ikera ra apiji rugadu. Ainore Pedro akore. Nono nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge egore nono Pedro ako mogadure jamedu.

b: Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai Getsêmani Moto Keje
source: Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai Getsêmani Moto Keje

b: Nono Jesus aregodure ture joruduwadowugebo ia iguru jeturewu ka. Nou iguru iere Getsêmani. Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tamugudo woe. Imagomode baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai.
source: Nono Jesus aregodure ture joruduwadowugebo ia iguru jeturewu ka. Nou iguru iere Getsêmani. Nono Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tamugudo woe. Imagomode baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai.

b: Jesus ure tugeragu Pedro ji, Tiagoji, Joãoji. Uture ebo kuri nono. Dukeje kiarigodu rakare. Joruduware boe pegamode pudui duji rugadu.
source: Jesus ure tugeragu Pedro ji, Tiagoji, Joãoji. Uture ebo kuri nono. Dukeje kiarigodu rakare. Joruduware boe pegamode pudui duji rugadu.

b: Makore nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge ji. Akore ikiarigodu rakare rugadu. Rakare tuwo iwido rugadu. Ca tadu rugadu woe tamagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai.
source: Makore nowu ture tugeragu jiwuge ji. Akore ikiarigodu rakare rugadu. Rakare tuwo iwido rugadu. Ca tadu rugadu woe tamagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji. Nono ure tubu jodo moto keje tumagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Makore Pao Kurirewu bagai boe pegakawo pudui. Makore Pao Kurirewu bagai uwo tumearudae mekido.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji. Nono ure tubu jodo moto keje tumagowo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai. Makore Pao Kurirewu bagai boe pegakawo pudui. Makore Pao Kurirewu bagai uwo tumearudae mekido.

b: Akore iogwa Kurirewunure aki. Aromode boe jamedu boe ji. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo piji. Mare ukawo nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.
source: Akore iogwa Kurirewunure aki. Aromode boe jamedu boe ji. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo piji. Mare ukawo nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Mare kocare enudure. Nono Jesus makore Pedro bagai. Akore Simão Pedro! Anudure? Amagodo Pao Kurirewu bagai itabowu hora uwo mitotu je mare kocare anudure kuri je.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge ewagai. Mare kocare enudure. Nono Jesus makore Pedro bagai. Akore Simão Pedro! Anudure? Amagodo Pao Kurirewu bagai itabowu hora uwo mitotu je mare kocare anudure kuri je.

b: Nono Jesus makore eiamedu boe ji. Ere pobe metia bokware. Akore tamearudae pemegare. Mare taraga bokware. Aino ca tanudukaba pugeje. Tamagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.
source: Nono Jesus makore eiamedu boe ji. Ere pobe metia bokware. Akore tamearudae pemegare. Mare taraga bokware. Aino ca tanudukaba pugeje. Tamagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji pugeje. Nono makore baru to nono tumago mogadure boeto ji pugeje.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudaru gu epiji pugeje. Nono makore baru to nono tumago mogadure boeto ji pugeje.

b: Nono Jesus ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae pugeje. Jorudure ei enudu kimore duji. Norire ekuji rugadu dukodire enudure rugadu. Nono eruduwakare tumagomode jiboe ji pugeje.
source: Nono Jesus ure tugirimi nowu ture joruduwadowuge etae pugeje. Jorudure ei enudu kimore duji. Norire ekuji rugadu dukodire enudure rugadu. Nono eruduwakare tumagomode jiboe ji pugeje.

b: Nono Jesus uture epiji pugeje tumagowo baru to pugeje. Dukejere care ure tugirimi etae pugeje. Nono makore ei. Akore tanudu kimonure rugadu kana? Urugadu. Aino care imagudumode boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai kuri aino rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus uture epiji pugeje tumagowo baru to pugeje. Dukejere care ure tugirimi etae pugeje. Nono makore ei. Akore tanudu kimonure rugadu kana? Urugadu. Aino care imagudumode boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai kuri aino rugadu.

b: Ca taragojedo. Pugeje. Nou ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu aregodu. Paduwo togi.
source: Ca taragojedo. Pugeje. Nou ure imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu aregodu. Paduwo togi.

b: Boe Ekimijera Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji
source: Boe Ekimijera Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji

b: Jesus mako kimore dukeje Judas Iscariotes aregodure etae. Jesus ure joruduwadowunure ema. Aregodure boebo. Nou boe etaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo. Etaregodure rago tabo. Boe ekimijerage ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai.
source: Jesus mako kimore dukeje Judas Iscariotes aregodure etae. Jesus ure joruduwadowunure ema. Aregodure boebo. Nou boe etaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo. Etaregodure rago tabo. Boe ekimijerage ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ere nowu boe etudo toro Jesus bagai.

b: Nou Judas Iscariotes makore nowu boe ji tugimadumoduie Jesus apo, tumoduie togwa to je koduto tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge erududo taidure tuwo tugeragu jiwunure ema duji.
source: Nou Judas Iscariotes makore nowu boe ji tugimadumoduie Jesus apo, tumoduie togwa to je koduto tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge erududo taidure tuwo tugeragu jiwunure ema duji.

b: Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture kuri Jesus ae rugadu. Ukimadure apo rugadu. Akore joruduwarewunure aki. Nono Judas Iscariotes ure togwa to Jesus je koduto.
source: Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture kuri Jesus ae rugadu. Ukimadure apo rugadu. Akore joruduwarewunure aki. Nono Judas Iscariotes ure togwa to Jesus je koduto.

b: Nono nowu boe pegarewuge ere tugeragu Jesus ji turaga tabo.
source: Nono nowu boe pegarewuge ere tugeragu Jesus ji turaga tabo.

b: Mare ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure tugeragu tariga kurirewuji. Ure ia imedu bija kado. Nou imedu nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewu utugarenure ema.
source: Mare ia Jesus ure joruduwadowu ure tugeragu tariga kurirewuji. Ure ia imedu bija kado. Nou imedu nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewu utugarenure ema.

b: Mare Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore ire boe emearudae pegado kana emearutorukawo tugimijeragei kana? Ro pegarewu karegure imi. Kocare tagaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo rago tabo tawo tageragu i nono taro moga ro pegarewuge eidu mogadure.
source: Mare Jesus makore nowu boe ji. Akore ire boe emearudae pegado kana emearutorukawo tugimijeragei kana? Ro pegarewu karegure imi. Kocare tagaregodure tariga kurirewu tabo rago tabo tawo tageragu i nono taro moga ro pegarewuge eidu mogadure.

b: Iragojere tagabo meri jamedu ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ire boe eruduwado nono. Mare tagare tageragu i. Mare aino care Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Tagaregodure tawo tageragu i nono Pao Kurirewu bataru mogadure.
source: Iragojere tagabo meri jamedu ji Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ire boe eruduwado nono. Mare tagare tageragu i. Mare aino care Pao Kurirewu bataru jeture pudui rugadu. Tagaregodure tawo tageragu i nono Pao Kurirewu bataru mogadure.

b: Dukodire Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe eregodure Jesus piji.
source: Dukodire Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe eregodure Jesus piji.

b: Nou boe pegarewuge eture Jesus apo dukeje ia iparedu uture eregodaji. Dukodire nowu boe pegarewuge etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji jamedu. Nou iparedu ukudau areiare mitotu je.
source: Nou boe pegarewuge eture Jesus apo dukeje ia iparedu uture eregodaji. Dukodire nowu boe pegarewuge etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji jamedu. Nou iparedu ukudau areiare mitotu je.

b: Mare uture piji tuwo cinorudo nowu boe pegarewuge epiji tuwiri kedo tabo.
source: Mare uture piji tuwo cinorudo nowu boe pegarewuge epiji tuwiri kedo tabo.

b: Jesus Rakojere Judeu Doge Ekimijerage Egorai
source: Jesus Rakojere Judeu Doge Ekimijerage Egorai

b: Nou boe ere Jesus reko toro Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewunure ema. Nouia Judeu doge ekimijerage edu nono jamedu. Ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijeragenure iage. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugenure iage. Boe eimijerage paru towugenure iage.
source: Nou boe ere Jesus reko toro Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewunure ema. Nouia Judeu doge ekimijerage edu nono jamedu. Ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijeragenure iage. Joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugenure iage. Boe eimijerage paru towugenure iage.

b: Pedro kodu jaere boe ji tudu tabo Jesus rekodaji boe erudukawo pudui. Nono aregodure nowu Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou uwai kejere ure tumugudo nono tugobaigaregebo joru okwai.
source: Pedro kodu jaere boe ji tudu tabo Jesus rekodaji boe erudukawo pudui. Nono aregodure nowu Judeu doge ekimijera kurirewu uwai ka. Nou uwai kejere ure tumugudo nono tugobaigaregebo joru okwai.

b: Nou bai ja tadare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage edure. Nou Jerusalém kejewu Judeu doge eimijerage eiamedu boe edure nono jamedu. Eiamedu boe etaiwore ia Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Ewiapagare batrarodurewuge ewadaru ji taiwo tabo nowu Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Etaidure tuwo Jesus bito. Mare erudukare ia Jesus ro pegarewuji.

Eiamedu boe etaiwore ia Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Ewiapagare batrarodurewuge ewadaru ji taiwo tabo nowu Jesus ro pegarewu bagai. Etaidure tuwo Jesus bito. Mare erudukare ia Jesus ro pegarewuji.

b: Boe egore Jesus ro pegaie. Mare ewadaru kodukare puregodaji.

b: Nono ia boe ewadrarodure pugeje Jesus roji.
source: Nono ia boe ewadrarodure pugeje Jesus roji.

b: egore cemearudure awu imedu bataru ji. Akore ime eie Pao Kurirewu uwai towuje. Mare tumoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai kurirewu butudo dukeje merimoduie pobe metia bokware tuwo nowu bai rakojedo pugeje. Ia ime karega. Pudumie tumoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai rakojedo pugeje.

b: Mare awu ime ewadaru kodukare puregodaji jamedu.
source: Mare awu ime ewadaru kodukare puregodaji jamedu.

b: Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure turagojedo. Makore Jesus ji. Akore amagomodukare nowu ewadaru jipagi kana? Boe rugadu ji kana egoino rugadu?

b: Mare Jesus makokare boe ji. Nono nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewu unarare Jesus ji pugeje. Akore umode boe ekinorudowunure aki? Pao Kurirewu Onaregedunure aki?

b: Jesus akore Imi rugadu. Mare iwo tawie Imedu Onaregedu romode jiboe ji. Awu inodu otobiji tarudumode i imugure Pao Kurirewu ukana pemegarewu jagwai duji. Tarudumode i ire irawuje baru piji boetugu tabo duji.
source: Jesus akore Imi rugadu. Mare iwo tawie Imedu Onaregedu romode jiboe ji. Awu inodu otobiji tarudumode i imugure Pao Kurirewu ukana pemegarewu jagwai duji. Tarudumode i ire irawuje baru piji boetugu tabo duji.

b: Ca nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure tugudau areia mega bowuje tugorigodure dukodi. Dukodire makore tumedage boe eimijeragei. Akore ca. Pamearudure awu Jesus bataru pegarewu ji rugadu.
source: Ca nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu ure tugudau areia mega bowuje tugorigodure dukodi. Dukodire makore tumedage boe eimijeragei. Akore ca. Pamearudure awu Jesus bataru pegarewu ji rugadu.

b: Unure tudo nono Pao Kurirewure. Pagare akoino. Mako peganure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Dukodi care nuba tamearudaere? Nuba paromode ji? Nou boe eimijerage eiamedu boe ere tumearudaedo nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewu mearudae mogadure. Emearutorukare Jesus akoinoduji. Egore pagaie akoino. Jesus ro pegaie rugadu. Tumoduie Jesus bito.

b: Nono ere todoguru barigu Jesus joki. Ere areia kogudo Jesus jegajeje. Nono ere boeto Jesus ji. Egokodure ji. egore ioguduba roino ai? Nono nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu ji pugeje tuwo boeto ji.
source: Nono ere todoguru barigu Jesus joki. Ere areia kogudo Jesus jegajeje. Nono ere boeto Jesus ji. Egokodure ji. egore ioguduba roino ai? Nono nowu tugobaigarege ere tugeragu ji pugeje tuwo boeto ji.

b: Pedro Makore Tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji
source: Pedro Makore Tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji

b: Pedro rakoje kimore nono nowu bawadu keje. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewu utugare aredu kodure nono.
source: Pedro rakoje kimore nono nowu bawadu keje. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge ekimijera kurirewu utugare aredu kodure nono.

b: Nou aredu jorudure Pedro ji. Pedro mugure nowu joru okwai ture tugera urudo dutabo. Nou aredu aiwore ji. Akore ature Nazaré kejewu Jesus apo jamedu.
source: Nou aredu jorudure Pedro ji. Pedro mugure nowu joru okwai ture tugera urudo dutabo. Nou aredu aiwore ji. Akore ature Nazaré kejewu Jesus apo jamedu.

b: Mare Pedro akore Boro. Ioruduwakare kaba jiba akagoino. Nono Pedro uture nowu bawadu kejewu bai poro ka. Nono ia kagariga kudugodure.
source: Mare Pedro akore Boro. Ioruduwakare kaba jiba akagoino. Nono Pedro uture nowu bawadu kejewu bai poro ka. Nono ia kagariga kudugodure.

b: Nono nowu aredu makore ia boe ji. Akore jowu imedu ia Jesus ure joruduwadowunure ema rugadu.
source: Nono nowu aredu makore ia boe ji. Akore jowu imedu ia Jesus ure joruduwadowunure ema rugadu.

b: Mare Pedro akore pugeje tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji. Ca Pedro rakoje kimore nono ji je. Dukejere ia boe emagore Pedro ji pugeje. egore Galiléia moto kejewunure aki nono Jesus mogadure. Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowunure aki rugadu.
source: Mare Pedro akore pugeje tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji. Ca Pedro rakoje kimore nono ji je. Dukejere ia boe emagore Pedro ji pugeje. egore Galiléia moto kejewunure aki nono Jesus mogadure. Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowunure aki rugadu.

b: Mare Pedro mako pegare ei tumagomodukaie boe remawu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu uiago boe pegado pudui. Akore ioruduwakare nowu tagagoino jiwu imeduji rugadu.
source: Mare Pedro mako pegare ei tumagomodukaie boe remawu ji dukeje Pao Kurirewu uiago boe pegado pudui. Akore ioruduwakare nowu tagagoino jiwu imeduji rugadu.

b: Care rore puku kagariga kudugodure pugeje. Dukodire Pedro biabuture Jesus makore puduiwu tuwadaru keje. Jesus makore Pedro ji makomoduie tuioruduwakaie pudui dukeje nowu kagariga kudugodumoduie rugadu. Pedro makomoduie tuioruduwakaie Jesus ji dumode pobe metia bokware rugadu. Aino ca Pedro biabuture nowu Jesus bataru keje rugadu jeture pudui duji rugadu. Dukodire kiarigodure turo pegarewuji. Dukodire ragudure.

b: Pilatos Aiwore Jesus Ro Pegarewu Bagai
source: Pilatos Aiwore Jesus Ro Pegarewu Bagai

b: N o u b a r o g w a t o , barogwakododutabo nowu Judeu doge enomea makudure aiwuge eimijerage, nouia Judeu doge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emagore pui tuwo tumearudae tawuje tuwo Jesus bito rugadu. Nono ere Jesus kogudo. Dukejere ere Jesus reko nowu boe eimijera governador Pilatos bagai rugadu.

Nono ere Jesus kogudo. Dukejere ere Jesus reko nowu boe eimijera governador Pilatos bagai rugadu.

b: Etaregodure Jesus apo Pilatos ae dukeje Pilatos unarare Jesus ji. Akore boe rugadu kana? Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu kana? Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino.
source: Etaregodure Jesus apo Pilatos ae dukeje Pilatos unarare Jesus ji. Akore boe rugadu kana? Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu kana? Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire akagoino.

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emago pegare Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu Pilatos biagai. Ewadrarodure Jesus rore jiboe ji.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emago pegare Jesus rore jiboe ji nowu Pilatos biagai. Ewadrarodure Jesus rore jiboe ji.

b: Dukodire Pilatos makore Jesus ji pugeje. Akore egore aro pegaie. Kocare amagokare boe ji ewadaru jipagi.

b: Egore Jesus Bitoduiago Rugadu
source: Egore Jesus Bitoduiago Rugadu

b: Judeu doge ewadae Páscoa kejere Pilatos ure ia ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji Judeu doge eroiaji. Judeu doge emagomode ia ro pegarewu ieji dukeje Pilatos umode nowu ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje.
source: Judeu doge ewadae Páscoa kejere Pilatos ure ia ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji Judeu doge eroiaji. Judeu doge emagomode ia ro pegarewu ieji dukeje Pilatos umode nowu ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje.

b: Ro pegarewuge emagare baicorewu tada nowu joruji. Iage ekorigodure pui ba kurirewu tada dukodire ere ia imedu bito. Dukodire eragojere nono baicorewu tada. Ia ro pegarewu imedu rakojere ebo jamedu. Iere Barrabás.
source: Ro pegarewuge emagare baicorewu tada nowu joruji. Iage ekorigodure pui ba kurirewu tada dukodire ere ia imedu bito. Dukodire eragojere nono baicorewu tada. Ia ro pegarewu imedu rakojere ebo jamedu. Iere Barrabás.

b: Aino care boe emagore Pilatoji uwo ia ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje turoiaji.
source: Aino care boe emagore Pilatoji uwo ia ro pegarewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje turoiaji.

b: Dukodire Pilatos makore ei. Akore tagaidure iwo awu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje? Jesus jire nowu Pilatos akoino.
source: Dukodire Pilatos makore ei. Akore tagaidure iwo awu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje? Jesus jire nowu Pilatos akoino.

b: Pilatos joruduware nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudae pegare Jesus jituji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui rugadu. Dukodire etaregodure Jesus apo Pilatos ae boe emearutorukawo Jesus ji pugeje. Mare Pilatos joruduware Jesus ro pegarewu bokwaie duji. Dukodire aidure Jesus utuwo pugeje. Aidukare turo pegawo Jesus ji.
source: Pilatos joruduware nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emearudae pegare Jesus jituji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui rugadu. Dukodire etaregodure Jesus apo Pilatos ae boe emearutorukawo Jesus ji pugeje. Mare Pilatos joruduware Jesus ro pegarewu bokwaie duji. Dukodire aidure Jesus utuwo pugeje. Aidukare turo pegawo Jesus ji.

b: Mare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere boe ero jodo. Dukodire nowu boe emagore Pilatoji uwo ro pegarewu imedu Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje.
source: Mare nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere boe ero jodo. Dukodire nowu boe emagore Pilatoji uwo ro pegarewu imedu Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje.

b: Mare Pilatos makore ei. Akore nuba iromode awu tagagoino Judeu doge eimijera kurirewuji?
source: Mare Pilatos makore ei. Akore nuba iromode awu tagagoino Judeu doge eimijera kurirewuji?

b: Nou boe doge ekudugodure. egore nou Jesus bito! Bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje!
source: Nou boe doge ekudugodure. egore nou Jesus bito! Bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje!

b: Pilatos akore Kodiba tagagoino? Ro pegarewu pa? Mare ewiapagakare ji. Ere tugudu rakado. egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu!
source: Pilatos akore Kodiba tagagoino? Ro pegarewu pa? Mare ewiapagakare ji. Ere tugudu rakado. egore bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje rugadu!

b: Pilatos aidure tuwo nowu boe doge ewudugugo. Dukodire rore nono etaidu mogadure. Ure Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Dukejere ure tugobaigarege edo boeto Jesus ji tapira biri iku tabo. Nono ure Jesus maku etai ewo bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje.
source: Pilatos aidure tuwo nowu boe doge ewudugugo. Dukodire rore nono etaidu mogadure. Ure Barrabás tawuje baicorewu piji utuwo pugeje. Dukejere ure tugobaigarege edo boeto Jesus ji tapira biri iku tabo. Nono ure Jesus maku etai ewo bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje.

b: Tugobaigarege Egokodure Jesus ji
source: Tugobaigarege Egokodure Jesus ji

b: Tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Jesus ji. Ere turemo apo nowu tugimijera Pilatos uwaito. Nono emagore nouia tugobaigarege ewagai. Ere bato pui nono Jesus ae.
source: Tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Jesus ji. Ere turemo apo nowu tugimijera Pilatos uwaito. Nono emagore nouia tugobaigarege ewagai. Ere bato pui nono Jesus ae.

b: Nono ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu tugu Jesus ji. Nou areia kaworu dugunure. Ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu atadawu towuje. Ere nowu atadawudo botoguruce. Dukejere ere tugu Jesus aoto atadawuwo ema.
source: Nono ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu tugu Jesus ji. Nou areia kaworu dugunure. Ere ia boe eimijera kurirewu atadawu towuje. Ere nowu atadawudo botoguruce. Dukejere ere tugu Jesus aoto atadawuwo ema.

b: Nono emago pegare Jesus ji. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki. Boe pemegawo ai awikawo jii toro. Mare tuwudorekeadae tabore egoino Jesus ji.
source: Nono emago pegare Jesus ji. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewunure aki. Boe pemegawo ai awikawo jii toro. Mare tuwudorekeadae tabore egoino Jesus ji.

b: Nono ere ipo to Jesus aoraji. Ere todoguru to ji. Ere tubu jodo Jesus jokorai. Ere tuie jodo mototo tuwudorekeadae pegarewu tabo.
source: Nono ere ipo to Jesus aoraji. Ere todoguru to ji. Ere tubu jodo Jesus jokorai. Ere tuie jodo mototo tuwudorekeadae pegarewu tabo.

b: Ere tumago pegarewu akedudo dukeje ere nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu tawuje Jesus piji. Ere Jesus ukudau areia tugu ji pugeje. Nono ere tugeragu Jesus ji tuduwo apo Jerusalém piji tuwo bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje toro ture boe ewidodurewu ka.
source: Ere tumago pegarewu akedudo dukeje ere nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ukudau areia moturewu tawuje Jesus piji. Ere Jesus ukudau areia tugu ji pugeje. Nono ere tugeragu Jesus ji tuduwo apo Jerusalém piji tuwo bito ipo padure pugajejewu keje toro ture boe ewidodurewu ka.

b: Boe Ere Jesus Bu Ipo Padure Pugajejewu Keje
source: Boe Ere Jesus Bu Ipo Padure Pugajejewu Keje

b: Eture Jesus apo dukeje tugobaigarege ere tugeragu ia imeduji oreduwo nowu Jesus bitodumode kejewu ipo tabo. Nou imedu iere Simão. Aregodure ipoguru piji ba kurirewu ka. Cirene ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Onaregedu imedu iere Alexandre. Ia onaregedu imedu iere Rufo. Tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Simãoji oreduwo nowu ipo tabo.
source: Eture Jesus apo dukeje tugobaigarege ere tugeragu ia imeduji oreduwo nowu Jesus bitodumode kejewu ipo tabo. Nou imedu iere Simão. Aregodure ipoguru piji ba kurirewu ka. Cirene ba kurirewu pijiwunure ema. Onaregedu imedu iere Alexandre. Ia onaregedu imedu iere Rufo. Tugobaigarege ere tugeragu Simãoji oreduwo nowu ipo tabo.

b: Nono eture Jesus apo toro ia tori ao ka. Ewadaru tabo nowu tori iere Gólgota. Boe ewadaru tabo iere: “Boe ewirewuge etaora ra jeta reo.”
source: Nono eture Jesus apo toro ia tori ao ka. Ewadaru tabo nowu tori iere Gólgota. Boe ewadaru tabo iere: “Boe ewirewuge etaora ra jeta reo.”

b: Ere ia jorubo barigu vinho kuruto. Nou jorubo iere mirra. Nono ere nowu vinho kuru maku Jesus ai kuduwo ce. Mare Jesus aidukare tuguduwo ce.
source: Ere ia jorubo barigu vinho kuruto. Nou jorubo iere mirra. Nono ere nowu vinho kuru maku Jesus ai kuduwo ce. Mare Jesus aidukare tuguduwo ce.

b: Nono tugobaigarege ere Jesus bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Ere Jesus ukudau areia pedo pui. Ere tuwadumode tabowu torirogu barigu tuioruduwawo ioguduba umode tugeragu Jesus ukudau areiaji.
source: Nono tugobaigarege ere Jesus bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje. Ere Jesus ukudau areia pedo pui. Ere tuwadumode tabowu torirogu barigu tuioruduwawo ioguduba umode tugeragu Jesus ukudau areiaji.

b: Meri jeture toro baru kugajeje dukeje ere bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje.
source: Meri jeture toro baru kugajeje dukeje ere bu ipo padure pugajejewu keje.

b: Ere atugoreboe bu ipo keje Jesus aora bukajeje. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu reo.
source: Ere atugoreboe bu ipo keje Jesus aora bukajeje. egore Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu reo.

b: Ere ia ro pegarewu ime pobedu doge emugudo nono Jesus apo jamedu nowu meri ji. Ia rakojere Jesus kana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia rakojere Jesus kana pegarewu jagwai jamedu.
source: Ere ia ro pegarewu ime pobedu doge emugudo nono Jesus apo jamedu nowu meri ji. Ia rakojere Jesus kana pemegarewu jagwai. Metia rakojere Jesus kana pegarewu jagwai jamedu.

b: Boe etaregodure nono dukeje ere taora paradudo. Emago pegare Jesus ji. egore akagore amoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo mare merimoduie pobe metia bokware dukeje amoduie rakojedo pugeje.
source: Boe etaregodure nono dukeje ere taora paradudo. Emago pegare Jesus ji. egore akagore amoduie Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo mare merimoduie pobe metia bokware dukeje amoduie rakojedo pugeje.

b: Kocare amodukare arawuje nowu ipo piji? Ca arawuje. Amodukare akinorudo nowu ipo piji rugadu?
source: Kocare amodukare arawuje nowu ipo piji? Ca arawuje. Amodukare akinorudo nowu ipo piji rugadu?

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emagore pui tugodakagiriwo Jesus ji. egore awu imedu akore tumoduie boe ekinorudo. Mare roiwakare tuwo cinorudo. Kocare umodukare boe ekinorudo rugadu.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage, nowu joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge emagore pui tugodakagiriwo Jesus ji. egore awu imedu akore tumoduie boe ekinorudo. Mare roiwakare tuwo cinorudo. Kocare umodukare boe ekinorudo rugadu.

b: Umode turawuje awu ipo piji dukeje pamearutorumode ji. Kocare umode boe ekinorudowu karegure ema pugeje. Israel doge eimijera kurirewu karegure ema rugadu. Nou ro pegarewuge epadure ipo keje Jesus apowuge emago pegare Jesus ji nowu boe eimijera pegarewugebo jamedu.
source: Umode turawuje awu ipo piji dukeje pamearutorumode ji. Kocare umode boe ekinorudowu karegure ema pugeje. Israel doge eimijera kurirewu karegure ema rugadu. Nou ro pegarewuge epadure ipo keje Jesus apowuge emago pegare Jesus ji nowu boe eimijera pegarewugebo jamedu.

b: Jesus Bire
source: Jesus Bire

b: Meri aregodure pagaia ka dukeje boecodure moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boecodure rugadu. Nou boeco kodure kuri toro nowu três hora ka. Nou três hora otobiji baru aregodure nono tumogadure pugeje.
source: Meri aregodure pagaia ka dukeje boecodure moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boecodure rugadu. Nou boeco kodure kuri toro nowu três hora ka. Nou três hora otobiji baru aregodure nono tumogadure pugeje.

b: Dukeje care Jesus makore tugudu tabo tuwadaru tabo. Akore eloí. Eloí. Lemá sabactani? Boe ewadaru tabore akore Pao Kurirewu. Pao Kurirewu. Kodiba are akera ra ipiji?
source: Dukeje care Jesus makore tugudu tabo tuwadaru tabo. Akore eloí. Eloí. Lemá sabactani? Boe ewadaru tabore akore Pao Kurirewu. Pao Kurirewu. Kodiba are akera ra ipiji?

b: Boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje egore tawiapagado. Jesus kudugodure Elias bagai.
source: Boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje egore tawiapagado. Jesus kudugodure Elias bagai.

b: Ia imedu rekodure ia esponja tabo. Ure nowu esponja pegodo vinho kuru tabo. Nono aregodure tabo Jesus ae. Ure nowu esponja kogudo ipo oto tabo. Nono ure nowu esponja raido nowu ipo tabo toro Jesus okwa ka. Akore Pabagamode Elias bagai uwo Jesus rawuje nowu ipo piji.
source: Ia imedu rekodure ia esponja tabo. Ure nowu esponja pegodo vinho kuru tabo. Nono aregodure tabo Jesus ae. Ure nowu esponja kogudo ipo oto tabo. Nono ure nowu esponja raido nowu ipo tabo toro Jesus okwa ka. Akore Pabagamode Elias bagai uwo Jesus rawuje nowu ipo piji.

b: Nono Jesus kudugodu rakare tugiarigodure dukodi dukeje bire.
source: Nono Jesus kudugodu rakare tugiarigodure dukodi dukeje bire.

b: Nou areia kurirewu bararere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tadawu ure tuwowuje nowu bai ja oto piji moto ka jamedu.
source: Nou areia kurirewu bararere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tadawu ure tuwowuje nowu bai ja oto piji moto ka jamedu.

b: Ia tugobaigarege eimijera rakoje puredure nowu Jesus padure kejewu ipoji. Jorudure Jesus bire duji. Akore boe rugadu. Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure ema rugadu.
source: Ia tugobaigarege eimijera rakoje puredure nowu Jesus padure kejewu ipoji. Jorudure Jesus bire duji. Akore boe rugadu. Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure ema rugadu.

b: Areme eragojere nono jamedu. Etaiwo jaere Jesus ae. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Salomé. Ia etumedago iere Maria jamedu. Nou Maria ore ime ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Umana iere José.
source: Areme eragojere nono jamedu. Etaiwo jaere Jesus ae. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Salomé. Ia etumedago iere Maria jamedu. Nou Maria ore ime ere pobe. Ia iere Tiago. Umana iere José.

b: Jesus rakoje kimore Galiléia moto keje dutabo nowu areme emearutorure ji. Aino eragojere nowu Jesus birewu keje. Ia areme etaregodure Jerusalém piji turagojewo nono jamedu.
source: Jesus rakoje kimore Galiléia moto keje dutabo nowu areme emearutorure ji. Aino eragojere nowu Jesus birewu keje. Ia areme etaregodure Jerusalém piji turagojewo nono jamedu.

b: Boe Ere Jesus Tugu Tori Poroto
source: Boe Ere Jesus Tugu Tori Poroto

b: Merirekodutabo José aregodure. Arimatéia ba kurirewu kejewunure ema. Boe eimijeranure ema jamedu. Boe etaidure ji. Emearutorure ji. Nou José upagare Pao Kurirewu bagai boe eiamedu boe eimijerawo ema. Aino care Jesus bire sexta feira meri keje. Dukodire José uture boe eimijera Pilatos bagai tumagowo ji. Pogurukare tumagowo ji. Aidure tuwo Jesus tugu mototo.
source: Merirekodutabo José aregodure. Arimatéia ba kurirewu kejewunure ema. Boe eimijeranure ema jamedu. Boe etaidure ji. Emearutorure ji. Nou José upagare Pao Kurirewu bagai boe eiamedu boe eimijerawo ema. Aino care Jesus bire sexta feira meri keje. Dukodire José uture boe eimijera Pilatos bagai tumagowo ji. Pogurukare tumagowo ji. Aidure tuwo Jesus tugu mototo.

b: Pilatos okeare Jesus bire kuri aino duji. Makore tugobaigarege eimijera bagai tunarawo ji Jesus bagai. Nou tugobaigarege eimijera akore Jesus bie rugadu. Nono Pilatos akore Kocare Jesus bire kuri je. Nono Pilatos makore Joseji uwo tugeragu Jesus ji uwo tugu mototo.
source: Pilatos okeare Jesus bire kuri aino duji. Makore tugobaigarege eimijera bagai tunarawo ji Jesus bagai. Nou tugobaigarege eimijera akore Jesus bie rugadu. Nono Pilatos akore Kocare Jesus bire kuri je. Nono Pilatos makore Joseji uwo tugeragu Jesus ji uwo tugu mototo.

b: Nono José ure akirodo ia boe ekudau areia moturewuji. Uture tabo birewu Jesus ae. Ure Jesus rawuje nowu ipo piji. Ure Jesus upodo nowu areia tabo. Nono ure Jesus tugu ia tori poro maiwuto nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Ere nowu tori porodo tuwo ia birewuge etugu nono. Mare ekare ia birewuge etugu nowu tori poroto raga. Ca José ure Jesus tugu nowu tori poroto dukeje ure ia tori kurirewu bu nowu tori poro je keje tuwo miwuje.
source: Nono José ure akirodo ia boe ekudau areia moturewuji. Uture tabo birewu Jesus ae. Ure Jesus rawuje nowu ipo piji. Ure Jesus upodo nowu areia tabo. Nono ure Jesus tugu ia tori poro maiwuto nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Ere nowu tori porodo tuwo ia birewuge etugu nono. Mare ekare ia birewuge etugu nowu tori poroto raga. Ca José ure Jesus tugu nowu tori poroto dukeje ure ia tori kurirewu bu nowu tori poro je keje tuwo miwuje.

b: Areme eku kidure rore aino duji. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Maria. José ucenure ema. Emagere eruduware kaiba Jesus padure.
source: Areme eku kidure rore aino duji. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Maria. José ucenure ema. Emagere eruduware kaiba Jesus padure.

b: Jesus Jewodure Pugeje
source: Jesus Jewodure Pugeje

b: Sábado boeco ji nowu areme ere tudawuje tuwo akirodo roreboe ji tuwo reko Jesus biri joki. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Maria. Tiago ucenure ema. Metago iere Salomé.
source: Sábado boeco ji nowu areme ere tudawuje tuwo akirodo roreboe ji tuwo reko Jesus biri joki. Iarodo iere Maria Madalena. Metago iere Maria. Tiago ucenure ema. Metago iere Salomé.

b: Domingo meri ji, ca boecoto eture nowu tori poro ka.
source: Domingo meri ji, ca boecoto eture nowu tori poro ka.

b: Epuredugodure dukeje emagore pui. egore nuba paromode pawo nowu tori poro jado? Tori kurirewu padure nowu tori poro je keje. Paragakare pawo nowu tori kurirewu tawuje nowu tori poro piji. Etaregodure dukeje etaiwore mare nowu tori kurirewu padukare nowu tori poro je keje pugeje.
source: Epuredugodure dukeje emagore pui. egore nuba paromode pawo nowu tori poro jado? Tori kurirewu padure nowu tori poro je keje. Paragakare pawo nowu tori kurirewu tawuje nowu tori poro piji. Etaregodure dukeje etaiwore mare nowu tori kurirewu padukare nowu tori poro je keje pugeje.

b: Dukodire ere turemo nowu tori poroto rugadu. Nono erudure ia ipareduji. Mugure nono nowu tori poro ja tada. Ukudau areia kigadu maere ji rugadu. Dukodire care epagudugodure nowu ipareduce.
source: Dukodire ere turemo nowu tori poroto rugadu. Nono erudure ia ipareduji. Mugure nono nowu tori poro ja tada. Ukudau areia kigadu maere ji rugadu. Dukodire care epagudugodure nowu ipareduce.

b: Nou iparedu makore ei. Akore tabagudukaba. Ioruduware kaba bagaiba taroino taemaru tabo. Tagaiwonure Nazaré pijiwu bitodurewu Jesus bagai. Ca rakojekare woe pugeje. Tagaiwodo padure kejewu toriji. Jewodure pugeje.
source: Nou iparedu makore ei. Akore tabagudukaba. Ioruduware kaba bagaiba taroino taemaru tabo. Tagaiwonure Nazaré pijiwu bitodurewu Jesus bagai. Ca rakojekare woe pugeje. Tagaiwodo padure kejewu toriji. Jewodure pugeje.

b: Tadudo pugeje toro Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewagai, Pedro bagai jamedu. Tawo ewie Jesus utumoduie etododai Galiléia moto ka. Torore boe erudumoduie pudui. Ure ewie marigudu erudumoduie pudui toro.
source: Tadudo pugeje toro Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewagai, Pedro bagai jamedu. Tawo ewie Jesus utumoduie etododai Galiléia moto ka. Torore boe erudumoduie pudui. Ure ewie marigudu erudumoduie pudui toro.

b: Nono nowu areme eregodure nowu tori poro piji tubagudu koia. Emororamagadure nowu tuiorudure jiboe ji rugadu. Dukodire emagokare boe ji boe ewiagai.
source: Nono nowu areme eregodure nowu tori poro piji tubagudu koia. Emororamagadure nowu tuiorudure jiboe ji rugadu. Dukodire emagokare boe ji boe ewiagai.

b: Jesus Ure Maria Madalena Jorududo Pudui
source: Jesus Ure Maria Madalena Jorududo Pudui

b: Domingo meri ji ca boecoto Jesus jewodure pugeje. Nono ure Maria Madalena jorududo pudui. Marigudu ure nowu bope doge etuwaire ewarigu nowu Maria Madalena piji. Nou bope doge etuwaire enodo padure sete.
source: Domingo meri ji ca boecoto Jesus jewodure pugeje. Nono ure Maria Madalena jorududo pudui. Marigudu ure nowu bope doge etuwaire ewarigu nowu Maria Madalena piji. Nou bope doge etuwaire enodo padure sete.

b: Aino care ure Maria Madalena jorududo pudui dukeje Maria Madalena uture nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae tuwo ewie tuiorudure Jesus jituji. Emage edure tuwai keje tragudu tabo tugiarigodu tabo.
source: Aino care ure Maria Madalena jorududo pudui dukeje Maria Madalena uture nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowuge etae tuwo ewie tuiorudure Jesus jituji. Emage edure tuwai keje tragudu tabo tugiarigodu tabo.

b: Maria Madalena ure ewie. Akore Jesus jewodure pugeje. Iorudure ji rugadu. Mare emearutorukare Maria Madalena makore jiboe ji.
source: Maria Madalena ure ewie. Akore Jesus jewodure pugeje. Iorudure ji rugadu. Mare emearutorukare Maria Madalena makore jiboe ji.

b: Jesus Ure Ime Pobedu Doge Erududo Pudui
source: Jesus Ure Ime Pobedu Doge Erududo Pudui

b: Ia ime pobedu doge eture tuwai piji ipoguru ka. Jesus ure joruduwadowugenure emage. Nono Jesus ure erududo pudui.
source: Ia ime pobedu doge eture tuwai piji ipoguru ka. Jesus ure joruduwadowugenure emage. Nono Jesus ure erududo pudui.

b: Dukodi care ere tugirimi nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewagai tuwo ewie tuiorudure Jesus jituji. Mare emearutorukare nowu ime pobedu doge egoino jiboe ji.
source: Dukodi care ere tugirimi nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge ewagai tuwo ewie tuiorudure Jesus jituji. Mare emearutorukare nowu ime pobedu doge egoino jiboe ji.

b: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Eiamedu Boe Erududo Pudui
source: Jesus Ure Ture Joruduwadowuge Eiamedu Boe Erududo Pudui

b: Dukeje care Jesus ure ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe erududo pudui. Enodo padure onze. Enogwagere dukeje Jesus aregodure etae. Mako rakare ei. Emearutorukare nouia tumedage ewadaru ji. Nou emedage erudure Jesus ji dukeje ere tumedage ewie mare emearutorukare. Dukodire Jesus mako rakare ei.
source: Dukeje care Jesus ure ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe erududo pudui. Enodo padure onze. Enogwagere dukeje Jesus aregodure etae. Mako rakare ei. Emearutorukare nouia tumedage ewadaru ji. Nou emedage erudure Jesus ji dukeje ere tumedage ewie mare emearutorukare. Dukodire Jesus mako rakare ei.

b: Dukodi care makore ei pugeje. Akore tadudo moto jamedu boe parugajeje tawo boe eiamedu boe ewie iwadaru pemegarewuji.
source: Dukodi care makore ei pugeje. Akore tadudo moto jamedu boe parugajeje tawo boe eiamedu boe ewie iwadaru pemegarewuji.

b: Imode mearutorure iwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo. Emearutorumode i dukeje etao pegododumode dukeje imode ekinorudo. Mare mearutorukare iwuge imode ewarigu boe pegarewuto.
source: Imode mearutorure iwuge eiamedu boe ekinorudo. Emearutorumode i dukeje etao pegododumode dukeje imode ekinorudo. Mare mearutorukare iwuge imode ewarigu boe pegarewuto.

b: Imode mearutorure iwuge ero rakado. Emode bope doge etuwaire etawuje boe epiji. Mare turaga tabo karega. Ikie tabore imearudae tabore eroino. Emagomode boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji jamedu. Boe erudumode eroino duji dukeje eruduwamode iragojere ebo duji.
source: Imode mearutorure iwuge ero rakado. Emode bope doge etuwaire etawuje boe epiji. Mare turaga tabo karega. Ikie tabore imearudae tabore eroino. Emagomode boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji jamedu. Boe erudumode eroino duji dukeje eruduwamode iragojere ebo duji.

b: Emode tugeragu awagei mare boe pegamodukare ei. Ekudumode jorubo pegarewuce mare boe pegamodukare ei. Emode tugera bu kogodurewuge ewugeje dukeje nowu kogodurewuge epemegagodumode jamedu.
source: Emode tugeragu awagei mare boe pegamodukare ei. Ekudumode jorubo pegarewuce mare boe pegamodukare ei. Emode tugera bu kogodurewuge ewugeje dukeje nowu kogodurewuge epemegagodumode jamedu.

b: Jesus Ruture Baruto
source: Jesus Ruture Baruto

b: Jesus ure tumago akedudo nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje ruture baru to. Aregodure toro baru to dukeje mugure Pao Kurirewu kana pemegarewu jagwai. Aino Pagimijera kurirewunure ema rugadu.
source: Jesus ure tumago akedudo nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje ruture baru to. Aregodure toro baru to dukeje mugure Pao Kurirewu kana pemegarewu jagwai. Aino Pagimijera kurirewunure ema rugadu.

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Pagimijera Jesus ure ero rakado. Dukodi care boe eruduware boe jokodu jirabodu boe egoino.
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore Jesus bataru pemegarewu ji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Pagimijera Jesus ure ero rakado. Dukodi care boe eruduware boe jokodu jirabodu boe egoino.

b: Ure Awu Jesus Rore Jiboe Makore Jiboe Bu Bapera Keje
source: Ure Awu Jesus Rore Jiboe Makore Jiboe Bu Bapera Keje

b: Imedia Teófilonure aki. Ire awu bapera atugodo awagai boe remawu tabo aruduwawo boe remawu ji rugadu. Boe ereadodure boe ewiagai tuiorudure jiwu Jesus rore jiboe ji tumearudure jiwu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Ia boe etaidure tuwo nowu boe ereadodure jiwu Jesus rore jiboe bu bapera keje, boe ereadodure jiwu Jesus makore jiboe bu bapera keje jamedu. Ere boe ereadodure jiboe bu bapera keje jamedu. Mare imire, ire iragado i ioruduwawo boe remawu ji rugadu. Ire iragado i ioruduwawo Jesus rore jiboe ji, makore jiboe ji. Dukodire imagore jorudure Jesus rore jiboe jiwugei, mearudure Jesus bataru jiwuge ji. Ere ioruduwado boe remawu ji rugadu. Dukodire inure awu bapera atugodo awagai boe remawu tabo aruduwawo boe remawu ji rugadu.
source: Imedia Teófilonure aki. Ire awu bapera atugodo awagai boe remawu tabo aruduwawo boe remawu ji rugadu. Boe ereadodure boe ewiagai tuiorudure jiwu Jesus rore jiboe ji tumearudure jiwu Jesus makore jiboe ji. Ia boe etaidure tuwo nowu boe ereadodure jiwu Jesus rore jiboe bu bapera keje, boe ereadodure jiwu Jesus makore jiboe bu bapera keje jamedu. Ere boe ereadodure jiboe bu bapera keje jamedu. Mare imire, ire iragado i ioruduwawo boe remawu ji rugadu. Ire iragado i ioruduwawo Jesus rore jiboe ji, makore jiboe ji. Dukodire imagore jorudure Jesus rore jiboe jiwugei, mearudure Jesus bataru jiwuge ji. Ere ioruduwado boe remawu ji rugadu. Dukodire inure awu bapera atugodo awagai boe remawu tabo aruduwawo boe remawu ji rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Ure Boe Ewie João Batista Botumoduie
source: Pao Kurirewu Ure Boe Ewie João Batista Botumoduie

b: Judéia moto keje Herodes boe eimijera unure ema. Dukejere ia imedu maragodure Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Nou imedu iere Zacarias. Maragodure Pao Kurirewu uwai tada tuwo Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu ai. Abias uwobenure nowu Zacariace. Nou Zacarias oreduje iere Isabel. Nou oreduje uwobenure Arãoce jamedu.
source: Judéia moto keje Herodes boe eimijera unure ema. Dukejere ia imedu maragodure Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Nou imedu iere Zacarias. Maragodure Pao Kurirewu uwai tada tuwo Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu ai. Abias uwobenure nowu Zacariace. Nou Zacarias oreduje iere Isabel. Nou oreduje uwobenure Arãoce jamedu.

b: Nou Zacarias toreduje apo emearutorure rugadu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu aidure ei. Makore ro pemegarewuge nuie emage.
source: Nou Zacarias toreduje apo emearutorure rugadu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu aidure ei. Makore ro pemegarewuge nuie emage.

b: Mare Isabel kuiarumodukare dukodire etore bokware. Aino care epegagodure tore bokware dutabo rugadu.
source: Mare Isabel kuiarumodukare dukodire etore bokware. Aino care epegagodure tore bokware dutabo rugadu.

b: Nou maragodure Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawuge ime emagare rugadu. Emode roreboe kowu. Nou roreboe uredudu rore Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ere kowu kamo keje Pao Kurirewu ai. Ere tori barigu tu tu je tuioruduwawo ioguduba umode roreboe kowu nowu meri ji. Ia meri keje nowu tori buture Zacarias ie keje dukodire Zacarias ure turemo tuginaigodu Pao Kurirewu mugure tadawu baito tuwo nowu roreboe kowu kamo keje Pao Kurirewu ai nowu tori buture tugie keje kodi.
source: Nou maragodure Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawuge ime emagare rugadu. Emode roreboe kowu. Nou roreboe uredudu rore Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ere kowu kamo keje Pao Kurirewu ai. Ere tori barigu tu tu je tuioruduwawo ioguduba umode roreboe kowu nowu meri ji. Ia meri keje nowu tori buture Zacarias ie keje dukodire Zacarias ure turemo tuginaigodu Pao Kurirewu mugure tadawu baito tuwo nowu roreboe kowu kamo keje Pao Kurirewu ai nowu tori buture tugie keje kodi.

b: Nono boere turugadu dukodire Zacarias ure roreboe kowu kamo keje rugadu. Toro bawadu kejere boe emagare. Emagore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai tubaga tabo Zacarias uwo tumaragodae iado.
source: Nono boere turugadu dukodire Zacarias ure roreboe kowu kamo keje rugadu. Toro bawadu kejere boe emagare. Emagore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai tubaga tabo Zacarias uwo tumaragodae iado.

b: Mare ukare iado raga dukeje ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure Zacarias ae. Rore puku ji nowu baru tadawu rakojere nono pudabo nowu kamo jagwai.
source: Mare ukare iado raga dukeje ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure Zacarias ae. Rore puku ji nowu baru tadawu rakojere nono pudabo nowu kamo jagwai.

b: Zacarias jorudure nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji dukeje pagudugodure.
source: Zacarias jorudure nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji dukeje pagudugodure.

b: Mare nowu baru tadawu akore apagudukaba. Amagore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai uwo akoredo. Pao Kurirewu mearudure amagore jiboe ji. Akoreduje Isabel kuiarumode rugadu. Taganaregedu imedu mode. Tamode iedo João aino.
source: Mare nowu baru tadawu akore apagudukaba. Amagore baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai uwo akoredo. Pao Kurirewu mearudure amagore jiboe ji. Akoreduje Isabel kuiarumode rugadu. Taganaregedu imedu mode. Tamode iedo João aino.

b: Botumode dukeje taegaremode ji rugadu. Boe egaregodumode ji rugadu.
source: Botumode dukeje taegaremode ji rugadu. Boe egaregodumode ji rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu aidu kurimode nowu taganaregedu Joãoji. Mako pemegamode João rore jiboe ji rugadu. Mare nowu taganaregedu João biedu pemegado kudukawo vinho kuruce jii toro rugadu, kudukawo piga kuruce jamedu jii toro rugadu. Pao Kurirewure akoino. Botumode dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojemode apo rugadu tuwo ro pemegado jii toro rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu aidu kurimode nowu taganaregedu Joãoji. Mako pemegamode João rore jiboe ji rugadu. Mare nowu taganaregedu João biedu pemegado kudukawo vinho kuruce jii toro rugadu, kudukawo piga kuruce jamedu jii toro rugadu. Pao Kurirewure akoino. Botumode dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojemode apo rugadu tuwo ro pemegado jii toro rugadu.

b: Ricodumode dukeje nowu taganaregedu João makomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji Israel moto kejewu Judeu doge ewiagai. Dukodire umode Judeu doge emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji pugeje. Nou mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emagamode pugeje Israel moto keje. Emode tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce pugeje.
source: Ricodumode dukeje nowu taganaregedu João makomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji Israel moto kejewu Judeu doge ewiagai. Dukodire umode Judeu doge emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji pugeje. Nou mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge emagamode pugeje Israel moto keje. Emode tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce pugeje.

b: Nou taganaregedu João kodumode Pao Kurirewu otodai. Rakamode, kurimode nono joruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Elias mogadure. Nou taganaregedu João okituwamode boe ji ewudugugoduwo torebo. Umode ro pegarewuge edo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji ro pemegarewuge emearudae ka pugeje. Umode Judeu doge ewie Pagimijera Kurirewu aregodumoduie kuri je ewo tudo turugadu Pagimijera Kurirewu togi.
source: Nou taganaregedu João kodumode Pao Kurirewu otodai. Rakamode, kurimode nono joruduware Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu Elias mogadure. Nou taganaregedu João okituwamode boe ji ewudugugoduwo torebo.
