Mare boe epogurumode turo pegarewuji, emode boe utugaregedo pudumi dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegado ei, umode boe remawugedo emage.

b: Jesus Ure Tuwadaru Pemegarewu Bu Boe Etore Ewugeje
source: Jesus Ure Tuwadaru Pemegarewu Bu Boe Etore Ewugeje

b: Ia boe etaregodure torebo Jesus ae uwo tugera bu nowu tore ewugeje. Mare Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu inodu jiboe ji dukeje etaidukare eroino duji. Emagore ei etaregodukaiago torebo Jesus bagai.
source: Ia boe etaregodure torebo Jesus ae uwo tugera bu nowu tore ewugeje. Mare Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu inodu jiboe ji dukeje etaidukare eroino duji. Emagore ei etaregodukaiago torebo Jesus bagai.

b: Mare Jesus makore nowu boe etorei rugadu. Akore mato. Etaregodure dukeje Jesus makore nouia boe ji. Akore tagaba tawu boe etore emearudae kajeje etaregoduwo itae. Etarego itae rugadu. Boe ewo tumearudae udo nono boe etore emearudae mogadure tuwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce rugadu turuduwo baru to.
source: Mare Jesus makore nowu boe etorei rugadu. Akore mato. Etaregodure dukeje Jesus makore nouia boe ji. Akore tagaba tawu boe etore emearudae kajeje etaregoduwo itae. Etarego itae rugadu. Boe ewo tumearudae udo nono boe etore emearudae mogadure tuwo tugimijerado Pao Kurirewuce rugadu turuduwo baru to.

b: Tawiagodukaba iwadaru piji. Boe etore emearutorure tuo tuje makore jiboe ji. Mare boe etore ji karega inagoino. Boe emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dujire inagoino. Boe emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji tuwo tugimijerado ema dukeje emugumode Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Mare emearutorumodukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje emugumodukare Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu.
source: Tawiagodukaba iwadaru piji. Boe etore emearutorure tuo tuje makore jiboe ji. Mare boe etore ji karega inagoino. Boe emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Dujire inagoino. Boe emearutorumode Pao Kurirewu ji tuwo tugimijerado ema dukeje emugumode Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Mare emearutorumodukare Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje emugumodukare Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu.

b: Imedu Oe Kurirewu Meardae Reo
source: Imedu Oe Kurirewu Meardae Reo

b: Ia Judeu doge eimijera unarare Jesus ji. Akore cegimijera pemegarewunure aki. Nuba iromode iewoduwo pugeje imuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo du akedukawo?
source: Ia Judeu doge eimijera unarare Jesus ji. Akore cegimijera pemegarewunure aki. Nuba iromode iewoduwo pugeje imuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo du akedukawo?

b: Jesus akore Ca akagore ipemegaie. Mare tu Pao Kurirewure pemegare rugadu. Aruduwa kana Pao Kurirewu nuie imi rugadu? Aino care amearudae pemegado amearutoruwo i rugadu. Marigudu aruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji. Ure maku etai marigudu. Nou bakaru akore aeribarikaiago akoreduje piji, akaiago boe ewido, akiwogukaiago boei, awadrarodukaiago, amearutoruwo aoji aceji.
source: Jesus akore Ca akagore ipemegaie. Mare tu Pao Kurirewure pemegare rugadu. Aruduwa kana Pao Kurirewu nuie imi rugadu? Aino care amearudae pemegado amearutoruwo i rugadu. Marigudu aruduware nowu Pao Kurirewu ure maku Judeu doge etaiwu bakaruji. Ure maku etai marigudu. Nou bakaru akore aeribarikaiago akoreduje piji, akaiago boe ewido, akiwogukaiago boei, awadrarodukaiago, amearutoruwo aoji aceji.

b: Nono nowu imedu akore Ikodu maidure dutabo imearutorure awu bataru jamedu boe ji ji aino.
source: Nono nowu imedu akore Ikodu maidure dutabo imearutorure awu bataru jamedu boe ji ji aino.

b: Nono Jesus akore Iaboe okwa kimore amearutoruwo ji jamedu. Akoe rugadu boe maku diero bagai. Nono nowu ako diero rugadu maku marenarue doge etai. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode akoe kurido baru tada. Aromode aino dukeje akaregodumode itae pugeje akoduwo itabo rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus akore Iaboe okwa kimore amearutoruwo ji jamedu. Akoe rugadu boe maku diero bagai. Nono nowu ako diero rugadu maku marenarue doge etai. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode akoe kurido baru tada. Aromode aino dukeje akaregodumode itae pugeje akoduwo itabo rugadu.

b: Nou imedu mearudure Jesus akore aino pudui duji dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Oe kurire rugadu. Aidukare tuwo tugera ra nowu toe jamedu boe piji rugadu.
source: Nou imedu mearudure Jesus akore aino pudui duji dukeje kiarigodure rugadu. Oe kurire rugadu. Aidukare tuwo tugera ra nowu toe jamedu boe piji rugadu.

b: Jesus jorudure nowu imedu kiarigodure duji dukodire akore Kocare boe rakare oe kurirewu imeduji uwo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce rugadu tumuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada. Oe kurire dukodire biapagakare Pao Kurirewu ji. Boe rakare oe kurirewu imeduji uwo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce nono boe raka cameloji uwo turemo agulha poroto dumogadure.
source: Jesus jorudure nowu imedu kiarigodure duji dukodire akore Kocare boe rakare oe kurirewu imeduji uwo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce rugadu tumuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo baru tada. Oe kurire dukodire biapagakare Pao Kurirewu ji. Boe rakare oe kurirewu imeduji uwo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce nono boe raka cameloji uwo turemo agulha poroto dumogadure.

b: Boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje enarare ji: – Mare ioguduba umode cinorudo tuiewoduwo pugeje tumuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo?
source: Boe emearudure nowu Jesus bataru ji dukeje enarare ji: – Mare ioguduba umode cinorudo tuiewoduwo pugeje tumuguwo Pao Kurirewu apo?

b: Nono Jesus akore Boe eroiwakare jiboe, Pao Kurirewu roiware ji.
source: Nono Jesus akore Boe eroiwakare jiboe, Pao Kurirewu roiware ji.

b: Nono Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore ceiamedu boe cere cegera ra cenoe jamedu boe piji cegoduwo akabo.
source: Nono Pedro makore Jesus ji. Akore ceiamedu boe cere cegera ra cenoe jamedu boe piji cegoduwo akabo.

b: Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire inagoino tai. Boe emode tugera ra tuwai piji, toreduje piji, tuo piji tuje piji tumanamage epiji, tuwiemage epiji tuwo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce tuwo boe emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje boe pemegarewu makudumode etai eroino du morice. Eture tuwai piji, toreduje piji, tumana mage epiji, tuo tuje epiji, tore epiji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodire nowu mori kurimode eture pijiboe kori rugadu woe awu moto keje. Mare toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegarewu kurido etai rugadu baru tada. Toro baru tadare emugumode rugadu, ewimodukare pugeje rugadu jii toro.
source: Jesus akore Uu. Boe jokodu jire inagoino tai. Boe emode tugera ra tuwai piji, toreduje piji, tuo piji tuje piji tumanamage epiji, tuwiemage epiji tuwo tugimijerado tu Pao Kurirewuce tuwo boe emearutorudo Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje boe pemegarewu makudumode etai eroino du morice. Eture tuwai piji, toreduje piji, tumana mage epiji, tuo tuje epiji, tore epiji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukodire nowu mori kurimode eture pijiboe kori rugadu woe awu moto keje. Mare toro ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe pemegarewu kurido etai rugadu baru tada. Toro baru tadare emugumode rugadu, ewimodukare pugeje rugadu jii toro.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Pugeje Tuwimoduie
source: Jesus Ure Boe Ewie Pugeje Tuwimoduie

b: Ia meri keje Jesus makore tu nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tawiapagado. Padurumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere Pao Kurirewu mearudae bu bapera keje. Egore imagudumoduie boe tuginaiwuge etai. Nou boe tuginaiwuge egorerumoduie i, erorerumoduie i, emoduie todoguru to i, emoduie boeto i, emoduie iwido. Mare merimoduie pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumoduie pugeje. Ainore nowu mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge egore. Pao Kurirewu mearudae jire egoino. Boemode aino i rugadu. Nou bataru jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Ia meri keje Jesus makore tu nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore tawiapagado. Padurumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ere Pao Kurirewu mearudae bu bapera keje. Egore imagudumoduie boe tuginaiwuge etai. Nou boe tuginaiwuge egorerumoduie i, erorerumoduie i, emoduie todoguru to i, emoduie boeto i, emoduie iwido. Mare merimoduie pobe metia bokware dukeje iewodumoduie pugeje. Ainore nowu mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge egore. Pao Kurirewu mearudae jire egoino. Boemode aino i rugadu. Nou bataru jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare kaba jiba Jesus akoino. Eruduwa bokware Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Dukodire eruduwakare rugadu.
source: Mare nowu ure joruduwadowuge eruduwakare kaba jiba Jesus akoino. Eruduwa bokware Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Dukodire eruduwakare rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Marenaru Joku Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago
source: Jesus Ure Marenaru Joku Bokwarewu Imedu Pemegago

b: Jesus aregodure Jericó ba kurirewu ka dukeje ia joku bokwarewu imedu mugure awara okwai togwamagudu tabo boe ji ia diero bagai, ia boe ekerogu bagai jamedu.
source: Jesus aregodure Jericó ba kurirewu ka dukeje ia joku bokwarewu imedu mugure awara okwai togwamagudu tabo boe ji ia diero bagai, ia boe ekerogu bagai jamedu.

b: Boe emagare tugodu tabo Jesus apo. Etaregodure dukeje nowu joku bokwarewu imedu mearudure nowu ewure akoji. Dukeje unarare ia imeduji. Akore kaibowu boeba ekodure aino? Amagodo iwiagai.
source: Boe emagare tugodu tabo Jesus apo. Etaregodure dukeje nowu joku bokwarewu imedu mearudure nowu ewure akoji. Dukeje unarare ia imeduji. Akore kaibowu boeba ekodure aino? Amagodo iwiagai.

b: Nou imedu akore Jesusre kodure aino woe. Nazaré ba kurirewu kejewunure ema.
source: Nou imedu akore Jesusre kodure aino woe. Nazaré ba kurirewu kejewunure ema.

b: Nono nowu joku bokwarewu imedu kudugodure Jesus rekodaji. Akore Jesus! Jesus! Mariguduwu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Davi uwobenure aki. Akogudugo itabo!
source: Nono nowu joku bokwarewu imedu kudugodure Jesus rekodaji. Akore Jesus! Jesus! Mariguduwu Judeu doge eimijera kurirewu Davi uwobenure aki. Akogudugo itabo!

b: Ia boe emago pegare nowu joku bokwarewu imeduji mugu kiorowo. Mare ure tugudu rakado pugeje rugadu. Akore Jesus! Davi Onaregedunure aki. Akogudugo itabo!
source: Ia boe emago pegare nowu joku bokwarewu imeduji mugu kiorowo. Mare ure tugudu rakado pugeje rugadu. Akore Jesus! Davi Onaregedunure aki. Akogudugo itabo!

b: Nono Jesus ure tuwuredo. Makore boe ji ewo nowu joku bokwarewu imedu reko pudae. Aregodure ae dukeje Jesus akore Kaba jiba akaidure irowo ai? Nou joku bokwarewu imedu akore Ikimijera. Itaidure itaiwowo pugeje.
source: Nono Jesus ure tuwuredo. Makore boe ji ewo nowu joku bokwarewu imedu reko pudae. Aregodure ae dukeje Jesus akore Kaba jiba akaidure irowo ai? Nou joku bokwarewu imedu akore Ikimijera. Itaidure itaiwowo pugeje.

b: Jesus akore Ca akaiwodo. Amearutorure i dukodire apemegagodure.
source: Jesus akore Ca akaiwodo. Amearutorure i dukodire apemegagodure.

b: Ca nowu imedu joku bokwarewu pemegagodure taci je rugadu. Aiwore pugeje rugadu. Dukodire nowu imedu jakaregodu kuricigore pudui rugadu. Mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji rore aino pudui duji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Nono kodure Jesus rekodaji tagoino dutabo. Boe erudure Jesus rore aino duji dukodire nowu boe emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.
source: Ca nowu imedu joku bokwarewu pemegagodure taci je rugadu. Aiwore pugeje rugadu. Dukodire nowu imedu jakaregodu kuricigore pudui rugadu. Mako pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji rore aino pudui duji boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Nono kodure Jesus rekodaji tagoino dutabo. Boe erudure Jesus rore aino duji dukodire nowu boe emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.

b: Jesus Uture Imposto Makudure Aiwu Imedu Zaqueu Uwai Ka
source: Jesus Uture Imposto Makudure Aiwu Imedu Zaqueu Uwai Ka

b: Jesus aregodure Jericó ba kurirewu ka dukeje boe emagare tugodui rekodaji dutabo.
source: Jesus aregodure Jericó ba kurirewu ka dukeje boe emagare tugodui rekodaji dutabo.

b: Ia imedu iere Zaqueu. Nou ure tugeragu imposto diero jiwuge eimijeranure ema. O diero kurire. Ure tugeragu boe eno imposto dieroji tuwo maku boe eimijera kurirewu ai.
source: Ia imedu iere Zaqueu. Nou ure tugeragu imposto diero jiwuge eimijeranure ema. O diero kurire. Ure tugeragu boe eno imposto dieroji tuwo maku boe eimijera kurirewu ai.

b: Nou Zaqueu aidure tuioruduwo Jesus ji nowu boe ekao. Mare roiwakare ricokare kodi.
source: Nou Zaqueu aidure tuioruduwo Jesus ji nowu boe ekao. Mare roiwakare ricokare kodi.

b: Dukodire care rekodure Jesus otodai nowu boe etododai. Dukeje ruture ia kodui i ricorewuto tubagawo Jesus bagai nono. Meardaere taiwowo nowu i piji toro moto ka. Jesus kodumode nono dukeje nowu Zaqueu jorudumode ji rugadu.
source: Dukodire care rekodure Jesus otodai nowu boe etododai. Dukeje ruture ia kodui i ricorewuto tubagawo Jesus bagai nono. Meardaere taiwowo nowu i piji toro moto ka. Jesus kodumode nono dukeje nowu Zaqueu jorudumode ji rugadu.

b: Ca Jesus kodure nono rugadu. Mare joruduware Zaqueu rakojere nowu i tada duji rugadu dukodire ure tuwuredo nowu i paru taiwo tabo nowu Zaqueu bagai. Jorudure Zaqueuji nono makore Zaqueu ieji. Akore Zaqueu. Arawuje nowu i piji. Amara tabo. Awu meri ji itaidure ipaduwo awai keje.
source: Ca Jesus kodure nono rugadu. Mare joruduware Zaqueu rakojere nowu i tada duji rugadu dukodire ure tuwuredo nowu i paru taiwo tabo nowu Zaqueu bagai. Jorudure Zaqueuji nono makore Zaqueu ieji. Akore Zaqueu. Arawuje nowu i piji. Amara tabo. Awu meri ji itaidure ipaduwo awai keje.

b: Dukodire Zaqueu ure turawuje tumara tabo. Nono uture Jesus apo tuwai ka tiegarere pudui dutabo.
source: Dukodire Zaqueu ure turawuje tumara tabo. Nono uture Jesus apo tuwai ka tiegarere pudui dutabo.

b: Boe eiamedu boe erudu pegare Jesus uture Zaqueu apo duji. egore Jesus uture tubaduwo ia ro pegarewu uwai keje.
source: Boe eiamedu boe erudu pegare Jesus uture Zaqueu apo duji. egore Jesus uture tubaduwo ia ro pegarewu uwai keje.

b: Toro nowu Zaqueu uwai ja tada Zaqueu ure turagojedo. Nono makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Aino care imode inoe kado puiato iwo ia maku marenarue doge etai. Ikiwogure jiwuge etaire imode makudu kurido pobe puibiji etai.
source: Toro nowu Zaqueu uwai ja tada Zaqueu ure turagojedo. Nono makore Jesus ji. Akore ikimijera. Aino care imode inoe kado puiato iwo ia maku marenarue doge etai. Ikiwogure jiwuge etaire imode makudu kurido pobe puibiji etai.

b: Nono Jesus akore awu meri ji Pao Kurirewu ure awu bai tadawuge ekinorudo ero pegarewu boe piji. Mare paga karega awu meri ji rugadu emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji kodi nono nowu mariguduwu etuo Abraão mearutoru mogadure. Itaregodure iemaruwo ro pegarewuge ewagai iwo etawuje ero pegarewu boe piji iwo ekinorudo etukawo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu ka ero pegarewu morice.
source: Nono Jesus akore awu meri ji Pao Kurirewu ure awu bai tadawuge ekinorudo ero pegarewu boe piji. Mare paga karega awu meri ji rugadu emearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji kodi nono nowu mariguduwu etuo Abraão mearutoru mogadure. Itaregodure iemaruwo ro pegarewuge ewagai iwo etawuje ero pegarewu boe piji iwo ekinorudo etukawo bope doge eda kejewu joru pegarewu ka ero pegarewu morice.

b: Tori Kuieje Diero Oto Padure Dez.
source: Tori Kuieje Diero Oto Padure Dez.

b: Jesus kodure Jerusalém kawu awara ji rugadu. Jaekare Jerusalém ba kurirewu ji rugadu. Boe ekodure rekodaji tuwiapaga tabo Jesus akoino duji. Nou boe emearudaere Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijerado pudumi woe moto keje kuri je. Egore nowu boe eimijera umoduie Jesusce rugadu. Mare Jesus makore nowu boe ji.
source: Jesus kodure Jerusalém kawu awara ji rugadu. Jaekare Jerusalém ba kurirewu ji rugadu. Boe ekodure rekodaji tuwiapaga tabo Jesus akoino duji. Nou boe emearudaere Pao Kurirewu umode boe eimijerado pudumi woe moto keje kuri je. Egore nowu boe eimijera umoduie Jesusce rugadu. Mare Jesus makore nowu boe ji.

b: Akore ia meri keje ia oe kurirewu imedu ure tudo turugadu tudu jaewo rugadu toro ia moto tuginaiwu ka. Nou moto tuginaiwu boe eimijera kurirewu makore nowu oe kurirewu imedu bagai tumagowo ji boe eimijerawo ema toro to moto keje. Nono nowu oe kurirewu imedu umode tugirimi mato to moto ka pugeje boe eimijerawo ema nono to moto keje.
source: Akore ia meri keje ia oe kurirewu imedu ure tudo turugadu tudu jaewo rugadu toro ia moto tuginaiwu ka. Nou moto tuginaiwu boe eimijera kurirewu makore nowu oe kurirewu imedu bagai tumagowo ji boe eimijerawo ema toro to moto keje. Nono nowu oe kurirewu imedu umode tugirimi mato to moto ka pugeje boe eimijerawo ema nono to moto keje.

b: Dukodire makore tudugarege ewagai. Enodo padure dez. Ure ia to diero tori kuieje maku eiamedu boe etai. Ure udo mito mito eiamedu boe etai. Makore ei. Akore Itu jaemode rugadu. Nou ire maku tagaiwu diero kurido tu tu je jii toro itaregodumode mato ibagi du ka.” Ainore nowu boe eimijera makore tudugaregei.
source: Dukodire makore tudugarege ewagai. Enodo padure dez. Ure ia to diero tori kuieje maku eiamedu boe etai. Ure udo mito mito eiamedu boe etai. Makore ei. Akore Itu jaemode rugadu. Nou ire maku tagaiwu diero kurido tu tu je jii toro itaregodumode mato ibagi du ka.” Ainore nowu boe eimijera makore tudugaregei.

b: Mare nowu moto kejewu ia boe etaidukare nowu oe kurirewu imeduji. Etaidukare boe eimijerawo ema nono pudabo. Dukodire ere ia tumedage etudo toro nowu moto tuginaiwu boe eimijera kurirewu bagai tuwo bie taidukaie nowu oe kurirewu imeduji, taidukaie boe eimijerawo ema nono pudabo.
source: Mare nowu moto kejewu ia boe etaidukare nowu oe kurirewu imeduji. Etaidukare boe eimijerawo ema nono pudabo. Dukodire ere ia tumedage etudo toro nowu moto tuginaiwu boe eimijera kurirewu bagai tuwo bie taidukaie nowu oe kurirewu imeduji, taidukaie boe eimijerawo ema nono pudabo.

b: – Mare nowu moto tuginaiwu boe eimijera kurirewu aidure nowu oe kurirewu imeduji rugadu. Ure boe eimijerado ema rugadu. Nono nowu oe kurirewu imedu ure tugirimi tuibagi to moto ka pugeje boe eimijerawo pudumi nono to moto keje rugadu. Aregodure dukeje makore tudugarege eiamedu boe ewagai. Aidure tuioruduwawo nuba erore to diero jamedu boe tabo.
source: – Mare nowu moto tuginaiwu boe eimijera kurirewu aidure nowu oe kurirewu imeduji rugadu. Ure boe eimijerado ema rugadu. Nono nowu oe kurirewu imedu ure tugirimi tuibagi to moto ka pugeje boe eimijerawo pudumi nono to moto keje rugadu. Aregodure dukeje makore tudugarege eiamedu boe ewagai. Aidure tuioruduwawo nuba erore to diero jamedu boe tabo.

b: Utugare boeto jiwu aregodure tugimijera ae. Akore Ire ako diero mitodurogu kurido pugeje. Nou dierorogu tabo imaragodure. Ire oto padudo dez.” Ainore nowu utugare akore.
source: Utugare boeto jiwu aregodure tugimijera ae. Akore Ire ako diero mitodurogu kurido pugeje. Nou dierorogu tabo imaragodure. Ire oto padudo dez.” Ainore nowu utugare akore.

b: Nono nowu boe eimijera akore Ure turugadu. Amaragodu pemegare inoerogu boe ji. Dukodi care imode boe eimijerado aki jamedu. Akaiwomode jiwuge emugure kejewu boe eda oto padumode dez.” Ainore nowu boe eimijera akore tudugare boeto jiwuji.
source: Nono nowu boe eimijera akore Ure turugadu. Amaragodu pemegare inoerogu boe ji. Dukodi care imode boe eimijerado aki jamedu. Akaiwomode jiwuge emugure kejewu boe eda oto padumode dez.” Ainore nowu boe eimijera akore tudugare boeto jiwuji.

b: Nono nouia utugare aregodure tugimijera ae. Akore Ire ako diero mitodurogu kurido pugeje. Ire udo ikera aboudure.” Ainore nowu utugare akore.
source: Nono nouia utugare aregodure tugimijera ae. Akore Ire ako diero mitodurogu kurido pugeje. Ire udo ikera aboudure.” Ainore nowu utugare akore.

b: Nono nowu boe eimijera akore Ure turugadu. Imode boe eimijerado aki jamedu. Akaiwomode jiwuge emugure kejewu boe eda umode ikera aboudure.” Ainore nowu boe eimijera akore nowu tudugare ji jamedu.
source: Nono nowu boe eimijera akore Ure turugadu. Imode boe eimijerado aki jamedu. Akaiwomode jiwuge emugure kejewu boe eda umode ikera aboudure.” Ainore nowu boe eimijera akore nowu tudugare ji jamedu.

b: Nono ia utugare aregodure tugimijera ae jamedu. Akore Ikimijeranure aki. Ikare ako dierorogu barigu. Ire biado boe epiji ia ikudau areiarogu tada. Ema reo.
source: Nono ia utugare aregodure tugimijera ae jamedu. Akore Ikimijeranure aki. Ikare ako dierorogu barigu. Ire biado boe epiji ia ikudau areiarogu tada. Ema reo.

b: Ipagudure ace. Are boe emaragodae rakado ei awo akoe kurido. Are boe emaragodu rakado ako boepaji. Emagere ere ako boepa pemegado mare akai rugadu. Are boe emaragodae rakado ei ako boepa tadaboe kadoduwo mare etai karega, akai rugadu.” Ainore nowu utugare akore tugimijeraji. Mare pagare akoino.
source: Ipagudure ace. Are boe emaragodae rakado ei awo akoe kurido. Are boe emaragodu rakado ako boepaji. Emagere ere ako boepa pemegado mare akai rugadu. Are boe emaragodae rakado ei ako boepa tadaboe kadoduwo mare etai karega, akai rugadu.” Ainore nowu utugare akore tugimijeraji. Mare pagare akoino.

b: Nono nowu boe eimijera akore aro pega. Iromode ai nono akago mogadure. Akagore ie amaragodae rakado ai. Akagore amaragodu rakaie ino boepaji dukodie inoe kurie. Kodire akire amearudae pegare i.
source: Nono nowu boe eimijera akore aro pega. Iromode ai nono akago mogadure. Akagore ie amaragodae rakado ai. Akagore amaragodu rakaie ino boepaji dukodie inoe kurie. Kodire akire amearudae pegare i.

b: Kocare akare ino dierorogu tugu bancoto metu pemegawo nono banco tada, makagoduwo nono banco tada.”
source: Kocare akare ino dierorogu tugu bancoto metu pemegawo nono banco tada, makagoduwo nono banco tada.”

b: Nono nowu boe eimijera makore nouia tudugaregei. Akore Tageragu nowu ino diero tori kuieje mitodu roguji nowu imedu piji. Maku nouia itugare ai nowu diero oto padure dez apowu ai.” Ainore nowu boe eimijera akore.
source: Nono nowu boe eimijera makore nouia tudugaregei. Akore Tageragu nowu ino diero tori kuieje mitodu roguji nowu imedu piji. Maku nouia itugare ai nowu diero oto padure dez apowu ai.” Ainore nowu boe eimijera akore.

b: Mare nowu rakojere nonowuge egore: “Akaba maku ai. O diero tori kuieje kurire. Enodo padure dez.” Egore.
source: Mare nowu rakojere nonowuge egore: “Akaba maku ai. O diero tori kuieje kurire. Enodo padure dez.” Egore.

b: Mare nowu boe eimijera makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore Boe makudumode nowu maragodu pemegarewuge etai. Mare nowu maragodu pegarewuge etaire boe makudumodukare rugadu. Nou maragodu pegarewuge enoerogu mode mare nowu enoerogu akedumode epiji rugadu.
source: Mare nowu boe eimijera makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore Boe makudumode nowu maragodu pemegarewuge etai. Mare nowu maragodu pegarewuge etaire boe makudumodukare rugadu. Nou maragodu pegarewuge enoerogu mode mare nowu enoerogu akedumode epiji rugadu.

b: Aino care tageragu nowu aidukare iwugei emagore boe ekimijera kurirewu ji taidukaie i woe pudabo tugimijerawo imi. Mato ebo itae tawo ewido woe. Emagore boe eimijera kurirewu ji taidukaie i. Emagore taidukaie tugimijerawo imi. Dukodire ewimode.”
source: Aino care tageragu nowu aidukare iwugei emagore boe ekimijera kurirewu ji taidukaie i woe pudabo tugimijerawo imi. Mato ebo itae tawo ewido woe. Emagore boe eimijera kurirewu ji taidukaie i. Emagore taidukaie tugimijerawo imi. Dukodire ewimode.”

b: Jesus Aregodure Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka Dukeje Boe Egarere Ji
source: Jesus Aregodure Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka Dukeje Boe Egarere Ji

b: Nou inodu otobiji Jesus uture nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu kawu awara ji rugadu.
source: Nou inodu otobiji Jesus uture nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu kawu awara ji rugadu.

b: Puredugodure boe eda Betfagé ka, boe eda Betânia ka jamedu. Nou boe eda mugu puredure Oliveira Tori Riji. Aregodure toro dukeje makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ime pobedu dogei tuwo etudo tododai.
source: Puredugodure boe eda Betfagé ka, boe eda Betânia ka jamedu. Nou boe eda mugu puredure Oliveira Tori Riji. Aregodure toro dukeje makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ime pobedu dogei tuwo etudo tododai.

b: Akore ei: – Tadudo toro nowu boe eda ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje tarudumode ia jumenta onaregeduji boe ere kogudo nono duji. Ia boe ekare tumugudo nowu jumenta onaregedu keje raga. Tamode bukigu kiwuje dukeje tadumode mato apo itae.
source: Akore ei: – Tadudo toro nowu boe eda ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje tarudumode ia jumenta onaregeduji boe ere kogudo nono duji. Ia boe ekare tumugudo nowu jumenta onaregedu keje raga. Tamode bukigu kiwuje dukeje tadumode mato apo itae.

b: Ia boe enaramode nukodiba tarore aino dukeje tamagodo bataru jipagi: “Pagimijera aidure ji”, aino.
source: Ia boe enaramode nukodiba tarore aino dukeje tamagodo bataru jipagi: “Pagimijera aidure ji”, aino.

b: Nono nowu ime pobedu doge eture toro nowu boe eda ka rugadu. Erudure nowu jumenta onaregeduji nono Jesus mako mogadure.
source: Nono nowu ime pobedu doge eture toro nowu boe eda ka rugadu. Erudure nowu jumenta onaregeduji nono Jesus mako mogadure.

b: Ere kiwuje dukeje nowu akure cewuge enarare ei. egore kaba kodiba taroino nowu cenagu jumenta onaregeduji?
source: Ere kiwuje dukeje nowu akure cewuge enarare ei. egore kaba kodiba taroino nowu cenagu jumenta onaregeduji?

b: egore Pagimijera aidure ji.
source: egore Pagimijera aidure ji.

b: Nono eture apo Jesus togi. Etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje ere tugudau areia cobertor boe bu nowu jumenta naregedu poru keje Jesus uwo tumugudo keje. Nono ere tugera maku Jesus ai rutuwo nowu jumenta naregedu ao ka.
source: Nono eture apo Jesus togi. Etaregodure Jesus ae dukeje ere tugudau areia cobertor boe bu nowu jumenta naregedu poru keje Jesus uwo tumugudo keje. Nono ere tugera maku Jesus ai rutuwo nowu jumenta naregedu ao ka.

b: Nou jumenta naregedu boe korikare ji. Pagudu bokware rugadu. Jesus uture apo. Uture dukeje boe ere tugudau areia cobertor bu awara ji tuwo awara pemegado. Nou awara ure turawuje Oliveira Tori Ri piji. Kodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka rugadu. Boe emagare rugadu tugodui Jesus apo. Eture tiegarere pudui dutabo rugadu. Egarere Jesus ro rakare jiboe ji. Dukodire ewadodu rakare Pao Kurirewu ie tabo tumago pemegare ji dutabo.
source: Nou jumenta naregedu boe korikare ji. Pagudu bokware rugadu. Jesus uture apo. Uture dukeje boe ere tugudau areia cobertor bu awara ji tuwo awara pemegado. Nou awara ure turawuje Oliveira Tori Ri piji. Kodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka rugadu. Boe emagare rugadu tugodui Jesus apo. Eture tiegarere pudui dutabo rugadu. Egarere Jesus ro rakare jiboe ji. Dukodire ewadodu rakare Pao Kurirewu ie tabo tumago pemegare ji dutabo.

b: egore Pagimijera Kurirewu reo. Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae. Ca Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ji rugadu! Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado baru tadawugei rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe emago pemegawo pagimijeraji rugadu moto keje, baru tada jamedu.
source: egore Pagimijera Kurirewu reo. Pao Kurirewu ure arego mato pagae. Ca Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado ji rugadu! Pao Kurirewu uwo boe pemegado baru tadawugei rugadu. Boe eiamedu boe emago pemegawo pagimijeraji rugadu moto keje, baru tada jamedu.

b: Fariseu doge edure nono nowu boebo jamedu mare emearudaekare nono nowu boe emearudae mogadure. Egore Jesus ji: – Amagodo nowu merure akabowu boe ji edukiorowo.
source: Fariseu doge edure nono nowu boebo jamedu mare emearudaekare nono nowu boe emearudae mogadure. Egore Jesus ji: – Amagodo nowu merure akabowu boe ji edukiorowo.

b: Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore nou boe egarere pudui kodire egoino tugudu tabo. Emagomodukare dukeje nowu toriguru mako pemegamode Pao Kurirewu ji aino nowu boe emugato.
source: Jesus makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore nou boe egarere pudui kodire egoino tugudu tabo. Emagomodukare dukeje nowu toriguru mako pemegamode Pao Kurirewu ji aino nowu boe emugato.

b: Jesus jorudure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ji dukeje ure tuwuredo nono. Okudure nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewugebo dukodire ragudure.
source: Jesus jorudure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ji dukeje ure tuwuredo nono. Okudure nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewugebo dukodire ragudure.

b: Akore Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewugenure tagi. Kocare awu meri ji umode boe ekinorudowu aregodure tagae mare tamearutorukare ji dukodire taruduwakare tabemegawo pui, Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu.
source: Akore Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewugenure tagi. Kocare awu meri ji umode boe ekinorudowu aregodure tagae mare tamearutorukare ji dukodire taruduwakare tabemegawo pui, Pao Kurirewu ji jamedu.

b: Ia meri keje jorudu pegare taiwuge emode taiado tagabo dukeje emode tubodo tagabo jice woje.
source: Ia meri keje jorudu pegare taiwuge emode taiado tagabo dukeje emode tubodo tagabo jice woje.

b: Emode tabegado. Emode tagore erugadu etagedudo. Nono emode tawai rugadu boe butudo jamedu. Mare paga karega. Pao Kurirewu ure umode boe ekinorudowu arego tawagai tuwo taginorudo taro pegarewu piji mare tamearutorukare ji dukodire boe pegamode aino tai rugadu.
source: Emode tabegado. Emode tagore erugadu etagedudo. Nono emode tawai rugadu boe butudo jamedu. Mare paga karega. Pao Kurirewu ure umode boe ekinorudowu arego tawagai tuwo taginorudo taro pegarewu piji mare tamearutorukare ji dukodire boe pegamode aino tai rugadu.

b: Jesus Uture Pao Kurirewu Uwai Ka
source: Jesus Uture Pao Kurirewu Uwai Ka

b: Jesus aregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukeje ure turemo Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Nono jorudure nowu boe ji ere toe maku diero bagai duji ere morido puai duji ere tagu ie maku diero bagai duji. Dukodire korigodure. Ure nowu boe enoe rugadu barigu. Ure nowu boe etudo Pao Kurirewu uwai piji rugadu.

source: Nono ia joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge eimijerage egore boe jokodu jire akagoino.

b: Mare pagare egoino. Ca boe eraga bokware tunarawo Jesus ji pugeje. Eraga bokware tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe tabo rugadu.
source: Mare pagare egoino. Ca boe eraga bokware tunarawo Jesus ji pugeje. Eraga bokware tuwo Jesus barigu boeto tagoino jiboe tabo rugadu.

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Umode Boe Ekinorudowuji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Umode Boe Ekinorudowuji

b: Nono Jesus unarare nowu boe ji. Akore boere boe eruduwado umode boe ekinorudowuji. Egore Davi onaregedu moduie ema. Mare eruduwa pemegakare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Nono Jesus unarare nowu boe ji. Akore boere boe eruduwado umode boe ekinorudowuji. Egore Davi onaregedu moduie ema. Mare eruduwa pemegakare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Nou mariguduwu boe eimijera Davi ure ia Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu makore nowu ikimijera umode boe ekinorudowuji. Akore Amugudo woe ikana pemegarewu jagwai jii toro imode nowu jorudu pegare aiwuge etagedudo du ka.”
source: Nou mariguduwu boe eimijera Davi ure ia Pao Kurirewu bataru bu bapera keje. Akore Pao Kurirewu makore nowu ikimijera umode boe ekinorudowuji. Akore Amugudo woe ikana pemegarewu jagwai jii toro imode nowu jorudu pegare aiwuge etagedudo du ka.”

b: – Tagoino dutabo Davi akore tugimijera nuie nowu umode boe ekinorudowuce. Mare Davi onaregedu mode ema jamedu. Ca nuba nowu umode boe ekinorudowu ure?
source: – Tagoino dutabo Davi akore tugimijera nuie nowu umode boe ekinorudowuce. Mare Davi onaregedu mode ema jamedu. Ca nuba nowu umode boe ekinorudowu ure?

b: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Boe Eimijerage Ero Pegare Jiboe ji
source: Jesus Ure Boe Eruduwado Boe Eimijerage Ero Pegare Jiboe ji

b: Boe emagare nono tuwiapaga tabo Jesus bataru ji. Nono Jesus ure ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado.
source: Boe emagare nono tuwiapaga tabo Jesus bataru ji. Nono Jesus ure ture joruduwadowuge eruduwado.

b: Akore taeku jado joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui. Ere boe etaiwodo tugudau areia moturewu meture pudui duji. Etaidure tuwo boe epogurudo. Etumode ba kurirewu ka dukeje etaidure boe emago pemegawo pudui etaidure boe ekimijeragewo pudumi kodi. Dukodire erore aino. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etumode Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka dukeje emode tugeragu boe eimijera mugure kejewu iraji tumuguwo keje. Etumode boe ewadae ka dukeje etumode boe eke jeture kejewu ira ka boe etododai togwagewo boeto ji.
source: Akore taeku jado joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge ji. Etaidure boe emearutoruwo tu pudui. Ere boe etaiwodo tugudau areia moturewu meture pudui duji. Etaidure tuwo boe epogurudo. Etumode ba kurirewu ka dukeje etaidure boe emago pemegawo pudui etaidure boe ekimijeragewo pudumi kodi. Dukodire erore aino. Nou joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwuge etumode Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka dukeje emode tugeragu boe eimijera mugure kejewu iraji tumuguwo keje. Etumode boe ewadae ka dukeje etumode boe eke jeture kejewu ira ka boe etododai togwagewo boeto ji.

b: Eragojemode boebo dukeje emago raimode baru to boe emearuduwo tagoi tuwadaru moturewu jituji. Mare pagatu je. Ekiwogure okoge bokwarewuge aremei. Ere nowu areme okoge bokwarewuge ewai aru epiji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode ei rugadu nowu ero pegarewu morice.
source: Eragojemode boebo dukeje emago raimode baru to boe emearuduwo tagoi tuwadaru moturewu jituji. Mare pagatu je. Ekiwogure okoge bokwarewuge aremei. Ere nowu areme okoge bokwarewuge ewai aru epiji. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu ro pega kuricigomode ei rugadu nowu ero pegarewu morice.

b: Okoge Bokwarewudo Aredu Ure To Diero Rogu Maku Pao Kurirewu Ai
source: Okoge Bokwarewudo Aredu Ure To Diero Rogu Maku Pao Kurirewu Ai

b: Jesus rakojere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada taiwo tabo nowu boe ji. Dukejere jorudure nowu oe kurirewuge ji. Ere ia toe tugu ia ira jagi tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai.
source: Jesus rakojere Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada taiwo tabo nowu boe ji. Dukejere jorudure nowu oe kurirewuge ji. Ere ia toe tugu ia ira jagi tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai.

b: Dukejere jorudure ia okoge bokwarewudo areduji, marenaruji. Nou okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero torirogu pobedu tugu nowu ira jagi. Toe mitodurogu ure maku.
source: Dukejere jorudure ia okoge bokwarewudo areduji, marenaruji. Nou okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero torirogu pobedu tugu nowu ira jagi. Toe mitodurogu ure maku.

b: Nono Jesus akore Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Awu marenaru aredu okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero jamedu boe maku dukodire ure to diero makudu kurido nowu oe kurirewuge eiamedu boe ekori.
source: Nono Jesus akore Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Awu marenaru aredu okoge bokwarewudo ure to diero jamedu boe maku dukodire ure to diero makudu kurido nowu oe kurirewuge eiamedu boe ekori.

b: Mare diero kurirewu ji karega inagoino. Nou oe kurirewuge ere to diero kurido Pao Kurirewu ai mare etaidukare jiwu kobo rogure ere maku. Enoe kurire rugadu kimo. Mare awu aredu ure to diero rugadu boe maku. Dujire inagoino tai.
source: Mare diero kurirewu ji karega inagoino. Nou oe kurirewuge ere to diero kurido Pao Kurirewu ai mare etaidukare jiwu kobo rogure ere maku. Enoe kurire rugadu kimo. Mare awu aredu ure to diero rugadu boe maku. Dujire inagoino tai.

b: Jesus Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwai Akedumoduie
source: Jesus Akore Pao Kurirewu Uwai Akedumoduie

b: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui Pao Kurirewu uwai jiboe ji. Egore Pao Kurirewu uwai motuie. Boe ere towuje tabowu tori motuie. Boe eie toe makudu kurido Pao Kurirewu ai. Du paduie nono nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada.
source: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge emagore pui Pao Kurirewu uwai jiboe ji. Egore Pao Kurirewu uwai motuie. Boe ere towuje tabowu tori motuie. Boe eie toe makudu kurido Pao Kurirewu ai. Du paduie nono nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada.

b: Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore moture mare ia meri keje ro pegarewuge emode awu Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo rugadu. Tori tabore pawobe ere towuje marigudu. Mare nowu tori jamedu boe epadumodukare pu aogeje pugeje.
source: Mare Jesus makore nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore moture mare ia meri keje ro pegarewuge emode awu Pao Kurirewu uwai butudo rugadu. Tori tabore pawobe ere towuje marigudu. Mare nowu tori jamedu boe epadumodukare pu aogeje pugeje.

b: Jesus Ure Ewie Nuba Boe Mode Boei
source: Jesus Ure Ewie Nuba Boe Mode Boei

b: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaba meri kejeba Pao Kurirewu uwai butumode? Kaba jiba cerudumode ceruduwawo nowu akagoino jiboe jetumode pudui kuri aino duji?
source: Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowuge enarare Jesus ji. egore kaba meri kejeba Pao Kurirewu uwai butumode? Kaba jiba cerudumode ceruduwawo nowu akagoino jiboe jetumode pudui kuri aino duji?

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore taeku jado boe ekawo taekiripagado. Boe emagamode tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Boe puredugoduie moto akeduwo. Mare pagare egoino. Mare du inodu tabo emode boe ekiripagado rugadu. Mare tamearutorukaba ei.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore taeku jado boe ekawo taekiripagado. Boe emagamode tuwadaru pegarewu tabo. Egomode umode boe ekinorudowu nuie pudumi. Boe puredugoduie moto akeduwo. Mare pagare egoino. Mare du inodu tabo emode boe ekiripagado rugadu. Mare tamearutorukaba ei.

b: Tamearudumode bakaru pegarewuji. Boe emode tawie boe erugoduie pui tuwaiga tabo. Erugodu akedukaie. Emoduie tugimijerage etawuje turaga tabo. Mare taragado tai tamororamagadukawo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ro pegarewuge erugoduji marigudu. Umodukare nowu erugodu tawuje epiji. Erugodumode pui tuwaiga tabo rugadu mare moto akedumodukare raga.
source: Tamearudumode bakaru pegarewuji. Boe emode tawie boe erugoduie pui tuwaiga tabo. Erugodu akedukaie. Emoduie tugimijerage etawuje turaga tabo. Mare taragado tai tamororamagadukawo. Pao Kurirewu joruduware ro pegarewuge erugoduji marigudu. Umodukare nowu erugodu tawuje epiji. Erugodumode pui tuwaiga tabo rugadu mare moto akedumodukare raga.

b: Jesus mako kimore ei. Akore boe eimijera kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo.
source: Jesus mako kimore ei. Akore boe eimijera kurirewuge erugodumode pui tugobaigaregebo.

b: Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Jorubo pegarewu jetumode boe ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe erudumode boe pegarewu boe ji ure turawuje baru piji duji.
source: Moto magadugodumode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe eke bokwamode boe jamedu boe parugajeje. Dukodire boe ewimode tuge boe ji koia. Jorubo pegarewu jetumode boe ji moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe erudumode boe pegarewu boe ji ure turawuje baru piji duji.

b: Mare ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu tai. Emode boe pegado tai rugadu. Emode tamagu Judeu doge eimijerage etai. Nou boe eimijerage emode tarego Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka taiwowo ia taro pegare jiboe bagai. Nono emode tadugu baicorewuto. Boe eimijera kurirewuge emagomode tawagai jamedu tumago pegawo tarore jiboe ji.
source: Mare ro pegarewuge emode tugeragu tai. Emode boe pegado tai rugadu. Emode tamagu Judeu doge eimijerage etai. Nou boe eimijerage emode tarego Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka taiwowo ia taro pegare jiboe bagai. Nono emode tadugu baicorewuto. Boe eimijera kurirewuge emagomode tawagai jamedu tumago pegawo tarore jiboe ji.

b: Dukejere tamagodo iwadaru pemegarewu ji ewadaru jipagi.
source: Dukejere tamagodo iwadaru pemegarewu ji ewadaru jipagi.

b: Mare tamororamagadukaba tamagore jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega.
source: Mare tamororamagadukaba tamagore jiboe bagai. Tamagomode mare tawadaru karega.

b: Imode iwadaru maku tagai tamagowo ewadaru jipagi. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ero rakamodukare tai tawadaru jipagi pugeje.
source: Imode iwadaru maku tagai tamagowo ewadaru jipagi. Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage ero rakamodukare tai tawadaru jipagi pugeje.

b: Tawie mage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Taomage tajemage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tawobe emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tamedage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tagi tawidodumode rugadu.
source: Tawie mage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Taomage tajemage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tawobe emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tamedage emode tamagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Ia tagi tawidodumode rugadu.

b: Tamearutorumode i dukodire boe eiamedu boe erudu pegamode tai.
source: Tamearutorumode i dukodire boe eiamedu boe erudu pegamode tai.

b: Mare ietu pemegamode tai ia tagao iku butukawo tagaora piji rugadu.
source: Mare ietu pemegamode tai ia tagao iku butukawo tagaora piji rugadu.

b: Tagaba tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji dukeje imode taginorudo tawarigudukawo bope doge eda ka rugadu taruduwo baru to itae.
source: Tagaba tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji dukeje imode taginorudo tawarigudukawo bope doge eda ka rugadu taruduwo baru to itae.

b: Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Akedumode
source: Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Akedumode

b: Jesus makore kimo. Akore tarudumode tugobaigarege pegarewuge ere taiado Jerusalém ba kurirewu tabo duji dukeje taruduwamode boe akedumode kuri aino duji.
source: Jesus makore kimo. Akore tarudumode tugobaigarege pegarewuge ere taiado Jerusalém ba kurirewu tabo duji dukeje taruduwamode boe akedumode kuri aino duji.

b: Inure tawie. Boe erudumode nowu inoduji dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakawo toro tori ao ka. Jerusalém ba kurirewu tadawuge eregodu rakawo. Nou rakojere ipoguru kejewuge eregodu rakawo jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka iaboe bagai pugeje tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.
source: Inure tawie. Boe erudumode nowu inoduji dukeje Judéia moto kejewuge eregodu rakawo toro tori ao ka. Jerusalém ba kurirewu tadawuge eregodu rakawo. Nou rakojere ipoguru kejewuge eregodu rakawo jamedu. Ekawo tugirimi tuwai ka iaboe bagai pugeje tuwo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.

b: Nou meri keje boe pegamode boe ji rugadu ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu boe pegamoduie boe ji rugadu boe ero pegarewu morice. Aino makore jiboe jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Nou meri keje boe pegamode boe ji rugadu ero pegarewu morice. Pao Kurirewu ure boe ewie marigudu boe pegamoduie boe ji rugadu boe ero pegarewu morice. Aino makore jiboe jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwamoka turegodu rakawo kodi. Boe pegamode etore kugure etuje magei jamedu eroiwamoka turegodu rakawo kodi. Boe pegamode awu moto ji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado awu Judeu dogei rugadu ero pegarewu morice.
source: Nou meri ji boe pegamode kuiarurewugei rugadu. Boe pegamode ei rugadu eroiwamoka turegodu rakawo kodi. Boe pegamode etore kugure etuje magei jamedu eroiwamoka turegodu rakawo kodi. Boe pegamode awu moto ji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu umode boe pegado awu Judeu dogei rugadu ero pegarewu morice.

b: Iage ewidodumode tariga kurirewu tabo. Boe emode iage etudo toro moto tuginaiwu ka etuguduwo baicorewuto toro. Nono boe tuginaiwuge etaregodumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka tuwo akedudo rugadu jii toro Pao Kurirewu joruduware jiwu meri ka.
source: Iage ewidodumode tariga kurirewu tabo. Boe emode iage etudo toro moto tuginaiwu ka etuguduwo baicorewuto toro. Nono boe tuginaiwuge etaregodumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka tuwo akedudo rugadu jii toro Pao Kurirewu joruduware jiwu meri ka.

b: Imedu Onaregedu Aregodumode Pugeje
source: Imedu Onaregedu Aregodumode Pugeje

b: Jesus mako kimore: – Meri joku umode tuginai. Ari joku umode tuginai. Kuieje doge emode tuginai jamedu. Moto kejewu boe eimijera kurirewuge epagudumode rugadu. Epagudumode pobo maerewu ako pegarewu akoji. Pobo maerewu umode pobo barigu moto ao ka.
source: Jesus mako kimore: – Meri joku umode tuginai. Ari joku umode tuginai. Kuieje doge emode tuginai jamedu. Moto kejewu boe eimijera kurirewuge epagudumode rugadu. Epagudumode pobo maerewu ako pegarewu akoji. Pobo maerewu umode pobo barigu moto ao ka.

b: Boe eruduwamode boe pegare moto jituji. Baru magadugodumode jamedu. Boe edu pagamode turoiwakare nowu boe pegare jiboe ji kodi. Dukodire ekugudugodumode tubagudu koia.
source: Boe eruduwamode boe pegare moto jituji. Baru magadugodumode jamedu. Boe edu pagamode turoiwakare nowu boe pegare jiboe ji kodi. Dukodire ekugudugodumode tubagudu koia.

b: Dukejere care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode tugodu tabo boetugu ao jituji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Dukejere care boe erudumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodumode tugodu tabo boetugu ao jituji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu ro rakarewuji. Erudumode Imedu Onaregedu o jorugu kurirewuji. Jorugure moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Tarudumode nowu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taragojedo tawo tado tarugadu. Tagaiwowo iwagai. Taruduwamode imode taginorudo rugadu kuri aino duji rugadu.
source: Tarudumode nowu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taragojedo tawo tado tarugadu. Tagaiwowo iwagai. Taruduwamode imode taginorudo rugadu kuri aino duji rugadu.

b: Figo I Ure Boe Eruduwado
source: Figo I Ure Boe Eruduwado

b: Jesus mako kimore. Akore Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je.
source: Jesus mako kimore. Akore Figo i ure taruduwado tu tu je.

b: Figo i okurogu boture dukeje tarudure roino duji rugadu. Dukodi care taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.
source: Figo i okurogu boture dukeje tarudure roino duji rugadu. Dukodi care taruduware bubutumode kuri je rugadu. Tagaiwore figo iji taruduwawo bubutumode kejewu meri ji. Ainore tarore tu tu je.

b: Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode itaregodumode kuri aino duji boe eimijera kurirewuwo imi. Bubutu ji karega inagoino. Ire inagoino rugadu. Itaregodumode kejewu meri jire inagoino tai.
source: Ca ire tawie nuba boemode meri jokuji nuba boemode ari jokuji. Iwo tawie. Tagaiwodo awu ire tawie jiboe jamedu boe ji emode taruduwado dubagai. Tarudumode ire tawie jiwu iwadaru jetumode pudui duji dukeje taruduwamode itaregodumode kuri aino duji boe eimijera kurirewuwo imi. Bubutu ji karega inagoino. Ire inagoino rugadu. Itaregodumode kejewu meri jire inagoino tai.

b: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.
source: Iwo tawie boe remawu ji. Toro ia meri keje ia tawobe erudumode awu imagore jiboe jeture pudui duji rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu tuwimodedu otodai.

b: Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare rugadu jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.
source: Baru akedumode. Moto akedumode. Mare iwadaru akedumodukare rugadu jii toro rugadu. Jetumode pudui rugadu.

b: Boe Ewo Tuioku Jado
source: Boe Ewo Tuioku Jado

b: Jesus mako kimore ei. Akore taeku jado. Tamororamagadukaba tawadae bagai. Tagaba tage kurudo tai. Tamororamagadukaba tamaragodae bagai. Tamororamagadumode nowu inoduji dukeje tamodukare tado tarugadu nowu ire tawie jiwu meri aregodumodedu ka.
source: Jesus mako kimore ei. Akore taeku jado. Tamororamagadukaba tawadae bagai. Tagaba tage kurudo tai. Tamororamagadukaba tamaragodae bagai. Tamororamagadumode nowu inoduji dukeje tamodukare tado tarugadu nowu ire tawie jiwu meri aregodumodedu ka.

b: Nou meri keje aregodumode tagae tae pagare tu je du ka. Moto kejewuge eiamedu boe emodukare cinorudo nowu itaregodumode kejewu meri keje.
source: Nou meri keje aregodumode tagae tae pagare tu je du ka. Moto kejewuge eiamedu boe emodukare cinorudo nowu itaregodumode kejewu meri keje.

b: Dukodire inagoino tai. Taeku jado. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai tu tu je uwo taragado, uwo taginorudo boe pegarewu boe piji, tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji jii toro itaregodumode du ka.
source: Dukodire inagoino tai. Taeku jado. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai tu tu je uwo taragado, uwo taginorudo boe pegarewu boe piji, tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure i dupiji jii toro itaregodumode du ka.

b: Nono Jesus ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada meri jamedu boe ji jii toro merirekodu ka tu tu je. Nou boeco ji ure tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri tori ao ka tu tu je.
source: Nono Jesus ure boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada meri jamedu boe ji jii toro merirekodu ka tu tu je. Nou boeco ji ure tudawuje nowu ba kurirewu piji tuduwo toro Oliveira Ri tori ao ka tu tu je.

b: Barogwakododure dukeje ure tugirimi Pao Kurirewu uwai ka pugeje tuwo boe eruduwado nono. Boe eiamedu boe eture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka Jesus togi tu tu je tuwiapagawo Jesus makore jiboe ji pugeje. Ainore Jesus rore nowu meri jamedu ji.
source: Barogwakododure dukeje ure tugirimi Pao Kurirewu uwai ka pugeje tuwo boe eruduwado nono. Boe eiamedu boe eture Pao Kurirewu uwai ka Jesus togi tu tu je tuwiapagawo Jesus makore jiboe ji pugeje. Ainore Jesus rore nowu meri jamedu ji.

b: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Pegarewu Tawuje
source: Boe Eimijerage Ere Tumearudae Pegarewu Tawuje

b: Judeu doge epuredugodure tuwo tuwadae towuje. Nou ewadae iere Páscoa. Nou tuwadae kejere emode ia amirewu tuginaiwu ko. Fermento metukare nowu amirewu tada.
source: Judeu doge epuredugodure tuwo tuwadae towuje. Nou ewadae iere Páscoa. Nou tuwadae kejere emode ia amirewu tuginaiwu ko. Fermento metukare nowu amirewu tada.

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere bato pui joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugebo. Emagore pui nuba turowo tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito du bagai. Mare boe etaidure Jesus ji dukodire nowu jorudu pegare Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage epagudure turo pegawo ji.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage ere bato pui joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaru jiwugebo. Emagore pui nuba turowo tuwo tugeragu Jesus ji tuwo bito du bagai. Mare boe etaidure Jesus ji dukodire nowu jorudu pegare Jesus jiwuge boe eimijerage epagudure turo pegawo ji.

b: Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai
source: Judas Iscariotes Akore Tumoduie Jesus Maku Boe Eimijerage Pegarewuge Etai

b: Nono bope doge eimijera Satanás ure turemo nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotito.
source: Nono bope doge eimijera Satanás ure turemo nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotito.

b: Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae tumagowo ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai. Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege eimijerage eire Judas Iscariotes akoino jamedu.
source: Dukodire Judas Iscariotes uture toro nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage etae tumagowo ei tumoduie Jesus maku etai. Pao Kurirewu uwai tadawu tugobaigarege eimijerage eire Judas Iscariotes akoino jamedu.

b: Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egarere pudui. Nou boe eimijerage ere diero tori udo 30 Judas Iscariotes ai.
source: Dukodire nowu boe eimijerage eiamedu boe egarere pudui. Nou boe eimijerage ere diero tori udo 30 Judas Iscariotes ai.

b: Dukodire Judas ure tugeragu nowu dieroji. Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo boe emagakare apo dubagai tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai nowu meri keje.
source: Dukodire Judas ure tugeragu nowu dieroji. Du nowu meri pijire nowu Judas Iscariotes aiwore Jesus rore jiboe ji tuioruduwo boe emagakare apo dubagai tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai nowu meri keje.

b: Jesus Umode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Eke Ko Ture Joruduwadowugebo
source: Jesus Umode Páscoa Kejewu Boe Eke Ko Ture Joruduwadowugebo

b: Páscoa meri aregodure Judeu doge ere tuge amirewu pemegado, ere tagu carneiro doge kugure ewido tuwo pemegado tuwo kowuje jamedu nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji.
source: Páscoa meri aregodure Judeu doge ere tuge amirewu pemegado, ere tagu carneiro doge kugure ewido tuwo pemegado tuwo kowuje jamedu nono turo mogadure tuwaduwo Páscoaji.

b: Jesus makore Pedro ji, Joãoji jamedu. Akore tadudo toro tawo page pemegado pawo kowuje pawaduwo Páscoaji.
source: Jesus makore Pedro ji, Joãoji jamedu. Akore tadudo toro tawo page pemegado pawo kowuje pawaduwo Páscoaji.

b: egore kaiba cemode nowu page pemegado?
source: egore kaiba cemode nowu page pemegado?

b: Jesus akore Tadumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje ia imedu aregodumode tadogi ia pori po tabo. Tadudo nowu imedu rekodaji. Umode turemo ia baito dukeje tanarado nowu uwaire bai cewuji ia paedumodurewu bagai. Tagagodo aino: “Pagimijera aidure ia tiedumodurewu bagai togwagewo Páscoa kejewu boe ekeji ture joruduwadowugebo nowu boe edurewu ja tada.”
source: Jesus akore Tadumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Tagaregodumode toro dukeje ia imedu aregodumode tadogi ia pori po tabo. Tadudo nowu imedu rekodaji. Umode turemo ia baito dukeje tanarado nowu uwaire bai cewuji ia paedumodurewu bagai. Tagagodo aino: “Pagimijera aidure ia tiedumodurewu bagai togwagewo Páscoa kejewu boe ekeji ture joruduwadowugebo nowu boe edurewu ja tada.”

b: Tagagomode aino dukeje nowu uwaire bai cewu umode tarududo ia boe edure kejewu bai pemegarewuji. Nou bai pemegamode rugadu pagwagewo Páscoa kejewu pageji. Nonore tamode page pemegado.
source: Tagagomode aino dukeje nowu uwaire bai cewu umode tarududo ia boe edure kejewu bai pemegarewuji. Nou bai pemegamode rugadu pagwagewo Páscoa kejewu pageji. Nonore tamode page pemegado.

b: Nono Pedro uture João apo jamedu. Etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukeje erudure boe ji nono Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Pascoaji nowu bai tada rugadu.
source: Nono Pedro uture João apo jamedu. Etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukeje erudure boe ji nono Jesus akoino jiboe ji. Nono ere tuge pemegado tuwaduwo Pascoaji nowu bai tada rugadu.

b: Nono Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowugebo. Nou boeco ji Jesus mugure nono ia ira keje togwage tabo ebo. Utumode Jesus bataru tabowuge emode emage.
source: Nono Jesus aregodure nouia ture joruduwadowugebo. Nou boeco ji Jesus mugure nono ia ira keje togwage tabo ebo. Utumode Jesus bataru tabowuge emode emage.

b: Akore itaidure rugadu iwo awu Páscoa kejewu boe eke kowuje mare boe ero pegamode i du otodai.
source: Akore itaidure rugadu iwo awu Páscoa kejewu boe eke kowuje mare boe ero pegamode i du otodai.

b: Nono imodukare awu boe eke kowuje pugeje jii toro Boe Eimijera Pao Kurirewu aregodumode nowu mearutorure puduiwuge ewagai du ka. Nono imode Pao Kurirewu uke remawu kowuje Pao Kurirewu apo.
source: Nono imodukare awu boe eke kowuje pugeje jii toro Boe Eimijera Pao Kurirewu aregodumode nowu mearutorure puduiwuge ewagai du ka. Nono imode Pao Kurirewu uke remawu kowuje Pao Kurirewu apo.

b: Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu vinho kuru paru tabo. Dukeje makore pugeje nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore awu pedo tai.
source: Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu vinho kuru paru tabo. Dukeje makore pugeje nowu ture joruduwadowuge ji. Akore awu pedo tai.

b: Inure tawie aino. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode iwo boe eimijera kurirewudo imi du ka.
source: Inure tawie aino. Ikudumodukare awu vinho kuruce pugeje jii toro itaregodumode iwo boe eimijera kurirewudo imi du ka.

b: Jesus ure tugeragu amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo ei. Akore ikodu reo. Makudumode taro pegarewu morice. Tagwagedo awuji tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.
source: Jesus ure tugeragu amirewuji. Imadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu amirewu paru tabo. Nono ure nowu amirewu kado dukeje ure pedo ei. Akore ikodu reo. Makudumode taro pegarewu morice. Tagwagedo awuji tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje.

b: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu turowo ji nono turo moga amirewu jitu mogadure. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Pao Kurirewu mearudae maiwu koiare imode iku redo boe ero pegarewu morice.
source: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu turowo ji nono turo moga amirewu jitu mogadure. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Pao Kurirewu mearudae maiwu koiare imode iku redo boe ero pegarewu morice.

b: Ca. Tagaiwodo. Umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu mugure woe itabo ira keje.
source: Ca. Tagaiwodo. Umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwu mugure woe itabo ira keje.

b: Mare iwimode nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure rugadu. Mare boe pegamode nowu umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji jamedu.
source: Mare iwimode nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure rugadu. Mare boe pegamode nowu umode imagu boe eimijerage pegarewuge etaiwuji jamedu.

b: Jesus akore aino dukeje care nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare pui duboba romode aino tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage etai du bagai.
source: Jesus akore aino dukeje care nowu ure joruduwadowuge enarare pui duboba romode aino tuwo Jesus maku boe eimijerage etai du bagai.

b: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Etokire Pui
source: Jesus Ure Joruduwadowuge Etokire Pui

b: Nono Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe etokire pui. Eiamedu boe egore boe eimijera kurirewu moduie pudumi nowu tumedage ekori.
source: Nono Jesus ure joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe etokire pui. Eiamedu boe egore boe eimijera kurirewu moduie pudumi nowu tumedage ekori.

b: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore boe tuginaiwuge eimijerage mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge egore boe emedage enuie pudumi mare pagare egoino. Ero rakare boe ji. Boe emearutorure tugimijeragei rugadu. Emearutorumodukare ei dukeje nowu boe eimijerage emode boe pegado nowu mearutorukare puduiwugei rugadu.
source: Mare Jesus makore ei. Akore boe tuginaiwuge eimijerage mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge egore boe emedage enuie pudumi mare pagare egoino. Ero rakare boe ji. Boe emearutorure tugimijeragei rugadu. Emearutorumodukare ei dukeje nowu boe eimijerage emode boe pegado nowu mearutorukare puduiwugei rugadu.

b: Mare tagi tarokaba nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewuge ero mogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tagojarokaba tai tawo tado nono ipare enojaromoga pudui tumanamagei dumogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tamearudae udo nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tawo boe eimijera pemegarewugedo tagi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi.
source: Mare tagi tarokaba nono nowu boe eimijera kurirewuge ero mogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tagojarokaba tai tawo tado nono ipare enojaromoga pudui tumanamagei dumogadure. Ia tagi tagaidumode tawo boe eimijerado tagi dukeje tamearudae udo nono boe utugare mearudae mogadure tawo boe eimijera pemegarewugedo tagi. Boe eimijera romode nono boe utugare ro mogadure tuwo boe eimijera pemegarewudo pudumi.

b: Boe eimijerage kurirewuge enogwagemode boeto ji. Utugarege emode boe eke maku etai. Boe eimijera kurirewunure imi rugadu mare ire ido nono boe etugare mogadure iwo tage maku tagai. Tarodo nono iro mogadure jamedu.
source: Boe eimijerage kurirewuge enogwagemode boeto ji. Utugarege emode boe eke maku etai. Boe eimijera kurirewunure imi rugadu mare ire ido nono boe etugare mogadure iwo tage maku tagai. Tarodo nono iro mogadure jamedu.

b: Boe rakare i. Du inodu tabo taragojere woe itabo. Tarudure boe rakare i duji. Mare Iogwa Kurirewu ure boe eimijera kurirewudo imi ietuwo boe ji. Dukodire imode boe eimijerado tagi jamedu taetuwo boe ji.
source: Boe rakare i. Du inodu tabo taragojere woe itabo. Tarudure boe rakare i duji. Mare Iogwa Kurirewu ure boe eimijera kurirewudo imi ietuwo boe ji. Dukodire imode boe eimijerado tagi jamedu taetuwo boe ji.

b: Mare boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi dukeje tagwagemode itabo tagudumode itabo imugurewu keje. Tamugumode boe eimijerage emuga keje jamedu. Boe eimijerage emode tagi jamedu tagaiwowo Judeu doge eiamedu boe ero pegarewu bagai.
source: Mare boe eimijera kurirewu mode imi dukeje tagwagemode itabo tagudumode itabo imugurewu keje. Tamugumode boe eimijerage emuga keje jamedu. Boe eimijerage emode tagi jamedu tagaiwowo Judeu doge eiamedu boe ero pegarewu bagai.

b: Jesus Makore Pedro ji Umoduie Tuioruduwa Bokwado Pudui
source: Jesus Makore Pedro ji Umoduie Tuioruduwa Bokwado Pudui

b: Nono Jesus makore Pedro ji. Akore Simão. Simão. Awiapaga pemegado imagomode ai jiboe ji. Bope doge eimijera Satanás okwamagudure tuwo turokogado ai tuwo amearudae pegado. Dukodire imagore Pao Kurirewu ji aparu tabo amearutorure idu akedukawo. Nono amode akirimi amearutoruwo i pugeje nono amode amedage emearutoru kurido i jamedu.
source: Nono Jesus makore Pedro ji. Akore Simão. Simão. Awiapaga pemegado imagomode ai jiboe ji. Bope doge eimijera Satanás okwamagudure tuwo turokogado ai tuwo amearudae pegado. Dukodire imagore Pao Kurirewu ji aparu tabo amearutorure idu akedukawo. Nono amode akirimi amearutoruwo i pugeje nono amode amedage emearutoru kurido i jamedu.

b: Mare Pedro akore Ikimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu. Imearutorure tu ai rugadu. Ire irugadu ikoduwo akabo imeduwo baicorewu tada akabo, iwiwo akabo jamedu.
source: Mare Pedro akore Ikimijera kurirewunure aki rugadu. Imearutorure tu ai rugadu. Ire irugadu ikoduwo akabo imeduwo baicorewu tada akabo, iwiwo akabo jamedu.

b: Jesus akore Inure awie boe remawu ji. Awu boeco ji akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.
source: Jesus akore Inure awie boe remawu ji. Awu boeco ji akagomode aruduwakaie i dumode pobe metia bokware. Dukeje care kagariga kudugodumode.

b: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ji pugeje. Akore ire tadudo toro boe etae marigudu tawo boe ewie iwadaru ji. Mare ire tadudo tagadarabo bokware dutabo, tamijigu bokware dutabo, tawure okeakejewu bokware dutabo. Ca inarawo tai. Tadure toro ia boe bokware tagai kana? egore boro. Iaboe okwakare cenai rugadu.
source: Nono Jesus makore ture joruduwadowuge eiamedu boe ji pugeje. Akore ire tadudo toro boe etae marigudu tawo boe ewie iwadaru ji. Mare ire tadudo tagadarabo bokware dutabo, tamijigu bokware dutabo, tawure okeakejewu bokware dutabo. Ca inarawo tai. Tadure toro ia boe bokware tagai kana? egore boro. Iaboe okwakare cenai rugadu.

b: Jesus akore aino care ore micigurewu umode tugeragu to miciguji. Ukadaraborewu umode tugeragu tugodaraboji. Iaboe maku diero bagai tawo akirodo ia tarigaji.
source: Jesus akore aino care ore micigurewu umode tugeragu to miciguji. Ukadaraborewu umode tugeragu tugodaraboji. Iaboe maku diero bagai tawo akirodo ia tarigaji.

b: Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje marigudu. Akore aino: “Boe ere udo nono ro pegarewu mogadure.” Ainore padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore marigudu. Aino ca nowu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Boe mode aino i rugadu nono nowu bataru mogadure.
source: Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru padure bapera keje marigudu. Akore aino: “Boe ere udo nono ro pegarewu mogadure.” Ainore padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore marigudu. Aino ca nowu bataru jetumode pudui rugadu. Boe mode aino i rugadu nono nowu bataru mogadure.

b: Ia nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu akore akaiwodo. Padarigare pobe woe. Jesus akore Ure turugadu.
source: Ia nowu Jesus ure joruduwadowu imedu akore akaiwodo. Padarigare pobe woe. Jesus akore Ure turugadu.

b: Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai
source: Jesus Makore Baruto Pao Kurirewu Bagai

b: Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji Oliveira ri ao ka turoiaji.
source: Jesus uture ture joruduwadowugebo nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu piji Oliveira ri ao ka turoiaji.

b: Aregodure taidure jiboe ka dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore tamagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.
source: Aregodure taidure jiboe ka dukeje Jesus makore ei. Akore tamagodo itabo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.

b: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje epiji kuri je tumagowo baru to. Ure tubu jodo moto keje tumagowo Tuoji.
source: Nono Jesus ure tudawuje epiji kuri je tumagowo baru to. Ure tubu jodo moto keje tumagowo Tuoji.

b: Akore iogwa. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo ipiji. Mare umodukare nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.
source: Akore iogwa. Boe ero pegamode idu utudo ipiji. Mare umodukare nono itaidu mogadure. Mare uwo nono akaidu mogadure.

b: Dukeje ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure Jesus ae tuwo raka maku ai.
source: Dukeje ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure Jesus ae tuwo raka maku ai.

b: Jesus mako kimore baru to turaga tabo. Akaru ure nono boe ekure tuwudure moto ka dutabo.
source: Jesus mako kimore baru to turaga tabo. Akaru ure nono boe ekure tuwudure moto ka dutabo.

b: Ure tumago akedudo dukeje Jesus ure tugirimi ture joruduwadowuge etae. Jorudure ei enudure duji. Emedugodure tugiarigodure dukodi.
source: Ure tumago akedudo dukeje Jesus ure tugirimi ture joruduwadowuge etae. Jorudure ei enudure duji. Emedugodure tugiarigodure dukodi.

b: Jesus makore ei. Akore kodiba tanudure? Taragojedo. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.
source: Jesus makore ei. Akore kodiba tanudure? Taragojedo. Tamagodo baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai bope ukawo tumearudae pegarewu maku tagai taro pegakawo.

b: Boe Eimijera Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji
source: Boe Eimijera Pegarewuge Ere Tugeragu Jesus ji

b: Jesus mako kimore aino nowu ture joruduwadowugei dukeje boe emagare taregodu tabo ae. Nou Jesus ure joruduwadowu Judas Iscariotes emare roino ebo tuwo erego Jesus bagai tuwo Jesus maku etai. Nono Judas ure tuburedo Jesus ji tugimaduwo apo. Ure togwa to co Jesus je koduto tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge erududo taidure tuwo tugeragu jiwu imedunure ema duji.

Nono Judas ure tuburedo Jesus ji tugimaduwo apo. Ure togwa to co Jesus je koduto tuwo nowu boe pegarewuge erududo taidure tuwo tugeragu jiwu imedunure ema duji.

b: Jesus makore Judaji. Akore are imagu awu boe pegarewuge etai. Kocare akaidure akimaduwo aino itabo?
source: Jesus makore Judaji. Akore are imagu awu boe pegarewuge etai. Kocare akaidure akimaduwo aino itabo?

b: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu boe pegarewuge emode tugeragu Jesus jituji dukeje enarare Jesus ji: – Cegimijera! Cemode cebodo ebo tariga tabo?
source: Ia Jesus ure joruduwadowuge erudure nowu boe pegarewuge emode tugeragu Jesus jituji dukeje enarare Jesus ji: – Cegimijera! Cemode cebodo ebo tariga tabo?

b: Mare nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowu upagakare Jesus makowo nowu tumedage ewadaru jipagi. Ure taredo nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu utugare ae. Ure tariga bu nowu utugare bija kajeje.
source: Mare nouia Jesus ure joruduwadowu upagakare Jesus makowo nowu tumedage ewadaru jipagi. Ure taredo nowu ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu utugare ae. Ure tariga bu nowu utugare bija kajeje.

b: Mare Jesus akore Tarokaba aino. Urugadu. Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje. Ca ure pemegago taci je.
source: Mare Jesus akore Tarokaba aino. Urugadu. Nono Jesus ure tugera bu nowu imedu bija keje. Ca ure pemegago taci je.
