b: Nou Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tadawu boe eimijera mearutorure Jesus ji. Ure tugimijerado ema rugadu. Iere Crispo. Uwobe eiamedu boe emearutorure jamedu. Ia Corinto ba kurirewu kejewuge emearudure nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorure jamedu. Dukejere etao pegododure jamedu.
source: Nou Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tadawu boe eimijera mearutorure Jesus ji. Ure tugimijerado ema rugadu. Iere Crispo. Uwobe eiamedu boe emearutorure jamedu. Ia Corinto ba kurirewu kejewuge emearudure nowu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje emearutorure jamedu. Dukejere etao pegododure jamedu.

b: Ia boeco ji Paulo jorudure iaboe ji. Ure nono boe uniau mogadure. Nono Pagimijera Jesus makore ji. Akore apagudukaba. Akaba akera ra amagore iwadaru jitu piji.
source: Ia boeco ji Paulo jorudure iaboe ji. Ure nono boe uniau mogadure. Nono Pagimijera Jesus makore ji. Akore apagudukaba. Akaba akera ra amagore iwadaru jitu piji.

b: Iragojere akabo. Ia boe pegarewuge emoka turo pegado ai. Iwobe emagare awu ba kurirewu keje.
source: Iragojere akabo. Ia boe pegarewuge emoka turo pegado ai. Iwobe emagare awu ba kurirewu keje.

b: Dukodire Paulo rakoje raire nowu ba kurirewu keje. Jorure mito ji nono, ari oto padure seis ji nono pugeje ture boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji duji.
source: Dukodire Paulo rakoje raire nowu ba kurirewu keje. Jorure mito ji nono, ari oto padure seis ji nono pugeje ture boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji duji.

b: Roma kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu ure Gálio utudo Acaia moto kejewuge etae eimijerace. Dukejere ia Judeu doge ere bato pui turo pegawo Pauloji. Ere tugeragu ji. Eture apo nowu boe eimijera Gálio ae.
source: Roma kejewu boe eimijera kurirewu ure Gálio utudo Acaia moto kejewuge etae eimijerace. Dukejere ia Judeu doge ere bato pui turo pegawo Pauloji. Ere tugeragu ji. Eture apo nowu boe eimijera Gálio ae.

b: egore awu imedu makore boe ji ewo turo udo tuginai tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji cero piji. Dukodire mearutorure awu imedu jiwuge etaidukare tumearutoruwo Roma kejewu boe eimijeraji pugeje.
source: egore awu imedu makore boe ji ewo turo udo tuginai tuwo tubu jodo tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji cero piji. Dukodire mearutorure awu imedu jiwuge etaidukare tumearutoruwo Roma kejewu boe eimijeraji pugeje.

b: Paulo makoiago nowu Gálioji mare nowu Gálio makore nowu Judeu dogei. Akore tagare iwudugugo nowu taro keje. Awu imedu ro pega bokware. Ro pegamode dukeje itaiwomode ji. Mare ro pegare jiboe bokware.
source: Paulo makoiago nowu Gálioji mare nowu Gálio makore nowu Judeu dogei. Akore tagare iwudugugo nowu taro keje. Awu imedu ro pega bokware. Ro pegamode dukeje itaiwomode ji. Mare ro pegare jiboe bokware.

b: Tu tago bakaru koiare ure tagarego woe. Taro jire tagagoino. Roma kejewuge ero karega. Dukodire tagi taruduwamode nuba taromode ji. Imire itaiwomodukare ji.
source: Tu tago bakaru koiare ure tagarego woe. Taro jire tagagoino. Roma kejewuge ero karega. Dukodire tagi taruduwamode nuba taromode ji. Imire itaiwomodukare ji.

b: Dukodire ure etudo tuwai piji.
source: Dukodire ure etudo tuwai piji.

b: Dukejere ere tugeragu ia imeduji. Iere Sóstenes. Ere boeto ji nowu Gálio rakojere tadawu bai meki. Emare Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tadawu boe eimijeranure ema. Mare nowu Gálio aiwokare nowu ero pegarewuji.
source: Dukejere ere tugeragu ia imeduji. Iere Sóstenes. Ere boeto ji nowu Gálio rakojere tadawu bai meki. Emare Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai tadawu boe eimijeranure ema. Mare nowu Gálio aiwokare nowu ero pegarewuji.

b: Paulo Ure Tugirimi Tuibagi Antioquia Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Paulo Ure Tugirimi Tuibagi Antioquia Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Paulo rakoje raire nowu Corinto kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo. Aidure tuduwo Síria moto ka Priscila apo Áquila apo jamedu. Dukodire uture pugeje nowu Corinto kejewuge tumedage epiji. Etaregodure Cencréia ba kurirewu ka dukeje Paulo ure tao kado. Marigudu makore turomoduie aino duji Pao Kurirewu biagai. Dukodire ukare tao kado boe eruduwawo tumagore aino Pao Kurirewu jituji. Mare kuri aino ure tumagore jiwu turo iado dukodire ure tao kado.
source: Paulo rakoje raire nowu Corinto kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo. Aidure tuduwo Síria moto ka Priscila apo Áquila apo jamedu. Dukodire uture pugeje nowu Corinto kejewuge tumedage epiji. Etaregodure Cencréia ba kurirewu ka dukeje Paulo ure tao kado. Marigudu makore turomoduie aino duji Pao Kurirewu biagai. Dukodire ukare tao kado boe eruduwawo tumagore aino Pao Kurirewu jituji. Mare kuri aino ure tumagore jiwu turo iado dukodire ure tao kado.

b: Eture Cencréia piji ikarerewu tabo. Nono etaregodure Éfeso ba kurirewu ka. Paulo uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Makore Judeu dogei nono.
source: Eture Cencréia piji ikarerewu tabo. Nono etaregodure Éfeso ba kurirewu ka. Paulo uture nowu Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka. Makore Judeu dogei nono.

b: Etaidure Paulo rakoje raiwo pudabo mare Paulo aidure tuduwo kuri je.
source: Etaidure Paulo rakoje raiwo pudabo mare Paulo aidure tuduwo kuri je.

b: Ure ewie. Akore Pao Kurirewu aidumode dukeje itaregodumode mato pugeje tagae. Dukejere uture Éfeso piji ikarerewu tabo pugeje. Mare Áquila Priscila ekodukare apo pugeje. Emugure nono Éfeso ba kurirewu keje.
source: Ure ewie. Akore Pao Kurirewu aidumode dukeje itaregodumode mato pugeje tagae. Dukejere uture Éfeso piji ikarerewu tabo pugeje. Mare Áquila Priscila ekodukare apo pugeje. Emugure nono Éfeso ba kurirewu keje.

b: Paulo aregodure Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka Judéia moto ka. Dukeje uture Jerusalém ka. Nonore uture mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae tugimaduwo ebo. Dupijire uture Antioquia ba kurirewu ka Síria moto ka.
source: Paulo aregodure Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka Judéia moto ka. Dukeje uture Jerusalém ka. Nonore uture mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae tugimaduwo ebo. Dupijire uture Antioquia ba kurirewu ka Síria moto ka.

b: Paulo Uture Pugeje Tuwo Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Emearutoru Rakado
source: Paulo Uture Pugeje Tuwo Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Emearutoru Rakado

b: Paulo rakoje raire nowu Antioquia ba kurirewu keje. Dukejere uture pugeje toro Galácia moto ka, Frígia moto ka tuwo nowu moto kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakado jamedu.
source: Paulo rakoje raire nowu Antioquia ba kurirewu keje. Dukejere uture pugeje toro Galácia moto ka, Frígia moto ka tuwo nowu moto kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakado jamedu.

b: Paulo rore aino dukeje ia imedu aregodure Éfeso ba kurirewu ka. Judeunure ema. Iere Apolo. Boture Alexandria ba kurirewu keje Egito moto keje. Emare mako pemegare. Joruduware rugadu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Paulo rore aino dukeje ia imedu aregodure Éfeso ba kurirewu ka. Judeunure ema. Iere Apolo. Boture Alexandria ba kurirewu keje Egito moto keje. Emare mako pemegare. Joruduware rugadu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Boe ere nowu Apolo joruduwado Jesus roji. Dukodire makore boe ewiagai tuwo eruduwado Jesus roredu jiboe ji tiegare tabo. Mare Apolo joruduwakare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etao pegododure duji. Joruduware tu João Batista ure boe etao pegodo duji.
source: Boe ere nowu Apolo joruduwado Jesus roji. Dukodire makore boe ewiagai tuwo eruduwado Jesus roredu jiboe ji tiegare tabo. Mare Apolo joruduwakare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etao pegododure duji. Joruduware tu João Batista ure boe etao pegodo duji.

b: Ca Apolo pogurukare tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji Judeu doge ewiagai ere bato pui bai tada. Priscila, Áquila emearudure Apolo bataru ji dukeje emagore ji utuwo pudabo toro tuwai ka. Ewai tadare ere Apolo joruduwado Pao Kurirewu ro remawu ji.
source: Ca Apolo pogurukare tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji Judeu doge ewiagai ere bato pui bai tada. Priscila, Áquila emearudure Apolo bataru ji dukeje emagore ji utuwo pudabo toro tuwai ka. Ewai tadare ere Apolo joruduwado Pao Kurirewu ro remawu ji.

b: Dukejere Apolo ure tumearudae tawuje tuduwo Acaia moto ka. Nou Éfeso kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere atugoreboe pemegado nowu Acaia moto kejewuge ewagai tuwo eruduwado nowu Apoloji, ewo tugera upodo apo. Ca uture. Aregodure toro dukeje Apolo ure tugera maku nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ei emearutoruwo Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Dukejere Apolo ure tumearudae tawuje tuduwo Acaia moto ka. Nou Éfeso kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere atugoreboe pemegado nowu Acaia moto kejewuge ewagai tuwo eruduwado nowu Apoloji, ewo tugera upodo apo. Ca uture. Aregodure toro dukeje Apolo ure tugera maku nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ro pemegare ei emearutoruwo Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Nou Apolo ure Judeu doge eruduwa bokwado tuwadaru pemegarewu tabo. Boe erudure nowu Apolo roji. Pao Kurirewu bataru tabore Apolo ure boe eruduwado Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu duji.
source: Nou Apolo ure Judeu doge eruduwa bokwado tuwadaru pemegarewu tabo. Boe erudure nowu Apolo roji. Pao Kurirewu bataru tabore Apolo ure boe eruduwado Jesus umode boe ekinorudowunure ema rugadu duji.

b: Paulo Uture Éfeso Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Paulo Uture Éfeso Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Apolo rakojere Corinto ba kurirewu keje dukeje Paulo uture Ásia moto ka taregoduwo Éfeso ba kurirewu ka. Aregodure dukeje Paulo jorudure ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji.
source: Apolo rakojere Corinto ba kurirewu keje dukeje Paulo uture Ásia moto ka taregoduwo Éfeso ba kurirewu ka. Aregodure dukeje Paulo jorudure ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji.

b: Unarare ei. Akore tamearutorure Jesus ji? Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje tagae? egore ceruduwakare nowu akagore jiwu Pao Kurirewu Uwariji.
source: Unarare ei. Akore tamearutorure Jesus ji? Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje tagae? egore ceruduwakare nowu akagore jiwu Pao Kurirewu Uwariji.

b: Paulo akore Tagao pegododure mare ioguduba bataru koiaba tagao pegododure? egore cemearutorure João Batista bataru ji dukodire cedao pegododure nono João Batista rore boe ji dumogadure.
source: Paulo akore Tagao pegododure mare ioguduba bataru koiaba tagao pegododure? egore cemearutorure João Batista bataru ji dukodire cedao pegododure nono João Batista rore boe ji dumogadure.

b: Paulo akore Boe ere tugera ra turo pegarewu piji dukeje João Batista ure etao pegodo. Emare ure boe ewie, ure nowu Judeu doge ewie, ia imedu kurirewu aregodumoduie turegodaji. Makore ei emearutoruwo nowu turegodajiwuji. Nou João Batista rekodajiwu Jesusnure ema.
source: Paulo akore Boe ere tugera ra turo pegarewu piji dukeje João Batista ure etao pegodo. Emare ure boe ewie, ure nowu Judeu doge ewie, ia imedu kurirewu aregodumoduie turegodaji. Makore ei emearutoruwo nowu turegodajiwuji. Nou João Batista rekodajiwu Jesusnure ema.

b: Nou boe emearudure nowu Paulo bataru ji dukeje etao pegododure pugeje emearutorure Pagimijera Jesus ji kodi.
source: Nou boe emearudure nowu Paulo bataru ji dukeje etao pegododure pugeje emearutorure Pagimijera Jesus ji kodi.

b: Paulo ure tugera bu ewugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje etae. Dukodire emagore tuioruduwakare jiwu boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji. Emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe tuginaiwuge ewiagai.
source: Paulo ure tugera bu ewugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure turawuje etae. Dukodire emagore tuioruduwakare jiwu boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji. Emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe tuginaiwuge ewiagai.

b: Nou ime enodo padure kejewure doze.
source: Nou ime enodo padure kejewure doze.

b: Paulo rakojere nowu ba kurirewu keje dukeje arire pobe metia bokware ji. Uture tu tu je Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka tumagowo ei nono. Pogurukare tumagowo boe ewiagai. Aidure tuwo emearutorudo Jesus ji rugadu, emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ure boe eimijera kurirewudo ema duji.
source: Paulo rakojere nowu ba kurirewu keje dukeje arire pobe metia bokware ji. Uture tu tu je Judeu doge ere bato puiwu bai ka tumagowo ei nono. Pogurukare tumagowo boe ewiagai. Aidure tuwo emearutorudo Jesus ji rugadu, emearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ure boe eimijera kurirewudo ema duji.

b: Mare iage emearutoru bokware. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo rugadu. Emago pegare Pagimijera Jesus ure maku boe etaiwu turoji nowu boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Dukodire Paulo uture nowu boe epiji mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo tuduwo imedu Tirano o escola ka. Meri jamedu ji makore nono nowu escola tada tuwo boe emearutorudo Jesus ji.
source: Mare iage emearutoru bokware. Etaidukare tumearutoruwo rugadu. Emago pegare Pagimijera Jesus ure maku boe etaiwu turoji nowu boe eiamedu boe ewiagai. Dukodire Paulo uture nowu boe epiji mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo tuduwo imedu Tirano o escola ka. Meri jamedu ji makore nono nowu escola tada tuwo boe emearutorudo Jesus ji.

b: Jorure pobe ji rore aino duji. Dukodire awu Ásia moto kejewuge eiamedu boe emearudure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Judeu doge emearudure. Boe tuginaiwuge emearudure jamedu.
source: Jorure pobe ji rore aino duji. Dukodire awu Ásia moto kejewuge eiamedu boe emearudure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Judeu doge emearudure. Boe tuginaiwuge emearudure jamedu.

b: Ceva Ore Ime Etaidure Tuwo Bope Doge Etawuje Boe Epiji
source: Ceva Ore Ime Etaidure Tuwo Bope Doge Etawuje Boe Epiji

b: Pao Kurirewu ure Paulo ro rakado.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure Paulo ro rakado.

b: Boe ere tugeragu nowu Paulo ukudau areia roguji. Eture nowu areiarogu tabo kogodurewuge etae. Dukodire nowu kogodurewuge epemegagodure rugadu. Bope doge ere tudawuje iage epiji.
source: Boe ere tugeragu nowu Paulo ukudau areia roguji. Eture nowu areiarogu tabo kogodurewuge etae. Dukodire nowu kogodurewuge epemegagodure rugadu. Bope doge ere tudawuje iage epiji.

b: Ca ia Judeu doge erudure nowu boe erore jiboe ji. Etaidure turowo aino jamedu. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera orenure emage. Enodo padure sete. Etuo iere Ceva. Marigudu nowu Ceva ore ime ere bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Erore aino tu tu je. Mare aino etaidure tumagowo Jesus ieji tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Emearutorukare Jesus ji mare etaidure tumagowo Jesus ie tabo. Emagore bope dogei. egore tadawuje awu boe epiji Paulo makore jiwu Jesus ie koia.
source: Ca ia Judeu doge erudure nowu boe erore jiboe ji. Etaidure turowo aino jamedu. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera orenure emage. Enodo padure sete. Etuo iere Ceva. Marigudu nowu Ceva ore ime ere bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Erore aino tu tu je. Mare aino etaidure tumagowo Jesus ieji tuwo bope doge etawuje boe epiji. Emearutorukare Jesus ji mare etaidure tumagowo Jesus ie tabo. Emagore bope dogei. egore tadawuje awu boe epiji Paulo makore jiwu Jesus ie koia.

b: Mare nowu bope makore ei. Akore ioruduware Jesus ji. Ioruduware Pauloji. Mare ioruduwakare tai. Imearutorumodukare tai jamedu.
source: Mare nowu bope makore ei. Akore ioruduware Jesus ji. Ioruduware Pauloji. Mare ioruduwakare tai. Imearutorumodukare tai jamedu.

b: Nou bope metu tadawu imedu ure taredo nowu Ceva orei turugoduwo ei. Ure turagado ei rugadu dukodire eregodure nowu imedu uwai piji. Ure etogorido. Ure ekudau areia bowuje.
source: Nou bope metu tadawu imedu ure taredo nowu Ceva orei turugoduwo ei. Ure turagado ei rugadu dukodire eregodure nowu imedu uwai piji. Ure etogorido. Ure ekudau areia bowuje.

b: Nou Éfeso ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje epagudugodure rugadu. Ere Pagimijera Jesus ie kurido rugadu.
source: Nou Éfeso ba kurirewu kejewuge eiamedu boe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje epagudugodure rugadu. Ere Pagimijera Jesus ie kurido rugadu.

b: Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edure nono jamedu. Marigudu ekare boe ewie nowu tumearutorure jituji. Mare aino ere boe eiamedu boe ewie tumearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Egore marigudu turo pegaie rugadu mare aino turo pegamodukaie pugeje.
source: Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edure nono jamedu. Marigudu ekare boe ewie nowu tumearutorure jituji. Mare aino ere boe eiamedu boe ewie tumearutorure Jesus ji rugadu. Egore marigudu turo pegaie rugadu mare aino turo pegamodukaie pugeje.

b: Iage barinure emage. Ere turo bu bapera keje. Mare emearutorure Jesus ji dukeje etaregodure nowu bapera tabo tuwo kowu tuwo nowu bapera akedudo. Nou ewadaru padure kejewu bapera mori kurire rugadu. Mori oto padure kejewure cinquenta mil moeda de prata. Mare aino ere nowu ture towu bapera akedudo.
source: Iage barinure emage. Ere turo bu bapera keje. Mare emearutorure Jesus ji dukeje etaregodure nowu bapera tabo tuwo kowu tuwo nowu bapera akedudo. Nou ewadaru padure kejewu bapera mori kurire rugadu. Mori oto padure kejewure cinquenta mil moeda de prata. Mare aino ere nowu ture towu bapera akedudo.

b: Ca aino Pagimijera Jesus bataru ure taodo boe ewokwaji. Ure boe emearutorudo rugadu.
source: Ca aino Pagimijera Jesus bataru ure taodo boe ewokwaji. Ure boe emearutorudo rugadu.

b: Éfeso Kejewuge Ere Bato Pui Tumago Rakawo Pui
source: Éfeso Kejewuge Ere Bato Pui Tumago Rakawo Pui

b: Nou inodu otobiji Paulo ure tumearudae tawuje tuduwo Macedônia moto ka, tuduwo Acaia moto ka, dukeje tuduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka jamedu. Akore itumode Jerusalém ka dukeje itaidure ituwo Roma ba kurirewu ka.
source: Nou inodu otobiji Paulo ure tumearudae tawuje tuduwo Macedônia moto ka, tuduwo Acaia moto ka, dukeje tuduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka jamedu. Akore itumode Jerusalém ka dukeje itaidure ituwo Roma ba kurirewu ka.

b: Dukejere ure tudugarege etudo tododai toro Macedônia moto ka. Ere pobe. Ia iere Timóteo. Metia iere Erasto. Mare rakoje kimore Éfeso ba kurirewu keje, Ásia moto keje.
source: Dukejere ure tudugarege etudo tododai toro Macedônia moto ka. Ere pobe. Ia iere Timóteo. Metia iere Erasto. Mare rakoje kimore Éfeso ba kurirewu keje, Ásia moto keje.

b: Rakoje kimo nono dukeje boe pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwugei Éfeso keje.
source: Rakoje kimo nono dukeje boe pegare mearutorure Jesus jiwugei Éfeso keje.

b: Ia Éfeso kejewu imedu ure bairogu towuje boe emearutorure jiwu bope doge ewaice. Maragodaenure tu ema rugadu. Nou imedu iere Demétrio. Nou ure toboe ure nono nowu Éfeso kejewuge emearutorure jiwu bope uwari uwai mogadure. Nou bope aredu uwari iere Diana. Nou Diana uwai kurirewu mugure nowu ba kurirewu keje. Nou Demétrio ure nowu bairogu to prata tabo. Nou ure towu bai pigigodure. Nou Éfeso kejewuge ere diero maku nowu Demétrio ai tuwo tugeragu nowu ure towu bai roguji tuwarice. Dukodire nowu Demétrio o diero kurire. Utugarege eno diero kurire jamedu.
source: Ia Éfeso kejewu imedu ure bairogu towuje boe emearutorure jiwu bope doge ewaice. Maragodaenure tu ema rugadu. Nou imedu iere Demétrio. Nou ure toboe ure nono nowu Éfeso kejewuge emearutorure jiwu bope uwari uwai mogadure. Nou bope aredu uwari iere Diana. Nou Diana uwai kurirewu mugure nowu ba kurirewu keje. Nou Demétrio ure nowu bairogu to prata tabo. Nou ure towu bai pigigodure. Nou Éfeso kejewuge ere diero maku nowu Demétrio ai tuwo tugeragu nowu ure towu bai roguji tuwarice. Dukodire nowu Demétrio o diero kurire. Utugarege eno diero kurire jamedu.

b: Demétrio ure tudugarege edo bato pui. Makore nouia maragodure nowu inodu jiwuge ewagai jamedu. Demétrio makore ei. Akore taruduware pago diero kurire duji pamaragodae koia.
source: Demétrio ure tudugarege edo bato pui. Makore nouia maragodure nowu inodu jiwuge ewagai jamedu. Demétrio makore ei. Akore taruduware pago diero kurire duji pamaragodae koia.

b: Mare taruduware Paulo bataru ji. Ema makore boe emearutorukawo pare towu boe ji pugeje, boe ewo tugera ra pare toboe piji. Unure boe emearudae mekido woe Éfeso ba kurirewu keje, awu Ásia moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe emagare tumearutoru tabo nowu Paulo bataru ji.
source: Mare taruduware Paulo bataru ji. Ema makore boe emearutorukawo pare towu boe ji pugeje, boe ewo tugera ra pare toboe piji. Unure boe emearudae mekido woe Éfeso ba kurirewu keje, awu Ásia moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Boe emagare tumearutoru tabo nowu Paulo bataru ji.

b: Boe emearutorumode nowu Paulo bataru ji dukeje etaidumodukare awu pare towu boe ji pugeje. Erudu pegamode awu pamaragodaeji. Pamearutorure jiwu bope aredu uwari Diana uwai kurirewu pegamode jamedu. Boe emearutorumodukare ji pugeje. Boe eiamedu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo awu bope aredu uwari Dianaji moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Mare boe emode tugera ra nowu Diana uwai kurirewu piji dukeje nowu bai pegamode. Boe erudu pegamode paroji jamedu.
source: Boe emearutorumode nowu Paulo bataru ji dukeje etaidumodukare awu pare towu boe ji pugeje. Erudu pegamode awu pamaragodaeji. Pamearutorure jiwu bope aredu uwari Diana uwai kurirewu pegamode jamedu. Boe emearutorumodukare ji pugeje. Boe eiamedu boe ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo awu bope aredu uwari Dianaji moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Mare boe emode tugera ra nowu Diana uwai kurirewu piji dukeje nowu bai pegamode. Boe erudu pegamode paroji jamedu.

b: Nou boe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje ekudugodure. egore Éfeso kejewu uwari Diana kurire rugadu! Pamearutorumode tu ji rugadu!
source: Nou boe emearudure nowu inoduji dukeje ekudugodure. egore Éfeso kejewu uwari Diana kurire rugadu! Pamearutorumode tu ji rugadu!

b: Nou erore jiboe ure tumaedo nowu ba kurirewu jamedu boe parugajeje. Nou boe ere tugeragu Paulo metage pobedu dogei. Ia iere Gaio. Metia iere Aristarco. Macedônia kejewugenure emage. Nou boe eture ebo toro nowu mugure ba kurirewu oiadadawu tuwororo okwa ka.
source: Nou erore jiboe ure tumaedo nowu ba kurirewu jamedu boe parugajeje. Nou boe ere tugeragu Paulo metage pobedu dogei. Ia iere Gaio. Metia iere Aristarco. Macedônia kejewugenure emage. Nou boe eture ebo toro nowu mugure ba kurirewu oiadadawu tuwororo okwa ka.

b: Paulo aidure tuduwo nowu boe etae tumagowo ei mare nouia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere togwa bu keje utukawo toro etae.
source: Paulo aidure tuduwo nowu boe etae tumagowo ei mare nouia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere togwa bu keje utukawo toro etae.

b: Ia nowu moto kejewu boe eimijerage ere tuwadaru maku nowu Paulo bagai. Metagenure emage. Emagore Pauloji utukawo toro jamedu.
source: Ia nowu moto kejewu boe eimijerage ere tuwadaru maku nowu Paulo bagai. Metagenure emage. Emagore Pauloji utukawo toro jamedu.

b: Nou ba kurirewu oiadadare nowu boe emagare rugadu. Boe korire ei rugadu. Ere taiado puapo. Iage ekudugodure iaboe ji. Nou iage ekudugodure ia tumearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Eruduwakare kodiba ture bato pui kodi boe ji.
source: Nou ba kurirewu oiadadare nowu boe emagare rugadu. Boe korire ei rugadu. Ere taiado puapo. Iage ekudugodure iaboe ji. Nou iage ekudugodure ia tumearudae pegarewu ji pugeje. Eruduwakare kodiba ture bato pui kodi boe ji.

b: Ia Judeu doge ere ia imedu rakojedo nowu boe egorai. Nou imedu iere Alexandre. Iage ekudugodure ji dukeje ure tugera nado edukiorowo. Aidure tumagowo nowu boe ji.
source: Ia Judeu doge ere ia imedu rakojedo nowu boe egorai. Nou imedu iere Alexandre. Iage ekudugodure ji dukeje ure tugera nado edukiorowo. Aidure tumagowo nowu boe ji.

b: Mare nowu boe eruduware Judeunure ema duji dukeje ekudugodu rakare pugeje. Hora oto padure pobe ei tagoino dutabo. egore Éfeso kejewu bope aredu uwari Diana kurire rugadu!
source: Mare nowu boe eruduware Judeunure ema duji dukeje ekudugodu rakare pugeje. Hora oto padure pobe ei tagoino dutabo. egore Éfeso kejewu bope aredu uwari Diana kurire rugadu!

b: Ca ia Éfeso kejewu boe eimijera ure nowu boe edukiorowo. Akore Éfeso kejewuge enure pagi. Boe eiamedu boe eruduware paetu pemegare nowu buture baru pijiwu tori uwaiji rugadu duji. Awu torire pawarinure ema. Pamearutoru kurire ji rugadu. Awu torire iere Diana Kurirewu.
source: Ca ia Éfeso kejewu boe eimijera ure nowu boe edukiorowo. Akore Éfeso kejewuge enure pagi. Boe eiamedu boe eruduware paetu pemegare nowu buture baru pijiwu tori uwaiji rugadu duji. Awu torire pawarinure ema. Pamearutoru kurire ji rugadu. Awu torire iere Diana Kurirewu.

b: Boe eiamedu boe eruduware nowu inoduji. Dukodire tawudugudo tagawo taro pegarewu to.
source: Boe eiamedu boe eruduware nowu inoduji. Dukodire tawudugudo tagawo taro pegarewu to.

b: Tagaregodure awu imebo woe. Mare ekiwogukare nowu tori padure tadawu baiji. Emagokare ia tuwadaru pegarewu ji nowu pamearutorure jiwu bope uwari areduji.
source: Tagaregodure awu imebo woe. Mare ekiwogukare nowu tori padure tadawu baiji. Emagokare ia tuwadaru pegarewu ji nowu pamearutorure jiwu bope uwari areduji.

b: Awu Demétrio utugaregebo etaidumode tumago pegawo ia boe ji dukeje etumode nowu aiwomode boe ero jiwu boe eimijerage etae etaiwowo ero pegarewu bagai.
source: Awu Demétrio utugaregebo etaidumode tumago pegawo ia boe ji dukeje etumode nowu aiwomode boe ero jiwu boe eimijerage etae etaiwowo ero pegarewu bagai.

b: Mare tagaidumode tarowo ia taroji dukeje taro pemegado nono paro mogadure.
source: Mare tagaidumode tarowo ia taroji dukeje taro pemegado nono paro mogadure.

b: Boe eruduwamode awu meri jiwu parore jiboe ji dukeje emago pegamode pai boe eimijera kurirewuge ewiagai. Awu paro ukare turugadu. Pamearudaekare turugadu awu paroji dukodire paroiwamodukare pawo pagimijerage emearudae pemegado awu meri jiwu parore jiboe ji.
source: Boe eruduwamode awu meri jiwu parore jiboe ji dukeje emago pegamode pai boe eimijera kurirewuge ewiagai. Awu paro ukare turugadu. Pamearudaekare turugadu awu paroji dukodire paroiwamodukare pawo pagimijerage emearudae pemegado awu meri jiwu parore jiboe ji.

b: Nou eimijera makore aino dukeje ure nowu boe doge etudo.
source: Nou eimijera makore aino dukeje ure nowu boe doge etudo.

b: Paulo Uture Macedônia Moto Ka Pugeje. Nou Pijire Uture Acaia Moto Ka Jamedu.
source: Paulo Uture Macedônia Moto Ka Pugeje. Nou Pijire Uture Acaia Moto Ka Jamedu.

b: Nou kudugodurewuge eture tuwai ka dukeje Paulo makore mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ewagai. Ure emearutoru rakado. Ukimadure ebo dukeje uture epiji. Uture Macedônia moto ka.
source: Nou kudugodurewuge eture tuwai ka dukeje Paulo makore mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ewagai. Ure emearutoru rakado. Ukimadure ebo dukeje uture epiji. Uture Macedônia moto ka.

b: Uture nowu Macedônia moto kejewuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae. Ure emearutoru rakado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Nou piji uture Acaia moto ka.
source: Uture nowu Macedônia moto kejewuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae. Ure emearutoru rakado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Nou piji uture Acaia moto ka.

b: Rakojere nowu Acaia moto kejewu arire pobe metia bokware ji nono. Utuiago Síria moto ka mare joruduware Judeu doge etaidure turo pegawo pudui toro duji. Dukodire ure tumearudae tawuje tuduwo tuibagi Macedônia moto ka pugeje.
source: Rakojere nowu Acaia moto kejewu arire pobe metia bokware ji nono. Utuiago Síria moto ka mare joruduware Judeu doge etaidure turo pegawo pudui toro duji. Dukodire ure tumearudae tawuje tuduwo tuibagi Macedônia moto ka pugeje.

b: Ia Beréia ba kurirewu kejewu imedu uture apo. Iere Sópatro. Pirro onaregedunure ema. Ia Tessalônica ba kurirewu kejewu ime pobedu doge eture apo jamedu. Ia iere Aristarco. Metia iere Segundo. Nou Derbe ba kurirewu kejewu imedu Gaio uture apo jamedu. Timóteo uture apo jamedu. Ásia moto kejewu ime pobedu doge eture apo jamedu. Ia iere Tíquico. Metia iere Trófimo.
source: Ia Beréia ba kurirewu kejewu imedu uture apo. Iere Sópatro. Pirro onaregedunure ema. Ia Tessalônica ba kurirewu kejewu ime pobedu doge eture apo jamedu. Ia iere Aristarco. Metia iere Segundo. Nou Derbe ba kurirewu kejewu imedu Gaio uture apo jamedu. Timóteo uture apo jamedu. Ásia moto kejewu ime pobedu doge eture apo jamedu. Ia iere Tíquico. Metia iere Trófimo.

b: Nou boe doge eture cedododai tubagawo cewagai toro Trôade ba kurirewu keje.
source: Nou boe doge eture cedododai tubagawo cewagai toro Trôade ba kurirewu keje.

b: Judeu doge ewadae akedure dukeje cedure jamedu. Nou ewadae iere Amirewu. Cedure Filipos ba kurirewu piji ikarerewu tabo. Imire iture Paulo apo jamedu. Merire ikera aboudure dukeje cedaregodure nowu pamedage etae Trôade ba kurirewu ka. Semana oto padure mito cei nono.
source: Judeu doge ewadae akedure dukeje cedure jamedu. Nou ewadae iere Amirewu. Cedure Filipos ba kurirewu piji ikarerewu tabo. Imire iture Paulo apo jamedu. Merire ikera aboudure dukeje cedaregodure nowu pamedage etae Trôade ba kurirewu ka. Semana oto padure mito cei nono.

b: Paulo Utumodukare Trôade Ba Kurirewu Ka Pugeje
source: Paulo Utumodukare Trôade Ba Kurirewu Ka Pugeje

b: Sábado boeco ji cere bato pui mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo cenogwagewo puapo. Nou barogwato Paulo utumode dukodire nowu boeco ji mako raire nowu boe dogei. Makore ei jii toro ari aregodure baru oia ka du ka.
source: Sábado boeco ji cere bato pui mearutorure Jesus jiwugebo cenogwagewo puapo. Nou barogwato Paulo utumode dukodire nowu boeco ji mako raire nowu boe dogei. Makore ei jii toro ari aregodure baru oia ka du ka.

b: Jorugu urugu makare nowu cere bato puiwu bai ja tada. Cere bato pui nowu bai aogejewu bai ja tada.
source: Jorugu urugu makare nowu cere bato puiwu bai ja tada. Cere bato pui nowu bai aogejewu bai ja tada.

b: Ia iparedu mugure nowu bai poro keje tuwiapaga tabo. Iere Êutico. Ca Paulo mako raire dukodire norire nowu Êutico jokuji. Dukodire unudure tuku je dukodire buture nowu bai poro piji toro moto ka. Boe erudure buture duji dukodire ere turawuje ae. Etaregodure ae dukeje erudure bokware duji.
source: Ia iparedu mugure nowu bai poro keje tuwiapaga tabo. Iere Êutico. Ca Paulo mako raire dukodire norire nowu Êutico jokuji. Dukodire unudure tuku je dukodire buture nowu bai poro piji toro moto ka. Boe erudure buture duji dukodire ere turawuje ae. Etaregodure ae dukeje erudure bokware duji.

b: Mare Paulo ure turawuje nowu bai piji nowu iparedu ae. Ure tugeragu ji. Ure tona bu kajeje. Dukeje akore Tamororamagadukaba. Bikare raga. Jere kimo.
source: Mare Paulo ure turawuje nowu bai piji nowu iparedu ae. Ure tugeragu ji. Ure tona bu kajeje. Dukeje akore Tamororamagadukaba. Bikare raga. Jere kimo.

b: Dukejere Paulo ruture nowu bai aogejewu bai ka pugeje. Ure tumugudo. Ure tuge pemegado dukeje okwagere. Nono mako raire nowu boe ji pugeje jii toro barogwakododu ka. Ca barogwakododure dukeje Paulo uture epiji.
source: Dukejere Paulo ruture nowu bai aogejewu bai ka pugeje. Ure tumugudo. Ure tuge pemegado dukeje okwagere. Nono mako raire nowu boe ji pugeje jii toro barogwakododu ka. Ca barogwakododure dukeje Paulo uture epiji.

b: Mare nowu boe eture nowu iparedu apo tuwai ka. Jere kimo. Bikare rugadu. Dukodire ewudugugodure.
source: Mare nowu boe eture nowu iparedu apo tuwai ka. Jere kimo. Bikare rugadu. Dukodire ewudugugodure.

b: Paulo Uture Mileto Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Paulo Uture Mileto Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Cedure Paulo otodai ikarerewu tabo Assôs ba kurirewu ka cebagawo Paulo bagai nono. Paulo akore tudumoduie toro tuwure tabo.
source: Cedure Paulo otodai ikarerewu tabo Assôs ba kurirewu ka cebagawo Paulo bagai nono. Paulo akore tudumoduie toro tuwure tabo.

b: Ca aregodure cedae dukeje ure taredo ikarerewuto jamedu. Dukeje cedure Mitilene ba kurirewu ka.
source: Ca aregodure cedae dukeje ure taredo ikarerewuto jamedu. Dukeje cedure Mitilene ba kurirewu ka.

b: Nou barogwato cedure pugeje. Cegodu puredure Quios moto ji. Pobore taiado nowu moto tabo. Nou barogwato cedaregodure Samos moto ka. Merire mito pugeje dukeje cedaregodure Mileto ba kurirewu ka.
source: Nou barogwato cedure pugeje. Cegodu puredure Quios moto ji. Pobore taiado nowu moto tabo. Nou barogwato cedaregodure Samos moto ka. Merire mito pugeje dukeje cedaregodure Mileto ba kurirewu ka.

b: Akere Pauloji taregoduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka tuwaduwo nowu Judeu doge ewadaeji. Nou ewadae iere Pentecostes. Aidure taregoduwo toro nowu ewadumode jiwu meri otodai. Dukodire mearudaere tudukawo Éfeso ba kurirewu ka.
source: Akere Pauloji taregoduwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka tuwaduwo nowu Judeu doge ewadaeji. Nou ewadae iere Pentecostes. Aidure taregoduwo toro nowu ewadumode jiwu meri otodai. Dukodire mearudaere tudukawo Éfeso ba kurirewu ka.

b: Paulo Ukimadure Nou Éfeso Kejewu Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Eimijeragebo
source: Paulo Ukimadure Nou Éfeso Kejewu Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Eimijeragebo

b: Dukodire Paulo makore nowu Éfeso kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijerage ewagai etaregoduwo tudogi.
source: Dukodire Paulo makore nowu Éfeso kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijerage ewagai etaregoduwo tudogi.

b: Etaregodure dukeje Paulo makore ei. Akore iragoje raire tagabo dukodire taruduware irore jiboe ji.
source: Etaregodure dukeje Paulo makore ei. Akore iragoje raire tagabo dukodire taruduware irore jiboe ji.

b: Ikare boe remawudo imi Pao Kurirewu utugare pemegarewuwo imi. Imaragodure dukeje itragudure boe rakare i dukodi. Judeu doge ere tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo i rugadu. Mare Pagimijera Jesus utugarenure imi rugadu dukodire imaragodure aino ai.
source: Ikare boe remawudo imi Pao Kurirewu utugare pemegarewuwo imi. Imaragodure dukeje itragudure boe rakare i dukodi. Judeu doge ere tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo i rugadu. Mare Pagimijera Jesus utugarenure imi rugadu dukodire imaragodure aino ai.

b: Taruduware. Ire boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Ipogurukare imagowo rugadu. Ipagudukare imagowo ba kurirewu oiadada, boe ewai ja tada jamedu.
source: Taruduware. Ire boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Ipogurukare imagowo rugadu. Ipagudukare imagowo ba kurirewu oiadada, boe ewai ja tada jamedu.

b: Ire Judeu doge ewie ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji, tumearutoruwo Pagimijera Jesus ji. Ire boe tuginaiwuge ewie aino jamedu.
source: Ire Judeu doge ewie ewo tugera ra turo pegarewu piji tumearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu ji, tumearutoruwo Pagimijera Jesus ji. Ire boe tuginaiwuge ewie aino jamedu.

b: Ca imearutorure Pao Kurirewu Uwariji dukodi iturumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Ioruduwakare nuba boe eromode i toro.
source: Ca imearutorure Pao Kurirewu Uwariji dukodi iturumode Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka. Ioruduwakare nuba boe eromode i toro.

b: Mare ioruduware marigudu Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure iwie iwarigudumoduie baicorewuto, boe pegamoduie i rugadu.
source: Mare ioruduware marigudu Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure iwie iwarigudumoduie baicorewuto, boe pegamoduie i rugadu.

b: Mare itaidukare irowo ia imearudaere jiboe ji. Itaidukare boe pemegawo i. Itaidure tu imearutoruwo Pagimijera Jesus ji iwo ure maku inaiwu imaragodae iado. Imagowo boe ewiagai imaragodaenure ema kodi. Iwo boe ewie Jesus koiare Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo boe ekinorudo rugadu.
source: Mare itaidukare irowo ia imearudaere jiboe ji. Itaidukare boe pemegawo i. Itaidure tu imearutoruwo Pagimijera Jesus ji iwo ure maku inaiwu imaragodae iado. Imagowo boe ewiagai imaragodaenure ema kodi. Iwo boe ewie Jesus koiare Pao Kurirewu aidure tuwo boe ekinorudo rugadu.

b: Iragoje raire tagabo iwo tawie tawo tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Mare itaregodumodukare mato pugeje.
source: Iragoje raire tagabo iwo tawie tawo tagimijerado Pao Kurirewuce. Mare itaregodumodukare mato pugeje.

b: Dukodire inure tawie aino. Ia tagi tamearutorukare Jesus ji raga mare imi igoia karega. Tamearutorumodukare Jesus ji dukeje tamodukare taginorudo bope doge eda pegarewu piji. Ire tawie marigudu.
source: Dukodire inure tawie aino. Ia tagi tamearutorukare Jesus ji raga mare imi igoia karega. Tamearutorumodukare Jesus ji dukeje tamodukare taginorudo bope doge eda pegarewu piji. Ire tawie marigudu.

b: Ikare ia Pao Kurirewu bataru biado tabiji. Ire tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae jamedu boe ji.
source: Ikare ia Pao Kurirewu bataru biado tabiji. Ire tawie Pao Kurirewu mearudae jamedu boe ji.

b: Dukodire taro pemegado, tamearudae pemegado taetu pemegawo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure emagu tagai. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeragenure tagi dukodire taetu pemegado ei. Pao Kurirewu onaregedu Jesus ure tugu redo emorice dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu ei.
source: Dukodire taro pemegado, tamearudae pemegado taetu pemegawo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure emagu tagai. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeragenure tagi dukodire taetu pemegado ei. Pao Kurirewu onaregedu Jesus ure tugu redo emorice dukodire Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu ei.

b: Itumode tabiji dukeje ia boe pegarewuge etaregodumode turo pegawo mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Ero pegamode nono rie ro mogadure.
source: Itumode tabiji dukeje ia boe pegarewuge etaregodumode turo pegawo mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Ero pegamode nono rie ro mogadure.

b: Ia rakojere tagabowu ime ewadrarodumode awu taetu pemegare jiwu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei tuwo tugeragu ei emearutorukawo pugeje Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Ia rakojere tagabowu ime ewadrarodumode awu taetu pemegare jiwu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei tuwo tugeragu ei emearutorukawo pugeje Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Dukodire inagoino tai. Taetu pemegado ei. Tawiagodukaba iro piji. Itragudu tabo ire taruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji meri ji boeco ji. Jorure pobe metia bokware i irore aino tai dutabo.
source: Dukodire inagoino tai. Taetu pemegado ei. Tawiagodukaba iro piji. Itragudu tabo ire taruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji meri ji boeco ji. Jorure pobe metia bokware i irore aino tai dutabo.

b: Ca imagonure Pao Kurirewu ji tabaru tabo jetu pemegawo tai rugadu. Tawo boe ewie jamedu emare aidure tuwo boe ekinorudo. Emare umode turo pemegado tai jamedu tamearutoru rakawo pudui. Ainore rore rugadu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ji.
source: Ca imagonure Pao Kurirewu ji tabaru tabo jetu pemegawo tai rugadu. Tawo boe ewie jamedu emare aidure tuwo boe ekinorudo. Emare umode turo pemegado tai jamedu tamearutoru rakawo pudui. Ainore rore rugadu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe ji.

b: Imi itaidukare ia boe enoe prataji, itaidukare enoe tori kuiejeji, ekudau areiaji.
source: Imi itaidukare ia boe enoe prataji, itaidukare enoe tori kuiejeji, ekudau areiaji.

b: Taruduware irore jiboe ji. Ire boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare imaragodure ia boe etai jamedu ia diero bagai iwo ikeragu nowu itaidure jiboe ji nowu imedage etaidure jiboe ji jamedu.
source: Taruduware irore jiboe ji. Ire boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare imaragodure ia boe etai jamedu ia diero bagai iwo ikeragu nowu itaidure jiboe ji nowu imedage etaidure jiboe ji jamedu.

b: Irore aino iwo boe eruduwado tumaragodae tabore emode tugeragu ia dieroji tuwo maku marenarue doge etai. Pagimijera Jesus emare akoino, “Boe emode boe ekuna dukeje egaremode pudui ture ekunauge ekori. Boe pemegamode ei nowu ture ekunauge ekori.”
source: Irore aino iwo boe eruduwado tumaragodae tabore emode tugeragu ia dieroji tuwo maku marenarue doge etai. Pagimijera Jesus emare akoino, “Boe emode boe ekuna dukeje egaremode pudui ture ekunauge ekori. Boe pemegamode ei nowu ture ekunauge ekori.”

b: Ainore Paulo ure tumago akedudo. Dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeragebo. Emagore baru to aino.
source: Ainore Paulo ure tumago akedudo. Dukeje ure tubu jodo moto keje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeragebo. Emagore baru to aino.

b: Etragudure tugiarigodure dukodi. Ere tona bu pugajeje. Ekimadure Paulo apo.
source: Etragudure tugiarigodure dukodi. Ere tona bu pugajeje. Ekimadure Paulo apo.

b: Ekiarigodure rugadu Paulo makore ei tuiorudumokaie ei pugeje kodi. Dukeje eture apo ikarerewu ka utumode kodi.
source: Ekiarigodure rugadu Paulo makore ei tuiorudumokaie ei pugeje kodi. Dukeje eture apo ikarerewu ka utumode kodi.

b: Paulo Uture Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka
source: Paulo Uture Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Ka

b: Cegimadure ebo dukeje cedure. Ceno ikarerewu utu jetorore toro nowu Cós moto ka. Nou barogwato cedaregodure Rodes ba kurirewu ka. Dupijire cedure Pátara ba kurirewu ka.
source: Cegimadure ebo dukeje cedure. Ceno ikarerewu utu jetorore toro nowu Cós moto ka. Nou barogwato cedaregodure Rodes ba kurirewu ka. Dupijire cedure Pátara ba kurirewu ka.

b: Nou Pátara kejere cerudure ia ikarerewuji. Nou ikarerewu kurire tudu jaewo pobo maerewuji. Utuiago Fenícia moto ka. Dukodire cere cedaredo to. Dukeje cedure.
source: Nou Pátara kejere cerudure ia ikarerewuji. Nou ikarerewu kurire tudu jaewo pobo maerewuji. Utuiago Fenícia moto ka. Dukodire cere cedaredo to. Dukeje cedure.

b: Cerudure Chipre moto ji dukeje cere cemegido toro Síria moto ka. Cedaregodure Tiro ba kurirewu ka dukeje cere cedawuje ikarerewu piji. Nou ikarerewu ure tuwuredo tuwo nowu ikarerewu tadaboe tawuje nono.
source: Cerudure Chipre moto ji dukeje cere cemegido toro Síria moto ka. Cedaregodure Tiro ba kurirewu ka dukeje cere cedawuje ikarerewu piji. Nou ikarerewu ure tuwuredo tuwo nowu ikarerewu tadaboe tawuje nono.

b: Tiro keje cerudure mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Ceragojere ebo kejewu meri oto padure sete. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure ewie boe pegamoduie Pauloji Jerusalém keje dukodire emagore ji utukawo toro.
source: Tiro keje cerudure mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ji. Ceragojere ebo kejewu meri oto padure sete. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure ewie boe pegamoduie Pauloji Jerusalém keje dukodire emagore ji utukawo toro.

b: Mare ceragojere ebo kejewu meri akedure dukeje cedure pugeje. Eiamedu boe tuwobebo, torebo eture cedabo toro pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nonore cere cebu jodo moto keje cemagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to.
source: Mare ceragojere ebo kejewu meri akedure dukeje cedure pugeje. Eiamedu boe tuwobebo, torebo eture cedabo toro pobo maerewu okwa ka. Nonore cere cebu jodo moto keje cemagowo Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to.

b: Dukejere cegimadure ebo. Cere cedaredo nowu ikarerewuto pugeje. Mare eture tuibagi tuwai ka.
source: Dukejere cegimadure ebo. Cere cedaredo nowu ikarerewuto pugeje. Mare eture tuibagi tuwai ka.

b: Ca cedure pugeje. Cedure Tiro piji Ptolemaida ba kurirewu ka. Cegimadure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge cemedagebo nono. Ceragojere ebo kejewu merire mitotu je.
source: Ca cedure pugeje. Cedure Tiro piji Ptolemaida ba kurirewu ka. Cegimadure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge cemedagebo nono. Ceragojere ebo kejewu merire mitotu je.

b: Nou barogwato cedure pugeje. Cedaregodure Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Nonore ceragojere Filipe apo. Nou Filipe ure boe emearutorudo Jesus ji rugadu. Marigudu Jerusalém kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere tugeragu imei ewo boe eke pedo boe ji. Enodo padure sete. Iare nowu Filipe rema.
source: Nou barogwato cedure pugeje. Cedaregodure Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Nonore ceragojere Filipe apo. Nou Filipe ure boe emearutorudo Jesus ji rugadu. Marigudu Jerusalém kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere tugeragu imei ewo boe eke pedo boe ji. Enodo padure sete. Iare nowu Filipe rema.

b: Ore areme ere pobe puibiji. Emagere ere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Ore areme ere pobe puibiji. Emagere ere boe ewie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Ceragojere nono dukeje ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu aregodure. Iere Ágabo. Aregodure Judéia moto piji.
source: Ceragojere nono dukeje ia makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu imedu aregodure. Iere Ágabo. Aregodure Judéia moto piji.

b: Aregodure cedae dukeje ure tugeragu Paulo opeagajejewuji. Ure tuwure kogudo, tugera kogudo tabo. Dukeje akore Pao Kurirewu Uwari akore Judeu doge pegarewuge ero pegamoduie nowu ore opeagajejewu cewuji, emoduie kogudo Jerusalém tada. Emoduie maku boe tuginaiwuge etai ero pegawo ji.
source: Aregodure cedae dukeje ure tugeragu Paulo opeagajejewuji. Ure tuwure kogudo, tugera kogudo tabo. Dukeje akore Pao Kurirewu Uwari akore Judeu doge pegarewuge ero pegamoduie nowu ore opeagajejewu cewuji, emoduie kogudo Jerusalém tada. Emoduie maku boe tuginaiwuge etai ero pegawo ji.

b: Cemearudure nowu inoduji dukeje cemago raire Pauloji utukawo Jerusalém ka.
source: Cemearudure nowu inoduji dukeje cemago raire Pauloji utukawo Jerusalém ka.

b: Mare Paulo akore Kodiba tagagoino i? Tare ikiarigo. Ire irugadu nowu Judeu doge ewo ikogudo. Ire irugadu iwiwo imearutorure Pagimijera Jesus ji kodi.
source: Mare Paulo akore Kodiba tagagoino i? Tare ikiarigo. Ire irugadu nowu Judeu doge ewo ikogudo. Ire irugadu iwiwo imearutorure Pagimijera Jesus ji kodi.

b: Cegare Paulo mearudae mekido dukodire cere cenogwa ra piji. Cenagore: – Pagimijera Jesus aidumode dukeje ainore umode rugadu.
source: Cegare Paulo mearudae mekido dukodire cere cenogwa ra piji. Cenagore: – Pagimijera Jesus aidumode dukeje ainore umode rugadu.

b: Ceragoje raire nono dukeje cere cenoroe pemegado ceduwo pugeje toro Jerusalém ka.
source: Ceragoje raire nono dukeje cere cenoroe pemegado ceduwo pugeje toro Jerusalém ka.

b: Ia Cesaréia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture cedabo jamedu. Ere cerego cebadumode kejewu bai ka. Nou uwaire bai cewu iere Menasom. Chipre kejewunure ema. Mearutorure Jesus ji marigudu.
source: Ia Cesaréia kejewu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eture cedabo jamedu. Ere cerego cebadumode kejewu bai ka. Nou uwaire bai cewu iere Menasom. Chipre kejewunure ema. Mearutorure Jesus ji marigudu.

b: Paulo Uture Tiago Ae
source: Paulo Uture Tiago Ae

b: Cedaregodure Jerusalém ka dukeje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge cemedage ekimadure cedabo rugadu.
source: Cedaregodure Jerusalém ka dukeje nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge cemedage ekimadure cedabo rugadu.

b: Nou barogwato Paulo uture cedabo Tiago ae. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijerage eiamedu boe eragojere nono jamedu.
source: Nou barogwato Paulo uture cedabo Tiago ae. Nou mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijerage eiamedu boe eragojere nono jamedu.

b: Paulo ukimadure ebo dukeje readodure ewiagai tumaragodaeji, nuba Pao Kurirewu rore toro boe tuginaiwuge ji.
source: Paulo ukimadure ebo dukeje readodure ewiagai tumaragodaeji, nuba Pao Kurirewu rore toro boe tuginaiwuge ji.

b: Emearudure ji dukeje emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukeje emagore Pauloji. egore cemananure aki. Mearutorure Jesus jiwu Judeu doge emagare rugadu. Aruduware. Emearutorure rugadu Moisés ure maku pagaiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.
source: Emearudure ji dukeje emago pemegare Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukeje emagore Pauloji. egore cemananure aki. Mearutorure Jesus jiwu Judeu doge emagare rugadu. Aruduware. Emearutorure rugadu Moisés ure maku pagaiwu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji.

b: Boe ere cewie akagoie Judeu doge emearutorumoduie Jesus ji dukeje ewo tugera ra nowu Moisés ure maku pagaiwu bakaru piji paro piji. Akagore ei ekawo tore ime ewaga oto biri kado pugeje. Akagore ei ewo tugera ra Judeu doge ero piji.
source: Boe ere cewie akagoie Judeu doge emearutorumoduie Jesus ji dukeje ewo tugera ra nowu Moisés ure maku pagaiwu bakaru piji paro piji. Akagore ei ekawo tore ime ewaga oto biri kado pugeje. Akagore ei ewo tugera ra Judeu doge ero piji.

b: Judeu doge eruduwamode akaregodure duji dukeje etaidumode turo pegawo ai. Nuba aromode?
source: Judeu doge eruduwamode akaregodure duji dukeje etaidumode turo pegawo ai. Nuba aromode?

b: Cedaidure atuwo ia imebo. Ere pobe puibiji. Marigudu emagore Pao Kurirewu ji turomode jiboe ji. Dukodire ekare tao kado.
source: Cedaidure atuwo ia imebo. Ere pobe puibiji. Marigudu emagore Pao Kurirewu ji turomode jiboe ji. Dukodire ekare tao kado.

b: Ca atudo ebo awo ero morido, arowo erore jiboe ji jamedu. Emode tao kado kuri je nono paroia mogadure. Nono tamode tarugadu tawo taremo Pao Kurirewu uwaito nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Dukodire care Judeu doge eruduwamode akare akera ra nowu Moisés ure maku pagaiwu paro piji rugadu duji. Eruduwamode tumearudure jiwu bataru ukare turugadu. Boe ewadrarodure ai boe ewiagai.
source: Ca atudo ebo awo ero morido, arowo erore jiboe ji jamedu. Emode tao kado kuri je nono paroia mogadure. Nono tamode tarugadu tawo taremo Pao Kurirewu uwaito nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Dukodire care Judeu doge eruduwamode akare akera ra nowu Moisés ure maku pagaiwu paro piji rugadu duji. Eruduwamode tumearudure jiwu bataru ukare turugadu. Boe ewadrarodure ai boe ewiagai.

b: Mare boe tuginaiwuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etaire cere ia atugoreboe maku etai marigudu. Cenagore ei ekawo ia makudure santo doge etaiwu bope doge eke kowuje, ekawo barogo ku kowuje, ekawo ia bitodurewu bukigu kogure itoru kajejewu barogo ko, eribarikawo tumugukare apowu aremei, eribarikawo tumugukare apowu imei.
source: Mare boe tuginaiwuge mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etaire cere ia atugoreboe maku etai marigudu. Cenagore ei ekawo ia makudure santo doge etaiwu bope doge eke kowuje, ekawo barogo ku kowuje, ekawo ia bitodurewu bukigu kogure itoru kajejewu barogo ko, eribarikawo tumugukare apowu aremei, eribarikawo tumugukare apowu imei.

b: Dukodire Paulo uture nowu imebo. Rore nono erore tuwo tubemegado turowo Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu turo boe ji. Dukeje ure turemo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Ure boe ewie nowu turoino jiboe akedumoduie kejewu meri ji. Akedumoduie dukeje tumoduie ia barogo kowu Pao Kurirewu ai turo pegarewu morice, nowu ime ero pegarewu morice jamedu.
source: Dukodire Paulo uture nowu imebo. Rore nono erore tuwo tubemegado turowo Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu turo boe ji. Dukeje ure turemo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Ure boe ewie nowu turoino jiboe akedumoduie kejewu meri ji. Akedumoduie dukeje tumoduie ia barogo kowu Pao Kurirewu ai turo pegarewu morice, nowu ime ero pegarewu morice jamedu.

b: Ere Paulo Kogudo Pao Kurirewu Uwai Tada
source: Ere Paulo Kogudo Pao Kurirewu Uwai Tada

b: Nou Paulo makore jiwu meri puredugodure pudui dukeje ia Ásia moto pijiwu Judeu doge erudure Pauloji Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada. Ere boe ekorigo tuwadrarodu tabo dukodire ere tugeragu Pauloji.
source: Nou Paulo makore jiwu meri puredugodure pudui dukeje ia Ásia moto pijiwu Judeu doge erudure Pauloji Pao Kurirewu uwai ja tada. Ere boe ekorigo tuwadrarodu tabo dukodire ere tugeragu Pauloji.

b: Ekudugodure: – Judeu dogenure pagi. Tagera maku cenai. Awu imedu ure boe eiamedu boe emearudae pegado pai. Ure boe emearudae pegado Moisés ure maku pagaiwu pago bakaruji parore jiboe ji jamedu. Ure boe emearudae pegado awu Pao Kurirewu uwaiji. Aino ure ia boe tuginaiwuge eremo awu Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Ukare turugadu. Ere awu bai pemegarewu pegado rugadu.
source: Ekudugodure: – Judeu dogenure pagi. Tagera maku cenai. Awu imedu ure boe eiamedu boe emearudae pegado pai. Ure boe emearudae pegado Moisés ure maku pagaiwu pago bakaruji parore jiboe ji jamedu. Ure boe emearudae pegado awu Pao Kurirewu uwaiji. Aino ure ia boe tuginaiwuge eremo awu Pao Kurirewu uwaito. Ukare turugadu. Ere awu bai pemegarewu pegado rugadu.

b: Erudure ia Éfeso kejewu imeduji Paulo apo nowu ba kurirewu keje. Dukodire emearudaere Paulo uie nowu imedu remo Pao Kurirewu uwai to duji. Nou imedu iere Trófimo. Mare pagare egoino. Paulo ukare nowu imedu remo Pao Kurirewu uwaito rugadu.
source: Erudure ia Éfeso kejewu imeduji Paulo apo nowu ba kurirewu keje. Dukodire emearudaere Paulo uie nowu imedu remo Pao Kurirewu uwai to duji. Nou imedu iere Trófimo. Mare pagare egoino. Paulo ukare nowu imedu remo Pao Kurirewu uwaito rugadu.

b: Ca nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge eruduwakare tumearudae bagai pugeje. Boe eregodure tuwo bato pui. Ere tugeragu Pauloji rugadu. Ere tumugudo kororo keje nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai piji. Nono ere Pao Kurirewu uwai poro miwuje.
source: Ca nowu ba kurirewu kejewuge eruduwakare tumearudae bagai pugeje. Boe eregodure tuwo bato pui. Ere tugeragu Pauloji rugadu. Ere tumugudo kororo keje nowu Pao Kurirewu uwai piji. Nono ere Pao Kurirewu uwai poro miwuje.

b: Nou boe etaidure tuwo Paulo bito. Mare nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewu Romano doge etugobaigarege eimijera mearudure nowu emearudae ji.
source: Nou boe etaidure tuwo Paulo bito. Mare nowu Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewu Romano doge etugobaigarege eimijera mearudure nowu emearudae ji.

b: Dukodire rekodure tugobaigaregebo toro etae. Nou boe erudure nowu tugobaigaregei dukeje ere tugera ra ture boeto Paulo jitu piji.
source: Dukodire rekodure tugobaigaregebo toro etae. Nou boe erudure nowu tugobaigaregei dukeje ere tugera ra ture boeto Paulo jitu piji.

b: Nou tugobaigarege eimijera uture Paulo ae. Ure tugeragu ji. Makore tugobaigaregei ewo Paulo kogudo corrente tabo. Dukeje unarare nowu boe ji. Akore iogudubanure ema? Nuba rore?
source: Nou tugobaigarege eimijera uture Paulo ae. Ure tugeragu ji. Makore tugobaigaregei ewo Paulo kogudo corrente tabo. Dukeje unarare nowu boe ji. Akore iogudubanure ema? Nuba rore?

b: Nou boe emagore bataru jipagi tugudu tabo, tugorigodu tabo. Mare emagore jiboe ure tuginai pubiji. Iage emagore iaboe ji. Mare iage emagore ia bataru ji pugeje. Dukodire nowu tugobaigarege eimijera joruduwakare nuba tumearudaemode nowu boe erore aino Paulo jituji. Dukodire makore tugobaigaregei etuwo Paulo apo toro tubadure tadawu bai rakarewu ka.
source: Nou boe emagore bataru jipagi tugudu tabo, tugorigodu tabo. Mare emagore jiboe ure tuginai pubiji. Iage emagore iaboe ji. Mare iage emagore ia bataru ji pugeje. Dukodire nowu tugobaigarege eimijera joruduwakare nuba tumearudaemode nowu boe erore aino Paulo jituji. Dukodire makore tugobaigaregei etuwo Paulo apo toro tubadure tadawu bai rakarewu ka.

b: Eture toro apo. Etaregoduiago toro dukeje nowu boe ekorigodure rugadu. Eiore jetu woje toro. Ekudugodure. egore nou Paulo bito! Nou korigodurewuge ere taiado paci Paulo apo. Dukodire nowu tugobaigarege enoredure Paulo apo tuwo turemo tuwaito nowu korigodurewuge epiji.
source: Eture toro apo. Etaregoduiago toro dukeje nowu boe ekorigodure rugadu. Eiore jetu woje toro. Ekudugodure. egore nou Paulo bito! Nou korigodurewuge ere taiado paci Paulo apo. Dukodire nowu tugobaigarege enoredure Paulo apo tuwo turemo tuwaito nowu korigodurewuge epiji.

b: Paulo Makore Turoji Boe Ewiagai
source: Paulo Makore Turoji Boe Ewiagai

b: Nou tugobaigarege eiago turemo tuwai rakarewuto Paulo apo dukeje Paulo makore nowu eimijeraji. Akore itaidure imagowo ai. Makore Grego bataru tabo dukodire nowu tugobaigarege eimijera makore bataru jipagi. Akore amagore i Grego bataru tabo. Dukodire jowu Egito kejewu imedu karegure aki. Emare aidure tuwo pagagedudo. Uture boe maerewu ka imebo. Enodo padu kejewure quatro mil. Ewaigare jamedu.
source: Nou tugobaigarege eiago turemo tuwai rakarewuto Paulo apo dukeje Paulo makore nowu eimijeraji. Akore itaidure imagowo ai. Makore Grego bataru tabo dukodire nowu tugobaigarege eimijera makore bataru jipagi. Akore amagore i Grego bataru tabo. Dukodire jowu Egito kejewu imedu karegure aki. Emare aidure tuwo pagagedudo. Uture boe maerewu ka imebo. Enodo padu kejewure quatro mil. Ewaigare jamedu.

b: Paulo akore Boro. Judeunure imi. Iwodure Tarso ba kurirewu tada Cilícia moto keje. Nou ba kurirewu kurire nowu moto keje. Ca itaidure imagowo awu boe ji.
source: Paulo akore Boro. Judeunure imi. Iwodure Tarso ba kurirewu tada Cilícia moto keje. Nou ba kurirewu kurire nowu moto keje. Ca itaidure imagowo awu boe ji.

b: Nou tugobaigarege eimijera akore Ure turugadu. Dukodire Paulo ure turagojedo nowu bai rakarewu baiporo keje. Ure tugera nado boe edukiorowo. Edukiorore dukeje Paulo makore ei Judeu doge ewadaru tabo.
source: Nou tugobaigarege eimijera akore Ure turugadu. Dukodire Paulo ure turagojedo nowu bai rakarewu baiporo keje. Ure tugera nado boe edukiorowo. Edukiorore dukeje Paulo makore ei Judeu doge ewadaru tabo.

b: Paulo makore nowu Judeu dogei. Akore iwobenure tagi. Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji iwo taruduwado irore jiboe ji.
source: Paulo makore nowu Judeu dogei. Akore iwobenure tagi. Tawiapaga pemegado iwadaru ji iwo taruduwado irore jiboe ji.

b: Emearudure ji makore ewadaru tabo duji dukodire edukiorore rugadu.
source: Emearudure ji makore ewadaru tabo duji dukodire edukiorore rugadu.

b: Nono Paulo makore pugeje. Akore Judeunure imi. Iwodure Tarso ba kurirewu tada Cilícia moto keje. Mare irijodure woe Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada. Joruduwarewu Gamaliel ure ioruduwado. Ure ioruduwado nowu mariguduwu pawobe eno bakaruji. Itaidure irowo Pao Kurirewu roji nono tagaidu mogadure.
source: Nono Paulo makore pugeje. Akore Judeunure imi. Iwodure Tarso ba kurirewu tada Cilícia moto keje. Mare irijodure woe Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada. Joruduwarewu Gamaliel ure ioruduwado. Ure ioruduwado nowu mariguduwu pawobe eno bakaruji. Itaidure irowo Pao Kurirewu roji nono tagaidu mogadure.

b: Imearudaere Jesus ji Pao Kurirewu karegure ema duji nono tamearudae mogadure. Dukodire iro pegare awu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei iwo ewido. Ire ikeragu imei, aremei iwo etugu baicorewuto.
source: Imearudaere Jesus ji Pao Kurirewu karegure ema duji nono tamearudae mogadure. Dukodire iro pegare awu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei iwo ewido. Ire ikeragu imei, aremei iwo etugu baicorewuto.

b: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu joruduware nowu irore jiboe ji. Nouia pagimijerage eruduware jamedu. Ere bapera maku inai iwo maku Damasco ba kurirewu kejewu Judeu doge etai iwo ikeragu nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei toro jamedu. Itaidure iwo ekogudo corrente tabo iwo erego mato Jerusalém ka ibagi iro pegawo ei. Dukodire iture toro.
source: Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewu joruduware nowu irore jiboe ji. Nouia pagimijerage eruduware jamedu. Ere bapera maku inai iwo maku Damasco ba kurirewu kejewu Judeu doge etai iwo ikeragu nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwugei toro jamedu. Itaidure iwo ekogudo corrente tabo iwo erego mato Jerusalém ka ibagi iro pegawo ei. Dukodire iture toro.

b: Paulo Readodure Ewiagai Tumearutorure Jesus ji Rugadu
source: Paulo Readodure Ewiagai Tumearutorure Jesus ji Rugadu

b: – Ca ikodure nowu Damasco kawu awara ji. Ipuredugodure Damasco ba kurirewuji. Meri aregodure baru oia ka dukeje ia jorugu rakarewu aregodure itae baru piji.
source: – Ca ikodure nowu Damasco kawu awara ji. Ipuredugodure Damasco ba kurirewuji. Meri aregodure baru oia ka dukeje ia jorugu rakarewu aregodure itae baru piji.

b: Ure iwududo moto ka dukeje imearudure mako ji. Akore, “Saulo, Saulo! Kodiba akaidure aro pegawo aino i?”
source: Ure iwududo moto ka dukeje imearudure mako ji. Akore, “Saulo, Saulo! Kodiba akaidure aro pegawo aino i?”

b: Inagore, “Ioguduba ure aki?” Akore, “Nazaré pijiwu Jesusnure imi. Aro peganure i rugadu.”
source: Inagore, “Ioguduba ure aki?” Akore, “Nazaré pijiwu Jesusnure imi. Aro peganure i rugadu.”

b: Nou uture itabowu ime erudure nowu joruguji mare emearudukare nowu makore jiboe ji.
source: Nou uture itabowu ime erudure nowu joruguji mare emearudukare nowu makore jiboe ji.

b: Nono inarare ji pugeje. Inagore, “Ikimijeranure aki. Nuba iromode?” Dukeje Pagimijera Jesus akore, “Aragojedo. Atudo Damasco ba kurirewu ka. Torore boe emode awie Pao Kurirewu aidure jiwu aromode jiboe ji.”
source: Nono inarare ji pugeje. Inagore, “Ikimijeranure aki. Nuba iromode?” Dukeje Pagimijera Jesus akore, “Aragojedo. Atudo Damasco ba kurirewu ka. Torore boe emode awie Pao Kurirewu aidure jiwu aromode jiboe ji.”

b: Ioku bokware nowu jorugu rakarewu koia. Dukodire nowu imedage ere tugeragu ikeraji tuwo irego Damasco ba kurirewu ka rugadu.
source: Ioku bokware nowu jorugu rakarewu koia. Dukodire nowu imedage ere tugeragu ikeraji tuwo irego Damasco ba kurirewu ka rugadu.

b: – Nou ba kurirewu Damasco tadare ia mearutorure pago bakaru jiwu imedu mugure. Iere Ananias. Nou Damasco kejewu Judeu doge eiamedu boe etaidu pemegare ji.
source: – Nou ba kurirewu Damasco tadare ia mearutorure pago bakaru jiwu imedu mugure. Iere Ananias. Nou Damasco kejewu Judeu doge eiamedu boe etaidu pemegare ji.

b: Nou Ananias aregodure itae. Makore i. Akore, “Imana Saulo. Akaiwodo pugeje.” Ca ioku pemegagodure taci je. Dukeje itaiwore pugeje.

b: Paulo Makore Judeu Doge Eimijeragei

b: Nou boe eimijera kurirewu Félix aiwore nowu atugoreboe ji dukeje unarare Pauloji. Akore kaibowu moto keje ba awodure? Paulo akore tuwoduie Cilícia moto keje.
source: Nou boe eimijera kurirewu Félix aiwore nowu atugoreboe ji dukeje unarare Pauloji. Akore kaibowu moto keje ba awodure? Paulo akore tuwoduie Cilícia moto keje.

b: Dukejere nowu Félix akore Nou jorudu pegare aro jiwuge etaregodumode dukeje iwiapagamode ewadaru ji, awadaru ji jamedu. Nono makore tugobaigaregei etaiwowo Pauloji, utukawo nowu tumaragodure tadawu bai kurirewu piji.
source: Dukejere nowu Félix akore Nou jorudu pegare aro jiwuge etaregodumode dukeje iwiapagamode ewadaru ji, awadaru ji jamedu. Nono makore tugobaigaregei etaiwowo Pauloji, utukawo nowu tumaragodure tadawu bai kurirewu piji.

b: Judeu Doge Eimijerage Emago Pegare Paulo Roji
source: Judeu Doge Eimijerage Emago Pegare Paulo Roji

b: Merire ikera aboudure dukeje Judeu doge eimijerage eture Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Ia eimijera iere Ananias. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewunure ema. Ia iere Tértulo. Emare joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaruji. Etaregodure nowu boe eimijera kurirewu Félix ae. Dukeje emagore nowu boe eimijeraji. Egore Paulo ro pegaie.
source: Merire ikera aboudure dukeje Judeu doge eimijerage eture Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Ia eimijera iere Ananias. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijera kurirewunure ema. Ia iere Tértulo. Emare joruduware Judeu doge eno bakaruji. Etaregodure nowu boe eimijera kurirewu Félix ae. Dukeje emagore nowu boe eimijeraji. Egore Paulo ro pegaie.

b: Nou boe eimijera Félix makore Paulo bagai. Paulo ure turemo dukeje nowu Tértulo makore nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ji rugadu. Akore cegimijeranure aki. Aruduwa kurire dukodire aro pemegare cei. Aki aigoiare akare boe pegarewuge erugo cei marigudu. Aki aigoiare are ceno moto pemegado.
source: Nou boe eimijera Félix makore Paulo bagai. Paulo ure turemo dukeje nowu Tértulo makore nowu boe eimijera kurirewu ji rugadu. Akore cegimijeranure aki. Aruduwa kurire dukodire aro pemegare cei. Aki aigoiare akare boe pegarewuge erugo cei marigudu. Aki aigoiare are ceno moto pemegado.

b: Cedaidure arore jiboe ji dukodire cemago pemegare aino ai.
source: Cedaidure arore jiboe ji dukodire cemago pemegare aino ai.

b: Itaidukare iwo akiarigo ma care awiapagado cewadaru ji tu jao.
source: Itaidukare iwo akiarigo ma care awiapagado cewadaru ji tu jao.

b: Cedaidukare awu imedu rore jiboe ji. Ro pegare rugadu. Ure Judeu doge ekiripagado. Ure boe erugo pui moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Meardae pegarewuge eimijeranure ema. Nou boe ekiere nazareno doge.
source: Cedaidukare awu imedu rore jiboe ji. Ro pegare rugadu. Ure Judeu doge ekiripagado. Ure boe erugo pui moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Meardae pegarewuge eimijeranure ema. Nou boe ekiere nazareno doge.

b: Aidure turo pegawo awu Pao Kurirewu uwaiji dukodire cere cegeragu ji cewo tugu baicorewuto.
source: Aidure turo pegawo awu Pao Kurirewu uwaiji dukodire cere cegeragu ji cewo tugu baicorewuto.

b: Anara pemegamode ji dukeje aruduwamode boe jokodu jire cenagoino duji.
source: Anara pemegamode ji dukeje aruduwamode boe jokodu jire cenagoino duji.

b: Nouia Judeu doge emagore aino pugeje nowu boe eimijera kurirewuji. Mare pagare egoino biagai. Ewadrarodunure.
source: Nouia Judeu doge emagore aino pugeje nowu boe eimijera kurirewuji. Mare pagare egoino biagai. Ewadrarodunure.

b: Paulo Makore Nou Judeu Doge Ewadaru Jipagi Nou Félix Biagai
source: Paulo Makore Nou Judeu Doge Ewadaru Jipagi Nou Félix Biagai

b: Nono nowu boe eimijera Félix ure tugera nado Paulo ae, Paulo makowo jamedu. Dukodire Paulo makore. Akore marigudu awu woewu boe eimijera kurirewu ure aki rugadu. Aruduware akaiwowo boe ji ero pegarewu bagai. Dukodire imearutorure ai imagowo awu boe eimijerage ewadaru jipagi awiagai.
source: Nono nowu boe eimijera Félix ure tugera nado Paulo ae, Paulo makowo jamedu. Dukodire Paulo makore. Akore marigudu awu woewu boe eimijera kurirewu ure aki rugadu. Aruduware akaiwowo boe ji ero pegarewu bagai. Dukodire imearutorure ai imagowo awu boe eimijerage ewadaru jipagi awiagai.

b: Iture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka iwo ipu jodo imago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji merire doze iroino dukeje. Anaramode boe ji dukeje emode awie nowu inagoino duji.
source: Iture Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka iwo ipu jodo imago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji merire doze iroino dukeje. Anaramode boe ji dukeje emode awie nowu inagoino duji.

b: Mare imago pegakare boe ji nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ikare boe ekiripagado nono. Awu Judeu doge eruduware nowu inoduji. Iro pegakare boe ji nowu ba kurirewu tada, nowu boe ere bato puiwu bai tada jamedu.
source: Mare imago pegakare boe ji nono Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Ikare boe ekiripagado nono. Awu Judeu doge eruduware nowu inoduji. Iro pegakare boe ji nowu ba kurirewu tada, nowu boe ere bato puiwu bai tada jamedu.

b: Akaiwo pemegamode ewadaru ji dukeje aruduwamode ewadrarodunure duji. Emago pegare i mare ewadrarodunure.
source: Akaiwo pemegamode ewadaru ji dukeje aruduwamode ewadrarodunure duji. Emago pegare i mare ewadrarodunure.

b: Mare imagomode aino ai. Ire ipu jodo imago pemegawo jawu cewobe emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ji. Irore nono nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ero mogadure jamedu. Mare awu emearutorukare Jesus jiwuge. Egore pagaie cenagoino. Mare cemearutorure Moisés ure bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Cemearutorure mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei, ere bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu.
source: Mare imagomode aino ai. Ire ipu jodo imago pemegawo jawu cewobe emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ji. Irore nono nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ero mogadure jamedu. Mare awu emearutorukare Jesus jiwuge. Egore pagaie cenagoino. Mare cemearutorure Moisés ure bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Cemearutorure mariguduwuge makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwugei, ere bu bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu.

b: Imearutorure awuge emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ji. Awu Pao Kurirewu koiare umode ro pemegarewuge, ro pegarewuge eiamedu boe eewodudo pugeje.
source: Imearutorure awuge emearutorure jiwu Pao Kurirewu ji. Awu Pao Kurirewu koiare umode ro pemegarewuge, ro pegarewuge eiamedu boe eewodudo pugeje.

b: Dukodire ire idurudo iro pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji, iro pemegawo boe ji jamedu, ia boe pegarewu metukawo itaora tada.
source: Dukodire ire idurudo iro pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji, iro pemegawo boe ji jamedu, ia boe pegarewu metukawo itaora tada.

b: Ca iragoje raire toro ia moto keje. Dukejere itaregodure mato pugeje Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka ia diero tabo iwo maku iwobe etai. Itaidure iwo iro pegarewu mori maku Pao Kurirewu ai uwai tada jamedu nono Judeu doge ero mogadure.
source: Ca iragoje raire toro ia moto keje. Dukejere itaregodure mato pugeje Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka ia diero tabo iwo maku iwobe etai. Itaidure iwo iro pegarewu mori maku Pao Kurirewu ai uwai tada jamedu nono Judeu doge ero mogadure.

b: Dukodire awu Judeu doge erudure i Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Mare inure itaimo nono ero mogadure ipemegawo irowo Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji iwo iremo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwaito nono ero mogadure jamedu. Boe edure nono mare erudu pegakare nowu irore jiboe ji dukodire ekare bato pui itae. Emago pegarewu kare pui.
source: Dukodire awu Judeu doge erudure i Pao Kurirewu uwai tada. Mare inure itaimo nono ero mogadure ipemegawo irowo Judeu doge eno bakaru tadawu boe ero boe ji iwo iremo nowu Pao Kurirewu uwaito nono ero mogadure jamedu. Boe edure nono mare erudu pegakare nowu irore jiboe ji dukodire ekare bato pui itae. Emago pegarewu kare pui.

b: Ia Ásia pijiwuge Judeu doge edure nono jamedu. Erudu pegamode ia irore jiboe ji dukeje etaregodumode woe tumago pegawo i. Mare erudu pegakare irore jiboe ji dukodire etaregodukare aino mato.
source: Ia Ásia pijiwuge Judeu doge edure nono jamedu. Erudu pegamode ia irore jiboe ji dukeje etaregodumode woe tumago pegawo i. Mare erudu pegakare irore jiboe ji dukodire etaregodukare aino mato.

b: Awu woewu Judeu doge erudukare ia iro pegarewu ji jamedu. Iragojere Judeu doge eimijeragebo dukeje emagokare i ia iro pegarewuji.
source: Awu woewu Judeu doge erudukare ia iro pegarewu ji jamedu. Iragojere Judeu doge eimijeragebo dukeje emagokare i ia iro pegarewuji.

b: Mare imagore aino, “Imearutorure birewuge eewodumode pugeje duji dukodire tagaiwonure ia iro pegarewu bagai.” Ainore inagore. Dukodi ca awuge ekorigodure aino i.
source: Mare imagore aino, “Imearutorure birewuge eewodumode pugeje duji dukodire tagaiwonure ia iro pegarewu bagai.” Ainore inagore. Dukodi ca awuge ekorigodure aino i.

b: Nono Félix ure emago akedudo. Joruduware mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudae ji erore jiboe ji. Akore tugobaigarege eimijera Lísias aregodumode dukeje imode imearudae tawuje ioruduwawo nuba iromode ai.
source: Nono Félix ure emago akedudo. Joruduware mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearudae ji erore jiboe ji. Akore tugobaigarege eimijera Lísias aregodumode dukeje imode imearudae tawuje ioruduwawo nuba iromode ai.

b: Makore tugobaigareji aiwo pemegawo Pauloji baicorewu tada mare ro pegakawo ji, tumagomoduie Paulo metage ewagai etaregoduwo mato ewo tugera maku ai.
source: Makore tugobaigareji aiwo pemegawo Pauloji baicorewu tada mare ro pegakawo ji, tumagomoduie Paulo metage ewagai etaregoduwo mato ewo tugera maku ai.

b: Félix Biapagare Paulo Bataruji Toreduje Drusila Apo
source: Félix Biapagare Paulo Bataruji Toreduje Drusila Apo

b: Ia meri keje Félix aregodure Paulo ae toreduje apo. Iere Drusila. Judeurodonure ema. Makore Paulo bagai dukeje ewiapagare Paulo bataru ji. Dukodire Paulo ure eruduwado boe emearutorure Jesus jitu duji.
source: Ia meri keje Félix aregodure Paulo ae toreduje apo. Iere Drusila. Judeurodonure ema. Makore Paulo bagai dukeje ewiapagare Paulo bataru ji. Dukodire Paulo ure eruduwado boe emearutorure Jesus jitu duji.

b: Paulo makore ei boe ewo turagado pudui turo pegakawo. Makore ei boe ewo turo jetorodo. Makore ei Pao Kurirewu aiwomoduie boe ji rugadu ia meri keje. Dukeje Félix pagudugodure. Akore atudo ipiji baicorewuto. Imode irugadu pugeje dukeje imagomode awagai pugeje.
source: Paulo makore ei boe ewo turagado pudui turo pegakawo. Makore ei boe ewo turo jetorodo. Makore ei Pao Kurirewu aiwomoduie boe ji rugadu ia meri keje. Dukeje Félix pagudugodure. Akore atudo ipiji baicorewuto. Imode irugadu pugeje dukeje imagomode awagai pugeje.

b: Mare aidure Paulo uwo ia diero maku pudai dukodire mako makore Paulo bagai tumagowo pui.
source: Mare aidure Paulo uwo ia diero maku pudai dukodire mako makore Paulo bagai tumagowo pui.

b: Jorure pobe dukeje Félix ure tudawuje boe eimijera governador pudumi dupiji. Pórcio Festo mugure mugato. Mare Félix aidukare tuwo Judeu doge ekorigo dukodire ukare Paulo tawuje baicorewu piji.
source: Jorure pobe dukeje Félix ure tudawuje boe eimijera governador pudumi dupiji. Pórcio Festo mugure mugato. Mare Félix aidukare tuwo Judeu doge ekorigo dukodire ukare Paulo tawuje baicorewu piji.

b: Paulo Aidure Tuduwo Romano Doge Eimijera Kurirewu Ae
source: Paulo Aidure Tuduwo Romano Doge Eimijera Kurirewu Ae

b: Boe eimijera kurirewu Festo aregodure nowu moto ka tumuguwo Félix mugato. Merire pobe metia bokware dukeje uture Cesaréia ba kurirewu piji toro Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka.
source: Boe eimijera kurirewu Festo aregodure nowu moto ka tumuguwo Félix mugato. Merire pobe metia bokware dukeje uture Cesaréia ba kurirewu piji toro Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka.

b: Judeu doge eimijerage emago pegare Pauloji nowu Festo biagai. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emago pegare Pauloji Festo biagai jamedu.
source: Judeu doge eimijerage emago pegare Pauloji nowu Festo biagai. Nou ure Judeu doge enomea maku Pao Kurirewu aiwuge eimijerage emago pegare Pauloji Festo biagai jamedu.

b: Enogwamagudure Festoji uwo Paulo arego pudae Jerusalém ka. Mare pagare egoino. Ere tumearudae tawuje tuwo Paulo bito awara keje.
source: Enogwamagudure Festoji uwo Paulo arego pudae Jerusalém ka. Mare pagare egoino. Ere tumearudae tawuje tuwo Paulo bito awara keje.

b: Mare Festo akore Paulo rakojere Cesaréia keje baicorewu tada. Kuri aino imode ikirimi ibagi toro.
source: Mare Festo akore Paulo rakojere Cesaréia keje baicorewu tada. Kuri aino imode ikirimi ibagi toro.

b: Tagimijerage etudo itabo toro Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka jamedu. Tarudumode ia awu Paulo ro pegarewu ji dukeje tamagodo ro pegarewu ji jakai rugadu.
source: Tagimijerage etudo itabo toro Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka jamedu. Tarudumode ia awu Paulo ro pegarewu ji dukeje tamagodo ro pegarewu ji jakai rugadu.

b: Festo rakojere nono Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje. Meri oto padure oito rabodu, dez rabodu ji nono. Dukejere ure tugirimi tuibagi Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Nou barogwato ure tumugudo tumuga ira keje taiwowo boe erore jiboe ji. Dukeje ca makore Paulo bagai.
source: Festo rakojere nono Jerusalém ba kurirewu keje. Meri oto padure oito rabodu, dez rabodu ji nono. Dukejere ure tugirimi tuibagi Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka. Nou barogwato ure tumugudo tumuga ira keje taiwowo boe erore jiboe ji. Dukeje ca makore Paulo bagai.

b: Etaregodure apo baicorewu piji dukeje nowu etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu pijiwuge Judeu doge ere taiado apo rugadu. Emago pegare ji rugadu. Egore Paulo ro pegaie rugadu. Mare boe erudukare nowu Paulo ia ro pegarewuji.
source: Etaregodure apo baicorewu piji dukeje nowu etaregodure Jerusalém ba kurirewu pijiwuge Judeu doge ere taiado apo rugadu. Emago pegare ji rugadu. Egore Paulo ro pegaie rugadu. Mare boe erudukare nowu Paulo ia ro pegarewuji.

b: Mare paga karega Paulo makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore irore nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Ikare imegido nowu ero piji. Iro pegakare Pao Kurirewu uwaiji. Iro pegakare Romano doge eimijera kurirewu Cesaji.
source: Mare paga karega Paulo makore ewadaru jipagi. Akore irore nono Judeu doge ero mogadure. Ikare imegido nowu ero piji. Iro pegakare Pao Kurirewu uwaiji. Iro pegakare Romano doge eimijera kurirewu Cesaji.

b: Mare Festo aidure turo pemegawo Judeu dogei etaiduwo pudui. Dukodire makore Pauloji. Akore akaidure atuwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka itabo? Nono ca ioruduwamode boe jokodu jire akagoino duji.
source: Mare Festo aidure turo pemegawo Judeu dogei etaiduwo pudui. Dukodire makore Pauloji. Akore akaidure atuwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka itabo? Nono ca ioruduwamode boe jokodu jire akagoino duji.

b: Mare Paulo aidukare. Akore iragojere woe. Boe eimijeranure aki amaragodure Romano doge eimijera kurirewu César ai akaiwowo boe erore jiboe ji awu amuga ira keje. Woe ca ure turugadu awo amearudae tawuje akaiwowo ia iro pegarewu bagai. Iro pega bokware Judeu dogei. Aki aruduware nowu inoduji.
source: Mare Paulo aidukare. Akore iragojere woe. Boe eimijeranure aki amaragodure Romano doge eimijera kurirewu César ai akaiwowo boe erore jiboe ji awu amuga ira keje. Woe ca ure turugadu awo amearudae tawuje akaiwowo ia iro pegarewu bagai. Iro pega bokware Judeu dogei. Aki aruduware nowu inoduji.

b: Emode ia ro pegarewuge ewido ero pegare kodi. Pegakare. Mare iro pegarewu bokware. Ewadrarodunure rabodu dukeje boe emoka imagu etai. Dukodire itaidure Romano doge eimijera kurirewu César aiwowo irore jiboe ji ia iro pegarewu bagai.
source: Emode ia ro pegarewuge ewido ero pegare kodi. Pegakare. Mare iro pegarewu bokware. Ewadrarodunure rabodu dukeje boe emoka imagu etai. Dukodire itaidure Romano doge eimijera kurirewu César aiwowo irore jiboe ji ia iro pegarewu bagai.

b: Dukodire Festo makore okituware puduiwuge ji. Nono makore Pauloji pugeje. Akore akaidure Romano doge eimijera kurirewu aiwowo arore jiboe ji ia aro pegarewu bagai. Dukodire cemode atudo toro Roma ba kurirewu ka nowu Romano doge eimijera kurirewu César bagai.
source: Dukodire Festo makore okituware puduiwuge ji. Nono makore Pauloji pugeje. Akore akaidure Romano doge eimijera kurirewu aiwowo arore jiboe ji ia aro pegarewu bagai. Dukodire cemode atudo toro Roma ba kurirewu ka nowu Romano doge eimijera kurirewu César bagai.

b: Boe Eimijera Agripa Aregodure Tuwie Berenice Apo Tuioruduwo Pauloji
source: Boe Eimijera Agripa Aregodure Tuwie Berenice Apo Tuioruduwo Pauloji

b: Ia meri keje boe eimijera Agripa aregodure tuwie Berenice apo Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka tugimaduwo Festo apo.
source: Ia meri keje boe eimijera Agripa aregodure tuwie Berenice apo Cesaréia ba kurirewu ka tugimaduwo Festo apo.

b: Nou boe ji barogwato Festo readodure ewiagai Paulo rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji jamedu. Akore ia imedu rakojere woe. Félix ure tugu baicorewuto.
source: Nou boe ji barogwato Festo readodure ewiagai Paulo rore jiboe ji makore jiboe ji jamedu. Akore ia imedu rakojere woe. Félix ure tugu baicorewuto.

b: Itaregodure toro Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukeje imearudure nowu Judeu doge eimijerage emago pegare awu imeduji. Etaidure iwo bito.
source: Itaregodure toro Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka dukeje imearudure nowu Judeu doge eimijerage emago pegare awu imeduji. Etaidure iwo bito.

b: Mare ire ewie awu Romano kejewuge ceroji. Cemodukare ia ro pegarewu bito nowu ro pegarewu ukare tugiegi dukeje. Mako pegare jiwuge emagomode tuiorudu pegare jiboe ji jokuto dukeje emare makomode ewadaru jipagi. Dukeje cerudumode ia ro pegare jiboe ji dukeje cemode tugu baicorewuto rabodu, cemode bito rabodu. Ainore cerore.
source: Mare ire ewie awu Romano kejewuge ceroji. Cemodukare ia ro pegarewu bito nowu ro pegarewu ukare tugiegi dukeje. Mako pegare jiwuge emagomode tuiorudu pegare jiboe ji jokuto dukeje emare makomode ewadaru jipagi. Dukeje cerudumode ia ro pegare jiboe ji dukeje cemode tugu baicorewuto rabodu, cemode bito rabodu. Ainore cerore.

b: Dukodire awu Judeu doge eimijerage etaregodure woe. Ca nowu barogwato imagore nowu imedu bagai emago pegawo ji jokuto rugadu.
source: Dukodire awu Judeu doge eimijerage etaregodure woe. Ca nowu barogwato imagore nowu imedu bagai emago pegawo ji jokuto rugadu.

b: Jorudu pegare jiwuge eragojere woe mare emagokare imearudaere jiboe ji.
source: Jorudu pegare jiwuge eragojere woe mare emagokare imearudaere jiboe ji.

b: Emagore awu imedu mearutorukaie Judeu doge erore jiboe ji. Emagore awu imedu mearutorukaie Pao Kurirewu bataru jamedu ji. Ia imedu iere Jesus. Egore nowu Jesus bie. Mare awu imedu Paulo akore nowu Jesus bikaie.
source: Emagore awu imedu mearutorukaie Judeu doge erore jiboe ji. Emagore awu imedu mearutorukaie Pao Kurirewu bataru jamedu ji. Ia imedu iere Jesus. Egore nowu Jesus bie. Mare awu imedu Paulo akore nowu Jesus bikaie.

b: Ca ioruduwakare emearutorure jiboe ji dukodire imearudaere ituwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka Paulo apo ioruduwa pemegawo erore jiboe ji, emearutorure jiboe ji. Dukeje itaiwowo awu Paulo ia ro pegarewu bagai.
source: Ca ioruduwakare emearutorure jiboe ji dukodire imearudaere ituwo Jerusalém ba kurirewu ka Paulo apo ioruduwa pemegawo erore jiboe ji, emearutorure jiboe ji. Dukeje itaiwowo awu Paulo ia ro pegarewu bagai.

b: Mare Paulo aidukare. Makore taiduie Roma kejewu pagimijera kurirewu aiwowo ia turo pegarewu bagai. Dukodire ire tugu baicorewuto pugeje iwo utudo toro Roma ba kurirewu ka pagimijera kurirewu César bagai.
source: Mare Paulo aidukare. Makore taiduie Roma kejewu pagimijera kurirewu aiwowo ia turo pegarewu bagai. Dukodire ire tugu baicorewuto pugeje iwo utudo toro Roma ba kurirewu ka pagimijera kurirewu César bagai.

b: Agripa makore Festoji. Akore itaidure imearuduwo awu imedu bataru jamedu boe ji. Festo akore Ca barogwato amearudumode ji.
source: Agripa makore Festoji. Akore itaidure imearuduwo awu imedu bataru jamedu boe ji. Festo akore Ca barogwato amearudumode ji.

Nou ba kurirewu kejewuge eimijerage etaregodure jamedu. Ere turo pemegado tuwo turemo nowu baito nono turo mogadure. Dukejere Festo makore Paulo bagai. Dukodire tugobaigarege ere turemo Paulo apo.

b: Festo makore agripaji, nowu bai tadawu boe ji jamedu. Akore tarudure awu imeduji. Judeu doge emago pegare ji rugadu. Etaregodure woe nowu tuwadaru pegarewu tabo Jerusalém piji. Ekudugodure iwo bito rugadu.

b: Mare iorudukare ia ro pegare jiboe ji iwo bito. Mare emare aidure Roma kejewu pagimijera kurirewu aiwowo turore jiboe bagai ia turo pegarewu bagai. Dukodire ire imearudae tawuje iwo utudo Roma ba kurirewu ka nowu pagimijera kurirewu aiwowo rore jiboe ji.

b: Mare ioruduwakare nuba imagomode atugoreboeto iwo nowu pagimijera kurirewu bie kodiba ire utudo toro. Dukodire ire arego mato taegai tawo ioruduwado nuba imagomode atugoreboeto. Boe eimijera Agripa. Akaiwodo nowu Paulo roji awo ioruduwado iwo atugoreboe pemegado pagimijera kurirewu bagai.
