b: Nou mariguduwuge pawobe eiamedu boe enogwagere Pao Kurirewu ure maku pudaiwu amirewuji.
source: Nou mariguduwuge pawobe eiamedu boe enogwagere Pao Kurirewu ure maku pudaiwu amirewuji.

b: Eiamedu boe ekudure Pao Kurirewu ure maku pudaiwu poboce jamedu. Nou pobo ure tudawuje Pao Kurirewu o tori piji. Jesus Cristo koiare ure nowu pobo udo tudawuje nowu tori piji tuwo maku nowu mariguduwuge pawobe etai.
source: Eiamedu boe ekudure Pao Kurirewu ure maku pudaiwu poboce jamedu. Nou pobo ure tudawuje Pao Kurirewu o tori piji. Jesus Cristo koiare ure nowu pobo udo tudawuje nowu tori piji tuwo maku nowu mariguduwuge pawobe etai.

b: Mare du inodu tabo nowu mariguduwuge pawobe ere tugera ra tumearutorure Pao Kurirewu jitu piji rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu boe erore jiboe ji. Dukodire ewire toro boe maerewu keje.
source: Mare du inodu tabo nowu mariguduwuge pawobe ere tugera ra tumearutorure Pao Kurirewu jitu piji rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu aidukare nowu boe erore jiboe ji. Dukodire ewire toro boe maerewu keje.

b: Dukodire pawo paeku rakado nowu mariguduwuge Israel doge erore jiboe ji parokawo nono ero mogadure. Emage ere tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo tu tu je. Mare aino care pawo pamearudae pemegado parokawo nono ero mogadure.
source: Dukodire pawo paeku rakado nowu mariguduwuge Israel doge erore jiboe ji parokawo nono ero mogadure. Emage ere tumearudae tawuje turo pegawo tu tu je. Mare aino care pawo pamearudae pemegado parokawo nono ero mogadure.

b: Emagere emago pemegare tuwai tadawu tuwari santoji. Etaidure tumearutoruwo ji nono tumearutoru moga Pao Kurirewu jitu mogadure. Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru makore nowu mariguduwu Israel doge erore jiboe ji rugadu. Akore nou boe ere tuwadae tawuje tumago pemegawo nowu boe ewai tadawu tuwari santo dogei dukeje ere tumugudo togwagewo tuguduwo jamedu. Nono ekudu raire. Ewadae pega remawure rugadu. Ewadu raire tumearudae pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Aino care parokawo nono ero mogadure. Pawo pamearudae pemegado pamearutorukawo boe ewai tadawu ewari santo dogei parokawo nono ero mogadure.
source: Emagere emago pemegare tuwai tadawu tuwari santoji. Etaidure tumearutoruwo ji nono tumearutoru moga Pao Kurirewu jitu mogadure. Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru makore nowu mariguduwu Israel doge erore jiboe ji rugadu. Akore nou boe ere tuwadae tawuje tumago pemegawo nowu boe ewai tadawu tuwari santo dogei dukeje ere tumugudo togwagewo tuguduwo jamedu. Nono ekudu raire. Ewadae pega remawure rugadu. Ewadu raire tumearudae pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Aino care parokawo nono ero mogadure. Pawo pamearudae pemegado pamearutorukawo boe ewai tadawu ewari santo dogei parokawo nono ero mogadure.

b: Nou mariguduwuge Israel doge eribarire tuwire epiji dukodire etagedure rugadu. Mare eiamedu karega. Mare nowu meri mitoduji birewuge enodo padure vinte e três mil. Aino care parokawo nono ero mogadure. Paeribarikawo pawire epiji, pagoge epiji.
source: Nou mariguduwuge Israel doge eribarire tuwire epiji dukodire etagedure rugadu. Mare eiamedu karega. Mare nowu meri mitoduji birewuge enodo padure vinte e três mil. Aino care parokawo nono ero mogadure. Paeribarikawo pawire epiji, pagoge epiji.

b: Ia emage ere turokogado Pao Kurirewu ji. Nou inodu kodi awage ere ewido. Ca parokawo nono ero mogadure. Pagawo parokogado Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Ia emage ere turokogado Pao Kurirewu ji. Nou inodu kodi awage ere ewido. Ca parokawo nono ero mogadure. Pagawo parokogado Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Ia emage emago pegare Pao Kurirewu ji pu biagai. Nou inodu kodi Pao Kurirewu ure tudugare baru tadawu utudo etae. Nou utugare baru tadawu iere Umode Boe Ewidowu aino. Ema koiare ure etagedudo. Ca pamago pegakawo Pao Kurirewu ji pui rugadu.
source: Ia emage emago pegare Pao Kurirewu ji pu biagai. Nou inodu kodi Pao Kurirewu ure tudugare baru tadawu utudo etae. Nou utugare baru tadawu iere Umode Boe Ewidowu aino. Ema koiare ure etagedudo. Ca pamago pegakawo Pao Kurirewu ji pui rugadu.

b: Ainore Pao Kurirewu rore nowu mariguduwu Israel dogei tuwo boe eiamedu boe eruduwado tumearudae ji. Nou Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe padure bapera keje tuwo pawie paioku jawo. Dukodire care pagaiwowo nowu baperaji paruduwawo Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji rugadu boe puredugodure awu moto akeduwo dukodi. Dukodire pawo pamearudae pemegado nono Pao Kurirewu aidumogadure.
source: Ainore Pao Kurirewu rore nowu mariguduwu Israel dogei tuwo boe eiamedu boe eruduwado tumearudae ji. Nou Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe padure bapera keje tuwo pawie paioku jawo. Dukodire care pagaiwowo nowu baperaji paruduwawo Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji rugadu boe puredugodure awu moto akeduwo dukodi. Dukodire pawo pamearudae pemegado nono Pao Kurirewu aidumogadure.

b: Ia tagi tagagore tamearutoru rakaie Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare taeku jado tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu jitu piji.
source: Ia tagi tagagore tamearutoru rakaie Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare taeku jado tagawo tagera ra tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu jitu piji.

b: Boe etaidumode tuwo tagaora korau nono turomoga ia tumedagei dumogadure. Bope aidumode tuwo tagaora pegado nono turomoga ia tamedagei dumogadure. Mare Pao Kurirewu akore tumoduie turaga maku mearutorure puduiwuge etai. Pao Kurirewu kodumode tuwadaru ji tu rugadu. Umode turaga maku tagai rugadu tawudukawo nowu etaora pegarewu rekodaji rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode taruduwado nuba taromode tawo tadawuje nowu boe emearudae pegarewu piji.
source: Boe etaidumode tuwo tagaora korau nono turomoga ia tumedagei dumogadure. Bope aidumode tuwo tagaora pegado nono turomoga ia tamedagei dumogadure. Mare Pao Kurirewu akore tumoduie turaga maku mearutorure puduiwuge etai. Pao Kurirewu kodumode tuwadaru ji tu rugadu. Umode turaga maku tagai rugadu tawudukawo nowu etaora pegarewu rekodaji rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode taruduwado nuba taromode tawo tadawuje nowu boe emearudae pegarewu piji.

b: Dukodire inagoino tai. Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi. Tamearutorukaba boe ewai tadawu tuwari santo dogei.
source: Dukodire inagoino tai. Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi. Tamearutorukaba boe ewai tadawu tuwari santo dogei.

b: Taruduware kodi. Tagaiwodo iwadaru ji. Iwadaru pegarewu bokware.
source: Taruduware kodi. Tagaiwodo iwadaru ji. Iwadaru pegarewu bokware.

b: Pamode bato pui dukeje pagudumode uva kuruce pawiabutuwo Pagimijera Jesus rore jiboe keje. Pagimadumode Pao Kurirewu apo nowu uva kuru paru tabo. Pamode pedo pui paguduwo ce nono pawiabutumode Jesus ku keje. Pagatu je karega. Pawiabutuwo ku keje dukodire parore aino. Pagwagemode amirewu ji pawiabutuwo boe pegare Pagimijera Jesus jitu keje jamedu. Pamode nowu amirewu pedo pui pawo ko nono pawiabutumode Jesus kodu keje. Pagatu je karega. Pawiabutuwo boe pegare jitu keje dukodire parore aino.
source: Pamode bato pui dukeje pagudumode uva kuruce pawiabutuwo Pagimijera Jesus rore jiboe keje. Pagimadumode Pao Kurirewu apo nowu uva kuru paru tabo. Pamode pedo pui paguduwo ce nono pawiabutumode Jesus ku keje. Pagatu je karega. Pawiabutuwo ku keje dukodire parore aino. Pagwagemode amirewu ji pawiabutuwo boe pegare Pagimijera Jesus jitu keje jamedu. Pamode nowu amirewu pedo pui pawo ko nono pawiabutumode Jesus kodu keje. Pagatu je karega. Pawiabutuwo boe pegare jitu keje dukodire parore aino.

b: Nou pagwagemode jiwu amirewu ure mitotu je. Pagi jamedu pare mitotu je nono nowu amirewu ure mitotu je dumogadure. Mare amirewu ji karega inagoino. Pare nono pawobere pugi dumogadure. Dujire inagoino. Pamagare mare paiamedu boe pagwagemode nowu amirewu mitoduji. Mare paiamedu boe pamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire paroino. Emare ure pawobedo pugi.
source: Nou pagwagemode jiwu amirewu ure mitotu je. Pagi jamedu pare mitotu je nono nowu amirewu ure mitotu je dumogadure. Mare amirewu ji karega inagoino. Pare nono pawobere pugi dumogadure. Dujire inagoino. Pamagare mare paiamedu boe pagwagemode nowu amirewu mitoduji. Mare paiamedu boe pamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire paroino. Emare ure pawobedo pugi.

b: Tawiabutudo nowu Israel doge ero keje. Ere boe egu barogorogu kowu Pao Kurirewu uwai tada turo pegarewu morice. Turore aino dukeje ere nowu barogorogu kodu kowuje jamedu. Nou okwagere nowu boe egu barogo kodu jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui tuwo nowu boe egu barogorogu kowu tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai turo pegarewu boe morice.
source: Tawiabutudo nowu Israel doge ero keje. Ere boe egu barogorogu kowu Pao Kurirewu uwai tada turo pegarewu morice. Turore aino dukeje ere nowu barogorogu kodu kowuje jamedu. Nou okwagere nowu boe egu barogo kodu jiwuge eiamedu boe ere bato pui tuwo nowu boe egu barogorogu kowu tuwo maku Pao Kurirewu ai turo pegarewu boe morice.

b: Mare ia boe eromode aino tuwai tadawu santo doge etai jamedu. Boe emode boe egu barogorogu kodu maku nowu tuwai tadawu santo doge etai mare pagare eroino. Boe ere tuwai tadawu santo towuje tuwo udo nono Pao Kurirewu mogadure. Mare pagare eroino.
source: Mare ia boe eromode aino tuwai tadawu santo doge etai jamedu. Boe emode boe egu barogorogu kodu maku nowu tuwai tadawu santo doge etai mare pagare eroino. Boe ere tuwai tadawu santo towuje tuwo udo nono Pao Kurirewu mogadure. Mare pagare eroino.

b: Bope doge etaire boe eroino. Dukodire emode boe egu barogorogu kodu bu ture towu irarogu keje nowu tuwai tadawu santo doge egorai tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare pagare eroino pagare egoino. Pao Kurirewu ai karega eroino. Bope doge etaire eroino. Ca iwo tawie. Tarokaba aino. Tagaba tagera maku bope doge etai.
source: Bope doge etaire boe eroino. Dukodire emode boe egu barogorogu kodu bu ture towu irarogu keje nowu tuwai tadawu santo doge egorai tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare pagare eroino pagare egoino. Pao Kurirewu ai karega eroino. Bope doge etaire eroino. Ca iwo tawie. Tarokaba aino. Tagaba tagera maku bope doge etai.

b: Tagaba taremo nowu bope doge erore jiboeto. Tamode taremo erore jiboeto dukeje tamearutorumodukare Pagimijera Jesus ji pugeje. Dukeje tagudumodukare nowu uva kuruce, tagwagemodukare nowu amirewu ji pugeje.
source: Tagaba taremo nowu bope doge erore jiboeto. Tamode taremo erore jiboeto dukeje tamearutorumodukare Pagimijera Jesus ji pugeje. Dukeje tagudumodukare nowu uva kuruce, tagwagemodukare nowu amirewu ji pugeje.

b: Mare mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure tagi. Tamode taremo nowu bope doge eroiato dukeje tamode Jesus korigo tai. Tamearudaekaba taragaie nono Pagimijera Jesus raka mogadure.
source: Mare mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure tagi. Tamode taremo nowu bope doge eroiato dukeje tamode Jesus korigo tai. Tamearudaekaba taragaie nono Pagimijera Jesus raka mogadure.

b: Ia tagi tagagore: – Paromode pagaidure jiwu parore jiboe jamedu boe ji. Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Mare ia tarore jiboe umode boe pegado ia tai. Tagagore: – Pao Kurirewu akore parowo pagaidure jiwu parore jiboe jamedu boe ji. Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Mare ia tarore jiboe umodukare boe pemegado ia tai.
source: Ia tagi tagagore: – Paromode pagaidure jiwu parore jiboe jamedu boe ji. Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Mare ia tarore jiboe umode boe pegado ia tai. Tagagore: – Pao Kurirewu akore parowo pagaidure jiwu parore jiboe jamedu boe ji. Boe jokodu jire tagagoino. Mare ia tarore jiboe umodukare boe pemegado ia tai.

b: Tagaidukaba boe pemegawo tu tai mare tamearudaedo boe pemegawo tamedagei jamedu.
source: Tagaidukaba boe pemegawo tu tai mare tamearudaedo boe pemegawo tamedagei jamedu.

b: Ure turugadu tai tawo akirodo boe koduji nowu umode boe kodu moridowu bai keje tawo ko. Tanarakaba nowu jeture bai kejewugei kaiba pijiba nowu boe kodu aregodure. Tabagudukaba nowu jeture nowu bai tadawu boe koduce. Pegakare rugadu.
source: Ure turugadu tai tawo akirodo boe koduji nowu umode boe kodu moridowu bai keje tawo ko. Tanarakaba nowu jeture bai kejewugei kaiba pijiba nowu boe kodu aregodure. Tabagudukaba nowu jeture nowu bai tadawu boe koduce. Pegakare rugadu.

b: Mare paga karega. Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Moto jamedu boe Pao Kurirewu onure ema. Moto kejeboe jamedu boe Pao Kurirewu onure ema.
source: Mare paga karega. Padure bapera kejewu Pao Kurirewu bataru akore Moto jamedu boe Pao Kurirewu onure ema. Moto kejeboe jamedu boe Pao Kurirewu onure ema.

b: Mearutorukare Jesus jiwu makomode tawagai tagwagewo pudabo dukeje tadudo uwai ka. Umode tuge maku tagai tagwagewo. Dukeje tagwagedo ji rugadu. Tanarakaba ji kaiba pijiba nowu boe eke aregodure.
source: Mearutorukare Jesus jiwu makomode tawagai tagwagewo pudabo dukeje tadudo uwai ka. Umode tuge maku tagai tagwagewo. Dukeje tagwagedo ji rugadu. Tanarakaba ji kaiba pijiba nowu boe eke aregodure.

b: Mare ia boe umode tawie nowu boe kodurogu makuduie tuwai tadawu santo doge etai bope doge ekece dukeje tagaba ko. Nou akoino taiwu mearutoru rakakare Jesus ji dukodi kana akore aino? Taruduwakare. Dukodire tagaba ko. Pegakare tawo ko jamedu. Mare tamode ko dukeje nowu mearutoru rakakare Jesus jiwu mearudae pegamode tare ko duji. Dukodire inagoino tagawo ko. Mare paga karega. Tamodukare ko dukeje tamodukare mearutoru akedudo Jesus ji mearudae pegakawo kodi. Mare ia tagi tagagore: – Kodiba iromodukare itaidure jiboe ji? Kodiba ia mearutoru rakakare Jesus jiwu umode iro jodo?
source: Mare ia boe umode tawie nowu boe kodurogu makuduie tuwai tadawu santo doge etai bope doge ekece dukeje tagaba ko. Nou akoino taiwu mearutoru rakakare Jesus ji dukodi kana akore aino? Taruduwakare. Dukodire tagaba ko. Pegakare tawo ko jamedu. Mare tamode ko dukeje nowu mearutoru rakakare Jesus jiwu mearudae pegamode tare ko duji. Dukodire inagoino tagawo ko. Mare paga karega. Tamodukare ko dukeje tamodukare mearutoru akedudo Jesus ji mearudae pegakawo kodi. Mare ia tagi tagagore: – Kodiba iromodukare itaidure jiboe ji? Kodiba ia mearutoru rakakare Jesus jiwu umode iro jodo?

b: Ikimadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu ike paru tabo dukodire ure turugadu iwo ko rugadu. Dukodire boe emago pegamodukare iroji. Ainore ia tagi tagagore.
source: Ikimadure Pao Kurirewu apo nowu ike paru tabo dukodire ure turugadu iwo ko rugadu. Dukodire boe emago pegamodukare iroji. Ainore ia tagi tagagore.

b: Mare iwo tawie. Boe etaiwore tai tagudure ceboe ji, tagwagere jiboe ji. Erudumode rugadu. Dukodire tagaiwodo tarore jiboe jamedu boe ji tawo taro udo nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure. Boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji pemegare rugadu duji.
source: Mare iwo tawie. Boe etaiwore tai tagudure ceboe ji, tagwagere jiboe ji. Erudumode rugadu. Dukodire tagaiwodo tarore jiboe jamedu boe ji tawo taro udo nono Pao Kurirewu mearudae mogadure. Boe eruduwo Pao Kurirewu mearudae ji pemegare rugadu duji.

b: Taro jetorodo boe erudu pegakawo tarore jiboe ji. Judeu doge, boe tuginaiwuge, mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe erudu pegakawo tarore jiboe ji.
source: Taro jetorodo boe erudu pegakawo tarore jiboe ji. Judeu doge, boe tuginaiwuge, mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe erudu pegakawo tarore jiboe ji.

b: Tarodo nono iro mogadure. Itaidure iro pemegawo boe eiamedu boe ji. Imearudaekare tu i. Imearudaere boe pemegawo boe eiamedu boe ji nowu boe emearutoruwo Jesus ji uwo ekinorudo rugadu.
source: Tarodo nono iro mogadure. Itaidure iro pemegawo boe eiamedu boe ji. Imearudaekare tu i. Imearudaere boe pemegawo boe eiamedu boe ji nowu boe emearutoruwo Jesus ji uwo ekinorudo rugadu.

b: Irore nono Jesus Cristo ro mogadure. Dukodi tarodo nono iro mogadure.
source: Irore nono Jesus Cristo ro mogadure. Dukodi tarodo nono iro mogadure.

b: Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu Jiwuge Areme Erore Jiboe Reo
source: Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu Jiwuge Areme Erore Jiboe Reo

b: Tawiagodukare ipiji. Tamearutorure ire taruduwado jiboe ji. Ure turugadu iagai rugadu.
source: Tawiagodukare ipiji. Tamearutorure ire taruduwado jiboe ji. Ure turugadu iagai rugadu.

b: Mare itaidure iwo taruduwado iaboe ji pugeje. Aredu ukimijerare toreduce. Imedu ukimijerare Jesusce. Jesus ukimijerare Pao Kurirewuce.
source: Mare itaidure iwo taruduwado iaboe ji pugeje. Aredu ukimijerare toreduce. Imedu ukimijerare Jesusce. Jesus ukimijerare Pao Kurirewuce.

b: Nono boe emode bato pui tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Nono imedu makomode baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu boe egai dukeje umode tatadawu tawuje taora piji. Makomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe ewiagai dukeje umode tatadawu tawuje taora piji. Umodukare tatadawu tawuje taora piji dukeje umode Jesus Cristo pogurudo.
source: Nono boe emode bato pui tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Nono imedu makomode baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu boe egai dukeje umode tatadawu tawuje taora piji. Makomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe ewiagai dukeje umode tatadawu tawuje taora piji. Umodukare tatadawu tawuje taora piji dukeje umode Jesus Cristo pogurudo.

b: Mare aredu makomode baru to nowu boe egai dukeje umode iaboe upodo taora tabo. Makomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe ewiagai dukeje umode iaboe upodo taora tabo. Umodukare iaboe upodo taora tabo dukeje umode toredu pogurudo nono ia aredu ro pegarewudo ro mogadure. Marigudu boe ere aredu ro pegarewudo udo tao kado boe eruduwawo ji ro pegarewudonure ema duji. Aredu umodukare iaboe upodo taora tabo tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai dukeje ure tudo nono aredu ao kadodurewudo mogadure.
source: Mare aredu makomode baru to nowu boe egai dukeje umode iaboe upodo taora tabo. Makomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji nowu boe ewiagai dukeje umode iaboe upodo taora tabo. Umodukare iaboe upodo taora tabo dukeje umode toredu pogurudo nono ia aredu ro pegarewudo ro mogadure. Marigudu boe ere aredu ro pegarewudo udo tao kado boe eruduwawo ji ro pegarewudonure ema duji. Aredu umodukare iaboe upodo taora tabo tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai dukeje ure tudo nono aredu ao kadodurewudo mogadure.

b: Dukodire boe emode bato pui tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje areme ewo iaboe upodo taora tabo. Aredu umodukare iaboe upodo taora tabo dukeje uwo tao rugadu boe kado rugadu. Aredu umode tao rugadu boe kado dukeje care pogurumode. Dukodire uwo iaboe upodo taora tabo tubogurukawo.
source: Dukodire boe emode bato pui tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje areme ewo iaboe upodo taora tabo. Aredu umodukare iaboe upodo taora tabo dukeje uwo tao rugadu boe kado rugadu. Aredu umode tao rugadu boe kado dukeje care pogurumode. Dukodire uwo iaboe upodo taora tabo tubogurukawo.

b: Mare imedu umodukare iaboe upodo taora tabo. Emare umode boe erududo Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewuji. Mare aredu umode boe erududo toredu ro pemegarewu ji jamedu.
source: Mare imedu umodukare iaboe upodo taora tabo. Emare umode boe erududo Pao Kurirewu ro pemegarewuji. Mare aredu umode boe erududo toredu ro pemegarewu ji jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewu ukare iaboe tawuje aredu piji tuwo imedu boeto jiwu towuje. Ure imedu boeto jiwu jura tawuje piji tuwo aredu boeto jiwudo towuje.
source: Pao Kurirewu ukare iaboe tawuje aredu piji tuwo imedu boeto jiwu towuje. Ure imedu boeto jiwu jura tawuje piji tuwo aredu boeto jiwudo towuje.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure imedu towuje boeto ji. Dukeje care ure aredu towuje imedu boeto jiwu metiawo ema.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure imedu towuje boeto ji. Dukeje care ure aredu towuje imedu boeto jiwu metiawo ema.

b: Dukodire areme emode iaboe upodo taora tabo boe eruduwo tumearutorure toredu jituji. Mare Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge erudumode boe ji dukodire areme emode iaboe upodo taora tabo nowu baru tadawuge eruduwo tumearutorure toredu jituji jamedu.
source: Dukodire areme emode iaboe upodo taora tabo boe eruduwo tumearutorure toredu jituji. Mare Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge erudumode boe ji dukodire areme emode iaboe upodo taora tabo nowu baru tadawuge eruduwo tumearutorure toredu jituji jamedu.

b: Pamearutorure Pagimijera Jesus ji. Dukodire aredu umodukare tumearudae udo tuginai toredu mearudae piji. Nono imedu umodukare tumearudae udo tuginai toreduje mearudae piji jamedu.
source: Pamearutorure Pagimijera Jesus ji. Dukodire aredu umodukare tumearudae udo tuginai toredu mearudae piji. Nono imedu umodukare tumearudae udo tuginai toreduje mearudae piji jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure imedu boeto jiwu jura tawuje piji tuwo aredu boeto jiwudo towuje. Mare ime eiamedu ewodure tuje areme epiji jamedu. Dukodire emearudae umodukare tuginai pubiji. Nono Pao Kurirewu koiare ure boe jamedu boe towuje rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure imedu boeto jiwu jura tawuje piji tuwo aredu boeto jiwudo towuje. Mare ime eiamedu ewodure tuje areme epiji jamedu. Dukodire emearudae umodukare tuginai pubiji. Nono Pao Kurirewu koiare ure boe jamedu boe towuje rugadu.

b: Itaidure tawo tamearudae tawuje rugadu. Boe emode bato pui tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare ukana turugadu aredu makowo baru to nowu taora kedo tabo?
source: Itaidure tawo tamearudae tawuje rugadu. Boe emode bato pui tumago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare ukana turugadu aredu makowo baru to nowu taora kedo tabo?

b: Boro. Ukare turugadu. Boe etaiwore Pao Kurirewu ure towu boe ji tuwo turore jiboe towuje. Paroia koiare imedu ao raimode dukeje nowu imedu pogurumode nowu tao raire duji.
source: Boro. Ukare turugadu. Boe etaiwore Pao Kurirewu ure towu boe ji tuwo turore jiboe towuje. Paroia koiare imedu ao raimode dukeje nowu imedu pogurumode nowu tao raire duji.

b: Mare aredu ao raimode dukeje nowu aredu motumode. Pao Kurirewu ure aredu aodo atadawu ema. Mare atadawu ji karega inagoino. Nou aredu ao jire inagoino.
source: Mare aredu ao raimode dukeje nowu aredu motumode. Pao Kurirewu ure aredu aodo atadawu ema. Mare atadawu ji karega inagoino. Nou aredu ao jire inagoino.

b: Ia tagi tagaidumodukare awu iwadaru ji. Mare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe erore aino. Ainore cerore jamedu. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emode bato pui tumago pemegawo Jesus ji dukeje ainore erore rugadu.
source: Ia tagi tagaidumodukare awu iwadaru ji. Mare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe erore aino. Ainore cerore jamedu. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emode bato pui tumago pemegawo Jesus ji dukeje ainore erore rugadu.

b: Pawiabutuwo Jesus Keje Ure Tugu Redo Paro Pegarewu Morice Kodi
source: Pawiabutuwo Jesus Keje Ure Tugu Redo Paro Pegarewu Morice Kodi

b: Mare imago pemegamodukare ia tarore jiboe ji. Tare bato pui tamago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare tare boe pegado tai.
source: Mare imago pemegamodukare ia tarore jiboe ji. Tare bato pui tamago pemegawo Pao Kurirewu ji. Mare tare boe pegado tai.

b: Boe ere iwie tarore jiboe ji. Egore tabokaie puapo. Ia tagi tamearudae uie tuginai nouia tamedage epiji. Ainore boe egore. Itaidukare imearutoruwo nowu ere iwie jiboe ji. Mare imearutorure.
source: Boe ere iwie tarore jiboe ji. Egore tabokaie puapo. Ia tagi tamearudae uie tuginai nouia tamedage epiji. Ainore boe egore. Itaidukare imearutoruwo nowu ere iwie jiboe ji. Mare imearutorure.

b: Meardae pemegarewuge emode tumearudae udo tuginai mearudae pegarewuge epiji rugadu. Dukodire boe etaiwomode tamearudae ji dukeje eruduwamode. Ia tagi tamearudae pemegare. Boe etaiwomode dukeje eruduwamode nowu inoduji.
source: Meardae pemegarewuge emode tumearudae udo tuginai mearudae pegarewuge epiji rugadu. Dukodire boe etaiwomode tamearudae ji dukeje eruduwamode. Ia tagi tamearudae pemegare. Boe etaiwomode dukeje eruduwamode nowu inoduji.

b: Tare bato pui dukeje tamearudaere tawo Pagimijera Jesus uke amirewu ko taguduwo nowu uva kuruce jamedu. Mare tagare Pagimijera Jesus uke amirewu ko tagudukare nowu uva kuruce jamedu.
source: Tare bato pui dukeje tamearudaere tawo Pagimijera Jesus uke amirewu ko taguduwo nowu uva kuruce jamedu. Mare tagare Pagimijera Jesus uke amirewu ko tagudukare nowu uva kuruce jamedu.

b: Tare bato pui dukeje taiamedu boe tagaregodure tage tabo. Nono tare tage kowuje nono rugadu. Tabagakare pu bagai tagwagewo puapo. Dukodire iage eke bokware. Kocare iage eke kurure ei jamedu.
source: Tare bato pui dukeje taiamedu boe tagaregodure tage tabo. Nono tare tage kowuje nono rugadu. Tabagakare pu bagai tagwagewo puapo. Dukodire iage eke bokware. Kocare iage eke kurure ei jamedu.

b: Kocare tage boeimode tai dukeje tagwagedo tu toro tawai keje rugadu. Mare tadure tage tabo boe ere bato puiwu bai ka tagwagewo boe egai mare tagare boe ekuna. Tare uke bokwarewuge epogurudo. Du taro peganure mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Dukodire care imago peganure awu tarore jiboe ji. Tagaidure imago pemegawo tarore jiboe ji. Mare itaidukare ji. Ukare turugadu.
source: Kocare tage boeimode tai dukeje tagwagedo tu toro tawai keje rugadu. Mare tadure tage tabo boe ere bato puiwu bai ka tagwagewo boe egai mare tagare boe ekuna. Tare uke bokwarewuge epogurudo. Du taro peganure mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge eiamedu boe ji. Dukodire care imago peganure awu tarore jiboe ji. Tagaidure imago pemegawo tarore jiboe ji. Mare itaidukare ji. Ukare turugadu.

b: Pagimijera Jesus ure ioruduwado rugadu. Ainore paromode pawo Pagimijera Jesus uke kowuje. Imedu ure Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Nou boeco ji Pagimijera Jesus ure tumugudo ture joruduwadowugebo tuge keje. Ure tugeragu amirewuji.
source: Pagimijera Jesus ure ioruduwado rugadu. Ainore paromode pawo Pagimijera Jesus uke kowuje. Imedu ure Jesus maku boe eimijerage pegarewuge etai. Nou boeco ji Pagimijera Jesus ure tumugudo ture joruduwadowugebo tuge keje. Ure tugeragu amirewuji.

b: Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu tuge amirewu paru tabo. Dukejere ure nowu amirewu kado puiato. Nono akore awu amirewu ikodu reo. Ire imagu boe ero pegarewu morice. Dujire inagoino. Tagwagedo ji tawiabutuwo iwugeje.
source: Imadure Pao Kurirewu bagai nowu tuge amirewu paru tabo. Dukejere ure nowu amirewu kado puiato. Nono akore awu amirewu ikodu reo. Ire imagu boe ero pegarewu morice. Dujire inagoino. Tagwagedo ji tawiabutuwo iwugeje.

b: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Pao Kurirewu mearudae maiwu koiare imode iku redo boe ero pegarewu morice. Tagududo awu uva kuruce tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje jamedu.
source: Enogwagere dukeje Jesus ure tugeragu vinho kuruji jamedu. Akore ikure nowu uva kuru rema. Pao Kurirewu mearudae maiwu koiare imode iku redo boe ero pegarewu morice. Tagududo awu uva kuruce tawiabutuwo iwugeje, irore jiboe keje jamedu.

b: Tagwagemode awu Pagimijera uke amirewuji. Tagudumode awu Pagimijera uke uva kuruce. Tarore aino dukeje tamode boe eruduwado Pagimijera bire boe ero pegarewu morice duji boe ewiabutuwo nowu bire dukeje. Tarodo aino tu tu je jii toro Pagimijera aregodu ka.
source: Tagwagemode awu Pagimijera uke amirewuji. Tagudumode awu Pagimijera uke uva kuruce. Tarore aino dukeje tamode boe eruduwado Pagimijera bire boe ero pegarewu morice duji boe ewiabutuwo nowu bire dukeje. Tarodo aino tu tu je jii toro Pagimijera aregodu ka.

b: Mare tagaiwodo tarore jiboe ji tamearudaere jiboe ji ia taro pegarewu bagai, ia tamearudae pegarewu bagai. Ia tamearudae pegarewu metumode tagabo dukeje tagaba awu Pagimijera uke kowuje. Ia tamearudae pegarewu metumode tagabo mare tamode ko dukeje taro peganure Pagimijera koduji, taro peganure Pagimijera kuji. Ia taro pegarewu metumode tagabo kimo mare tamode Pagimijera uke kowuje dukeje tamode nono nowu ure Pagimijera bitowuge emogadure.
source: Mare tagaiwodo tarore jiboe ji tamearudaere jiboe ji ia taro pegarewu bagai, ia tamearudae pegarewu bagai. Ia tamearudae pegarewu metumode tagabo dukeje tagaba awu Pagimijera uke kowuje. Ia tamearudae pegarewu metumode tagabo mare tamode ko dukeje taro peganure Pagimijera koduji, taro peganure Pagimijera kuji. Ia taro pegarewu metumode tagabo kimo mare tamode Pagimijera uke kowuje dukeje tamode nono nowu ure Pagimijera bitowuge emogadure.

b: Tagudumode awu Pagimijera uke uva kuruce, tagwagemode awu Pagimijera uke amirewuji. Mare tawiagodumode Pagimijera Jesus bire paro pegarewu morice dupiji dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu.
source: Tagudumode awu Pagimijera uke uva kuruce, tagwagemode awu Pagimijera uke amirewuji. Mare tawiagodumode Pagimijera Jesus bire paro pegarewu morice dupiji dukeje boe pegamode tai rugadu.

b: Kocare ainore tarore rugadu. Dukodire kogodurewuge tamagare. Rakakarewuge tamagare jamedu. Ia tamedage ewire jamedu.
source: Kocare ainore tarore rugadu. Dukodire kogodurewuge tamagare. Rakakarewuge tamagare jamedu. Ia tamedage ewire jamedu.

b: Mare pagaiwowo parore jiboe ji boeto ji paro pegarewu bagai, pamearudae pegarewu bagai pawo pamearudae tawuje parokawo aino pugeje pamearudaekawo aino pugeje. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu ro pegamodukare pai.
source: Mare pagaiwowo parore jiboe ji boeto ji paro pegarewu bagai, pamearudae pegarewu bagai pawo pamearudae tawuje parokawo aino pugeje pamearudaekawo aino pugeje. Dukejere Pao Kurirewu ro pegamodukare pai.

b: Pao Kurirewu aiwomode paroji. Jorudumode ia paro pegarewu ji dukeje umode boe pegado pai tuwo paro pemegado mearutorukarewuge epiji. Dukodire pawarigudumodukare toro joru pegarewuto mearutorukare Jesus jiwugebo.
source: Pao Kurirewu aiwomode paroji. Jorudumode ia paro pegarewu ji dukeje umode boe pegado pai tuwo paro pemegado mearutorukarewuge epiji. Dukodire pawarigudumodukare toro joru pegarewuto mearutorukare Jesus jiwugebo.

b: Dukodire tamode bato pui tagwagewo Pagimijera ukeji dukeje tabagado pu bagai tagwagewo puapo. Imedagenure tagi.
source: Dukodire tamode bato pui tagwagewo Pagimijera ukeji dukeje tabagado pu bagai tagwagewo puapo. Imedagenure tagi.

b: Ia tagi tage boeire tai dukeje tagwagedo tawai keje boeto ji. Nono tamode bato pui dukeje taro pegarewu bokwamode. Nono Pao Kurirewu umodukare boe pegado tai. Itaregodumode tagae dukeje imode taruduwado pugeje iwo ia taro jetorodo pugeje.
source: Ia tagi tage boeire tai dukeje tagwagedo tawai keje boeto ji. Nono tamode bato pui dukeje taro pegarewu bokwamode. Nono Pao Kurirewu umodukare boe pegado tai. Itaregodumode tagae dukeje imode taruduwado pugeje iwo ia taro jetorodo pugeje.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Ure Maku Boe Etaiwu Emaragodae Reo
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Ure Maku Boe Etaiwu Emaragodae Reo

b: Tanarare i taruduwawo Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure maku boe etaiwu turo pemegarewu boe ji boe emaragodae boe ji jamedu. Imedagenure tagi. Nono imode taruduwado boe remawu ji.
source: Tanarare i taruduwawo Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure maku boe etaiwu turo pemegarewu boe ji boe emaragodae boe ji jamedu. Imedagenure tagi. Nono imode taruduwado boe remawu ji.

b: Marigudu tamearutorukare Jesus ji. Boe ere taekiripagado rugadu tamearutoru pagawo boe ewai tadawu tuwari santo dogei. Nou boe ewai tadawu tuwari santo doge boe karegure emage dukodire emagokare iaboe ji boe ewiagai. Pagatu jere tamearutorure ei. Marigudu awu inodure aino. Mare aino tamearutorure Jesus ji rugadu.
source: Marigudu tamearutorukare Jesus ji. Boe ere taekiripagado rugadu tamearutoru pagawo boe ewai tadawu tuwari santo dogei. Nou boe ewai tadawu tuwari santo doge boe karegure emage dukodire emagokare iaboe ji boe ewiagai. Pagatu jere tamearutorure ei. Marigudu awu inodure aino. Mare aino tamearutorure Jesus ji rugadu.

b: Dukodire iwo tawie. Boe emago pegamode Jesus ji mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari koia karega ure egodo aino. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode boe eruduwado dukeje emode tugimijerado Jesusce. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari umodukare boe eruduwado dukeje emodukare tugimijerado ema rugadu.
source: Dukodire iwo tawie. Boe emago pegamode Jesus ji mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari koia karega ure egodo aino. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode boe eruduwado dukeje emode tugimijerado Jesusce. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari umodukare boe eruduwado dukeje emodukare tugimijerado ema rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure mitotu je. Emare umode mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu tumaragodaeji. Mare ure maku boe etaiwu boe emaragodae umode tu tu tuginai pubiji.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure mitotu je. Emare umode mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu tumaragodaeji. Mare ure maku boe etaiwu boe emaragodae umode tu tu tuginai pubiji.

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe emaragodae ure tuginai pubiji. Mare tuwo tugera maku puaire eroino tuwo pu mearutoru rakado Jesus ji rugadu. Jesus jire eiamedu boe emearutorure tuwo nowu tumaragodae towuje.
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe emaragodae ure tuginai pubiji. Mare tuwo tugera maku puaire eroino tuwo pu mearutoru rakado Jesus ji rugadu. Jesus jire eiamedu boe emearutorure tuwo nowu tumaragodae towuje.

b: Boe eruduwamodukare tuwo ia tumedage emaragodae towuje. Mare Pao Kurirewu koiare umode boe eiamedu boe eroiwado tu tu ture maku etaiwu emaragodae jamedu boe ji.
source: Boe eruduwamodukare tuwo ia tumedage emaragodae towuje. Mare Pao Kurirewu koiare umode boe eiamedu boe eroiwado tu tu ture maku etaiwu emaragodae jamedu boe ji.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boebo dukodire umode eiamedu boe edo turugadu tumaragodaeji. Mare umode maku etaiwu emaragodae umode tuginai tu tu pubiji. Mare ewo boe pemegado puai du bagaire nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari roino.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boebo dukodire umode eiamedu boe edo turugadu tumaragodaeji. Mare umode maku etaiwu emaragodae umode tuginai tu tu pubiji. Mare ewo boe pemegado puai du bagaire nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari roino.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode iage edo turugadu tuwo etaora pemegado enogituwawo boe ji. Ainore nouge emaragodaere tu tu je. Iagere Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode edo turugadu tuwo boe eruduwa kurido rugadu. Dukodire care nouge emode tugera maku tumedage mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai nowu tuioruduware jiboe tabo.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode iage edo turugadu tuwo etaora pemegado enogituwawo boe ji. Ainore nouge emaragodaere tu tu je. Iagere Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode edo turugadu tuwo boe eruduwa kurido rugadu. Dukodire care nouge emode tugera maku tumedage mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai nowu tuioruduware jiboe tabo.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure mitotu je rugadu. Mare ure ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu emearutoru rakawo rugadu. Dukodire nouge emode mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emearutoru rakado Jesus ji rugadu tu tu je. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu ewo kogodurewuge epemegago. Dukodire nouge emode boe epemegago rugadu tu tu je. Ainore emaragodaere.

Dukodire nouge emode boe epemegago rugadu tu tu je. Ainore emaragodaere.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu ero rakawo. Umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu emagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu eruduwawo tumaragodae remawu ji. Eruduwawo bopere ure ia boe emaragodae maku etai pagatu je jamedu. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu emagowo boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji taci je. Umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu emearuduwo boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji ewo boe eruduwado nowu ewadaru ji rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu ero rakawo. Umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu emagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai. Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu emagowo boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji taci je. Umode ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge edo turugadu emearuduwo boe tuginaiwuge ewadaru ji ewo boe eruduwado nowu ewadaru ji rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure mitotu je. Umode mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe edo turugadu tumaragodaeji. Mare ure maku etaiwu boe emaragodae mode tu tu tuginai pubiji. Emare joruduware ture maku etaiwu emaragodaeji.
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure mitotu je. Umode mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe edo turugadu tumaragodaeji. Mare ure maku etaiwu boe emaragodae mode tu tu tuginai pubiji. Emare joruduware ture maku etaiwu emaragodaeji.

b: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Ere Tudo Nono Tuwobere Pugi Dumogadure
source: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Ere Tudo Nono Tuwobere Pugi Dumogadure

b: Boe ekanare pudogi. Boe epogorare pudogi. Boe etaorare jamedu dukodire boere turugadu. Okware jiboe bokware boewo ema. Birire. Kodure. Okware jiboe bokware. Mearutorure Jesus Cristo jiwuge ere nono boe ekana boe epogora mogadure boe etaora mogadure jamedu. Mare boe ekana boe epogora boe etaora ji karega inagoino. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emaragodae jire inagoino. Emaragodae mode tuginai pubiji. Mare ere nono tuwobenure pugi dumogadure tumearutorure Jesus jitu tabo. Dujire inagoino jamedu.
source: Boe ekanare pudogi. Boe epogorare pudogi. Boe etaorare jamedu dukodire boere turugadu. Okware jiboe bokware boewo ema. Birire. Kodure. Okware jiboe bokware. Mearutorure Jesus Cristo jiwuge ere nono boe ekana boe epogora mogadure boe etaora mogadure jamedu. Mare boe ekana boe epogora boe etaora ji karega inagoino. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emaragodae jire inagoino. Emaragodae mode tuginai pubiji. Mare ere nono tuwobenure pugi dumogadure tumearutorure Jesus jitu tabo. Dujire inagoino jamedu.

Mare pamearutorure Jesus ji dukodire Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure pamearudae maiwu maku pagai tuwo pado nono pawobere pugi dumogadure. Nou Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure mitotu je rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu Tuwari maku paiamedu boe etai.

Metia roiwakare iaboe ji mare ia metia roiware ji. Dukodire mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere tugera maku tu tu puai tumaragodu pemegawo boe etai Pao Kurirewu maragodae jamedu boe ji.

b: Pabogurure pai dukodire pare pagudau areia upodo pabewatabo. Pare nowu pagudau areia upodo pabewatabo upowo nowu pabogurure ceboe tabo.

Boe pemegamode ia pamediaji dukeje paiamedu boe paegaremode apo. Dujire inagoino.

b: Boe etaiwomode pudui espelhoto dukeje erudumode mare erudu arudugodumode boe ji. Pagaiwore Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ji nono boe etaiwore espelhoto dumogadure. Mare espelho ji karega inagoino. b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari umode Pao Kurirewu bataru maku boe etai emagowo ji. Mare nowu makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ewo tuwudugudo tumago tabo nowu bataru ji boe ewiagai.
