Tamugu pemega raido Jesus Cristo apo rugadu.

b: Imearudu kurire tai nono imearudu kurire itorei dumogadure. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tamugu pemegado Jesus Cristo apo. Pamugu pemegamode apo dukeje ema aregodumode dukeje pabagudumodukare ce. Pabogurumodukare. Pamodukare pawiado piji.
source: Imearudu kurire tai nono imearudu kurire itorei dumogadure. Dukodire inagoino tai. Tamugu pemegado Jesus Cristo apo. Pamugu pemegamode apo dukeje ema aregodumode dukeje pabagudumodukare ce. Pabogurumodukare. Pamodukare pawiado piji.

b: Jesus Cristo ro pega bokware rugadu. Taruduware nowu inoduji marigudu. Mare iwo tawie pugeje. Dukodire taruduware Pao Kurirewu ore eroji jamedu. Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ere turo pemegado. Pao Kurirewu ure toredo emage rugadu dukodire eroino.
source: Jesus Cristo ro pega bokware rugadu. Taruduware nowu inoduji marigudu. Mare iwo tawie pugeje. Dukodire taruduware Pao Kurirewu ore eroji jamedu. Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge ere turo pemegado. Pao Kurirewu ure toredo emage rugadu dukodire eroino.

b: Ainore Pao Kurirewu Ore Ere
source: Ainore Pao Kurirewu Ore Ere

b: Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire pai rugadu. Tawiapagado! Mearudu kurire pai dukodire ure toredo pagi. Dukodire makore pai. Akore itorenure tagi. Mare mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge eruduwakare ji dukodire eruduwakare pai jamedu.
source: Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire pai rugadu. Tawiapagado! Mearudu kurire pai dukodire ure toredo pagi. Dukodire makore pai. Akore itorenure tagi. Mare mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge eruduwakare ji dukodire eruduwakare pai jamedu.

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi. Ca Pao Kurirewu orenure pagi mare paruduwakare raga nuba pamode. Jesus Cristo aregodumode dukeje parudumode ji rugadu. Parudumode ji dukeje umode pado nono ture rugadu. Paruduware nowu inoduji rugadu.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi. Ca Pao Kurirewu orenure pagi mare paruduwakare raga nuba pamode. Jesus Cristo aregodumode dukeje parudumode ji rugadu. Parudumode ji dukeje umode pado nono ture rugadu. Paruduware nowu inoduji rugadu.

b: Upagare tumearutoru tabo Jesus Cristo bagaiwuge emode turo pegarewu barigu tubiji turo pemegawo nono Jesus Cristo ro mogadure.
source: Upagare tumearutoru tabo Jesus Cristo bagaiwuge emode turo pegarewu barigu tubiji turo pemegawo nono Jesus Cristo ro mogadure.

b: Boe ero pegamode dukeje emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ure maku boe etaiwu bakaruji. Ca boe ero pegare jiboe jire boe eroino tumearutoru bokware Pao Kurirewu ure maku boe etaiwu bakaru jitu piji.
source: Boe ero pegamode dukeje emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu ure maku boe etaiwu bakaruji. Ca boe ero pegare jiboe jire boe eroino tumearutoru bokware Pao Kurirewu ure maku boe etaiwu bakaru jitu piji.

b: Taruduware Jesus Cristo aregodure tuwo boe ero pegarewu tawuje epiji. Taruduware ema ro pega bokware.
source: Taruduware Jesus Cristo aregodure tuwo boe ero pegarewu tawuje epiji. Taruduware ema ro pega bokware.

b: Dukodire mugu pemegamode Jesus apowu umode turo pegarewu barigu tubiji. Mare ro pegarewuge erudukare Jesus ji. Ro pegarewuge eruduwakare Jesus ji.
source: Dukodire mugu pemegamode Jesus apowu umode turo pegarewu barigu tubiji. Mare ro pegarewuge erudukare Jesus ji. Ro pegarewuge eruduwakare Jesus ji.

b: Batrarodurewuge etaidure tuwo taekiripagado. Tamearutorukaba ei. Imearudu kurire tai nono imearudu kurire itore kugurei dumogadure. Boe ero pemegamode dukeje epemegare nono Jesus pemegare dumogadure.
source: Batrarodurewuge etaidure tuwo taekiripagado. Tamearutorukaba ei. Imearudu kurire tai nono imearudu kurire itore kugurei dumogadure. Boe ero pemegamode dukeje epemegare nono Jesus pemegare dumogadure.

b: Ro pegarewuge emearutorure bope doge eimijeraji. Ekimijeranure ema rugadu. Dukodire ero pegare rugadu. Bope doge eimijera ro pega kurire boe ji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ure moto to dukeje nowu bope doge eimijera ro pegare tu tu je rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu aregodure tuwo bope doge erore jiboe akedudo.
source: Ro pegarewuge emearutorure bope doge eimijeraji. Ekimijeranure ema rugadu. Dukodire ero pegare rugadu. Bope doge eimijera ro pega kurire boe ji rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ure moto to dukeje nowu bope doge eimijera ro pegare tu tu je rugadu. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu aregodure tuwo bope doge erore jiboe akedudo.

b: Pao Kurirewu ore ero pegamode mare ero pegarewu raimodukare Pao Kurirewu mearudae meture etada kodi. Emode turo pegarewu barigu tubiji. Etuonure Pao Kurirewuce dukodire ero pega raimodukare.
source: Pao Kurirewu ore ero pegamode mare ero pegarewu raimodukare Pao Kurirewu mearudae meture etada kodi. Emode turo pegarewu barigu tubiji. Etuonure Pao Kurirewuce dukodire ero pega raimodukare.

b: Ainore taruduware Pao Kurirewu orei. Mare taruduware bope doge eimijera orei jamedu. Ro pegarewugenure emage. Dukodi care taruduware ei. Pao Kurirewu ore karegure emage. Mearudu kuri bokwarewugenure emage. Dukodi care taruduware ei. Pao Kurirewu ore karegure emage. Bope doge eimijera orenure emage.
source: Ainore taruduware Pao Kurirewu orei. Mare taruduware bope doge eimijera orei jamedu. Ro pegarewugenure emage. Dukodi care taruduware ei. Pao Kurirewu ore karegure emage. Mearudu kuri bokwarewugenure emage. Dukodi care taruduware ei. Pao Kurirewu ore karegure emage. Bope doge eimijera orenure emage.

b: Tamearudu Kurido Pui
source: Tamearudu Kurido Pui

b: Tamearudure boeto jiwu bataru reo. Pamearudu kuriwo pai. Ainore awu bataru ure.
source: Tamearudure boeto jiwu bataru reo. Pamearudu kuriwo pai. Ainore awu bataru ure.

b: Parokawo nono imedu Caim ro mogadure. Ema mearutorure bope doge eimijeraji dukodire ure tuwie imedu bito. Mare paga karega. Uwie mearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji turo pemegawo. Mare Caim mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji turo pemegakawo. Dukodire ure tuwie bito.
source: Parokawo nono imedu Caim ro mogadure. Ema mearutorure bope doge eimijeraji dukodire ure tuwie imedu bito. Mare paga karega. Uwie mearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji turo pemegawo. Mare Caim mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu bataru ji turo pemegakawo. Dukodire ure tuwie bito.

b: Imedagenure tagi. Mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge erudu pegamode tai mare tabagudukaba.
source: Imedagenure tagi. Mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge erudu pegamode tai mare tabagudukaba.

b: Mearudu kuri bokwarewuge ere nono birewuge emogadure. Emodukare tudawuje tuwi piji. Mare pagi karega. Marigudu pare nono birewugere jamedu. Mare aino pare pagera ra paro pegarewu piji dukodire pagare nono birewugere pugeje. Pare nono bikarewugere. Boe eruduware nowu inoduji. Pamearudu kurire boe ji dukodire boe eruduware bikarewugenure pagi duji.
source: Mearudu kuri bokwarewuge ere nono birewuge emogadure. Emodukare tudawuje tuwi piji. Mare pagi karega. Marigudu pare nono birewugere jamedu. Mare aino pare pagera ra paro pegarewu piji dukodire pagare nono birewugere pugeje. Pare nono bikarewugere. Boe eruduware nowu inoduji. Pamearudu kurire boe ji dukodire boe eruduware bikarewugenure pagi duji.

b: Mare jorudu pegare boeiwuge ere nono ure boe ewidowuge emogadure rugadu. Taruduware. Ure boe ewidowuge ewimode rugadu. Eewodumodukare pugeje. Emugumodukare Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu.
source: Mare jorudu pegare boeiwuge ere nono ure boe ewidowuge emogadure rugadu. Taruduware. Ure boe ewidowuge ewimode rugadu. Eewodumodukare pugeje. Emugumodukare Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu.

b: Jesus Cristo ure tumagu paro pegarewu morice. Ainore paromode pamearudu kuriwo boe ji. Paromode nono Jesus ro mogadure. Pamode pamagu pawo pamedia udo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.
source: Jesus Cristo ure tumagu paro pegarewu morice. Ainore paromode pamearudu kuriwo boe ji. Paromode nono Jesus ro mogadure. Pamode pamagu pawo pamedia udo tuginorudo boe pegarewu piji.

b: Oe kurirewu jorudumode ia marenaruji. Mare ukare iaboe maku ai. Nono nowu oe kurirewu makomode tumearudu kurie Pao Kurirewu ji mare pagare akoino. Ukare boe maku marenaru ai.
source: Oe kurirewu jorudumode ia marenaruji. Mare ukare iaboe maku ai. Nono nowu oe kurirewu makomode tumearudu kurie Pao Kurirewu ji mare pagare akoino. Ukare boe maku marenaru ai.

b: Imearudu kurire tai nono imearudu kurire itore kugurei dumogadure. Tamearudu kurido boe ji taro pemegarewu tabo. Tu tawadaru tabo karega. Taro tabo tamode tamearudu kurido boe ji. Taro udo nono Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu mako mogadure. Nono care tamearudu kurimode boe ji rugadu.
source: Imearudu kurire tai nono imearudu kurire itore kugurei dumogadure. Tamearudu kurido boe ji taro pemegarewu tabo. Tu tawadaru tabo karega. Taro tabo tamode tamearudu kurido boe ji. Taro udo nono Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu mako mogadure. Nono care tamearudu kurimode boe ji rugadu.

b: Boe Epogurumodukare Tumagowo Pao Kurirewu ji
source: Boe Epogurumodukare Tumagowo Pao Kurirewu ji

b: Pamearudu kurimode pui dukeje paruduwamode pamearutorure jiboe ji. Pao Kurirewu jire pamearutorure. Boe remawu jire pamearutorure. Pamearutorumode ji rugadu dukeje pamearudu kurimode pui. Nono pabogurumodukare pamagowo Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Pamearudu kurimode pui dukeje paruduwamode pamearutorure jiboe ji. Pao Kurirewu jire pamearutorure. Boe remawu jire pamearutorure. Pamearutorumode ji rugadu dukeje pamearudu kurimode pui. Nono pabogurumodukare pamagowo Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Pawiagoromode paro pegarewu ji dukeje nowu paro pegarewu umode pagiarigo. Dukodi care pamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Ema kurire paiamedu boe kori. Emare joruduware boe jamedu boe ji. Pamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje umode pagiarigodu barigu pabiji.
source: Pawiagoromode paro pegarewu ji dukeje nowu paro pegarewu umode pagiarigo. Dukodi care pamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Ema kurire paiamedu boe kori. Emare joruduware boe jamedu boe ji. Pamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje umode pagiarigodu barigu pabiji.

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi rugadu. Care pawiagoromode paro pegarewu ji dukeje pamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukejere pabogurumodukare pamagowo Pao Kurirewu ji pugeje.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi rugadu. Care pawiagoromode paro pegarewu ji dukeje pamearutoruwo tu Pao Kurirewu ji. Dukejere pabogurumodukare pamagowo Pao Kurirewu ji pugeje.

b: Pamearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje umode pamagore bagaiboe maku pagai. Paromode aidure jiboe ji dukeje umode pamagore bagaiboe maku pagai. Ainore paruduwamode ore remawugenure pagi duji. Ainore pabogurumodukare pamagowo Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Pamearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje umode pamagore bagaiboe maku pagai. Paromode aidure jiboe ji dukeje umode pamagore bagaiboe maku pagai. Ainore paruduwamode ore remawugenure pagi duji. Ainore pabogurumodukare pamagowo Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Emare makore pai pamearutoruwo Tonaregedu Jesus Cristoji. Makore pai pamearudu kuriwo pui. Ainore Jesus Cristo makore pai jamedu.
source: Emare makore pai pamearutoruwo Tonaregedu Jesus Cristoji. Makore pai pamearudu kuriwo pui. Ainore Jesus Cristo makore pai jamedu.

b: Pamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje pamugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo. Pao Kurirewu mugu pemegamode pagabo jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ure Tuwari maku mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe etai. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojemode pagabo dukeje paruduwamode Pao Kurirewu mugure pagabo duji rugadu.
source: Pamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji dukeje pamugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo. Pao Kurirewu mugu pemegamode pagabo jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ure Tuwari maku mearutorure puduiwuge eiamedu boe etai. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojemode pagabo dukeje paruduwamode Pao Kurirewu mugure pagabo duji rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Ukare Nono Bopere
source: Pao Kurirewu Uwari Ukare Nono Bopere

b: Imearudu kurire jiwuge imedagenure tagi. Tamearutorukaba kuri aino boe eiamedu boe ji. Taipaga pemegado ewadaru ji jao ewadaru umode nono Pao Kurirewu batarure dubagai. Batrarodurewuge emagare kodire inagoino. Ere tumaedo moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe ekiripagado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwuge imedagenure tagi. Tamearutorukaba kuri aino boe eiamedu boe ji. Taipaga pemegado ewadaru ji jao ewadaru umode nono Pao Kurirewu batarure dubagai. Batrarodurewuge emagare kodire inagoino. Ere tumaedo moto jamedu boe parugajeje tuwo boe ekiripagado Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu piji.

b: Ainore taruduwamode Pao Kurirewu Uwari bataru remawu ji. Ia imedu akore Jesus Cristo aregoduie baru piji tuwo imedudo pudumi woe moto keje du nowu imedu apore nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere.
source: Ainore taruduwamode Pao Kurirewu Uwari bataru remawu ji. Ia imedu akore Jesus Cristo aregoduie baru piji tuwo imedudo pudumi woe moto keje du nowu imedu apore nowu Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere.

b: Mare ia imedu akomode Jesus aregodukaie baru piji. Akomode imedu nuie ema tu rugadu. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojekare nowu imedu apo. Bope rakojere apo. Urugodure Jesus jiwu bope doge eimijera ure nowu bope maku nowu imedu ai. Marigudu tamearudure nowu urugodure Jesus jiwu aregodumoduie. Ca aregodure marigudu. Rakojere woe moto keje rugadu.
source: Mare ia imedu akomode Jesus aregodukaie baru piji. Akomode imedu nuie ema tu rugadu. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojekare nowu imedu apo. Bope rakojere apo. Urugodure Jesus jiwu bope doge eimijera ure nowu bope maku nowu imedu ai. Marigudu tamearudure nowu urugodure Jesus jiwu aregodumoduie. Ca aregodure marigudu. Rakojere woe moto keje rugadu.

b: Mare tagi Pao Kurirewu utugaregenure tagi. Tare nono itore emogadure. Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere tagabo. Bope doge eragojere mearutorukare Jesus jiwugebo. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakare bope doge eiamedu boe ekori. Ca iage egore tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare ewadrarodunure. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure taragado tamearutorukawo nowu batrarodurewuge ji. Ca tamearutorukare ei rugadu.
source: Mare tagi Pao Kurirewu utugaregenure tagi. Tare nono itore emogadure. Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakojere tagabo. Bope doge eragojere mearutorukare Jesus jiwugebo. Mare Pao Kurirewu Uwari rakare bope doge eiamedu boe ekori. Ca iage egore tumagoie Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare ewadrarodunure. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure taragado tamearutorukawo nowu batrarodurewuge ji. Ca tamearutorukare ei rugadu.

b: Awu batrarodurewuge emagore tu mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge emearudae ji. Emagore tu mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge ero jiboe ji. Dukeje mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge emearutorure nowu batrarodurewuge ewadaru ji rugadu emearutorukare Jesus ji kodi.
source: Awu batrarodurewuge emagore tu mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge emearudae ji. Emagore tu mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge ero jiboe ji. Dukeje mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge emearutorure nowu batrarodurewuge ewadaru ji rugadu emearutorukare Jesus ji kodi.

b: Mare pagi pamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Joruduware Pao Kurirewu jiwu biapagamode awu iwadaru ji. Mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwu biapagamodukare awu iwadaru ji. Ainore parore paruduwawo boe jokodurewu Pao Kurirewu Uwariji. Ainore parore paruduwawo batrarodurewu bope dogei.
source: Mare pagi pamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu. Joruduware Pao Kurirewu jiwu biapagamode awu iwadaru ji. Mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwu biapagamodukare awu iwadaru ji. Ainore parore paruduwawo boe jokodurewu Pao Kurirewu Uwariji. Ainore parore paruduwawo batrarodurewu bope dogei.

b: Pao Kurirewu Mearudu Kurire Boei Rugadu
source: Pao Kurirewu Mearudu Kurire Boei Rugadu

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu umode pamearudu kurido pui. Ca pamearudu kuriwo pui rugadu. Pao Kurirewu orenure tagi dukeje tamearudu kurimode boe ji. Taruduware Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje tamearudu kurimode boe ji.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu umode pamearudu kurido pui. Ca pamearudu kuriwo pui rugadu. Pao Kurirewu orenure tagi dukeje tamearudu kurimode boe ji. Taruduware Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje tamearudu kurimode boe ji.

b: Mare joruduwakare Pao Kurirewu jiwu mearudu kurimodukare boe ji. Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji marigudu. Boe emearudu kurimodukare boe ji dukodire boe eruduware nowu boei, nowu boe eruduwakare Pao Kurirewu jituji.
source: Mare joruduwakare Pao Kurirewu jiwu mearudu kurimodukare boe ji. Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji marigudu. Boe emearudu kurimodukare boe ji dukodire boe eruduware nowu boei, nowu boe eruduwakare Pao Kurirewu jituji.

b: Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji rugadu. Dukodire ure tonaregedu mitodu rawuje pagae moto ka paro pegarewu morice pamugu pemegawo Pao Kurirewu apo du akedukawo. Dukodire paruduware Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji duji.
source: Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji rugadu. Dukodire ure tonaregedu mitodu rawuje pagae moto ka paro pegarewu morice pamugu pemegawo Pao Kurirewu apo du akedukawo. Dukodire paruduware Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji duji.

b: Ainore ure rugadu. Emare mearudu kurire boe ji boeto ji. Pagi karega. Paruduwakare pamearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Emare mearudu kurire pai boeto ji. Dukodire ure tonaregedu rawuje mato moto ka bitoduwo paro pegarewu morice tuwiagoduwo paro pegarewu piji.
source: Ainore ure rugadu. Emare mearudu kurire boe ji boeto ji. Pagi karega. Paruduwakare pamearudu kuriwo Pao Kurirewu ji. Emare mearudu kurire pai boeto ji. Dukodire ure tonaregedu rawuje mato moto ka bitoduwo paro pegarewu morice tuwiagoduwo paro pegarewu piji.

b: Ainore Pao Kurirewu rore. Mearudu kurire pai rugadu. Dukodire pamearudu kuriwo pui jamedu. Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi.
source: Ainore Pao Kurirewu rore. Mearudu kurire pai rugadu. Dukodire pamearudu kuriwo pui jamedu. Imearudu kurire jiwu imedagenure tagi.

b: Boe erudukare Pao Kurirewu ji mare pamearudu kurimode pui dukeje Pao Kurirewu mugu pemegamode pagabo. Umode pamearudu kurido pui rugadu.
source: Boe erudukare Pao Kurirewu ji mare pamearudu kurimode pui dukeje Pao Kurirewu mugu pemegamode pagabo. Umode pamearudu kurido pui rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure Tuwari maku pagai. Dukodire paruduware pamugu pemegare apo duji. Paruduware mugu pemegare pagabo duji jamedu.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure Tuwari maku pagai. Dukodire paruduware pamugu pemegare apo duji. Paruduware mugu pemegare pagabo duji jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure tonaregedu rawuje boe etae. Cerudure ji rugadu. Dukodire cere boe ewie aino. Umode boe ekinorudowunure nowu Pao Kurirewu onaregeduce rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure tonaregedu rawuje boe etae. Cerudure ji rugadu. Dukodire cere boe ewie aino. Umode boe ekinorudowunure nowu Pao Kurirewu onaregeduce rugadu.

b: Pamagomode boe ewiagai Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu nuie Jesusce dukeje pamugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo. Pao Kurirewu mugu pemegamode pagabo jamedu.
source: Pamagomode boe ewiagai Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu nuie Jesusce dukeje pamugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo. Pao Kurirewu mugu pemegamode pagabo jamedu.

b: Pagi paruduware Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire pai rugadu. Dukodire pabagudukare Pao Kurirewuce. Pabogurukare pamagowo ji. Ainore Pao Kurirewu ure. Mearudu kurirewunure ema rugadu. Dukodire pamearudu kuri raimode boe ji dukeje pamugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo. Pao Kurirewu mugu pemegamode pagabo jamedu.
source: Pagi paruduware Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire pai rugadu. Dukodire pabagudukare Pao Kurirewuce. Pabogurukare pamagowo ji. Ainore Pao Kurirewu ure. Mearudu kurirewunure ema rugadu. Dukodire pamearudu kuri raimode boe ji dukeje pamugu pemegamode Pao Kurirewu apo. Pao Kurirewu mugu pemegamode pagabo jamedu.

b: Ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe erududo turo pegarewu moriji. Mare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emoridodure marigudu dukodire epogurumodukare nowu roino jiwu meri keje. Pamearutorure Jesus ji. Dukodire umode pamearudu kurido pudui rugadu. Umode pamearudu kurido boe ji jamedu. Dukodire paromode boe ji nono Jesus Cristo ro mogadure.
source: Ia meri keje Pao Kurirewu umode boe erududo turo pegarewu moriji. Mare mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emoridodure marigudu dukodire epogurumodukare nowu roino jiwu meri keje. Pamearutorure Jesus ji. Dukodire umode pamearudu kurido pudui rugadu. Umode pamearudu kurido boe ji jamedu. Dukodire paromode boe ji nono Jesus Cristo ro mogadure.

b: Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire jiwu pagudumodukare Pao Kurirewu rore pudui jiboe ji. Pao Kurirewu umode pamearudu kurido rugadu dukeje umode pabagudu bokwado. Mare joruduwakare Pao Kurirewu jiwu pagudure rugadu. Pagudure turo pegarewu jitu kodi. Mearudu kurimodukare rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire jiwu pagudumodukare Pao Kurirewu rore pudui jiboe ji. Pao Kurirewu umode pamearudu kurido rugadu dukeje umode pabagudu bokwado. Mare joruduwakare Pao Kurirewu jiwu pagudure rugadu. Pagudure turo pegarewu jitu kodi. Mearudu kurimodukare rugadu.

b: Ca Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji boeto ji dukodire pamearudu kuriwo ji jamedu. Pamearudu kuriwo boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu.
source: Ca Pao Kurirewu mearudu kurire boe ji boeto ji dukodire pamearudu kuriwo ji jamedu. Pamearudu kuriwo boe eiamedu boe ji rugadu.

b: Pamagomode pamearudu kurie Pao Kurirewu ji mare parudu pegare boe ji dukejere pawadrarodunure. Pagaidu pemegamodukare parudure jiwu boe ji dukeje pagaidu pemegamodukare parudukare jiwu Pao Kurirewu ji.
source: Pamagomode pamearudu kurie Pao Kurirewu ji mare parudu pegare boe ji dukejere pawadrarodunure. Pagaidu pemegamodukare parudure jiwu boe ji dukeje pagaidu pemegamodukare parudukare jiwu Pao Kurirewu ji.

b: Jesus Cristo makore pai rugadu. Pamearudu kuriwo boe ji. Pamearudu kurimode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje pamearudu kurimode boe eiamedu boe ji.
source: Jesus Cristo makore pai rugadu. Pamearudu kuriwo boe ji. Pamearudu kurimode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje pamearudu kurimode boe eiamedu boe ji.

b: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Eromodukare Ro Pegarewuge Emearudae Jiboe ji
source: Mearutorure Jesus Jiwuge Eromodukare Ro Pegarewuge Emearudae Jiboe ji

b: Umode boe ekinorudowunure Jesusce rugadu. Mearutorure nowu inodu jiwuge Pao Kurirewu orenure emage jamedu. Boe emearudu kurire boe ji dukeje emearudu kurimode nowu boe etorei jamedu.
source: Umode boe ekinorudowunure Jesusce rugadu. Mearutorure nowu inodu jiwuge Pao Kurirewu orenure emage jamedu. Boe emearudu kurire boe ji dukeje emearudu kurimode nowu boe etorei jamedu.

b: Pamearudu kurimode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje pamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Paromode aino dukeje paruduware pamearudu kurire Pao Kurirewu orei jamedu.
source: Pamearudu kurimode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje pamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Paromode aino dukeje paruduware pamearudu kurire Pao Kurirewu orei jamedu.

b: Pamearudu kurire Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje pamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ore ewiapagamodukare ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewuji. Ca Pao Kurirewu orenure pagi dukodire boe rakakare pai pamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Paromodukare ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewu ji pamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji dukodi.
source: Pamearudu kurire Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje pamearutorumode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ore ewiapagamodukare ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewuji. Ca Pao Kurirewu orenure pagi dukodire boe rakakare pai pamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Paromodukare ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewu ji pamearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji dukodi.

b: Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure Jesusce. Tu nowu mearutorure nowu inodu jiwu biapagamodukare ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewu ji tu rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu onaregedunure Jesusce. Tu nowu mearutorure nowu inodu jiwu biapagamodukare ro pegarewuge emearudae pegarewu ji tu rugadu.

b: Ainore Boe Eruduware Jesus ji
source: Ainore Boe Eruduware Jesus ji

b: Jesus aregodure moto ka dukeje ao pegododure pobo tabo. Aregodure moto ka dukeje bire. Ure tugu maku boe etai kodire bire. Pao Kurirewu Uwari akoino jamedu. Emare batrarodumodukare
source: Jesus aregodure moto ka dukeje ao pegododure pobo tabo. Aregodure moto ka dukeje bire. Ure tugu maku boe etai kodire bire. Pao Kurirewu Uwari akoino jamedu. Emare batrarodumodukare

b: Jesus ao pegododure pobo tabo boe eruduwawo Jesus ure pudumi duji. Ure tugu redo boe eruduwawo Jesus ure pudumi duji. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure boe ewie Jesus ure ema duji.
source: Jesus ao pegododure pobo tabo boe eruduwawo Jesus ure pudumi duji. Ure tugu redo boe eruduwawo Jesus ure pudumi duji. Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure boe ewie Jesus ure ema duji.

b: Pamearutorumode boe ewadaru ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu bataru jetorore boe ewadaru kori. Emare makore tonaregedu jiboe ji.
source: Pamearutorumode boe ewadaru ji. Mare Pao Kurirewu bataru jetorore boe ewadaru kori. Emare makore tonaregedu jiboe ji.

b: Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru meture mearutorure onaregedu jiwuge ebo. Mare mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge egore batrarodunuie. Emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu makore tonaregedu jiboe jituji.
source: Nou Pao Kurirewu bataru meture mearutorure onaregedu jiwuge ebo. Mare mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu jiwuge egore batrarodunuie. Emearutorukare Pao Kurirewu makore tonaregedu jiboe jituji.

b: Pao Kurirewu onaregedu bire paro pegarewu morice dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode pamugudo pudabo. Du akedumodukare.
source: Pao Kurirewu onaregedu bire paro pegarewu morice dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode pamugudo pudabo. Du akedumodukare.

b: Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu jiwu mugumode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Mare nowu mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu jiwu mugumodukare Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu.
source: Mearutorure Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu jiwu mugumode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu. Du akedumodukare rugadu. Mare nowu mearutorukare Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu jiwu mugumodukare Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu.

b: Mugure Pao Kurirewu Apowu Akedumodukare
source: Mugure Pao Kurirewu Apowu Akedumodukare

b: Inure awu atugoreboe maku tagai taruduwawo tamugumode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu. Nou tamugure Pao Kurirewu apo du akedumodukare rugadu. Tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu Onaregeduji dukeje tamugumode apo rugadu jii toro rugadu. Aino care taruduware awu ire tawie jiboe ji rugadu.
source: Inure awu atugoreboe maku tagai taruduwawo tamugumode Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu. Nou tamugure Pao Kurirewu apo du akedumodukare rugadu. Tamearutorure Pao Kurirewu Onaregeduji dukeje tamugumode apo rugadu jii toro rugadu. Aino care taruduware awu ire tawie jiboe ji rugadu.

b: Pamagomode Pao Kurirewu bagai pagaidure jiboe bagai Pao kurirewu mearudae pemegarewu tabo dukeje mearudumode rugadu. Dukodire pabogurumodukare pamagowo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.
source: Pamagomode Pao Kurirewu bagai pagaidure jiboe bagai Pao kurirewu mearudae pemegarewu tabo dukeje mearudumode rugadu. Dukodire pabogurumodukare pamagowo Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.

b: Pamagomode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje mearudumode pai rugadu. Paruduware nowu inoduji dukodire paruduware umode pamagore bagaiboe maku pagai rugadu duji.
source: Pamagomode Pao Kurirewu ji dukeje mearudumode pai rugadu. Paruduware nowu inoduji dukodire paruduware umode pamagore bagaiboe maku pagai rugadu duji.

b: Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu ro pegamode dukeje tamagodo baru to nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwu paru tabo. Pao Kurirewu biagodumode boe ero pegare jiboe piji rugadu. Biagodure piji dukeje nowu boe butugugodure Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu. Mare ia boe ero pegare jiboe ure tuginai. Du pijire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare rugadu. Tamagokaba baru to awu rore aino jiwu paru tabo.
source: Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwu ro pegamode dukeje tamagodo baru to nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwu paru tabo. Pao Kurirewu biagodumode boe ero pegare jiboe piji rugadu. Biagodure piji dukeje nowu boe butugugodure Pao Kurirewu apo rugadu. Mare ia boe ero pegare jiboe ure tuginai. Du pijire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare rugadu. Tamagokaba baru to awu rore aino jiwu paru tabo.

b: Boe ero pegamode pui. Mare paga karega Pao Kurirewu jire eroino turo pegarewu jamedu boe tabo. Mare ia boe ero pegare jiboe ure tuginai. Du pijire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare rugadu.
source: Boe ero pegamode pui. Mare paga karega Pao Kurirewu jire eroino turo pegarewu jamedu boe tabo. Mare ia boe ero pegare jiboe ure tuginai. Du pijire Pao Kurirewu biagodumodukare rugadu.

b: Paruduware Pao Kurirewu ore ero pega raimodukare rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu jetu pemegare ei. Bope doge eimijera umodukare tugera to ei.
source: Paruduware Pao Kurirewu ore ero pega raimodukare rugadu. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu jetu pemegare ei. Bope doge eimijera umodukare tugera to ei.

b: Paruduware Pao Kurirewu utugaregenure pagi duji. Mare Bope Doge Eimijera unure tumearudae maku mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe etai emearutoruwo tu nowu tumearudae pegarewu ji rugadu.
source: Paruduware Pao Kurirewu utugaregenure pagi duji. Mare Bope Doge Eimijera unure tumearudae maku mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge eiamedu boe etai emearutoruwo tu nowu tumearudae pegarewu ji rugadu.

b: Paruduware Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu aregodure rugadu. Emare ure paruduwado. Dukodi care paruduware Pao Kurirewu ji. Boe Remawunure ema. Pamugu pemegare Pao Kurirewu apo. Pamugu pemegare Onaregedu Jesus Cristo apo jamedu. Pao Kurirewu Remawunure ema. Umode pamugudo baru tada pudabo. Du akedumodukare.
source: Paruduware Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu aregodure rugadu. Emare ure paruduwado. Dukodi care paruduware Pao Kurirewu ji. Boe Remawunure ema. Pamugu pemegare Pao Kurirewu apo. Pamugu pemegare Onaregedu Jesus Cristo apo jamedu. Pao Kurirewu Remawunure ema. Umode pamugudo baru tada pudabo. Du akedumodukare.

b: Imearudu kurire tai nono imearudu kurire itorei dumogadure. Dukodire imagore aino tai. Tamearutorukaba bope doge ewadaru ji. Tamearutorukaba boe ewai tadawu santo dogei. Tagaba Pao Kurirewudo emage. Urugadurewu.
source: Imearudu kurire tai nono imearudu kurire itorei dumogadure. Dukodire imagore aino tai. Tamearutorukaba bope doge ewadaru ji. Tamearutorukaba boe ewai tadawu santo dogei. Tagaba Pao Kurirewudo emage. Urugadurewu.

b: João Ure Awu Atugoreboe Towuje Jamedu
source: João Ure Awu Atugoreboe Towuje Jamedu

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeranure imi. Inure awu atugoreboe pemegado iwo maku tagai. Muga pajenure aki. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu ai. Muga paje orenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu tai jamedu. Imearudu kurire tai rugadu. Joruduware boe jokodu jiwuge eiamedu emearudu kurire tai rugadu.
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeranure imi. Inure awu atugoreboe pemegado iwo maku tagai. Muga pajenure aki. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu ai. Muga paje orenure tagi. Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu tai jamedu. Imearudu kurire tai rugadu. Joruduware boe jokodu jiwuge eiamedu emearudu kurire tai rugadu.

b: Paruduware boe remawu ji. Metumode pagabo jii toro. Akedumodukare.
source: Paruduware boe remawu ji. Metumode pagabo jii toro. Akedumodukare.

b: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode turo pemegarewu maku pagai. Okudugodumode pagabo. Umode pabemegado pudui. Umode pabemegado pui. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu Jesus Cristo romode pai nono tuo ro mogadure rugadu. Boe remawu jire eromode pai rugadu. Emearudu kurire pai dutabore eromode aino pai.
source: Dukodire Pao Kurirewu umode turo pemegarewu maku pagai. Okudugodumode pagabo. Umode pabemegado pudui. Umode pabemegado pui. Pao Kurirewu Onaregedu Jesus Cristo romode pai nono tuo ro mogadure rugadu. Boe remawu jire eromode pai rugadu. Emearudu kurire pai dutabore eromode aino pai.

b: Paruduwawo Boe Remawuji. Paruduwawo Pamearudu Kuriwo Boei.
source: Paruduwawo Boe Remawuji. Paruduwawo Pamearudu Kuriwo Boei.

b: Ioruduware ia akore erore nono Boe Remawu ro mogadure. Emearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Dukodire iagarere i rugadu.
source: Ioruduware ia akore erore nono Boe Remawu ro mogadure. Emearutorure Pao Kurirewu bataru ji rugadu. Dukodire iagarere i rugadu.

b: Dukodire inagoino. Pamearudu kuriwo pui. Awu ire maku akaiwu iwadaru maiwu karega. Makudure pagai boeto ji.
source: Dukodire inagoino. Pamearudu kuriwo pui. Awu ire maku akaiwu iwadaru maiwu karega. Makudure pagai boeto ji.

b: Pamearudu kurimode aino pui dukeje pamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu. Emare ure pawie marigudu paiamedu boe pamearudu kuriwo pui rugadu.
source: Pamearudu kurimode aino pui dukeje pamearutoruwo Pao Kurirewu bataru ji jamedu. Emare ure pawie marigudu paiamedu boe pamearudu kuriwo pui rugadu.

b: Ure boe ekiripagadowuge emagare. Eture moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emagere egore Jesus Cristo nuie ia boe etuwarice. Emearudaekare emaie rugadu duji. Ainore etaidure tuwo boe ekiripagado. Erudu pegare Jesus ji.
source: Ure boe ekiripagadowuge emagare. Eture moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Emagere egore Jesus Cristo nuie ia boe etuwarice. Emearudaekare emaie rugadu duji. Ainore etaidure tuwo boe ekiripagado. Erudu pegare Jesus ji.

b: Dukodire taeku jado. Tagaba tagera ra taro pemegarewu piji. Taro pemegarewu moridodumode tagai rugadu.
source: Dukodire taeku jado. Tagaba tagera ra taro pemegarewu piji. Taro pemegarewu moridodumode tagai rugadu.

b: Mearutorukare Jesus Cristo bataru jiwu mearutorumode ia bataru ji jamedu. Mearutorure ia bataru ji pugeje dukeje mugukare Pao Kurirewu apo. Mearutorure tu Jesus Cristo bataru jiwu mugure Pao Kurirewu apo, Onaregedu apo.
source: Mearutorukare Jesus Cristo bataru jiwu mearutorumode ia bataru ji jamedu. Mearutorure ia bataru ji pugeje dukeje mugukare Pao Kurirewu apo. Mearutorure tu Jesus Cristo bataru jiwu mugure Pao Kurirewu apo, Onaregedu apo.

b: Dukodire ia boe etaregodumode tawaito tuwo taruduwado ia bataru ji tuwo taekiripagado dukeje tagaba eremo tawaito. Tagimadukaba ebo.
source: Dukodire ia boe etaregodumode tawaito tuwo taruduwado ia bataru ji tuwo taekiripagado dukeje tagaba eremo tawaito. Tagimadukaba ebo.

b: Mare tagimadumode ebo dukeje tamode tamedagedo emage. Tagimadumode ebo dukeje tamode ero pegarewu maedo. Dukodire inagoino. Tagimadukaba ebo.
source: Mare tagimadumode ebo dukeje tamode tamedagedo emage. Tagimadumode ebo dukeje tamode ero pegarewu maedo. Dukodire inagoino. Tagimadukaba ebo.

b: Bataru Urugadurewu
source: Bataru Urugadurewu

b: Iwadaru kurire imagowo tai. Mare imodukare bu bapera keje. Dukodire itaidure itaregoduwo tagae iwo tawie. Dukejere paegaremode pui rugadu.
source: Iwadaru kurire imagowo tai. Mare imodukare bu bapera keje. Dukodire itaidure itaregoduwo tagae iwo tawie. Dukejere paegaremode pui rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu atuieji marigudu. Nou atuie ore etaidure tugimaduwo tawagai rugadu.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure tugeragu atuieji marigudu. Nou atuie ore etaidure tugimaduwo tawagai rugadu.

b: João Ure Awu Atugoreboe Boigoduwu Towuje
source: João Ure Awu Atugoreboe Boigoduwu Towuje

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeranure imi. Inure awu atugoreboe maku imedu Gaio ai. Imedianure aki. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Imagore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to aparu tabo boe pemegawo ai, akogodukawo. Ioruduware amearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge eimijeranure imi. Inure awu atugoreboe maku imedu Gaio ai. Imedianure aki. Imearudu kurire ai rugadu. Imagore Pao Kurirewu bagai baru to aparu tabo boe pemegawo ai, akogodukawo. Ioruduware amearutorure Pao Kurirewu ji rugadu.
editorial_note: A fonte agrupa os versículos 1–2 sem numeração; faixa inferida na importação.

b: Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etaregodure dukeje ere iwie nuba are duji. Egore amearutoru rakaie boe jokodurewu bataru ji. Dukodire iagarere i rugadu. Ioruduware ai. Are aro pemegado Pao Kurirewu bataru kodaji boe jokodu jire akoino kodi.
source: Ia mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etaregodure dukeje ere iwie nuba are duji. Egore amearutoru rakaie boe jokodurewu bataru ji. Dukodire iagarere i rugadu. Ioruduware ai. Are aro pemegado Pao Kurirewu bataru kodaji boe jokodu jire akoino kodi.

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere nono itore emogadure. Imearudumode ere turo pemegado rugadu dukeje iagaremode i rugadu. Ere turo pemegado nono Pao Kurirewu bataru kodaji. Boe jokodu jire Pao Kurirewu akoino.
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ere nono itore emogadure. Imearudumode ere turo pemegado rugadu dukeje iagaremode i rugadu. Ere turo pemegado nono Pao Kurirewu bataru kodaji. Boe jokodu jire Pao Kurirewu akoino.

b: João Mako Pemegare Imedu Gaioji
source: João Mako Pemegare Imedu Gaioji

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu imedianure aki. Akare akera ra mearutorure Jesus jiwuge epiji awo akera maku etai. Aruduwakare ei mare are akera maku etai.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu imedianure aki. Akare akera ra mearutorure Jesus jiwuge epiji awo akera maku etai. Aruduwakare ei mare are akera maku etai.

b: Etaregodure mato dukeje ere mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewie woe arore jiboe ji. Amearudu kurire ei rugadu. Etumode tuibagi to moto ka dukeje akera maku etai pugeje, aro pemegado ei pugeje etaregodu pemegawo tuwai ka. Pao Kurirewu jakaremode pudui aroino duji.
source: Etaregodure mato dukeje ere mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewie woe arore jiboe ji. Amearudu kurire ei rugadu. Etumode tuibagi to moto ka dukeje akera maku etai pugeje, aro pemegado ei pugeje etaregodu pemegawo tuwai ka. Pao Kurirewu jakaremode pudui aroino duji.

b: Nou are akera maku etaiwuge etu jaere tuwo boe ewie Jesus jiboe ji. Mare etaidukare tuwo boe rakado mearutorukare Jesus jiwugei dukodire ekare tugeragu eiago maku pudai boe ji. Etaiwore tu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai ewo tugera maku pudai tugodu pemegawo.
source: Nou are akera maku etaiwuge etu jaere tuwo boe ewie Jesus jiboe ji. Mare etaidukare tuwo boe rakado mearutorukare Jesus jiwugei dukodire ekare tugeragu eiago maku pudai boe ji. Etaiwore tu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ewagai ewo tugera maku pudai tugodu pemegawo.

b: Mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure pagi. Dukodire pawo pagera maku awu boe etai rugadu. Paroino dutabo pamaragodumode ebo ewo boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire inagoino.
source: Mearutorure Jesus jiwugenure pagi. Dukodire pawo pagera maku awu boe etai rugadu. Paroino dutabo pamaragodumode ebo ewo boe eruduwado Pao Kurirewu bataru ji. Pao Kurirewu bataru remawu jire inagoino.

b: Imedu Diótrefes, Imedu Demétrio Ero Reo
source: Imedu Diótrefes, Imedu Demétrio Ero Reo

b: Ire ia atugoreboe biagarewu maku mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai toro tawai keje. Mare imedu Diótrefes mearutorukare iwadaru ji. Aidure tuwo boe eimijerado pudumi.
source: Ire ia atugoreboe biagarewu maku mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etai toro tawai keje. Mare imedu Diótrefes mearutorukare iwadaru ji. Aidure tuwo boe eimijerado pudumi.

b: Itaregodumode toro dukeje imode boe eruduwado nowu Diótrefes ro pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Emare mako pegare cei boe ewiagai. Jorudu pegare cei dukodire okirure rugadu. Mare ukare turo pegarewu iado raga. Maigodu aino mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etaregodure ae mare ukare tugera upodo ebo, ukare eremo tuwaito. Ure iage edo tugera ra nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge epiji dukodire ekare tugera upodo nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge ebo jamedu. Aidure tuwo etudo Pao Kurirewu uwai piji.
source: Itaregodumode toro dukeje imode boe eruduwado nowu Diótrefes ro pegarewu jamedu boe ji. Emare mako pegare cei boe ewiagai. Jorudu pegare cei dukodire okirure rugadu. Nono ia tagi tamodukare tagera ra tamearutorure i du piji, tamodukare tagera ra taro pemegarewu piji dukeje imode tamugudo imegi boe eimijeragewo tagi jamedu nono imugure Iogwa Kurirewu meki dumogadure. b: Baru Tadawuge Emago Pemegare Jesus ji

b: Je urugu kaworure nono nowu tori pemegarewu jaspe urugu kaworure dumogadure. Urugu kujagure nono nowu tori pemegarewu sardônio urugu kujagure dumogadure. Nou boe eimijera muga ira mugure ia jure kaworurewu oiadada. Nou jure kaworure nono nowu tori pemegarewu esmeralda kaworure dumogadure.

b: Boe eimijerage emuga ira enodo padu kejewure vinte quatro. Etaiare paci nowu boe eimijera kurirewu apo. Boe emugure ewugeje jamedu. Boe eimijeragenure emage jamedu. Ekudau areia kigadu maere ei. Nou etaotadawu tadare nowu tori kuieje doge emedure.

b: Nou boe eimijera kurirewu muga ira pijire boeiaragudu ure tudawuje, boeiaruru ure tudawuje. Nou boe eimijera kurirewu muga ira jokoraire jorugu enodo padu kejewure sete urugure dutabo. Joru mare joru karega. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawugenure emage.

b: Ia barogo aorare nono leão aora mogadure. Ia barogo aorare nono tapira imedu aora mogadure. Ia barogo aorare nono boe etaora mogadure. Ia barogo aorare nono aroeceba koduredu umogadure.

b: Nou barege eigodo oto padu kejeboere seis tu tu ei. Eeku epadure etaora meji pudogi. Nono nowu barege eragodure meri ji boeco ji. egore Pao Kurirewu rore jiboe ure tuginai boe ero pegarewu piji rugadu. Ro pegarewu bokware rugadu. Pao Kurirewu ro rakarewunure ema rugadu. Boe eimijera kurirewunure ema rugadu. Marigudu ure rugadu. Emanure ema rugadu jii aino. Akedumodukare jamedu jii toro rugadu.

Boe emearutoruwo awadaru ji rugadu. Akire are amearudae tawuje awo boe jamedu boe towuje. Amearudae koiare boe etagedukare marigudu.

b: Boe Eimijera Kurirewu Iedure Bapera Upododurewuji
source: Boe Eimijera Kurirewu Iedure Bapera Upododurewuji

b: Iorudure ia bapera upododurewu ji nowu boe eimijera kurirewu iera pemegarewu tada. Bataru padure nowu bapera rugadu boe keje. Selo bekururedu oto padure sete nowu bapera keje. Nou bekuru koiare ure nowu bapera mi.
source: Iorudure ia bapera upododurewu ji nowu boe eimijera kurirewu iera pemegarewu tada. Bataru padure nowu bapera rugadu boe keje. Selo bekururedu oto padure sete nowu bapera keje. Nou bekuru koiare ure nowu bapera mi.

b: Nono iorudure Pao Kurirewu baru tadawu utugare kurirewuji. Kudugodure baru tadawuge ewagai. Akore ioguduba pemegare tuwo nowu bekuru rawuje nowu bapera piji tuwo nowu bapera jado?

b: Mare ia pemegarewu ukare baru tada, ukare moto keje, ukare bope doge eda keje tuwo nowu bapera jado taiwowo nowu baperaji.
source: Mare ia pemegarewu ukare baru tada, ukare moto keje, ukare bope doge eda keje tuwo nowu bapera jado taiwowo nowu baperaji.

b: Dukodire itragudu rakare ikiarigodure dutabo. Ia boe pemegakare tuwo nowu bapera jado, taiwowo nowu baperaji dukodire itragudure aino.

b: Macare ia boe eimijera makore i. Akore akragudukaba. Akaiwodo. Iare mitotu je. Israel doge ekimijera kurirewu Davi onaregedunure ema. Iere Leão. Judá uwobenure ema. Ure boe pegarewuge eraga akedudo. Emare pemegare tuwo nowu bekuru tawuje bapera piji, tuwo nowu bapera jado.

b: Nono iorudure ji. Iere Cordeiro Jesus jamedu. Iorudure nowu boe pegarewuge ere bitowu enoe oiaji ierato, bureto, orebaru kuda. Ure tumagu tuwidoduwo boe ero pegarewu morice kodi. Rakojere nowu boe eimijerage etoiadada, nowu baregere pobe puibiji etoiadada, puredure nowu boe eimijera kurirewu muga iraji. Pao Kurirewu o baru tadawu utugaregere enodo padure sete nono jamedu. Pao Kurirewu ure erududo moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Ere nono nowu Cordeiro Jesus kejewu joku mogadure. Ere nono nowu Cordeiro ukigare.

b: Dukejere nowu baregere pobe puibiji ere tubu jodo nowu Cordeiro Jesus jokorai tugimaduwo apo. Nou boe eimijerage ere tubu jodo jamedu. Nou boe eiamedu boe ekedure tuwabo akorewu arpaji tiamedu boe tabo. Eiamedu boe ekedure ruwobo roguji tiamedu boe tabo. Nou ruwoborogu todure tori kuieje tabo. Nou ruwoborogu tadare roreboe jeture. Nou roreboe uredudure, rore. Mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emagomode baru to Pao Kurirewu bagai dukeje nowu uredudu rutumode.

Ainore arore awo akirodo boe ji Pao Kurirewu ai. Mare boe eiamedu karega emearutorure ai. Moto jamedu boe parugajejewuge iage emearutorumode ai. Mare iage emearutorumodukare ai. Are akeragu ei emearutoruwo ai dukeje are emaragodudo Pao Kurirewu ai ewo boe enomea maku tu tu Pao Kurirewu ai. Boe eimijerage umode emage. Dukodire aki apemegare rugadu awo akeragu nowu baperaji awo nowu bekuru tawuje nowu bapera piji awo jado.

Boe eruduwawo boe eimijera kurirewunure aki duji. Boe eruduwawo araga kodure boe eiamedu boe eraga kori duji. Boe emagowo aruduware boe jamedu boe jituji. Akoe kuriwo boe eiamedu boe ekori du pemegare rugadu.

b: Nono ca iwiapagare pugeje. Nono imearudure baru tadawuge eiamedu boe eraji, moto kejewuge eiamedu boe eraji, pobo tadawuge eiamedu boe eraji, bope doge eda kejewuge eiamedu boe eraji. Boe eiamedu boe eragodure. egore Pamago pemegawo Cordeiro Jesus ji du akedumodukare. Pamago pemegawo nowu Boe Eimijera Kurirewu ji du akedumodukare. Pamode ie kurido. Pamode boe eruduwado raka kodure boe eiamedu boe eraga kori duji. Pamagomode aino jii toro rugadu. Nou pamago akedumodukare rugadu.

b: Nono nowu barege ere pobe puibijidu doge egore awu bataru ure turugadu! Nono nowu boe eimijerage ere tubu jodo mototo Cordeiro Jesus jokorai. Emago pemegare ji rugadu.

b: Cordeiro Jesus Ure Padure Bapera Kejewu Rawuje Bapera Piji
source: Cordeiro Jesus Ure Padure Bapera Kejewu Rawuje Bapera Piji

b: Itaiwore pugeje. Cordeiro Jesus ure nowu padure bapera kejewu boeto jiwu rawuje nowu upododurewu bapera piji. Dukodire care nowu baregere pobe puibijidu epijire ia mako rakare. Akore nono boeiaruru ako mogadure. Akore akarego mato!

b: Ca ia kuwaru ure tudawuje. Nou kuwaru kujagure. Ia boe mugure keje. Nou mugure kuwaru kejewu raka makudure ai rugoduwo boe ji moto keje. Tariga kurirewu makudure ai jamedu. Rugodure boe ji dukeje boe erugodure pui jamedu. Dukodire boe ere pu bito.

b: Imearudure ia akoji nowu baregere pobe puibijidu epiji. Akore boe emodukare tugeragu dieroji tumaragodae morice. Trigo jarogu mode mito meri jamedu ji jii semana ao ka emaragodae morice. Cevada ja mode mito ia padumode kajeje tumoriwo nono nowu trigo mori mogadure. Mare boekaguru mode. Vinho mode jamedu.

Cevada ja mode mito ia padumode kajeje tumoriwo nono nowu trigo mori mogadure. Mare boekaguru mode. Vinho mode jamedu.

b: Nono Cordeiro Jesus ure padure bapera kejewu rawuje nowu bapera piji pugeje. Dukodire care nowu baregere pobe puibijidu epiji ia akore aino pugeje: – Mato!

b: Itaiwore dukeje iorudure ia kuwaru ekurewuji. Mugure kuwaru kejewu iere Birewuge Eimijera. Iaboe kodu puredure nono nowu kuwaru rekodaji. Iere Bope Doge Eda. Nono boe ere pobe puibiji eiamedu boe epijire ia boe ewimode nowu birewuge eimijera koia. Umode boe ewido rugadu. Umode boe erugodudo pui. Umode ewido tuge boe ji koia. Umode jorubo pegarewu jetudo ei ewiwo. Umode barege pegarewuge edo boe ewido jamedu.

Nou kamo kuda iorudure nowu mearutorure Pao Kurirewu jiwuge birewuge ji. Ewidodure emagore Pao Kurirewu bataru ji kodi. Ewidodure ekare tugera ra tumagowo Pao Kurirewu bataru jitu piji. b: Pao Kurirewu Ie Padure Kejewu Boe

b: Tapira Ukiga Oto Padure Sete

b: Nono nowu tapira ukiga padure apowu baru tadawu utugarege ere tudo turugadu tuwo togwa tugu to tapira ukigato.
source: Nono nowu tapira ukiga padure apowu baru tadawu utugarege ere tudo turugadu tuwo togwa tugu to tapira ukigato.

b: Nou boeto jiwu ure togwa tugu to tapira ukigato. Ca bubuture buporira tabo. Bubuture joru tabo jamedu. Nou bubutu buture boe eku tabo jamedu. Ure boebutu kowu. Ure itura kowu. Ukare jamedu boe kowu. Abowure ure kowu.

b: Nono ia utugare baru tadawu ure togwa tugu to tapira ukigato pugeje. Iaboe kurirewu barigudure pobo maerewuto. Ure nono ia tori kurirewure. Mare jorure ji. Nono nowu tori ure turemo nowu poboto dukeje ure pobo maerewu udo nono boe eku mogadure.

b: Nono nowu pobo maerewu tadare ia kare ewire. Iage ewikare. Nou tori ure nowu mugure pobo maerewu kejewu ikarerewuge etagedudo. Mare iage etagedukare.

b: Nono ia utugare baru tadawu ure togwa tugu to tapira ukigato. Ca ia kuieje kurirewu buture baru piji. Jorure ji. Buture poborerewuto moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Buture tori po aogeje moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Nono ia utugare baru tadawu ure togwa tugu to tapira ukigato. Ca ia kuieje kurirewu buture baru piji. Jorure ji. Buture poborerewuto moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Buture tori po aogeje moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Nou kuieje iere jirirewu. Dukodire nowu poborerewu po jirire. Nou tori po jirire. Boe ekudumode ce dukeje ewire. Birewuge emagare pobo pegare dukodi.

b: Nono itaiwore pugeje. Imearudure ia aroeceba akoji. Kodure toro baru otoji. Akore boe pega! Boe pega remawu! Nouia utugarege baru tadawuge emode togwa tugu to tapira ukigato kimo. Ere pobe metia bokware. Emode togwa tugu to tapira ukigato dukeje boe pegamode boe ji rugadu moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Ainore aroeceba akore.

b: Nono ia utugare baru tadawu ure togwa tugu to tapira ukigato. Nono iorudure ia kuiejeji moto keje. Buture baru piji moto ka. Pao Kurirewu ure ia chave maku nowu kuieje ai uwo moto poro kurirewu jado.
source: Nono ia utugare baru tadawu ure togwa tugu to tapira ukigato. Nono iorudure ia kuiejeji moto keje. Buture baru piji moto ka. Pao Kurirewu ure ia chave maku nowu kuieje ai uwo moto poro kurirewu jado.

b: Nou kuieje ure nowu moto poro kurirewu jado dukeje jeredudure rugadu. Nou jeredudu ure nono ia joru kurirewu uredudu mogadure. Nou moto poro pijiwu jeredudu ure meri joku bokwado.
source: Nou kuieje ure nowu moto poro kurirewu jado dukeje jeredudure rugadu. Nou jeredudu ure nono ia joru kurirewu uredudu mogadure. Nou moto poro pijiwu jeredudu ure meri joku bokwado.

b: Nono kitariga doge ere turawuje nowu jeredudu piji moto ka. Pao Kurirewu ure edo tudugo to boe ji nono betaga doge ero mogadure.
source: Nono kitariga doge ere turawuje nowu jeredudu piji moto ka. Pao Kurirewu ure edo tudugo to boe ji nono betaga doge ero mogadure.

b: Makore ei ekawo boebutu ko, iguru aru ko. Mare etaiwowo Pao Kurirewu ie padukare eri kejewu boe ewagai tuwo tudugo to ei nono betaga doge ero mogadure.
source: Makore ei ekawo boebutu ko, iguru aru ko. Mare etaiwowo Pao Kurirewu ie padukare eri kejewu boe ewagai tuwo tudugo to ei nono betaga doge ero mogadure.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure nowu kitariga doge erodo aino ei. Mare ekawo boe ewido mare tu etugowo korire ei rugadu. Ariwo ikera aboudure dukeje koriwo nono ia betaga kori mogadure.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure nowu kitariga doge erodo aino ei. Mare ekawo boe ewido mare tu etugowo korire ei rugadu. Ariwo ikera aboudure dukeje koriwo nono ia betaga kori mogadure.

b: Nou kitariga doge etugo korire nowu boe ji dure arire ikera aboudure. Dukejere nowu ere tudugo towu boe etaidure tuwiwo rugadu kori rakare kodi. Mare ewimodukare. Etaidure tuwo tuwido mare eroiwakare tuwo tuwido.
source: Nou kitariga doge etugo korire nowu boe ji dure arire ikera aboudure. Dukejere nowu ere tudugo towu boe etaidure tuwiwo rugadu kori rakare kodi. Mare ewimodukare. Etaidure tuwo tuwido mare eroiwakare tuwo tuwido.

b: Nou kitariga doge ere nono kuwaru dogere. Etaora kejere ia tori kuiejerewu pemegarewu padure. Jere nono boe ere.
source: Nou kitariga doge ere nono kuwaru dogere. Etaora kejere ia tori kuiejerewu pemegarewu padure. Jere nono boe ere.

b: Etao ure nono areme etao mogadure. Ore nono adugo o mogadure.
source: Etao ure nono areme etao mogadure. Ore nono adugo o mogadure.

b: Iaboe padure emorora keje. Ure nono meriri rakarewu mogadure. Eigodo jarurure nono kuwaru doge ere tumugudo kejewu imaridorewurogu jaruru rakare dumogadure. Marigudu boe erugodure pui nowu imaridorewurogu tabo. Nou imaridorewurogu re rakare dukeje jaruru rakare.
source: Iaboe padure emorora keje. Ure nono meriri rakarewu mogadure. Eigodo jarurure nono kuwaru doge ere tumugudo kejewu imaridorewurogu jaruru rakare dumogadure. Marigudu boe erugodure pui nowu imaridorewurogu tabo. Nou imaridorewurogu re rakare dukeje jaruru rakare.

b: Nou kitariga doge eto ure nono betaga doge eto mogadure. Nou eto tabore emode boe etogorido arimode ikera aboudure togorire boe ji dutabo.
source: Nou kitariga doge eto ure nono betaga doge eto mogadure. Nou eto tabore emode boe etogorido arimode ikera aboudure togorire boe ji dutabo.

b: Nou kitariga doge eimijera kurirewure. Emare jeture nowu moto poro kurirewu ji kodire eimijeranure ema. Ioruduware ieji. Israel doge ewadaru tabo iere “Abadom”. Grécia kejewuge ewadaru tabo iere “Apolião”. Boe ewadaru tabo egore boe Etagedudowu Epanure ema.
source: Nou kitariga doge eimijera kurirewure. Emare jeture nowu moto poro kurirewu ji kodire eimijeranure ema. Ioruduware ieji. Israel doge ewadaru tabo iere “Abadom”. Grécia kejewuge ewadaru tabo iere “Apolião”. Boe ewadaru tabo egore boe Etagedudowu Epanure ema.

b: Ca boe pegarewu boeto jiwu akedure. Mare boe pegarewu kimomode dure pobe.
source: Ca boe pegarewu boeto jiwu akedure. Mare boe pegarewu kimomode dure pobe.

b: Nono ia utugare baru tadawu ure togwa tugu to tapira ukigato. Ca nowu Pao Kurirewu o tori kuiejerewu kamo pijire imearudure ia boe emagoji.
source: Nono ia utugare baru tadawu ure togwa tugu to tapira ukigato. Ca nowu Pao Kurirewu o tori kuiejerewu kamo pijire imearudure ia boe emagoji.

b: Makore nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji. Akore bope dogere pobe puibiji. Ekogudodure. Epuredure Eufrates poji. Ca ekiwuje etuwo.
source: Makore nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawuji. Akore bope dogere pobe puibiji. Ekogudodure. Epuredure Eufrates poji. Ca ekiwuje etuwo.

b: Pao Kurirewu ure ekogudo marigudu etukawo nowu meri aregodure du otodai. Du aino care nowu utugare baru tadawu ure nowu bope doge ekiwuje rugadu. Nono eture. Ere turugadu tuwo boe ewido. Ere bitowuge emagare moto jamedu boe parugajeje.
source: Pao Kurirewu ure ekogudo marigudu etukawo nowu meri aregodure du otodai. Du aino care nowu utugare baru tadawu ure nowu bope doge ekiwuje rugadu. Nono eture. Ere turugadu tuwo boe ewido. Ere bitowuge emagare moto jamedu boe parugajeje.

b: Nou bope doge eno tugobaigarege emagare rugadu. Ere 200,000,000. Ekodure kuwaru dogebo.
source: Nou bope doge eno tugobaigarege emagare rugadu. Ere 200,000,000. Ekodure kuwaru dogebo.

b: Iorudure jiboe ure nono boe eniaure. Mare iorudure nowu kuwaru dogei. Iaboe padure nowu mugure kuwaru kejewuge emorora keje. Rakare nono meriri raka mogadure. Iage ekujagure. Iage ekaworure. Iage ekure. Nou kuwaru doge etaora ure nono adugo doge etaora mogadure. Enogwa pijire joru ure tudawuje, jeredudu ure tudawuje, enxofre urugudu ure tudawuje.
source: Iorudure jiboe ure nono boe eniaure. Mare iorudure nowu kuwaru dogei. Iaboe padure nowu mugure kuwaru kejewuge emorora keje. Rakare nono meriri raka mogadure. Iage ekujagure. Iage ekaworure. Iage ekure. Nou kuwaru doge etaora ure nono adugo doge etaora mogadure. Enogwa pijire joru ure tudawuje, jeredudu ure tudawuje, enxofre urugudu ure tudawuje.

b: Ere bitowuge emagare moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Nou jeredudu, nowu joru, nowu enxofre urugudu ere tudawuje nowu kuwaru doge enogwa piji tuwo boe ewido.
source: Ere bitowuge emagare moto jamedu boe parugajeje. Nou jeredudu, nowu joru, nowu enxofre urugudu ere tudawuje nowu kuwaru doge enogwa piji tuwo boe ewido.

b: Nou kuwaru doge epegare rugadu nowu togwa tabo. Nou eto pegare jamedu. Eto ere nono awagure rugadu. Nou awage ere boe etogorido jamedu.
source: Nou kuwaru doge epegare rugadu nowu togwa tabo. Nou eto pegare jamedu. Eto ere nono awagure rugadu. Nou awage ere boe etogorido jamedu.

b: Mare nowu bikarewu boe emearutorukare raga Pao Kurirewu ji. Ere tubu jodo kimo ture towuboe egorai tumago pemegawo ei. Ekare tugera ra piji. Ere tubu jodo kimo bope doge egorai tumago pemegawo bope dogei. Ere tubu jodo kimo tuwai tadawu santo doge egorai tumago pemegawo ei. Ere nowu tuwai tadawu santo doge etowuje tori kuieje tabo, prata tabo, meriri tabo, tori tabo, ira tabo. Nou ewai tadawu santo doge eku remawu bokware, emearudu bokware, emeru bokware.
source: Mare nowu bikarewu boe emearutorukare raga Pao Kurirewu ji. Ere tubu jodo kimo ture towuboe egorai tumago pemegawo ei. Ekare tugera ra piji. Ere tubu jodo kimo bope doge egorai tumago pemegawo bope dogei. Ere tubu jodo kimo tuwai tadawu santo doge egorai tumago pemegawo ei. Ere nowu tuwai tadawu santo doge etowuje tori kuieje tabo, prata tabo, meriri tabo, tori tabo, ira tabo. Nou ewai tadawu santo doge eku remawu bokware, emearudu bokware, emeru bokware.

b: Nou bikarewu boe ekare tugera ra tumode boe ewido dupiji. Ekare tugera ra to jorubo pegarewu piji. Ekare tugera ra tieribarire tumugukare apowugei dupiji. Ekare tugera ra tugiwogu piji jamedu.
source: Nou bikarewu boe ekare tugera ra tumode boe ewido dupiji. Ekare tugera ra to jorubo pegarewu piji. Ekare tugera ra tieribarire tumugukare apowugei dupiji. Ekare tugera ra tugiwogu piji jamedu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Utugare Baru Tadawu Iedure Bapera Biagarewuji
source: Pao Kurirewu Utugare Baru Tadawu Iedure Bapera Biagarewuji

b: Nono iorudure ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu rakarewuji. Ure turawuje baru piji. Ia boetugu ure taiado nowu baru tadawu apo. Ia jure ure taiado nowu baru tadawu aora tabo. Je ure nono meri joku mogadure. Pogora ure nono joru mogadure.
source: Nono iorudure ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu rakarewuji. Ure turawuje baru piji. Ia boetugu ure taiado nowu baru tadawu apo. Ia jure ure taiado nowu baru tadawu aora tabo. Je ure nono meri joku mogadure. Pogora ure nono joru mogadure.

b: Ia bapera biagarewu padure iera keje. Nou bapera jadodure. Ure ia tuwure bu pobo maerewu aogeje. Ure tuwure bu boeki keje.
source: Ia bapera biagarewu padure iera keje. Nou bapera jadodure. Ure ia tuwure bu pobo maerewu aogeje. Ure tuwure bu boeki keje.

b: Kudugodure nono adugo doge ego mogadure tago tabo. Kudugodure dukeje boeiarurugodure. Nou boeiaruru doge enodo padure sete.
source: Kudugodure nono adugo doge ego mogadure tago tabo. Kudugodure dukeje boeiarurugodure. Nou boeiaruru doge enodo padure sete.

b: Emagore tuwadaru ji dukeje iago nowu ewadaru bu bapera keje. Mare ia boe makore iwagai baru piji. Akore akaba nowu amearudure jiwu boeiaruru bataru bu bapera keje boe eruduwakawo nowu bataru ji. Dukodire ikare nowu boeiaruru makore jiboe bu bapera keje.
source: Emagore tuwadaru ji dukeje iago nowu ewadaru bu bapera keje. Mare ia boe makore iwagai baru piji. Akore akaba nowu amearudure jiwu boeiaruru bataru bu bapera keje boe eruduwakawo nowu bataru ji. Dukodire ikare nowu boeiaruru makore jiboe bu bapera keje.

b: Nono iorudu kimore nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu rakarewuji. Ia bure padu kimore nowu pobo maerewu aogeje. Ia bure padu kimore boeki keje. Nono ure tugera raido baru to.
source: Nono iorudu kimore nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu rakarewuji. Ia bure padu kimore nowu pobo maerewu aogeje. Ia bure padu kimore boeki keje. Nono ure tugera raido baru to.

b: Nono akore Ca Pao Kurirewu pagamodukare pai pugeje. Umode ture boe ewie marigudu jiboe jetudo pudui kuri aino. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu readodure boe eruduwakare jiwu turoji mearutorure puduiwuge ewiagai, makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ewiagai. Kuri aino ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu umode togwa tugu to tapira ukigato pugeje. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode tuwadaru jetudo pudui rugadu. Umode nowu turo towuje rugadu. Pao Kurirewu akedumodukare, bimodukare. Ema ure baru to, ure moto to, ure pobo maerewu to. Pao Kurirewu ure boe jamedu boe towuje rugadu. Emare joruduware awu iwadaru ure turugadu duji. Ainore nowu pobo maerewu kejewu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu akore.
source: Nono akore Ca Pao Kurirewu pagamodukare pai pugeje. Umode ture boe ewie marigudu jiboe jetudo pudui kuri aino. Marigudu Pao Kurirewu readodure boe eruduwakare jiwu turoji mearutorure puduiwuge ewiagai, makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwuge ewiagai. Kuri aino ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu umode togwa tugu to tapira ukigato pugeje. Dukeje Pao Kurirewu umode tuwadaru jetudo pudui rugadu. Umode nowu turo towuje rugadu. Pao Kurirewu akedumodukare, bimodukare. Ema ure baru to, ure moto to, ure pobo maerewu to. Pao Kurirewu ure boe jamedu boe towuje rugadu. Emare joruduware awu iwadaru ure turugadu duji. Ainore nowu pobo maerewu kejewu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu akore.

b: Dukeje care nowu baru pijiwu makore i pugeje. Akore toro. Akeragu nowu jadodurewu bapera roguji. Akeragu ji Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu piji. Emare rakojere pobo maerewu keje boeki keje.
source: Dukeje care nowu baru pijiwu makore i pugeje. Akore toro. Akeragu nowu jadodurewu bapera roguji. Akeragu ji Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu piji. Emare rakojere pobo maerewu keje boeki keje.

b: Nono iture toro nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ae. Imagore ji nowu baperarogu bagai. Ema makore i. Akore akeragu ji. Akwagedo ji. Betumode mare akuri tada pagodumode.
source: Nono iture toro nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ae. Imagore ji nowu baperarogu bagai. Ema makore i. Akore akeragu ji. Akwagedo ji. Betumode mare akuri tada pagodumode.

b: Care ire ikeragu nowu bapera roguji. Ire kowuje. Nono beture rugadu nono meawe ewedu mogadure. Mare ikuri tada ca pagodure.
source: Care ire ikeragu nowu bapera roguji. Ire kowuje. Nono beture rugadu nono meawe ewedu mogadure. Mare ikuri tada ca pagodure.

b: Nono emagore i pugeje. egore Pao Kurirewu unure awie nuba turomode boe eimijeragei, nuba turomode boei, nuba turomode boe eiamedu boe ji moto parugajeje. Amagodo awu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai.
source: Nono emagore i pugeje. egore Pao Kurirewu unure awie nuba turomode boe eimijeragei, nuba turomode boei, nuba turomode boe eiamedu boe ji moto parugajeje. Amagodo awu Pao Kurirewu bataru ji boe ewiagai.

b: Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataru Jiwuge Ere Pobe Tumago Tabo Boe Ewiagai
source: Makore Pao Kurirewu Bataru Jiwuge Ere Pobe Tumago Tabo Boe Ewiagai

b: Ere ia ipo maku inai. Nou ipo ure nono ia boe iwara mogadure. Nono Pao Kurirewu makore i. Akore atudo toro Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Nou ipo tabore amode nowu iwai remagu. Nou ipo tabore amode nowu boe ere tapira kowu kejewu turo pegarewu mori cewu kamo remagu. Nono amode mearudu kurire iwuge eremagu nowu iwai tada aruduwawo nuba nowu ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo iwugeire nono nowu bai ja tada.
source: Ere ia ipo maku inai. Nou ipo ure nono ia boe iwara mogadure. Nono Pao Kurirewu makore i. Akore atudo toro Pao Kurirewu uwai ka. Nou ipo tabore amode nowu iwai remagu. Nou ipo tabore amode nowu boe ere tapira kowu kejewu turo pegarewu mori cewu kamo remagu. Nono amode mearudu kurire iwuge eremagu nowu iwai tada aruduwawo nuba nowu ere tubu jodo tumago pemegawo iwugeire nono nowu bai ja tada.

b: Mare akaba iwai kejewu iogora remagu ire maku boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe etai kodi. Nou boe tuginaiwuge emode boe pegado Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewu boe dogei. Iwai rakojere nowu ba kurirewu keje. Emode pegado kejewu ari oto padumode quarenta e dois.
source: Mare akaba iwai kejewu iogora remagu ire maku boe tuginaiwuge eiamedu boe etai kodi. Nou boe tuginaiwuge emode boe pegado Jerusalém ba kurirewu kejewu boe dogei. Iwai rakojere nowu ba kurirewu keje. Emode pegado kejewu ari oto padumode quarenta e dois.

b: Imode itugarege ere pobedu doge etudo boe etae. Makore iwadaru jiwuge unure emage. Readodure imearudaere jiboe irore jiboe jiwugenure emage. Ekudau areia pegarewu tabore eromode aino. Emagomode iwadaru ji boe ewiagai. Emagore kejewu meri oto padumode 1,260. Ainore Pao Kurirewu makore i.
source: Imode itugarege ere pobedu doge etudo boe etae. Makore iwadaru jiwuge unure emage. Readodure imearudaere jiboe irore jiboe jiwugenure emage. Ekudau areia pegarewu tabore eromode aino. Emagomode iwadaru ji boe ewiagai. Emagore kejewu meri oto padumode 1,260. Ainore Pao Kurirewu makore i.

b: Boe eiamedu boe eimijeranure Pao Kurirewuce rugadu. Ia i dogere pobe Pao Kurirewu apo. Nou i iere Oliveira. Ia jorugu doge ere pobe eragojere Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Mare Oliveira i ji karega inagoino. Jorugu ji karega inagoino. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu ime pobedu dogeire inagoino.
source: Boe eiamedu boe eimijeranure Pao Kurirewuce rugadu. Ia i dogere pobe Pao Kurirewu apo. Nou i iere Oliveira. Ia jorugu doge ere pobe eragojere Pao Kurirewu apo jamedu. Mare Oliveira i ji karega inagoino. Jorugu ji karega inagoino. Nou makore Pao Kurirewu bataru jiwu ime pobedu dogeire inagoino.

b: Boe etaidumode tuwo nowu ime pobedu doge etogorido mare emodukare etogorido. Joru umode tudawuje nowu ime pobedu doge enogwa piji. Nou joru tabore nowu ime pobedu doge emode nowu boe ewido.
source: Boe etaidumode tuwo nowu ime pobedu doge etogorido mare emodukare etogorido. Joru umode tudawuje nowu ime pobedu doge enogwa piji. Nou joru tabore nowu ime pobedu doge emode nowu boe ewido.

b: Emagomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare nowu ime pobedu doge eragamode tuwo bubutu akedudo jamedu. Eragamode tuwo pobodo nono boe eku mogadure. Emagomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare eragamode tuwo jorubo pegarewu jamedu boe barigu moto ka jamedu taidure jiwu meri keje rugadu.
source: Emagomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare nowu ime pobedu doge eragamode tuwo bubutu akedudo jamedu. Eragamode tuwo pobodo nono boe eku mogadure. Emagomode Pao Kurirewu bataru ji mare eragamode tuwo jorubo pegarewu jamedu boe barigu moto ka jamedu taidure jiwu meri keje rugadu.

b: Nono emode tuwadaru akedudo dukeje ia barogo pegarewu umode tudawuje nowu moto poro kurirewu piji turugoduwo nowu ime pobedu dogei. Nou barogo pegarewu rakamode ei, umode ewido.
source: Nono emode tuwadaru akedudo dukeje ia barogo pegarewu umode tudawuje nowu moto poro kurirewu piji turugoduwo nowu ime pobedu dogei. Nou barogo pegarewu rakamode ei, umode ewido.

b: Dukeje umode nowu ime pobedu doge ewu Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada awara kajeje. Nou Jerusalém kejewu boe ere Jesus bito marigudu. Nou Jerusalém kejewu boe ero pegamode nono Sodoma kejewu boe ero pegare dumogadure. Ero pegamode nono Egito kejewuge ero pegare dumogadure.
source: Dukeje umode nowu ime pobedu doge ewu Jerusalém ba kurirewu tada awara kajeje. Nou Jerusalém kejewu boe ere Jesus bito marigudu. Nou Jerusalém kejewu boe ero pegamode nono Sodoma kejewu boe ero pegare dumogadure. Ero pegamode nono Egito kejewuge ero pegare dumogadure.

b: Nou birewuge ime pobedu doge ere boe pegado ro pegarewuge ji. Mare ewire dukeje nowu ro pegarewuge emaga kimore. Dukodire care boe doge eiamedu boe etaregodure moto jamedu boe piji. Nono nowu boe etaiwo raire nowu ime birewuge ji. Merire pobe metia bokware ei taiwo tabo nowu birewu imei. Nono meri aregodure pagaia ka pugeje etaiwo kimore nowu pobedu doge birewugei dutabo. Mare boe emodukare nowu birewuge ime etugu mototo rugadu.

Nono nowu boe etaiwo raire nowu ime birewuge ji. Merire pobe metia bokware ei taiwo tabo nowu birewu imei. Nono meri aregodure pagaia ka pugeje etaiwo kimore nowu pobedu doge birewugei dutabo. Mare boe emodukare nowu birewuge ime etugu mototo rugadu.

b: Moto jamedu boe pijiwu boe egaremode pudui nowu ime ewire kodi. Ewadumode ewi keje. Emode iaboe pemegarewu maku puai nowu ime ewire kodi. Egaremode turo pegarewu ji rugadu.
source: Moto jamedu boe pijiwu boe egaremode pudui nowu ime ewire kodi. Ewadumode ewi keje. Emode iaboe pemegarewu maku puai nowu ime ewire kodi. Egaremode turo pegarewu ji rugadu.

b: Merire pobe metia bokware dukeje meri aregodure pagaia ka pugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure togwamu nowu ime enogwato. Dukodire ime birewuge pobedu doge eewodure pugeje. Ere turagojedo. Jorudure eiwuge epagudugodure ece rugadu.
source: Merire pobe metia bokware dukeje meri aregodure pagaia ka pugeje dukeje Pao Kurirewu ure togwamu nowu ime enogwato. Dukodire ime birewuge pobedu doge eewodure pugeje. Ere turagojedo. Jorudure eiwuge epagudugodure ece rugadu.

b: Mearutorure Cordeiro Jesus Jiwuge Ero Reo

b: Dukejere iorudure ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure turawuje baru piji. Pao Kurirewu ure turaga maku ai rugadu tuwo boe erore jiboe udo nono tumearudae mogadure. Urugure dukodire ure moto urugudo.

b: Mako pemegare boe eiamedu boe emearuduwo. Akore ba kurirewu Babilônia akedure rugadu! Aino bope doge edure nowu ba kurirewu tada. Kiebarege pegarewuge emugumode nono.

Dukodire nowu mearutorukare Jesus jiwuge ewarigudure joru maerewuto emearutorukare Jesus ji kodi. Nono Pao Kurirewu ure boe pegarewuboe rugadu boe barigu nowu joru maerewuto akeduwo rugadu. Nono boe ewimodukare pugeje. Pao Kurirewu ure bope doge eda barigu joru maerewuto jamedu. Birewuge eda boigoduwunure nowu joru maerewuce. Awu birewuge eda boigoduwu akedumodukare jii toro rugadu.

b: Pao Kurirewu Umode Baru Maiwu To Moto Maiwu To Jamedu

b: Nono iorudure ia baru maiwuji. Iorudure ia moto maiwuji jamedu. Baru boeto jiwu akedure. Moto boeto jiwu akedure jamedu. Pobo maerewu akedure jamedu.
source: Nono iorudure ia baru maiwuji. Iorudure ia moto maiwuji jamedu. Baru boeto jiwu akedure. Moto boeto jiwu akedure jamedu. Pobo maerewu akedure jamedu.

b: Nono iorudure nowu Pao Kurirewu rakojere tadawu ba kurirewu maiwuji. Iere Jerusalém Maiwu. Nou ba kurirewu ure turawuje nowu baru maiwu piji, Pao Kurirewu piji. Pao Kurirewu ure nowu ba kurirewu to. Ure udo turugadu. Nou ba kurirewu aregodure nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge etae nono ia okogerewudo aredu aregodumode tugudau areia moturewu tabo dumogadure. Mare aredu ji karega inagoino. Nou baru pijiwu ba kurirewu kurire, moture. Dujire inagoino.

b: Nono imearudure ia boe mako ji nowu boe eimijera muga ira piji. Akore ca Pao Kurirewu mugumode boebo. Mugumode boebo dukodire utugarege mode emage. Pao Kurirewu rakojemode boebo. Emearutorumode ji rugadu.
source: Nono imearudure ia boe mako ji nowu boe eimijera muga ira piji. Akore ca Pao Kurirewu mugumode boebo. Mugumode boebo dukodire utugarege mode emage. Pao Kurirewu rakojemode boebo. Emearutorumode ji rugadu.

b: Umode eioguru kabi eku piji. Boe ewimodukare pugeje. Boe ekiarigodumodukare pugeje. Boe etragudumodukare pugeje. Boe ewiri korimodukare pugeje. Awu boe pegareboe jamedu boe akedu.

b: Nono Boe Eimijera Kurirewu akore Ca! Ire boe jamedu boe maiwudo. Dukeje makore i jamedu. Akore iwadaru bu bapera keje boe emearutoruwo awu iwadaru ji. Awu iwadaru jetumode pudui rugadu. Boe jokodu jire inagoino rugadu.
source: Nono Boe Eimijera Kurirewu akore Ca! Ire boe jamedu boe maiwudo. Dukeje makore i jamedu. Akore iwadaru bu bapera keje boe emearutoruwo awu iwadaru ji. Awu iwadaru jetumode pudui rugadu. Boe jokodu jire inagoino rugadu.

b: Nono Boe Eimijera Kurirewu mako kimore: – Urugadurewu! Ire iado. Boetojiwunure imi. Boigoduwunure imi jamedu. Ire boeto jiboe to. Ire boe jamedu boe iado. Imode pobo boeire jiwuge ekududo ino poboce mare emodukare morido. Kudumode ino pobo cewu bimodukare rugadu.
source: Nono Boe Eimijera Kurirewu mako kimore: – Urugadurewu! Ire iado. Boetojiwunure imi. Boigoduwunure imi jamedu. Ire boeto jiboe to. Ire boe jamedu boe iado. Imode pobo boeire jiwuge ekududo ino poboce mare emodukare morido. Kudumode ino pobo cewu bimodukare rugadu.

b: Ukare tugera ra ipijiwuge itoremode emage. Emearutorumode i rugadu. Etuo kurirewu mode imi rugadu.

b: Mare pogurure tumearutorukawo iwuge ewarigudumode joru maerewuto. Mearutoru bokware iwuge ewarigudumode joru maerewuto jamedu. Ro pegarewuge ewarigudumode joru maerewuto. Ure boe ewidowuge ewarigudumode joru maerewuto jamedu. Jeribarire tumugukare apowuge eiwuge ewarigudumode joru maerewuto jamedu. Ure jorubo kuru pegarewu towujewuge ewarigudumode joru maerewuto jamedu. Mearutorure tuwai tadawu santo doge eiwuge ewarigudumode joru maerewuto. Batrarodurewuge ewarigudumode joru maerewuto jamedu. Awuge eiamedu boe ewarigudumode joru maerewuto, enxofre urugudu maerewuto jamedu. Eragojemode nono du akedumodukare rugadu.

b: Jerusalém Ba Kurirewu Maiwu Reo

b: Nono ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure itae pugeje. Cewu ure pori tadaboe redo moto kejewunure ema. Du emare aregodure pugeje. Makore i. Akore mato. Iwo arududo Cordeiro Jesus oredujeji.
source: Nono ia Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu aregodure itae pugeje. Cewu ure pori tadaboe redo moto kejewunure ema. Du emare aregodure pugeje. Makore i. Akore mato. Iwo arududo Cordeiro Jesus oredujeji.

b: Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tugeragu i. Nono nowu baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu utugare ure irego ia tori kurirewu ao ka. Ure iorududo Jerusalém ba kurirewuji. Ure turawuje baru piji. Pao Kurirewu rakojere nowu ba kurirewu tada.
source: Dukeje Pao Kurirewu Uwari ure tugeragu i. Nono nowu baru tadawu Pao Kurirewu utugare ure irego ia tori kurirewu ao ka. Ure iorududo Jerusalém ba kurirewuji. Ure turawuje baru piji. Pao Kurirewu rakojere nowu ba kurirewu tada.

b: Dukodire nowu ba kurirewu jorugure Pao Kurirewu jorugu pemegarewu tabo. Moture nono ia tori motu mogadure. Kaworure nono ia tori kaworurewu dumogadure. Ure nono meriri kuru mogadure jamedu.
source: Dukodire nowu ba kurirewu jorugure Pao Kurirewu jorugu pemegarewu tabo. Moture nono ia tori motu mogadure. Kaworure nono ia tori kaworurewu dumogadure. Ure nono meriri kuru mogadure jamedu.

b: Nono ia moto ri padure nowu ba kurirewu kujegajeje. Nou moto ri baiporo enodo padu kejewure doze. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge enodo padu kejewure doze jamedu. Eeture nowu moto ri baiporo dogei. Nou Israel doge etumana mage mariguduwuge enodo padu kejewure doze jamedu. Du ekie padure tu tu nowu moto ri baiporo doge ewugeje.
source: Nono ia moto ri padure nowu ba kurirewu kujegajeje. Nou moto ri baiporo enodo padu kejewure doze. Pao Kurirewu utugarege baru tadawuge enodo padu kejewure doze jamedu. b: Meri rutu jagwai nowu moto ri baiporo dogere pobe metia bokware. Meri butu jagwai moto ri baiporo dogere pobe metia bokware jamedu. Norte jagwai nowu moto ri baiporo dogere pobe metia bokware jamedu. Sul jagwai nowu moto ri baiporo dogere pobe metia bokware jamedu.
source: Meri rutu jagwai nowu moto ri baiporo dogere pobe metia bokware. Meri butu jagwai moto ri baiporo dogere pobe metia bokware jamedu. Norte jagwai nowu moto ri baiporo dogere pobe metia bokware jamedu. Sul jagwai nowu moto ri baiporo dogere pobe metia bokware jamedu.

b: Nou moto ri todure aogejewu tori doge enodo padu kejewure doze. Du aiare nowu ba kurirewu tabo jamedu. Nou tori ewugejere nowu uture Cordeiro Jesus bataru tabowuge ekie padure. Enodo padu kejewure doze jamedu.
source: Nou moto ri todure aogejewu tori doge enodo padu kejewure doze. Du aiare nowu ba kurirewu tabo jamedu. Nou tori ewugejere nowu uture Cordeiro Jesus bataru tabowuge ekie padure. Enodo padu kejewure doze jamedu.

b: Ia makore iwu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu iedure ia ipoji. Nou ipo ure nono ia boe iwara mogadure. Nou ipo tabore umode nowu ba kurirewu remagu. Ere tori kuiejedo nowu ipoce.
source: Ia makore iwu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu iedure ia ipoji. Nou ipo ure nono ia boe iwara mogadure. Nou ipo tabore umode nowu ba kurirewu remagu. Ere tori kuiejedo nowu ipoce.

b: Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure nowu ba kurirewu remagu nowu ipo tabo. Raire 2,200 quilômetros. Barire 2,200 quilômetros jamedu. Ricore 2,200 quilômetros jamedu. Ricore, raire, barire nono pureore rugadu.
source: Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure nowu ba kurirewu remagu nowu ipo tabo. Raire 2,200 quilômetros. Barire 2,200 quilômetros jamedu. Ricore 2,200 quilômetros jamedu. Ricore, raire, barire nono pureore rugadu.

b: Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure nowu moto ri remagu. Ricoredu oto padu kejewure 64 metros.
source: Nono nowu Pao Kurirewu utugare baru tadawu ure nowu moto ri remagu. Ricoredu oto padu kejewure 64 metros.

b: Nou moto ri towujedure tori kaworurewu tabo. Nou ba kurirewu towujedure tori kuieje pemegarewu tabo. Nou tori kuieje kigadure nono meriri kuru kigadu mogadure.
source: Nou moto ri towujedure tori kaworurewu tabo. Nou ba kurirewu towujedure tori kuieje pemegarewu tabo. Nou tori kuieje kigadure nono meriri kuru kigadu mogadure.

b: Tori moturewuge epadure nowu moto ri parugajeje. Ia tori kaworure nono korao bo mogadure. Ia tori kaworure nono ia kudoro bo mogadure. Ia tori kujagure nono nabure bo mogadure. Ia tori kaworure nono kido bo kaworu mogadure.
source: Tori moturewuge epadure nowu moto ri parugajeje. Ia tori kaworure nono korao bo mogadure. Ia tori kaworure nono ia kudoro bo mogadure. Ia tori kujagure nono nabure bo mogadure. Ia tori kaworure nono kido bo kaworu mogadure.

b: Ia tori atugore nono orari atugo mogadure. Ia tori kujagure nono aigo bu kujagu mogadure. Ia tori ekure nono ciwabo oiaga eku mogadure. Ia tori kaworure nono keakorogo bo kaworu mogadure. Ia tori ekure nono kuido bo eku mogadure. Ia tori kigadurewu atugo kujagure. Ia tori kaworure nono kuido kaworu mogadure atugo ekurewu tabo. Ia tori kujagure nono tadari kujagu mogadure.

b: Nou moto ri baiporo doge enodo padu kejewure doze. Etowujedure tori tuginaiwu pérola tabo. Tori tuginaiwu pérola doge enodo padu kejewure doze. Dutabore nowu moto ri baiporo doge etowujedure nowu tori tuginaiwu tabo. Nou ba kurirewu tadawu awara towujedure tori kuieje tabo. Nou tori kuieje kigadure nono meriri kuru kigadu mogadure pemegare rugadu kodi.
source: Nou moto ri baiporo doge enodo padu kejewure doze. Etowujedure tori tuginaiwu pérola tabo. Tori tuginaiwu pérola doge enodo padu kejewure doze. b: Pao Kurirewu rakojere nowu ba kurirewu oiadada Cordeiro Jesus apo. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu uwai bokware nowu ba kurirewu tada. Kodire boe etumode kuri Pao Kurirewu ae, Cordeiro Jesus ae jamedu.
source: Pao Kurirewu rakojere nowu ba kurirewu oiadada Cordeiro Jesus apo. Dukodire Pao Kurirewu uwai bokware nowu ba kurirewu tada. Kodire boe etumode kuri Pao Kurirewu ae, Cordeiro Jesus ae jamedu.

b: Merikare, arikare uruguwo nowu ba kurirewuji. Pao Kurirewu pijire jorugu pemegarewu ure tudawuje. Urugure nowu ba kurirewuji. Cordeiro Jesus pijire jorugu pemegarewu ure tudawuje. Urugure nowu ba kurirewu tada jamedu.
source: Merikare, arikare uruguwo nowu ba kurirewuji. Pao Kurirewu pijire jorugu pemegarewu ure tudawuje. Urugure nowu ba kurirewuji. Cordeiro Jesus pijire jorugu pemegarewu ure tudawuje. Urugure nowu ba kurirewu tada jamedu.

b: Erugure boe eiamedu boe eruduwo boe emeruwo. Boe eimijera kurirewuge eiamedu boe etaregodumode nowu ba kurirewuto tuwo Pao Kurirewu ie kurido.
source: Erugure boe eiamedu boe eruduwo boe emeruwo. Boe eimijera kurirewuge eiamedu boe etaregodumode nowu ba kurirewuto tuwo Pao Kurirewu ie kurido.

b: Nou ba kurirewu umodukare to baiporo mi. Boecodumodukare dukodire nowu moto ri baiporo doge emidodumodukare pugeje.
source: Nou ba kurirewu umodukare to baiporo mi. Boecodumodukare dukodire nowu moto ri baiporo doge emidodumodukare pugeje.

b: Boe eiamedu boe emode toe kurirewu reko nowu ba kurirewu ka tuwo toe jeto nowu ba kurirewu tada.
source: Boe eiamedu boe emode toe kurirewu reko nowu ba kurirewu ka tuwo toe jeto nowu ba kurirewu tada.

b: Ia boe pegarewu umodukare nowu ba kurirewu tada. Ia ro pegarewu umodukare turemo nowu ba kurirewuto. Ia batrarodurewu umodukare turemo nowu ba kurirewuto. Tu nowu mearutorure Jesus jiwuge emode turemo nowu ba kurirewuto. Pao Kurirewu ure ekie bu nowu bimodukarewuge ekie padure kejewu bapera keje marigudu.
source: Ia boe pegarewu umodukare nowu ba kurirewu tada. Ia ro pegarewu umodukare turemo nowu ba kurirewuto. Ia batrarodurewu umodukare turemo nowu ba kurirewuto.
